rows.name: Meowmunitions Prologue
rows.short_description: This game gives you a roguelike bullet hell experience where you play as a cat whose eggs were stolen by the birds. Do your best to retrieve the eggs by Picking up Crafting components to Customize your own gun, and Shoot down the birds.
rows.description_html: This game gives you a roguelike bullet hell experience where you play as a cat whose eggs were stolen by the birds. Do your best to retrieve the eggs by Picking up Random Crafting components to Customize your gun, and Shoot down the evil birds. Travel through a constantly changing forest, desert, mountain, and volcano to get to a crystal cave full of ancient runes and discover the mystery behind the deeds of the birds. the map is procedurally generated every time you play, giving you a fresh and exciting experience each time. While traveling to retrieve your egg, you are bound to face various birds, from ostrich to penguins and even mythical birds you've never seen before. And at the end of each biome, you have to face the ultimate challenge like the evil mage bird, the king of the sand, or even a big fat owl! Discover and unlock various crafting components that let you customize your gun in every way you like. You can make it a machine gun that fires bubbles, a giant cannon that fires snowballs that also burn and freeze your enemy just because you like to make it that way, or maybe even something as silly as a rainbow laser. It is all up to you to decide how your gun works. If you feel a little lonely traveling alone through the unknown world, you can invite your friends to come over and help you, whether online or local!

rows.name: Don't Wake God
rows.short_description: Take on the role of Tieface - a dream figment, whose goal is to prevent his dreamer from waking up - if he wakes up, you die! Acquire abilities, outsmart your enemies, and most importantly... Don't Wake God.
rows.description_html: Don't Wake God is a short 1 hour Roguelite/Survival/Stealth game, with replay value. Key features: - Discover 80 unique objects and creatures, each with their own story and secrets. - Master 21 abilities, choosing which 4 to acquire in each playthrough. - Complete your collection with info on each object, and enjoy endless replay value with randomized elements. - Explore the dreamlike world with stunning, handcrafted watercolor art. - Continue the adventure with the Endless Dream Mode after completing the main game. About the game: You play as Tieface, a character who exists only within the dreams of The Man. Your goal is to prevent The Man from waking up, as Tieface will die if he does. The game is made up of 15 levels, each representing a different dream. As you navigate through the dream world, you must avoid being seen by The Man and manipulate objects and creatures around you to keep the dream looking normal and mundane. However, be prepared for the unexpected, as strange and surreal monsters may appear at any moment. The game is made with hand-painted watercolor artwork by solo game developer Alex Klexber. It is a top-down roguelite game with special abilities, objects and creatures collection, and vibrant, psychedelic art. Don't Wake God is a unique and challenging game that will keep you on your toes as you try to keep The Man asleep and Tieface alive.

rows.name: Soundscape XR: 2024
rows.short_description: Exploratory musical metaverse hybrid reality warp world.
rows.description_html: The Soundscape journey began in 2014 with the creation of hyper-immersive virtual spaces to enjoy the music that moves you; in VR and on PC. A decade later, we're opening the doors to a freeform, cutting-edge hybrid reality, powered by the latest technologies like UE5 and Lumen.   Soundscape is about exploring new connections within music & visual arts. We're in the teleportation business empowering individuals with tools to connect and flow from anywhere. The collective of artists behind the project have made the incredible choice of offering Soundscape as a gift.  Experience the magic from their fingertips to your mind. - Take flight and explore worlds brought to life by music, Sonic AI powers a unique experience every time. - Customize your Soundskin avatar and dance into another dimension to meet up with friends and fans in an artistic musical metaverse experience. - Bring the music you love, or get lost in sound within audiovisual experiments and collaborations with artists like Deadmau5, Goose, Slash, FISHER, and Chris Lake. - Crossplay between PC & VR, both unique experiences working together in harmony to enhance your own.  Soundscape XR: 2024 supports all major legacy HMDs and motion controllers from 2014-2025.  For those looking to experience our most advanced features, including new native Steam Frame support, you'll want to purchase Soundscape 2026.  For ten years, our collective of artists have been putting their love into building the purest virtual destination for the enjoyment of music with no ads, no data tracking, no microtransactions, no DRM, and no corporate BS. Its our honor and privilege to share with you our art and creations. It's taken a lot to build this into something that we've dreamed about, and we're so grateful for your support. Join us on our journey to an advanced audiovisual future.

rows.name: King of Light
rows.short_description: 这是一部描绘战争与权谋的奇幻史诗——古老的魔法帝国因贵族叛乱而分崩离析，一位无法使用魔法的王子成为了这个国家最后的希望。你将扮演王子洛林，在「战役」中运筹决胜，在「推理」中破解迷局，在乱世中走出一条用善良与智慧铸就的王者之道。
rows.description_html: 剧情简介 帝国——作为神秘与魔法起源地的君主制大国，因为一场由贵族发起的叛乱而面临分裂的危机。 短时间内，国王去世、王位继承人相继遭到暗害……就在人们以为帝国的历史即将宣告终结之时，一支名为“光明军”的势力出现了。这支由王子洛林带领的军队，打出“光复王权”的旗号，向叛军发起挑战，决心将濒临崩溃的帝国重新统一。 我们的故事，将从洛林和他的光明军开始讲起。 玩法简介 《光明王传说》是单人独立创作的 策略推理剧情向RPG游戏 ，游戏内容分为“战役”与“推理”两部分。 “战役”类似回合制战棋，需要玩家在了解规则的基础上选择最为合适的行动策略，通常以击退敌方将领为胜利条件。 “推理”类似逆转裁判，需要玩家选择合适的线索来解答现有的疑问，最后推理出事件的真相或找出解决问题的方法。 游戏难度较低， 全程只做选择题 （游戏攻略在手册中）。

rows.name: Baalzebub
rows.short_description: A turn-based infernal dungeon crawler.
rows.description_html: You do not remember how this happened or who you are. All of a sudden you found yourself in Hell and you want to get out. The only way seems to lead through the 14 levels of Hell. Each level except for the first one is ruled by a boss holding the exit portal key. Since you are in Hell, the level bosses happen to be the Hell's most important fallen angels such as Lucifer, Mammon, Dantalion, Furcas, Zagan, Belphegor or Asmodeus. They are very strong, yet each of them possess a vulnerability you might want to discover. Make your way out through all of the levels of randomly generated infernal dungeon, get the keys, food, weapons and other items from dead monsters, overcome bosses and escape that horror! Try to beat the high score in the global Hall of Fame. This is a survival turn-based dungeon crawler game resembling the rogue-like classics from decades ago. Game controls Use arrow keys, WASD keys or a game controller to move your hero and attack nearby enemy creatures. Click locations to set spell cast target or to shoot arrows (with a bow equipped and some arrows in your backpack). You can equip armor items to your hero's body. The equipped items wear when used. The backpack weight does matter. It affects the stamina and health params significantly. Make sure you watch the health and stamina all the time, because with zero health your hero will die forever. When entering a new level (also the first level), some items are hidden by default. This is especially true for the level map and the exit portal. You need to find the red scroll to uncover the hidden properties of the level. Such a scroll is unique and it is in possession of a random opponent. Game features Permadeath (if your character dies, the game is over) Turn-based gameplay with an intuitive interface Procedural level generation Limited inventory where the weight matters a lot Hidden items and traps You must hunt for food to survive More than a hundred of different creatures Enemies can steal your inventory items Attack and shooting accuracy based on weapon condition and luck Weapon wear and repair Stamina, mana and health recover by using potions, scrolls and food only Retro styling with a smooth camera movement No tutorials, no guides, no hand-holding Your global rank is shown throughout the game Game progress is saved automatically and also manually - from the menu.

rows.name: Offroad Mechanic Simulator: Prologue - First Job
rows.short_description: Start your career in servicing off-road vehicles in the free Prologue for Offroad Mechanic Simulator. Repair, modify, and upgrade three different cars. Use professional tools, parts from the shop, and unlockable perks and skills. Test your work driving through the scenic forest.
rows.description_html: Offroad Mechanic Simulator: Prologue - First Job is a free version of Offroad Mechanic Simulator. With a large slice through the gameplay, it provides a good taste of the full game and a fun experience on its own! If you want to try the full version, check below! Enter the world of off-road vehicles! Have you ever seen an off-road beast of a car and thought that working on this vehicle as a mechanic must be a ton of fun? Offroad Mechanic Simulator provides you with an experience as close as possible to modifying real off-road rides to face immensely rough terrain. Get your very own garage, full of equipment and tools of the trade. Shop for the best parts on the market and mount them to make the cars far exceed their original capabilities. Repair, restore, modify – but mind the budget, you’re on contract after all! However, no work is done without testing it! Jump behind the well and see how your modifications perform against cliffs, deep sand, running rivers, thick mud, and any kind of harsh obstacles you can stumble upon off the beaten path. You might need to bring in some specialized equipment to face some of the hardest tasks! Offroad Mechanic Simulator: Prologue – First Job shows off the definite experience, far evolved from the previous demonstrations. This is a great occasion to discover the game anew and prepare for the full release. Players can enjoy features such as: Improved physics, car models, and handling Entirely new UI Three new cars to dismantle and re-assemble Repair, Washing, Tuning, and Adjustment commissions A new Forest map to conquer New garage rooms, parts, and options New perks and skills Wide access to nearly all skills available in the full game Possibility of achieving up to level 4 of experience

rows.name: Swarm Horror
rows.short_description: Swarm Horror is a survival horror game in which the player must progress while defeating insects. The goal of the game is to escape from the feeding ground of the insects you have wandered into. The insects call their friends to feed on you.
rows.description_html: You wake up in an unknown place. You attempt to escape. As you continue your search, you encounter a swarm of insects. This is their feeding ground. Will you be able to escape? Game Features First-person perspective Explore and solve tricks Use melee weapons to kill insects as you progress. Controls Move with WASD TAB to check your belongings Use the mouse to move the viewpoint and check your belongings. CTRL to crouch SHIFT to run. Play time . About 1-2 hours.

rows.name: Midnight Dash
rows.short_description: Midnight Dash is an difficult 2D platformer. It tells the story about Sean and Piu the light source.
rows.description_html: Story! The game tells you a story about Sean who gets lost from home and tries to find hes way back. While trying to find a way back Sean meets a magical light source Piu who agrees to help you but on one condition.. You help him to find something that he had lost. Help Sean and Piu to reach their goals in this difficult adventure! Cool stuff • A intensive single-player adventure, with a lot of cool characters and difficult levels. • Game of hardcore platforming challenges and amazing secrets. • Brutal Bonus levels that can be accessed from the main menu. Built for the hardcore gamers. • Fun and catchy music. • Inbuilt speedrun timer and death counter. • Local co-op levels. The controls are simple and easy to understand. You can jump, air-dash, slide, attack and even fly! Also Piu will help you light up the path in some levels. Have fun helping Sean and Piu in this difficult adventure!

rows.name: Kill Pill
rows.short_description: All you need to do is kill the pills. Shoot your way to a new high score while collecting powerups to shake things up.
rows.description_html: All you need to do is kill the pills. Shoot your way to a new high score while collecting powerups to shake things up. Kill Pill is a simple arena shooter game where you shoot pills that randomly spawn around the map. There are six types of powerups you can get: speed (red), jump (blue), automatic firing (green), collateral damage (purple), shotgun (orange), and freezing time (white). Two modes are in the game. Classic mode only has red pills which run toward you. Arcade mode has 4 types of pills: red ones, orange ones which split in two when you shoot them, blue ones which jump with you, and green ones which are faster than you. Each kill is one point added to your score. High scores are saved between each session. How high can you go?

rows.name: Shoot! VR
rows.short_description: Shoot! VR is a first-person shooter simulation game using virtual reality. The game simulates the environment of an indoor shooting range. The game has different modes and offers a choice of different weapons.
rows.description_html: Shoot! VR is a first-person shooter simulation game. The game simulates the environment of an indoor shooting range. The game has different modes and offers a choice of different weapons. In time mode, the player tries to get the best score possible within the time limit. Random targets will be generated in the scene. Players must shoot as many targets as possible during the countdown to get a higher score. When the player shoots, there is a virtual sign on the side in front of him/her indicating the score obtained and the time left to remind the player. When the time is up, the player quits the game and the page displays the score. In level mode, the difficulty of the level changes from easy to hard over time. Each level has a preset score and players must achieve a score greater than or equal to the preset score before the countdown ends before entering the next level. As the player progresses through the level, the difficulty becomes higher and higher. The difficulty of the level is determined by the speed at which the target disappears and the score that must be achieved to advance to the next level. If the score obtained by the player before the end of the time is lower than the predefined score, the game is over and the virtual screen (panel) will display the final score obtained by the player. In training mode, players can shoot freely with different weapons. This mode is the default mode when a player enters a scene, i.e. the player does not choose to start a game in time or level mode. Players have no time or score limit, they can shoot freely. Players can also choose the difficulty they want, which means the different time interval between the appearance and disappearance of targets.

When the time is up, the player quits the game and the page displays the score. In level mode, the difficulty of the level changes from easy to hard over time. Each level has a preset score and players must achieve a score greater than or equal to the preset score before the countdown ends before entering the next level. As the player progresses through the level, the difficulty becomes higher and higher. The difficulty of the level is determined by the speed at which the target disappears and the score that must be achieved to advance to the next level. If the score obtained by the player before the end of the time is lower than the predefined score, the game is over and the virtual screen (panel) will display the final score obtained by the player. In training mode, players can shoot freely with different weapons. This mode is the default mode when a player enters a scene, i.e. the player does not choose to start a game in time or level mode. Players have no time or score limit, they can shoot freely. Players can also choose the difficulty they want, which means the different time interval between the appearance and disappearance of targets.

rows.name: Dummy Pirates: Ocean Tales
rows.short_description: From the Planet Chromatica, the first 3D TPS sailing MOBA game! Become the King-of-Dummies by competing and winning in deadly matches, while exploring the wonders of the Ocean Tales.
rows.description_html: To win the team deathmatch, team-up with your friends to compete in a 3v3 multiplayer game. Gold will be awarded for every kill, use it on items to enhance your crew's abilities and powers. Burn your enemies with heatwaves as the Black Flames Crew, infect them with vital viruses as the Germ Pirates Crew, or kill them with acid rain as the Poisonous Grum Crew. Unleash each crew's immersive abilities. Explore the rewards that the powerful curses of the Ocean Tales have to offer and gather them all, chests and potions for all crews to assemble. Earn additional gold by finding and defeating the monsters, but be careful, they bite! Each crew has a dummy captain, customize with the unique props you gather from all your victories. Keep your victories and level up to be worthy of the biggest title of all!

rows.name: Missing Stars
rows.short_description: Missing Stars is a visual novel that aims to depict mental disorders and the people who live with them in a realistic, but sensitive and respectful light.
rows.description_html: Missing Stars is a visual novel that aims to depict mental disorders and the people who live with them in a realistic, but sensitive and respectful light. After an accident that left him traumatized, Erik Wilhelm transfers in to Privatgymnasium St. Dymphna, a special Viennese boarding school for teenagers and young adults struggling with their mental health. There, he meets a colorful cast of characters that will turn his formerly uneventful life upside down. As he settles into his new school, Erik will learn more about mental health and how to best approach it. Somewhere along the way, he might just find companionship, too... Featuring: Five unique routes with fun, endearing characters. With over 230,000 words, that leaves you with about 14 hours of readable content! Original Soundtrack Gallery/Music Room Accessibility Options Steam Achievements This visual novel contains sensitive themes, including fictional depictions of psychological issues and trauma. All characters depicted are the age of 18 or older.

rows.name: Precision
rows.short_description: This is a simple 2d follow the mouse game where you have to get to the end to win! This game can be annoying and hard to get through levels but can be very fun! If you touch anything red you will die.
rows.description_html: This is a 2D simple puzzle game where the player follows the mouse and you cannot touch any obstacles or you will have to restart the level. You will have obstacles in your way to make the levels more difficult like spinners, chasing blocks, disappearing blocks and more. You will collect coins along the way and try to be as precise as possible to get through small passage ways and openings. Being simple to learn, this game is for everyone. Challenge yourself to speed through each level as fast as possible. Try your best to get through them all! More levels will be added with new obstacles for you to have to create new strategies to get around. This game can be very triggering but when you complete a level it feels good!

rows.name: Find the Whales
rows.short_description: Find the Whales is a free-to-play educational game for all ages about ocean conservation. Find marine animals and do conservation quests to help protect them & their habitats!
rows.description_html: Find the Whales is a free-to-play educational game for all ages about ocean conservation. Players travel to simulated places on the globe to find whales, fish, and other marine animals. They also do simulated conservation quests to help the animals. The locations featured are Hawaii and the Mesoamerican Reef. In this 2D side-scroller, players walk, snorkel, and SCUBA dive to find crabs, whales, fish, dolphins and other animals. Quests include planting mangrove seedlings, stopping illegal fishing, slowing down speeding boats, cleaning polluted water, farming seaweed and listening for whales with a hydrophone. Players collect points for finding species. They can also take photos to store in the simulated photo album. Points are used to purchase quest-related tools in the simulated stores at each location. Players also collect information cards. The more times they find the same species, the more information is added to these cards - text, photos and videos about these species.

rows.name: Altered Algorithm
rows.short_description: Altered Algorithm is an action-thriller VR experience blending the craft of film and games in a new way. In this story-driven game set in a futuristic 1983 LA, your playground will be detective work, head-to-head combat, and the ability to DYNAMICALLY interact with full motion video characters.
rows.description_html: Altered Algorithm: Episode 1 is a free VR experience introducing you back to a time of gaming simplicity and the excitement of unique experiences. This project has been in development for only 6 months by a small team of developers (including me, Nick DePalo), a community of amazing artists, and a group of filmmaking partners. We hope to build on this foundational endeavor of episodic adventures with your support. Our goal is to introduce new, interesting, and unique experiences to the world. Welcome to an alternate LA, set in a futuristic 1983. You're either a militant or mercenary. Jeremiah, our main protagonist lives in an alternate past where technology has already flourished for decades causing ALL risk to be mitigated. He's a hired 'Field Adjuster' who's job is to hunt down any threats to make the world 'SAFE' through the use of the most advanced AI Predictive software and Threat Analytics ever created with a new government program called... CASSI. ​CASSI, a ' C entralized A I S afety S urveillance I nfrastructure' is designed to serve, mitigate, and protect everyone and everything. ​When the A.I. Threat Algorithm Jeremiah relies on is infiltrated by Kenji Kimora, an infamous underground gang leader, an altered simulation unfolds, and it causes a system city lockdown beyond repair. These events lead Jeremiah to embark on a journey within the simulation to explore the deep city slums of gangs, freewill, and the chaos of choice to discover the altered algorithm of who he truly is and needs to become. There, Jeremiah is presented with the greatest risk ever encountered.... himself . Action-thriller set in an altered futuristic timeline of 1983 LA, where advanced technology has already flourished for decades​ Unique FMV (Full Motion Video) environments and characters that allow dynamic interaction within the real-time 3D world ​ 'Natural Narrative' driven pacing is at the heart of our experience. The choices you make will dynamically unfold the story you drive forward. SEARCH, SOLVE, or SURVIVE... the choice is yours.​ Environmental puzzles that involve the player to use their detective tools, the sandbox world, or weapons on hand to manipulate and solve the world's mysteries Players assume the first-person perspective of a fully playable character in VR known as Jeremiah, who can interact within a world of FMV (Full Motion Video) characters and elements by solving environmental puzzles and options for ranged combat, which reveals your story's journey.

rows.name: ROSE
rows.short_description: ROSE is a violent rogue-lite arena shooter where you sacrifice your body parts to progress and gain new weapons and abilities. Slaughter waves of monstrous enemies and defeat titanic bosses in randomized arenas or die trying!
rows.description_html: ROSE is a violent arena shooter with rogue-like elements. Create your own builds by sacrificing parts of your body or reversing the sacrifices to gain boost and new abilities. Unlock new weapons, enhance them with powerful upgrades. Progress through randomized arenas, defeat demented enemies and vanquish titanic bosses to uncover the dark story. What are you willing to sacrifice to save your lost daughter Rose? Sacrifice your flesh and blood After each arena has been cleared you can choose from several sacrifices. Sacrifices will increase the complexity and difficulty of the game. Each body part sacrificed will add new mechanics and will change the game in a meaningful way. Each sacrifice will increase your stress level, with enough stress you can reverse a sacrifice to gain a new ability instead. Ever-changing arenas Arenas are randomly selected from dozens of pre-made layouts. Traps, enemies and other objects are procedurally spawned. Each arena can spawn multiple waves of enemies. In some arenas you can figh for additional rewards. In such cases, enemies will spawn with a special rule-set, forcing you to strategize and change your play style to complete the rule objective. Not all the arenas are created equal, some may offer special mid-run upgrades or present you with an additional challenge in the form of a mini-boss. Weapons and abilities Each weapon provides a unique gameplay experience, some can even alter the maps themselves. The gun selection ranges from a simple revolver to a demented gun which consumes your blood for ammo and punishes you each time you miss. Unlock new weapons, upgrade them every time you die, then jump into battle once more! Enemies and bosses Enemies spawn in waves. After you clear a certain number of waves, the sacrificial altar will unlock, and you will move to a new arena. Some arenas may spawn bosses instead of regular enemies. Story Rose tells a story about life, death and hope. You will find out more about the story by progressing through the arenas, special encounters, defeating bosses and dying. Features: Sacrifice your flesh and blood to progress Reverse sacrifices to gain boosts instead Unlock and upgrade unique weapons Slaughter waves of demented enemies Defeat titanic bosses Progress through the randomized arenas to uncover the dark story Avoid traps and other procedurally placed obstacles

rows.name: Pineapple on pizza
rows.short_description: Can a video game convey a flavor?
rows.description_html: Eating a pizza is like holding a party in your mouth, but what would that party feel like if the pizza had pineapple on it? Pineapple on pizza is a short game about exploring an island full of dancing people, finding a way to ruin the party, and unexpectedly enjoying it. We strongly encourage you to stop reading and just play it. Surprise does enhance the flavor. Features: About 10 minutes of gameplay. An island full of people dancing. Cool music. Dark, yet very bright humor. Unexpected emotions you might not have experienced before. A volcano you can jump into when you get tired of exploring. If you liked the game, consider supporting us by buying the soundtrack on Steam.

rows.name: A Song Of Sunlight
rows.short_description: An RPG set in a distant, lonely future. Follow Arem, a young man lured from his small island community to explore the desolate megastructure beneath it: “The Well.” With the simple goal of finding the exit, Arem will burden himself with something more terrible than he ever thought possible.
rows.description_html: Arem has lived his life surrounded by ocean waves and fields of dying grass . Upon his small island lies The Settlement , a community of just three thousand: the children of the sun. Passing the long years in prayer and simple work, the blessed people of the Island live and die by their traditions. Arem, like all young men and women of The Settlement, knows well the laws of his people: perform one's obligation for the greater good, and never enter The Well - a passage leading deep into the unknown earth below.  Raised as a Woundbearer, Arem greatly desires to come of age and do his part in improving the lives of his community- none more so than Sachita, the burning girl, shunned by The Settlement but whom he loves dearly.  Yet, when Arem is suddenly given the responsibilities he always dreamed of, he finds his certainty shattered by the truth of the horror held at The Settlement’s close reach. Now doubting the only life he's ever known, Arem embarks on a secret mission to save his people and unravel the true nature of his world.     Descending into the Well and desperately searching for answers, Arem comes to understand just how much he truly has to lose. A Song of Sunlight features a novel pseudo-turn-based combat system that challenges players to fight for their lives against horrifying enemies. Make split-second calculated decisions, then attack, block, evade, and look for openings in real-time against multiple targets in thrilling combat encounters. By day, carry out your duties to the Settlement and interact with its inhabitants to obtain resources and learn more about the world. By night, explore desolate megastructures filled with mystery and danger, discover weapons and equipment lost to humanity, and customize your build to suit many distinct play styles. A tightly woven intersection of gameplay and narrative, players will interact with the game world and characters in depth.

rows.name: Touch the Color
rows.short_description: Take your reflexes and aim to the next level with Touch the Color, the arcade-style reaction and accuracy game that’s easy to pick up but hard to put down.
rows.description_html: Take your reflexes and aim to the next level with Touch the Color, the arcade-style reaction and accuracy game that’s easy to pick up but hard to put down. In Touch the Color, you’re given a matrix of colors but only one is your target. All you need to do is click on the correct color as fast as possible to ramp up your score. If its simplicity is reminding you of time-waster games, think again. Touch the Color is an arcade reaction time game that’ll work your mouse aim and take it to new heights. The faster and more accurately you click, the sharper your brain and skills become. Fast-paced color switching means you’ll be challenged at every turn. And as the pace increases, so does your drive to keep improving your score. It’s a reflex challenge that’s both addictive and beneficial yet can also be as calm or as tryhard as you want it to be. Chill by focusing on improving your own score or take it to the online stage by climbing the leaderboard ranks. Fast-paced Gameplay Touch the Color’s gameplay only requires a single click of the mouse, making it easy to pick up. Focus on your speed and accuracy for optimal gains. Customize Your Experience Touch the Color features tons of unlockable themes, each with its own personality. Ramp up your score to earn stars to make the experience your own. Ranking System - Challenge yourself further by ranking up. Touch the Color features a worldwide ranking leaderboard where you can beat the scores of others including your friends.

rows.name: Dot
rows.short_description: The purpose of Dot is to ascend to the next world in the least number of actions possible. You can play as a dot, heart, cat, penguin or union. Enjoy this game as a free experience. Relax and calmly navigate these worlds.
rows.description_html: Dot is a peaceful game about traversal of worlds. The purpose of Dot is to ascend to the next world in the least number of actions possible. You can play as a dot, heart, cat or penguin. Enjoy this game as a free experience. Relax and calmly navigate this unique space. Use the mouse to direct the dot in a direction of travel and click to move the dot. The dot continues to travel until it reaches a rest point, or falls off the platform. Navigate platforms and rest points to reach the ascension location and progress to the next world. Activate buttons and avoid darkness to reach the game's unknown conclusion. This is an open ended experience where the player chooses when to complete or end the game, there are no right or inright, correct or incorrect, affirmative or confirmative solutions. Please enjoy. With Love, Little Sky Studios.

rows.name: Nightly Trash
rows.short_description: You're an average-joe in a 1950's like aesthetic, working at a diner while taking out the trash. Each night has different events as you play through, so keep your eyes open for anything... off...
rows.description_html: Game Description You play as a 17 year old boy who was desperate to get a job and finds himself an awful adventure . As your job you work as a cook at a local diner , and you as the player have to take out the trash in every night to finish up your shift. Each night has a different event as you play through the game. As each night goes on you'll eventually discover something from the sewers, and will uncover the secrets of the diner. What will you discover from these horrid times? Key Features: In game tutorial for new players A very basic gameplay mechanic but also fun A small interesting story And very short game About Me I am a individual who is trying to achieve their dreams, and I have successfully achieved one out of many. I have always wanted to make video games ever since I was a kid, but during that time you had to either work at; a AAA studio or be a very smart, and skilled person in order to make games. As technology advanced and still does to this day everyone around the world has made things to help with the lack of knowledge on how to either: Programming, 3D Modeling, Sound Effects, and etc! This doesn't mean me as a game developer is using this as a clutch to make games, but rather a jump start on my adventure to become better at this, and be more skilled in the near future.

I have always wanted to make video games ever since I was a kid, but during that time you had to either work at; a AAA studio or be a very smart, and skilled person in order to make games. As technology advanced and still does to this day everyone around the world has made things to help with the lack of knowledge on how to either: Programming, 3D Modeling, Sound Effects, and etc! This doesn't mean me as a game developer is using this as a clutch to make games, but rather a jump start on my adventure to become better at this, and be more skilled in the near future.

rows.name: Astral Coconut
rows.short_description: A skating based adventure in a vast alien world.
rows.description_html: Astral Coconut was a student project completed in 4 months by a team of game design students. The game is an action adventure 3D platformer set in a sci-fi fantasy world. Skate your way through large open areas in this fluid, atmospheric platforming adventure. Leap, dash, grapple, and grind to maintain constant momentum as you fight your way through the treacherous terrain. Conquer the alien world by utilizing intuitive, flowing combat that always keeps you moving forward. Upgrade your attributes to allow you to take on harder challenges as you progress deeper into the heart of the world. Fight through the planet's inhabitants, cross deadly landscape, and seek your ultimate goal at the end of the world!

rows.name: The King of Cats
rows.short_description: Navigate the claustrophobic corridors of a cargo ship and try to survive a night with man-eating tigers on the loose. Your choices will determine who lives and who dies.
rows.description_html: The King of Cats  is a short visual novel inspired by animal horror films and Michael Crichton's classic novel, Jurassic Park. Doctor Kemp is a millionaire wildlife biologist with a love for big cats. He just bought a litter of tigers for a unique business opportunity in Mexico. The only problem is the deal isn't exactly legal. He assembles a team to smuggle the tigers aboard a cargo ship and escort them across the ocean. But when a storm hits early in the voyage, the tigers break free and the hunt begins. Navigate the claustrophobic corridors of a vessel with man-eating tigers on the loose. Your choices will determine who lives and who dies. This is an approximately 9,000 word story with two major endings. Join the Discord and talk about the game!

rows.name: Castle of Blackwater
rows.short_description: Castle of Blackwater is a 2D, action-packed, social deduction game with a magical twist. In this intense game of trust and betrayal, up to 10 strangers are trapped in a castle of danger and deception, with a mission to complete tasks and escape with their lives.
rows.description_html: Castle of Blackwater is a fast-paced   social deduction game with a magical twist. Up to 10 strangers are trapped in a castle filled with danger, deception, and dark forces. Will you fight to survive and escape, or will you betray and eliminate? Choose Your Faction Protectors  –   Complete tasks, form alliances, and expose the Satanic Satanic  – Sabotage, eliminate, and manipulate your way to victory Forgotten  – Play both sides and stir up chaos like a true wildcard Features Proximity Voice & Text Chat  – Scream, scheme, or whisper sweet lies into your friends’ ears. 10 Unique Characters & Abilities – Silence players mid-discussion, transform into a werewolf, or literally read minds to uncover bloody secrets. 20+ Mini-Games & Tasks – Slice veggies like a ninja, chop down a tree like a lumberjack, or light candles like a medieval DJ in a musical memory game. 200+ Customisation Items - Equip awesome weapons, flashy shields, and fun emotes. Teabag enemies, dance with a skeleton, or go out in style with custom eliminations! Death is not the end! – As a ghost, collect souls to buy power-ups for your team. Influence the game from beyond the grave! In the ever-lasting battle between good and evil, only one side will survive to claim the Castle’s victory. Many members are joining our Discord to keep up to date with development. We're a small but active team, so if you have any suggestions or questions, we would love to talk to you on Discord.

rows.name: Modules
rows.short_description: Modules is a VR art experience by Maxim Zhestkov, where architecture, sculpture, film, and music blend together to immerse viewers into the artist's world.
rows.description_html: Modules is a project by Maxim Zhestkov, where different forms of art – architecture, sculpture, film, and music – blend together to create an intense, interactive virtual experience. Modules will expand to contain Maxim Zhestkov’s entire body of work. Over the course of years, the project will grow as he grows, expanding into new territories and blurring the boundaries between art, games, and reality. With experimentation at its core, it is Zhestkov’s playground, where he is able to refine his work with no end, challenging the limits of his own medium. Features: - Explore 11 rooms with unique audiovisual installations - Discover the project with or without a VR headset - Dive deeper with the artist’s voice commentaries about the project

rows.reviews_html: “‘Modules’ is submersive; taking body and mind through an 11-room network of space-age staircases, ledges, lifts and corridors, navigated by pinching your (real-world) fingers. Your earthbound body flinches as Zhestkov’s monumental sculptures sail past your face, almost squash you, and bend, dissolve, and warp around you. They are hyperreal digital simulations that mirror real-world physics, halfway between the gaming universe and real-world museum experience.” Wallpaper* “Modules is an ever-evolving project he plans to develop throughout [Zhestkov's] lifetime, adding new iterations every six months.” FRAME

rows.name: finland corruption simulator
rows.short_description: experience boring life in simulator game and this will just is it finland corruption simulator and then you can just play it nothing intresting so do what ever you want in game what you will can so basically nothing
rows.description_html: - gameplay is totally about walking - you can watch over to left and right with A and D keys - this game runs with java so you need to have java to run this game - game resolution is 640x480 - you can move forward and backwards with W and S keys - you can open stats and messages from pressing I key in keyboard - you can send message from pressing 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, - you can use car from pressing N in keyboard - you can open controls window section from pressing C in keyboard - cool review i found '  This game blew my mind. I didn't think that there were any games that could top the classics compared to finland corruption simulator. It's very kind of the creator noobius to not charge any money for this game because it will truly blow you away when you play it. And may I just take a moment to talk about that amazing description text on the store page. When I first read this description, I shed several tears. The story of this game is just so fricking beautiful. There are four life changing modes in this game each one better than the other. The first mode is the dlc launcher, now I haven't played any of the dlc because I didn't want to give myself a heart attack from experiencing such a beautiful game, so I unfortunately skipped it, but I wouldn't be surprised if the dlc was as amazing if not even more amazing as the base game. Next there's mode 2 which is the low 64 bit mode. In this mode you play as the iconic god knows what character and you're apparently crippled since you move at the same pace as a snail. Unless you press the 'n' key in which case you become sonic and move at the speed of light. The world building in this mode is nothing but true art. It's a white world with a black sky with a bunch of squares everywhere. And I really love the story in this mode: You start the game. I also live that in this mode you don't use your mouse to look around, but you have to use the arrow keys and I think that this is just such a well thought out decision because who really uses a mouse to look around in a game these days? I also love that you are unable to look up or down and that just filled me with so much emotion such as me smashing my keyboard into my screen and me crying because my girlfriend was cheating on me again, oh wait that was just a dream I forgot, I don't have a girlfriend. I really resonate with the message that this mode is trying to tell me. If the message wasn't clear to you already, it is clearly trying to convey that you need to give up on your dreams and fricking suffer in a mental institute. And that is just so inspiring because it is. Mode 3 is the stuff of legends. This is the VR mode. Now I don't own a VR headset so I unfortunately couldn't experience this mode properly, but I booted it up anyway. And when I did, I got the most amazing pop ups consisting of 'Unable to init VR runtime: Installation path could not be located (110)' which I think we can all relate to and ofcourse the classic: 'Composistor initialization failed.' which is and always will be one of the most powerful messages ever said by anything in history. The gameplay was incredible and just so unique from all the other modes. It is the exact same thing as mode 2, except there are more cubes. The message that this mode is trying to tell you is clearly that we shouldn't take finland corruption simulator for granted. There will be a time when this game will be taken off Steam and when it does, we will have taken this game for granted, because there's nothing in this world that brings me more disappointment than this game. The last mode is the classic mode and to say that it is a divine experience would be a severe understatement. I couldn't believe it when I booted up this mode, because this mode is filled with the most passion, love, depression, adventure, friendship, the cold hard reality of life as a bellhop, and chihuahua's out of any game I have seen in 15 minutes. All this mode is is an error message saying: 'This application requires a Java runtime environment'. When I experienced the gameplay, I had to jack off for 5 hours before I could press ok. My room is now covered in semen. I think the message that this mode is trying to convey is pretty clear, but for your dumb dumbs out there I'll explain it for you. The message that it's trying to convey is that we shouldn't try to fix problems and that we should just say ok and be depressed. Such a powerful message. This game is nothing short of a masterpiece. The game not only conveys a powerful message in 3 of its modes (and possibly the dlc as well), but it's also very accurate as it's obviously based on a true story. I've been to Finland's capital Stockholm and I can tell you that out of all 4 modes, mode 4 is the most realistic and accurately represents Stockholm perfectly out of all of them. I 100% recommend this game if you wanna experience the beauty that is Finalnd, but don't wanna leave your room because of your depression. I'm now gonna cry myself to sleep. ' SORRY I HAD TO EDIT THE REVIEW LITTLE BIT BECAUSE NO CURSING = GOOD AND NO CONTACT TO OTHER GAMES THEY SAID OR SOMETHING ALSO THANKS FOR THE COPY PASTE CONTENT :D

rows.name: Rhythm Taichi XR
rows.short_description: Rhythm Taichi XR is a physical dancing mixed reality rhythm game that turns your smartphone into a motion camera. It is compatible with most custom songs on beatsaver, and requires no specialized hardware. It is also available as a second screen for your phone or as a standalone VR game.
rows.description_html: Rhythm Taichi XR is a physical dancing mixed reality rhythm game that turns your smartphone into a motion camera. It is compatible with most custom songs on beatsaver, and requires no specialized hardware. It is also available as a second screen for your phone or as a standalone VR game. 3D Rhythm, reinvented Rhythm Taichi takes a fresh new approach to 3D rhythm games. Slide your fingers gracefully along the paths traced on the screen, following the beats of the music - it's like practicing Taichi with your fingers! Swipe with style, swipe with ease Rhythm Taichi is built from the ground up, optimized for touch input. A carefully crafted pathing algorithm provides a comfortable yet challenging amount of finger travel for each hand. We've also ruthlessly optimized the game's graphics and networking pipeline to ensure that the game responds quickly and smoothly to your actions. Looks good, feels good too The new touch tracking algorithm is more precise then ever - and with the innovative 'rainfall' style timing effects, you get instant feedback on your synchronization performance. Finishing a song is just the beginning - compete against players around the world by perfecting your runs and submitting your scores on the leaderboard! Thousands of supported songs Rhythm Taichi maintains compatibility with the beat saver song format, and provides an in-game integration with the beat saver API for thousands of supported songs. If you don't wish your songs to be indexed within the game, specify that in the description of your song on beatsaver and send us an email with the link. You can also download songs from beatsaver yourself and install them by using the 'import' function from within the game menu or extract directly to the following directory: C:\Users[Your username]\AppData\LocalLow\Tempstudio, LLC\Rhythm Taichi\savedsongs It's time to dance in XR Rhythm Taichi's 2.0 update features XR mode support on PC. Powered by the latest advancement in artificial intelligence and machine learning, XR mode turns your phone into a high speed motion camera, without needing any specialized hardware. If you have trouble getting started, make sure to read the manual. Virtual Reality Supported Rhythm Taichi supports desktop VR setups (on Windows). Controller phone is not required, but can be used to sign in to submit scores to the leaderboard. Adjust the in-game height with the settings on the left part of the menu if your position is uncomfortable.

rows.name: The Last Duskreaper
rows.short_description: Try this side view platformer metroidvania that tells the story of a bird in a dying kingdom infected by glitched monsters.
rows.description_html: Ashley is a brave little bird . Following the call of one of her old friends, she returns to her native kingdom, the Immortal Shadow Lands. She discovers that this world is invaded by glitched and weird monsters , the anomalies , created by a mysterious Scarlet Ghost. Ashley and her friend Poe , take the initiative of ridding this world of what gnaws at it at the request of the king himself. But who knows what dark secrets are hidden by Poe, the Scarlet Ghost, the origins of the anomalies and the kingdom or Ash herself? Our little bird, in this adventure, will never be at the end of its surprises . Inspired by the fabulous work of Team Cherry on their masterpiece, Hollow Knight , this game will test its player in an adventure through the many territories that compose the world that offers itself in a totally open way in this platformer metroidvania . So what are you waiting for to try your luck ?

rows.name: Lilith Wants to Buy Your Soul
rows.short_description: Take a personality test with a definitely-not-clingy demon girl.
rows.description_html: Hi there! I'm a demon named Lilith. I used to haunt books, oujia boards, and telephone lines, but now I spend my time traveling the internet, looking for  people like you. Why don't you come visit? Together we can..  Take a thoughtful, engaging, personality test  Use that test to find the value of your soul, in dollars (I made a nice certificate!) Discuss demon lore (though I'm really an imp) I promise it'll be ten minutes of questions and fun!   I mean, it's not like I really  want you to talk to me or anything like that... but if you just happened to want to speak to me, someone who definitely isn't lonely, then I think that could be nice. Got it?  Then let's begin. Warning: this visual novel may contain dark themes.

rows.name: Xploquest 3
rows.short_description: Xploquest 3 is a turn-based role-playing game where you explore an open world and manage your character.
rows.description_html: The XPLOQUEST saga continues with this third episode. What is XPLOQUEST? It's a turn-based, square-by-square role-playing game. The principle is very simple : 1-You explore the world 2-You kill monsters 3-You complete quests 4-You make money 5-You gain experience 6-You level up 7-You go back to town 8-You buy equipment and skills 9-See 1. In the world of XPLOQUEST, everyone wants you dead or your money. Things to know: No loot, only gold: In XPLOQUEST enemies and chests don't give you equipment, just gold to spend in towns. Backup only in town: You don't decide when you save the game. It happens automatically when entering and leaving a town. So when you leave a city, make sure you have what it takes. Fights and quests, it's all the way: You cannot flee a fight or stop a quest in progress. Quick fight: When you keep the attack button pressed, the fight takes place automatically. Remember to watch your life. The food: Each move on the map uses a food ration. Don't forget to buy some. Controls: The game is played with the gamepad or the keyboard. You can change the configuration of keyboard controls.

rows.name: RPG Fitness VR
rows.short_description: From the Creators who brought you the Multi-Award Winning Swordy Quest, comes RPG Fitness VR! Imagine waking up with no name, food or supplies. Where are you? It doesn't matter now. Set in a Fantasy and Living World, your goal is clear: Save humanity. Can you unlock the secrets of RPG Fitness VR?
rows.description_html: Exclusive to Steam VR & from the Creators who brought you the Multi-Award Winning Swordy Quest, comes their latest creation, RPG Fitness VR! Get ready to embark on a thrilling adventure in RPG Fitness VR, where crafting, hunting, gathering and climbing combine to create a gaming experience like no other. With immersive virtual reality graphics, you'll feel like you're truly a part of this enchanted world, with the power to explore, conquer and survive in a fully-realized 3D environment. But RPG Fitness VR isn't just a game, it's also a workout! By keeping you active and engaged, you'll get in shape while you explore new worlds and face new challenges. Whether you're battling against fierce monsters, gathering resources, or climbing towering peaks, you'll be constantly moving and exercising. Craft your own weapons, hunt for food, and gather resources as you explore this vast and wondrous world. With a huge variety of items to find and weapons to craft, you'll always have a new challenge to tackle. And with new obstacles and enemies added regularly, you'll never run out of adventures to embark on. And with the power of virtual reality, you'll feel like you're truly a part of this world. The immersive 3D graphics and 360-degree gameplay will make you feel like you're actually there, giving you the ultimate gaming experience. Whether you're exploring ancient ruins, navigating treacherous forests, or battling against fierce beasts, you'll feel like you're right in the thick of the action. So what are you waiting for? Get your VR headset ready and start your Fitness Quest today! With its combination of gameplay, exercise, and virtual reality, you'll never have more fun or get in better shape. Join the RPG Fitness VR community and see where your journey takes you! With so much to explore, conquer and experience, RPG Fitness VR is the perfect game for gamers who want a unique and active experience. FEATURES ● Open World Environment - allowing you to explore grasslands, oceans, mountains & more ● Get fit while playing an RPG (e.g. Use your arms to walk around the island and climb to hidden areas. Manually craft & mine for items using arm movements) ● Enemies around every corner! ● Weapon crafting - where finding the right materials is key to fending off enemies ● Survival aspects - requiring careful resource management ● Hidden Upgrade items - finding them can mean the difference between life & death ● Eye-catching graphics - transport you to another world ● Intuitive navigation system ● Player customization through levelling system ● & much, much more... THANKS Special Thanks to Duke54 for the Height Map! Sound effects and music obtained from Zapsplat

rows.name: Locke(d)
rows.short_description: An algorithm decided to show you this. What now?
rows.description_html: You wake up sitting across from a beautiful stranger. 'There is nothing I want more than to talk to you right now.' And so you talk. Locke(d) is a short, mysterious and atmospheric visual novel with brief point-and-click segments. Linear visual novel ~3000 words 10-30 minutes of reading The game was originally made within 2 weeks, and was heavily inspired by a passage in John Locke's 'An Essay Concerning Human Understanding' .

rows.name: Stewart The Fox
rows.short_description: Join Stewart the Fox on an epic adventure through four challenging levels filled with obstacles, enemies, and two boss battles. As you collect hidden items to help Stewart emerge victorious in this action-packed platformer game.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Stewart the Fox!⠀ in this action-packed platformer, you'll play as Stewart, a brave fox on a quest to defeat enemies, overcome obstacles, and emerge victorious.⠀ As you journey through the game's four levels, you'll encounter a variety of challenges and foes, including tricky jumps, dangerous enemies and two epic boss battles. With quick reflexes and clever strategy, you'll need to navigate through each level and emerge unscathed. But the challenges don't stop there! Throughout the game, you'll also be on the lookout for collectibles hidden throughout the levels. So grab your controller / mouse and join Stewart on his epic adventure. Can you help him emerge victorious and claim victory in Stewart the Fox? Play the new Multiplayer mode! Speedrun through the levels with up to 5 other friends! click the Multiplayer button in the main menu to play online. NOTE: This game is meant to be challenging depending on your Platformer skills. (This means that some people may have alot of trouble beating the game, is this the case for you? Visit the #Guides section in the community tab to view a Developer playtrough! NOTE: Controllers are supported in-game, not in Menu's. NOTE: This game is made by a single developer in the timespan of 2 weeks, keep this in mind, its meant to be a fun little game to speedrun or beat.

rows.name: MITE - Terror in the forest
rows.short_description: MITE is a horror game, with some difficulty, in which you play a hiker who has lost his family in a cursed forest... find your family and escape, while strange creatures from Japanese folklore chase you, orient yourself .
rows.description_html: MITE is a third-person horror game, which makes use of Japanese folklore and a popular history of the regions... live the terror of being chased at night in the most haunted forest in the region, by a strange yokai who It haunts you when you stop looking at it. Chapter 1: A hiker who has lost his wife and son in one of the most enchanted forests in the region, a forest where one should not be at night, must find his partner and son... while being chased by a strange creature that catches it. get closer little by little while you stop looking at him... more and more speed, don't fall while you walk... because if you stop looking at him... maybe when you get up you will find him face to face, run away from the forest with your family and try not to return to him. (Not available) Chapter 2: In chapter two, MITE will be the hunted, and Taki, a priest and two policemen will go after him, will they finish off MITE? Fear: Experience the terror of walking in a forest with spirits and Japanese yokais. Exploration: Wander through the forest, walking carefully and trying not to stop looking at the strange spirit for a long time... or it will approach you. Genre: This game is from the Horror-Narrative genre, designed for horror movie lovers. Orientation: In a forest and without a compass, the most difficult thing is to find your way around, make it on your own, your family is waiting for you. No saving: This game is made to be passed in the same game, due to its simplicity, but it will not be an easy task. Our studio specializes in scary games, and we often use Japanese folklore and mythology as a source of inspiration. At Kanashi Studio we study the price, and we set an affordable one for all players, 'giving is receiving'.

rows.name: AmazeVR Megan Thee Stallion VR Concert
rows.short_description: Get ready for a mind-blowing experience. You’ll be front and center at a private performance by Megan Thee Stallion, with every beat and lyric amplified in stunning virtual reality. Imagine being at an exclusive VIP concert, but with the added thrill of diving into a fully-realized digital world.
rows.description_html: NOTICE: Due to the 8k video used in this experience, AMD graphics cards are unfortunately not compatible. We apologize for any inconvenience. Embark on a journey into the Hottieverse, the most innovative and high-tech music experience in the world. You’ll be front and center at a private performance by Megan Thee Stallion, with every beat and lyric amplified in stunning virtual reality. Imagine being at an exclusive VIP concert, but with the added thrill of diving into a fully-realized digital world. Not everyone can enter. The gateway is guarded against intruders who might try to break in. Only those with the skill to hack through the security will find themselves face-to-face with Megan Thee Stallion. The stage is larger than life. Experiencing her live-action performance just inches away makes the music seem louder, the beats stronger, and the excitement palpable. Don't miss out on the most high-quality VR concert ever made. Step into the world of Megan Thee Stallion and let the music take over. The free trial offers a preview of one interactive stage. The full ‘Enter Thee Hottieverse’ VR Concert can be purchased in the app and includes behind the scenes footage and shareable highlights. Megan Thee Stallion is the first of many artists to be featured by AmazeVR. Be on the lookout for more VR Concerts this summer.

rows.name: Eye 4 Eye
rows.short_description: Embark on a mission to unveil the truth behind a missing daughter case. Utilize the search engine to gather clues and uncover the dark secrets of TempleTech. Experience a suspenseful journey through the eyes of Hazel.
rows.description_html: Eye 4 Eye is a first-person detective adventure puzzle game with retro graphics. It takes place in a futuristic dystopia where everyone has a brain chip installed for the betterment of society. You play as Hazel, a struggling detective, tasked with solving a mysterious missing daughter case in a Victorian mansion inside of a high-tech company complex. Employ your cutting-edge bionic eye and use tools like the search engine, history vision, and item examination to journey down your investigative path. Engage your inner sleuth and challenge yourself with thought-provoking puzzles and enigmatic mysteries as you uncover the truth behind the missing girl. As you unveil the company's dark secrets, experience the thrill of piecing together an intricate mystery in a futuristic world brought to life in a captivating 90s retro aesthetic. Playtime is around 30 - 60 minutes depending on your playstyle. Features: High-Tech Detective Tools - Utilize the search engine to gather clues and piece together the mystery at hand. Puzzle Packed - Put your problem-solving skills to the test as you work to unravel the truth. Can you solve the mystery on your own? Unravel a Dark Conspiracy - Embark on a journey to uncover the truth behind the mysterious disappearance of a young girl. Step into the Future - Immerse yourself in the world of 2073 and unravel the wrongdoing of the powerful high-tech company TempleTech.

rows.name: Metal March: Beginner Experience
rows.short_description: Metal March, is the ultimate fusion of CHESS-inspired turn-based strategy and card game mechanics (CCG)! Create a force that fits your strategy & style and generate powerful synergies by using cards and relics to complete your expedition! Gather your troops and get ready to March your Metals!
rows.description_html: Metal March: Beginner Experience is a free playable preview game of Metal March. This version game is includes 1 race and 1 region, a total of 2-3 hours of playable time. You'll see the overall flow of the game, the initial strategy, etc. The full game includes the following! CHESS-inspired turn-based strategy game mixed with card collection genres. (Based on our current updates) Select your troops from 5 races Race-themed areas 7 types of unique troops and 10 types of unique magic powers per race More than 10 types of troops and 20 types of magic shared among troops More than 40 kinds of relics The world has turned into complete chaos. The fragile peace between races has shattered and trust is in short supply. As tensions rise and old alliances crumble, all the races are now preparing for an expedition to the World's Roof. Which one of the races will be the first to reach the Roof? Only YOU will be the one to know. Get ready for an epic adventure to claim the powerful relics atop the World's Roof! Remember, you must be the first to take over the relics at the World's Roof before others. But beware, time is running out. You must be the first to reach the relics before others. With the help of the Wandering Wizard, you can briefly monitor the battlefield and control your troops. You can identify each of your troops with tin dolls with different appearances. All troops have their own movement / attack patterns. In addition to the attributes and characteristics of the troop's powers, these movement and attack patterns are also essential factors that you need to consider in strategy. Thoroughly plan your strategy and win. Effectively win the battle by moving troops where the enemy can't counter-attack and quickly retreating to a position the enemy cannot follow. Strategies like this will matter. MAGIC can be a key that completes your strategy. With Magic, you can either protect or strengthen your team. You can also choose a strategy that destroys enemies with magic attacks. Your magic combination also plays a vital role in the battle. Even within the same collaboration of troops, strategies vary depending on which magic spells you cast and in what order. There are 4 races that you can select for your troops. Each race has its own strengths and weaknesses. You can overcome the weaknesses of your race with the skills and magics of other races. To succeed at the beginning of the expedition, some races need to focus on using their unique strengths while others need to work on overcoming their weaknesses. There is another way to strengthen your troops and magic skills... RELICS! RELICS provide special effects and synergies in ways that can't be obtained from other sources. With relics, you can increase your income during the expedition, add beneficial effects before starting a battle, strengthen certain types of troops & magic powers, and weaken your enemies. You can only activate a limited number of relics, but you can replace them at any time except during battle. Choose and use relics according to your needs and circumstances!

rows.description_html: A first person shooter where players see who can survive to be the last one alive as the flood below them rises. Players are pitted against each other in a research lab with a helicopter pad on top in which players can go from one level to another leading to one fire fight to the next in this fast paced combat FPS Battle Royale. There can only be one survivor. Additional Game Modes Present.

rows.name: Bloodhound: First day in hell
rows.short_description: Crush the cult of Astaroth and vanquish her hellspawn, make them squeal and hide where they came from. Enjoy a Fresh Look & Old Fun in this arcade horror FPS game inspired by the legends of the 90s.
rows.description_html: Take the role of a skilled and determined warrior tasked with stopping the malevolent cult of Astaroth. These sinister individuals have called upon the forces of Hell to aid them in their quest for power, and it's up to you to put an end to their nefarious plans. With your trusty firearms at the ready, you'll need to fight your way through hordes of cultists and demons, all while working to prevent Astaroth from making its way to Earth. Do you have what it takes to save the world from certain doom? Dive in a thrilling introduction to the game's action-packed world. In 'First Day in Hell' you'll get a taste of what's to come as you begin your quest to stop the cult of Astaroth. From the first moment, you'll be thrown into the thick of the battle, facing off against waves of enemies as you work to make your way through the demonic realm. With intense, fast-paced gameplay and a hauntingly atmospheric setting. As you journey through the depths of Hell, you'll have access to an impressive arsenal of weapons to aid you in your quest. In 'First Day in Hell' you'll get a taste of what's to come as you wield weapons like the Machete, Revolver, Pump Action Shotgun, Double Barreled Shotgun with Harpoon, and Assault Rifle AG043. Each weapon has its own unique strengths and weaknesses, allowing you to tailor your approach to each encounter. Whether you prefer to get up close and personal with the Machete or take out enemies from a distance with the powerful AG043, Bloodhound's arsenal has something for every playstyle. So gear up, lock and load, and get ready to take the fight to the cult of Astaroth in this adrenaline-fueled shooter.

rows.name: Wobbles
rows.short_description: Play as a godly figure, guiding a line of adorable creatures called Wobbles across a landscape that you manipulate using various gadgets. As you do this, you progress the Wobbles civilization through the eras and advancing their technology, ultimately unlocking new gadgets for you to use.
rows.description_html: A Message From The Developers Wobbles was originally released on August 27th, 2013 for iOS and Android. This is the exact same game released then, just recompiled for PC. As the game was originally built for mobile devices, there may be some terminology such as 'tap' or 'pinch to zoom' that can be be replaced by left clicking with your mouse, or scrolling with your mouse wheel. As this game has not been updated since 2013 and was intended to be a mobile game, there is a possibility that not all features will work as intended. Just something to keep in mind. About the Game Play as a godly figure, guiding a line of adorable creatures called Wobbles across a landscape that you manipulate using various gadgets. As players do this, they are progressing the Wobbles civilization through the eras and advancing their technology, ultimately unlocking new gadgets for you to use. Wobbles features six different eras for players to play through, each with their own unique gadget that modifies the environment around them. Each era features ten levels for you to play in, leaving the player with 60 levels to play. Key Features Progressing Civilization - As players progress the Wobbles civilization, they feel rewarded and like they are making an impact on the Wobbles society. Adorable Creatures - Wobbles are adorable little creatures that everyone will love. Wobbles will have different costumes in each era, adding a lot of variety to the game! Tons of levels - Wobbles has 6 eras for you to progress through, each with 10 levels bringing you 60 levels to play. Unique mechanics and levels - Each world features it’s own unique mechanics combined with the ones unlocked from previous levels. This leads into fun and interesting puzzles that can be solved in many different ways. Awards Wobbles is a winner of the “Best Entertainment Game” award from the Mass DiGI Game Challenge in March 2013, hosted at the Microsoft New England Research and Development Center. rows.name: Artovya
rows.short_description: Dive into the bizarre land of Artovya in a thrilling CCG! Master five distinct factions—Fantasy, Alien, Futuristic, Horror, and Interdimensional. Forge your strategy with unique mechanics and thrilling battles across fantastical realms. Unleash your creativity, build your deck, and dominate!
rows.description_html: Welcome to the Wild World of Artovya! As Sir Typhil of Creulor trekked through the kingdom of Artovya and beyond, he met many strange and unusual characters from far off places. Now a vast interdimensional war has broken out in the once peaceful realm. Dive more deeply into the bizarre land of Artovya in a thrilling CCG. Embark on an extraordinary strategic journey where fantasy clashes with futuristic dystopias, strange alien beings, interdimensional chaos, and spine-chilling horror. Each deck you create is a gateway to a new world of possibilities. Welcome to the adventure that seamlessly blends complexity, visual brilliance, and accessible gameplay dynamics. Explore Five Unique Factions: Fantasy: Step into a land of knights, dragons, and ancient magic. Build your strength through healing, summon mighty creatures, and unleash devastating spells upon your adversaries. Alien: Command uncanny alien species with unique abilities and unpredictable strategies. Utilize their biological superiority to outpace and outsmart your enemy. Futuristic: Navigate through a neon-lit dystopian future where technology reigns supreme. Engage in espionage, hack your opponent's deck, and manipulate outcomes with cutting-edge tech. Horror: Delve into the macabre with necromancy and control frightening monstrosities. Paralyze your opponents with fear, and turn the tides by bringing creatures back from the beyond. Interdimensional: Manipulate space, time, and reality at your whim. Warp the very fabric of the game with cards that alter the state of play and disrupt the conventional rules of engagement. Game Features: In-Game Interactive Tutorial: Play through the tutorial levels to learn the mechanics and play styles of the game. Receive five free decks upon completion, so you can start playing right away! Dual-Realm Game Board: Each player commands their own realm. This spatial aspect requires strategic positioning and movement of cards across the board, adding a layer of tactical depth. Master the art of maneuvering your forces to outwit your opponent. Diverse Strategic Approaches: Instead of limiting players to predefined archetypes, Artovya provides a toolbox of versatile and diverse card options, encouraging players to explore their own style of play. Whether you lean towards aggressive assaults, defensive stands, or cunning tactical plays, you'll find the cards to support your strategy. Strategically Paced Gameplay: Gameplay supports more calculated thinking. Artovya invites players to deeply engage with the mechanics and explore creative deck building. This pacing ensures that even non-meta, experimental decks can find their place and succeed, giving players the freedom to try new and unconventional strategies without dying in the first 3 turns or suddenly losing out of nowhere. Regular Updates: The game will be added to with new, interesting features and cards regularly, keeping the gameplay fresh and exciting. Community and Multiplayer Focus: Engage with a vibrant community and challenge players from around the world. Build your decks, share strategies, and make friends. Whether you’re a tactical thinker or a lore enthusiast, this game offers something for everyone. Unleash your creativity, plan your strategies, and rise to become the ultimate master of Artovya. Ready your deck and prepare for battle — the realms await!

rows.name: Farmburgh
rows.short_description: Farmburgh is a point-and-click idle farming sim game that offers a fresh take on the classic genre. Grow crops, raise animals, craft goods, and decorate your farm. Suitable for hardcore optimizers and casual fans alike. Become the ultimate virtual farmer in Farmburgh!
rows.description_html: Farmburgh is a re-imagining of the classic browser point and click idle farming games (you know which ones I'm talking about). Many of those games have since fizzled out or have been converted to mobile cash grabs. Farmburgh dares to be a breath of fresh air on the genre. You can decorate your farm, plant many various crops, raise (sometimes wacky) animals and craft trade goods to sell for a profit. Farmburgh has a little for everyone, from the hardcore optimizer, squeezing every last drop of profit out of their farm to the artistic person, creating a beautiful home for their animals. Whatever your style, come on down to Farmburgh and become the virtual farmer you were always meant to be. What would a farming game be without farming? Plow your fields and plant your crops with just a couple of clicks. Each plant takes a designated real life time to grow, from minutes to hours. Plant a few rows of corn on your lunch break and come back after work to harvest them. All the plants are always in season in Farmburgh, so you have many to choose from. Each one with their own advantages and disadvantages. Be sure to check in often, especially around holidays. The store is known to stock up on special crops during those times. Animals have their place on the farm too! Don't worry though, Farmburgh is a strictly no-kill district. That means you have to come up with some creative ways to gather resources from your animals. We won't tell you what those are yet...that's up to you to see for yourself! Animal's produce a resource every few minutes to every few hours once they reach adulthood. This game never takes itself too seriously. So you may have some exotic animals along side your cows and sheep. Now you've got plenty of produce and plenty of animal products, so now what? You could sell them like that or combine your different resources to make even more money. Some buildings have an option to purchase crafting stations in them. These crafting stations allow you to combine resources to make food, alcohol, textiles and other trade good. Once you set recipe, it'll continue crafting until you tell it to stop or it runs out of ingredients. Just like crop and animals, crafting takes a designated amount of real life time to do. This may take longer than selling directly, but I promise the payoff will be worth it! After all that hard work, it's time to get paid. You're able to sell your goods to various marketplaces. Each marketplace requires a one time purchase in order to use them. They each also have products that sell at a higher or lower price than normal. For instance, you can't sell your homemade vodka at a school bake sale and your knitted sweater wouldn't do well at a winery. You start off with your roadside stand, making minimal profits. Eventually you can work your way up! So you've got tons of cash now, what's next? Decorate your farm with tons of decorations from the catalog. Fences, benches, flags, trees and so much more. New decor is being added all the time. (Protip, the haybales are really good for pixel art!). There's so much more to discover and even more to come! Weekly requests, level system and animal storage top list!

rows.name: Speedway Ringer
rows.short_description: Speedway Ringer is a top-down racer inspired by American stock car oval racing and the real-life challenges of Motorsports. Drivers will need a balance of aggression and patience to perfect their technique and succeed in a chaotic online multiplayer environment.
rows.description_html: Overview Speedway Ringer is a top-down racer inspired by American stock car oval racing and the real-life challenges of Motorsports. Drivers will need a balance of aggression and patience to perfect their technique and succeed in a chaotic online multiplayer environment. Whether you're a seasoned racer or just a gamer looking for a new challenge, Speedway Ringer is a quick, fun way to race with your friends. Tracks Speedway Ringer features 7 short tracks, each with its own unique characteristics and challenges. The tracks are inspired by real-life American stock car racing circuits. Additional track types are currently in development. Drivers must tune their car to find the right balance of speed and control to achieve the best lap times. In addition to the standard tracks, the game will also feature special event tracks throughout the year that provide unique challenges. Dynamic Track System Driving lines themselves affect the track grip, making every race a unique and challenging experience. As drivers take a line through the turns, they can affect the grip of the track in that area, creating a dynamic optimal line. This means that players must not only focus on their driving skills but also adapt to the changing conditions. This system is tuned to be extremely sensitive and adds to the chaos. Paint Schemes Set your favorite paint scheme and race it online against your friends! For a limited time, join our Discord to submit your own scheme and have it added to the game! Indie Developer Speedway Ringer was primarily developed by one person. Join our Discord to submit feedback and get help from the community. By supporting our first title, you're helping us improve our netcode, physics model, implementing AI, as well as creating the foundation for more racing games in the future!
