rows.name: Dead On Your Lawn
rows.short_description: Prepare for intense action, heart-pounding combat, and a fight for survival where every corner of the dungeon could be your last. Will you have what it takes to reclaim your lawn from the clutches of these parasitic fiends? The challenge is set, and the lawn is yours to protect!
rows.description_html: Prepare for intense action, heart-pounding combat, and a fight for survival where every corner of the dungeon could be your last. Will you have what it takes to reclaim your lawn from the clutches of these parasitic fiends? The challenge is set, and the lawn is yours to protect! In Dead on Your Lawn, you step into a fast-paced world where the dungeon isn't just any dungeon—it's your 'lawn.' The inhabitants of this dark, twisted place refer to their dangerous home as their lawn, and it's up to you to defend it. You'll face off against gruesome monsters—parasite-controlled corpses that want nothing more than to destroy you and your team. The story kicks off with your character on the brink of death, only to be rescued by the Strong Warriors of Reclamation Division (S.W.O.R.D). Now, as a member of this elite team, you must fight to reclaim your lawn from the horrors that infest it. Your mission is clear: eliminate the infection, protect your territory, and ensure that the monsters stay dead on your lawn.

rows.name: Danger Cliff
rows.short_description: It's a 2D Collectathon! Run, jump and drill your way through huge levels with crazy mechanics and unique visual style to find collectables in whatever order you want!
rows.description_html: Danger Cliff is a 2D Collectathon Platformer that harkens back to the golden age of internet browser games. You play as Clifford--an overwhelmingly positive young adventurer--followed by his best friend Boxer. One day while the duo was out exploring a set of mysterious sky ruins, Boxer's home starship was blown out of the sky! With no one more competent willing to help, Clifford and Boxer volunteer to explore several huge zones in search of the ship's missing parts before whoever shot it down can get their hands on them. Gameplay: In classic Collectathon style, you start off in a hub world with access to only one level containing several collectables. The more collectables you get, the more new levels you unlock! Eventually, you'll unlock a super-tough boss course which, upon completion, will grant you access to the next set of levels! Cone Rush: Clifford's signature move! When activated, he'll transform into a drill and fly in the direction held. This can be done once horizontally and once upward before needing to recharge by landing. Many of the game's challenges are too large to tackle with a standard jump, so mastery of the Cone Rush is critical! On top of that, there are additional moves such the Air Dash and Power Jump which are not required to beat the game, but allow skillful players to pull off some crazy tricks! Content: The game contains 19 main courses, each with multiple objectives. There are also several extra levels, including dedicated final boss and secret final boss levels, 7 endless challenge rush stages, harder rematches against 6 major bosses, unlockable challenge modes, and more! With a high level of skill, players can beat the final boss after around 2.5 hours of gameplay, while completing the game by getting all 100 collectables will take around 5 hours (First time playthroughs will likely take much longer).

rows.short_description: Experience real-world live performances in unique virtual venues with Studio 5, powered by Condense. Attend live events as an avatar and interact with performers and other fans in-game.
rows.description_html: Experience real-world live performances in unique virtual venues with Studio 5 , powered by Condense. Then you'll land in one of Studio 5's virtual venues. You’ll be able to move around, explore the venue and interact with other avatars using your keyboard and mouse. Get ready for a live performance like no other! You can send messages directly to the artist during the performance on our Discord too. Become part of our community At Condense, we want to bring the world's live events to virtual spaces, and we want to hear from you. Tell us what you thought about your Studio 5 experience by joining our Discord community.

rows.name: PROTOTYPE原型
rows.short_description: A cinematic techno-thriller about the fate of the intermediate links of progress.
rows.description_html: Hong Kong, nearest future. Socio-economic crises have not been exhausted, and political contradictions are only getting sharper. However, even against such a background, detached human minds learn to artificially recreate their likeness. Techno-demo about itself, about self-reflection of the unfinished and artificial. My attempt to convey the voice of those who are dismissed and forgotten in the stream of indifferent progress. Novel features: - fully animated graphics in retro style. - different forms of psychological and physical violence. - hard electronic soundtrack. - an intricate plot that requires careful reading.

rows.name: Enkate
rows.short_description: An action-rpg multiplayer with rogue-like influences, in a post-apocalyptic world.
rows.description_html: Enkate is an action rpg rogue like where death is final. Only wings persist after death, rare and precious items which improve as the player progresses. 3 playable classes : - Savage : tank/support - Mercenary : dps - Veterinary heal /support It is necessary to compose balanced teams to defeat the most terrible enemies, and to equip yourself with the best objects found on enemies, or crafted with resources. story Writings handed down for several generations recount the event that radically changed the organization of human society on Earth, destroying its structure and breaking it up into hundreds of thousands of “lands” floating like a cloudy star in space. The earth would have been the battleground of several extra-terrestrial people, and armed with extremely powerful technology, their clashes would have reduced the planet to a heap of floating debris. We don't know for certain how much time has passed since the ultra-bang, given the little temporal indication since the disorganization of the solar system. Days and nights follow each other chaotically in a world where the calendar and the seasons no longer exist. High engineers still estimate that we are currently between 2269 and 2286. On Enkate, the last human institutions organize themselves to ensure their survival. The only hope is the reappropriation of the different lands floating in the form of piles of residues in the universe to exploit the resources still present there. The Enkatonian high engineers have developed a process to open a portal to these different lands, where soldiers are transported in order to acquire information and establish a lasting colony if possible. The portal must nevertheless be set up by a team of explorers to allow the teleportation of the rest of the soldiers, but its lifespan cannot exceed thirty minutes.

rows.name: The Secret of Darkwoods
rows.short_description: Open-world illustrated text-based RPG. Inspired by classic role-playing video games and fantasy gamebooks, the secret of darkwoods is a free game, a non-linear standalone adventure with side quests in a vast world.
rows.description_html: Open-word illustrated text-based RPG The Secret of Darkwoods is an open-world, procedural, text-based RPG that allows players to explore a vast and dangerous world filled with secrets and treasures to discover. The game is set in the mythical land of Emeyralia, a dark and foreboding place where ancient magic and mythical creatures still exist. Players take on the role of a brave adventurer who must journey through the treacherous forests, swamps, and dungeons of Emeyralia in order to uncover the secrets of the land and become a true hero. As they explore the world, players will encounter a wide variety of enemies and obstacles, from fierce beasts and powerful warriors to treacherous traps and hidden dangers. Choose your fate in this non-linear fantasy gamebook. Key Features 800+ Unique Text Pages With Variations 350+ Generated Illustrations Play the main quest (3 to 5 hours), or randomly explore and start side quests Explore villages, cities, dungeons, swamps, caves, forests, cemeteries and temples Music by Dungeon Synth Artists: Percidae, Hjartans, Bounce castle, Alloch Nathir, Kasriel, Erang, Black Rose Tomes, Infernal Symphony, Rap2h In order to survive the dangers of Emeyralia, players will need to use their cunning, strength, and dexterity to overcome their enemies and progress through the game. They can choose from a variety of weapons, armors, and abilities to help them in their quest, and they can also collect valuable treasures and artifacts to aid them on their journey. The game features stunning ai-generated visuals, and its atmospheric soundtrack is composed by seven talented dungeon synth composers. Inspired by Daggerfall and Fighting Fantasy gamebooks, The Secret of Darkwoods is an original RPG experience that will keep players coming back for more. Visit more than 25 towns, villages, and cities. Explore cemeteries, swamps, caves, dungeons, forests, and temples. Talk with people in taverns, in shops, or in the streets, and ask them for scripted quests or procedurally generated ones. Fight deadly monsters.

rows.name: Boba Boyz
rows.short_description: This all-new video game musical centers around a bubble tea shop with a secret: their boba actually brings happiness to its customers! When the boys need a new employee after their last crew member mysteriously disappears, boba won't be the only thing you fall in love with.
rows.description_html: This one-player visual novel features seven unique musical numbers, a cute cafe shop, and a plot that will keep you on your toes! Boba Boyz centers around a bubble tea shop that serves literal happiness in a cup! The boba is irresistible and never fails to brighten customers' days. When you need a summer job, you get to know the four charming baristas running the joint: Aero, Berkeley, Carmen, and Diego. Be careful though, once you've been serenaded and wrapped up in these boys' minigames, boba won't be the only thing bringing a smile to your face.

rows.short_description: Confront the moral dilemma, and then become the hero that saves the world.
rows.description_html: Due to some unwanted circumstances, worlds are on the brink of demise. It is now up to you to determine the fate of the two dimensions. After getting the information you need from the auxiliary Artificial Intelligence, please make the decision you believe is the most justice. Gameplay In this interactive fiction, you get to play as the pilot of a critical mission, and by choosing dialogue branches and making decisions that will pose impacts on the two alternative dimensions, you would become the hero who saves humanity. Your participation in the operation is very much appreciated.

rows.name: Death Gunfire - Kill the Zombie
rows.short_description: An oasis island originally rich in resources, due to the attack of the virus, everyone was infected with the mutated virus, and the whole island was full of the breath of death... How do you defeat these zombies when you are the only survivor on the dead island? Can you survive?...
rows.description_html: An oasis island originally rich in resources, due to the attack of the virus, everyone was infected with the mutated virus, and the whole island was full of the breath of death... How do you defeat these zombies when you are the only survivor on the dead island? Can you survive? You will play as the only survivor on the Dead Island, use your weapons, or shoot the gasoline tanks to kill these zombies. Now put on your haptic vest and VR headset, pick up your VR joystick, and defeat these zombies! Death Gunfire - Kill the Zombie is a zombie shooting game that combines VR and a haptic vest to allow you to go deeper into the environment and shock your senses. The thrill of shooting zombies and the vibration of the haptic vest will swarm as the zombie’s attack, allowing you to have a more incredible gaming experience when playing the game alone. • Addictive single player. • The vibrations from the haptic vest swarm your senses when a zombie attack or a gas tank explodes. • Get up close and personal with zombies to enhance your sense of terror.

rows.name: Aashaa
rows.short_description: A quick atmospheric 2D precision platformer taking place in Medieval India where the player must take back the throne. Repeatedly dying and finding game breaking exploits is heavily encouraged in this short indie title.
rows.description_html: Soon to be crowned, royal princess Aashaa is betrayed by her jealousy-filled brother, Bakwas, and cast down into the depths of the kingdom's dungeon. Untouched for over hundreds of years, the dungeon is a force to be reckoned with. In order to fight for her spot as Queen, Aashaa must brave every floor of the dungeon and find her way out before Bakwas can take the throne. Controller Support: Supported for all gamepad types (Xbox, PS, Valve, etc) Speedrunning: An intuitive speedrunning system is built into the game including a smart timer integrated into the interface and a stats reveal that is shown when the game is completed. This mechanic allows for a more intense gaming experience and encourages the player to find shortcuts. Controls: WASD or Arrows or Left Joystick to Move M or Gamepad Shoulder Buttons to Mute K or Right Click or Gamepad Trigger Buttons to Dash R or Gamepad North Button to Self Destruct Space or Gamepad East Button or Gamepad West Button to Interact Escape or Gamepad Start Button or Gamepad Select Button to Exit to Main Menu

rows.name: Thief Simulator 2: Prologue
rows.short_description: Tired of political exploitation? Join me and let's rebuild our thieving business together! Let's steal cars, radios, and TVs - anything that catches your eye can be yours! Recall what it's like to be a thief in Thief Simulator 2: Prologue!
rows.description_html: You and a buddy robbed a mob. You lived a nice life until assassins burst into your house. They found you. You have to find the hidden contact with your friend and together somehow get out of trouble. Go wild in a typical American town. 4 houses are available for theft, all with different loot. Who knows what you'll find? More than 5 missions to complete (from robberies to planting suspicious packages on people, or taking photos for hire). Buy numerous tools of all kinds - use them to help yourself while plunging into others' houses. Crowbars, lockpicks, binoculars, ATM hacking tools etc.

rows.name: Hexagon Puzzle Blocks
rows.short_description: Get ready to challenge your skills with this isometric puzzle game! Each level presents a new hexagon grid and selection of colored shapes to fit together. With a relaxing yet challenging gameplay experience, this game is perfect for puzzle fans of all levels. Exercise your brain and have fun today!
rows.description_html: Hexagon Puzzle Blocks is an isometric puzzle game designed to engage your mind and relax your senses. With every level, you'll encounter a hexagonal grid that changes in shape and layout, challenging you to fit colorful puzzle pieces perfectly within the grid. Each new level brings fresh configurations, ensuring the gameplay stays varied and stimulating. As you progress, you'll develop your spatial reasoning skills, using logic and creativity to place each shape. The game's calming design, intuitive controls, and soothing atmosphere make it an ideal experience for puzzle enthusiasts and casual players alike. Whether you're looking to unwind or seeking a mental challenge, Hexagon Puzzle Blocks offers hours of satisfying gameplay. With dozens of levels to explore and endless strategies to discover, this game is perfect for anyone who enjoys thoughtful, rewarding puzzles. Try your hand at filling the grid and find yourself immersed in a world of relaxing problem-solving. Key Features: Varied hexagonal grids and puzzle shapes in each level Engaging gameplay that encourages creative thinking and spatial awareness Relaxing atmosphere, designed for casual and puzzle fans alike A satisfying blend of challenge and simplicity to suit all skill levels Start playing today and see how far your puzzle-solving skills can take you!

rows.name: Spaceminers
rows.short_description: Spaceminers is a free-to-play game where you can win Real Gold. Spaceminers: Gold Runner is a timed racing obstacle course and is the first of three game modes in our Early Access phase that will be released throughout 2023 and 2024. The full Spaceminers game launches in Spring 2025.
rows.description_html: WHAT IS SPACEMINERS? During this Early Access phase, you enrol in the Spaceminers Academy as a Cadet, launching your adventure with Spaceminers: Gold Runner . This initial game mode presents you with a timed racing obstacle course where you compete against yourself and the global leaderboard to get the best time over the finish line. As autumn approaches, we will introduce Spaceminers: Gold Warrior , an engaging Co-op PVE Arena, and in early 2024, you can eagerly await the release of the ultimate game mode, Spaceminers: Gold Miner , a Gold-Digging training experience. SPACEMINERS: GOLD RUNNER TOURNAMENT We will host regular in-game tournaments where you run the course and compete for a place on the global leaderboard to win Real Gold . The winners of our in-game tournaments will get a digital proof of ownership of the gold they have won, which is physically held in a Swiss vault. SPACEMINERS GAME MECHANIC Master the art of movement and combat with these core features: Double Jump: Soar to new heights with a trusty double jump. Aerial Maneuvers: Pivot and navigate freely through the air, gaining the upper hand. Stamina System: Manage your stamina to sprint faster, jump farther, and outpace your rivals. The Rockbreaker: Unleash this devastating grenade launcher to clear your path and conquer your foes. Jump into the action and experience the thrill of Spaceminers! SPACEMINERS: GOLD RUNNER The course is divided into eight different zones designed to challenge your skills: Burial Chambers : Master the jump and double jump system Vipers' Pit : Evade deadly fireball obstacles Hades' Lair : Quickly find your way out before the room is filled with acid Boulder Dash : Time your jumps perfectly to avoid being crushed by massive boulders Hoodoo Hop : Eliminate as many enemies as you can without sacrificing speed Laser Chase : Run and avoid the colossal spaceship laser beams Sacred Mountain : Run, climb, and kill enemies to reach the Sacred Temple Sacred Temple : Sprint through the hallowed Temple to collect your Gold Nugget COMING SOON The full Spaceminers game is set to launch in 2025. In this final stage, players will employ all the skills they've honed at the Spaceminers Academy to confront the enemy and claim control over the universe's gold.

rows.name: Find the Birds
rows.short_description: Find the Birds is a free to play educational game about birds and conservation.
rows.description_html: Find the Birds is a free to play educational game about birds and conservation. There are no paid upgrades nor ads. It is a 2D simulated birdwatching experience. Player travel the globe, to places such as Illinois (USA), Japan, Arizona (USA), and British Columbia (Canada). Once there, they explore and try to find local birds, some of which are endangered. For finding them, the receive points. They then use these points in the simulated stores to exchange for tools to do quests to help the birds, such as placing nest boxes. Players can also take photos using the camera tool interface and store them in their simulated album using that interface. Player use such icons and interfaces to play the game.

rows.name: Music Store Simulator Prologue
rows.short_description: With Music Store Simulator Prologue you can lead a musical instruments manufacturing company. Create, sell, earn and reinvest improving and developing your business. Expand your Brand and climb to success in order to become the world's largest manufacturer of musical instruments!
rows.description_html: Join Our Discord Try this About the Game Welcome to the free sample of our game! Music Store Simulator Prologue! In this immersive experience, you get to be the mastermind behind a successful musical instrument manufacturing company. In Music Store Simulator Prologue, you can create, sell, and earn while constantly improving and developing your business. Your customers will come to you with their dream musical instrument requests, and it's up to you to make their dreams a reality. From the assembly work, to painting and configuration, you'll be in charge of the entire process. As you exceed your customers' expectations, your reputation will grow, and more customers will be lining up to place orders with you. With every successful order, you'll earn profits that can be reinvested to buy more advanced tools and unlock additional rooms to expand your atelier. As you improve the quality of your musical instruments, you'll have the opportunity to produce your own unique instruments, add them to your private collection, and even sell them online. In Music Store Simulator Prologue, your success depends on your skill level and experience with different materials and don't forget to keep your warehouse stocked with the parts, paintings, glues, and tools you need to keep production going. Your tools will get old over time, so be sure to invest in better equipment and work tables to speed up procedures and reduce production time. As you grow your brand, you'll have the chance to expand your business by launching advertising campaigns and producing musical instruments in different countries. With the right strategy and financial management, you'll be able to open branches all over the world and become a worldwide musical instruments producer. In the Music Store Simulator Prologue, the possibilities are endless. Are you ready to take on the challenge of building a successful musical instrument manufacturing company? Get started today and unleash your creativity! Features Graphic design and modelling aimed to reproduce accurately all the details of the musical instruments. 2 Electric Guitars to create. More than 50 pieces to use, all customizable in materials and finishing. Production of instruments based on specific orders of customers from all over the world. Typical production steps: joint, screwing, gluing. Realistic timing: painting and glue drying requires different processing times (in the meanwhile will have to progress on other orders). Warehouse management of pieces, paintings, glues and tools. Opportunity to play the musical instruments you created (of course after tuning them!).

rows.name: Postmouse
rows.short_description: Join Postmouse on their very first journey to deliver mail in a treacherous world unfit for a tiny mouse. Explore the ruins, meet charming characters and solve puzzles on your way through an abandoned mansion in this free, student-made adventure - all in one small mouse-sized package!
rows.description_html: From the students of the Animation Workshop, Postmouse is a third-person single-player puzzle platforming game about a timid mouse who has to go on their first adventure to deliver mail. Having always dreamt of the world beyond their little post-office, Postmouse is emboldened to enter the great unknown. Meet charming animals, solve precarious puzzles and explore ruins of a time long past on your mission to deliver letters to those waiting to hear from their loved ones.  ____________________________________________________________________________  FEATURE LIST:  Run around and explore a vast, ruined landscape situated in the midst of a 19th century abandoned mansion - a lovingly handcrafted, overgrown teslapunk landscape.  Solve environmental puzzles, navigate treacherous climates, and most importantly - deliver the mail on time!  Meet and talk to the many diverse residents of the Yellow Woods on your journey - listen to their worries, and they may even help you on your way. Help Postmouse tackle new, exciting situations on a journey that explores the boundaries of their comfort zone.  Collect stamps for the local collector as you explore to receive beautiful concept art and background story.    ____________________________________________________________________________    STUDIO STORY - who are we?   In an isolated town, in the middle of Denmark, surrounded by fields. In a campus made from old military barracks. You find an education in Animation and Computer Graphics. There, in the dark, lit up only by blue light from computer screens, you will find a large group of students with a lot of creative energy. - Critters Collective! Formed, because we had no other choice. Please, do enjoy. It has been made with blood, sweat, tears and the occasional beer.

rows.name: Weird and Unfortunate Things Are Happening
rows.short_description: Join Alicia as she tries to save her niece from a city warped and twisted by otherworldly beings in this eccentric RPG.
rows.description_html: “THERE IS NO NIGHTMARE IN DAYBREAK. THE CITY IS ABSOLUTELY FINE. PLEASE FORGET THAT IT EVER EXISTED.” Weird and unfortunate things are happening in the city of Daybreak. To the rest of the world, the city seems to have simply vanished, but inside, it has become a playground for mysterious beings who see humans only as hosts for their own amusement. Alicia’s a bit strange. She still likes to wear her old baseball jersey, even though her team disbanded over a year ago. She can see otherworldly creatures that no one else seems to notice. She also has weird powers that she keeps hidden from the rest of the world. But when she receives a call for help from her niece in Daybreak, she’ll do anything to save her. Caught up in the struggle along with Alicia are Miriam, a secretary and gun aficionado who only wants to escape the city, Lamar, an overworked middle school English teacher, and Dottie, Alicia’s niece, who has been captured for some nefarious purpose. Explore what’s left of the ravaged city and find your way through surreal otherworldly areas that connect the broken urban shell. Encounter any other citizens who have survived and make contact with the strange entities that now inhabit this realm. Survive. Or be swallowed up by the city and forgotten forever. Turn-based RPG with a survival edge - scrounge the ruined city for restorative items, money, obols (special currency used to buy skills) and rare collectors items to sell for cash! Exploration is always rewarded with new items, equipment, and secrets around every turn! Meet a wide variety of characters, human and otherwise. Allies, survivors, and power-mad villains await! Enjoy tactical battles where fighting wisely will allow you to decimate foes! Strategize your attacks against the eight different types of foe, and figure out the mysterious Unknowns, whose strengths and weaknesses are hidden from you! Customize your characters' battle style with over fifty unique active and passive skills in the Skill Space. There's much more to this world than meets the eye. Find hidden corridors between realities, puzzle through eldritch languages, and collect bizarre curios to help unravel Daybreak's mysteries. Four difficulty levels allow you to adjust the game to your liking, even in the midst of play! From a walk in the park to a deadly journey through hell, play the way you enjoy the most. Estimated playtime is 15-20 hours. Warnings : Game contains flashing lights and swearing.

rows.name: Under Maintenance
rows.short_description: An everyday dramedy otome game that asks the tough question: When a game about love goes down for maintenance, can the game of love begin?
rows.description_html: After a rough day at work, all you want to do is settle in with your favorite otome game, only to realize it's gone down for maintenance. How will you pass these troubling times? Risk going to a watering hole to drown your sorrows in a beverage of choice? Begrudgingly scroll through a dating app to meet your love for the night? Either way - adventure, shenanigans, and hot singles in your area await! Disclaimer: heartache probable - choose wisely. Features A nameable protagonist with configurable skin and hair tones; Partial voice acting; Four routes with multiple endings; Eight CGs; A floofy cat; In-game texting, including with your nameable BFF; Accessibility options - OpenDyslexic and Atkinson Hyperlegible fonts, two text sizes to choose from, darkmode and lightmode textbox options. Content Warnings Strong language/profanity. Mentions of alcohol and alcohol use. Sexually suggestive content without explicit descriptions or depictions.

rows.name: Obsta-Loop
rows.short_description: The Spiritual Successor to our NES classic, Exit-Loop. Its the NEW most Fun-Zaniest, Insaneist, Death-Loopiest, Crypt-Pillageist experience ever! Now with power-ups, masks, Multiplayer AND ON PC! (...Multiplayer coming soon!!!)
rows.description_html: Obsta-Loop is a zany, goofy, yet unforgiving 2d platformer in which you must reach an exit while running a formidable obstacle course. You have no weapons... your only chance is to exit the death gauntlet using evasion, agility power-ups and mastering your environment. Don't forget to collect treasure along the way! There are many paths and many solutions, so pay attention to your surroundings and be prepared to try, and try again. Primary Features: Single player or split screen competitive multiplayer (multiplayer is not yet available and will be added later (see roadmap in Early Access section for details)) Multi-path, Non-linear level design Tons of hidden paths and secrets to discover Permadeath! Die and retry in an unforgiving environment where one-hit kills. Various types of treasure Power-ups and modifiers that change gameplay in fun and interesting ways Varied enemies and hazards Player customization with colors and masks Your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to reach an exit as quickly and as lucratively as possible with the highest score... and your LIFE!!!

rows.name: Kitchen Chaos - Learn Game Development
rows.short_description: NOTE: This is a learning project, learn how to build this game! - The customers are hungry, it's up to you to fill them up with all kinds of interesting interactions!
rows.description_html: NOTE: This is a learning project. This is the final game created by following my FREE YouTube course. The customers are hungry, it's up to you to fill them up! Pick up some ingredients, prepare them, put them on a plate and deliver them. Work with the various counters to prepare them. Pick up a full Cheese block, cut it into slices, then cook a Meat Patty (but don't let it burn!), pick them up on a Plate, add some Bread and you have a nice burger! Features: - 7 Ingredients to use - 3 Complete Recipes to create - 6 unique Kitchen Counters to interact with ----------------------------------------------- Watch the full FREE course video to learn how to build this game step-by-step starting completely from scratch over 45 Lectures. If you're a complete Beginner or a more Intermediate user you will learn a lot from following this course. The quality of the code in this course is on the same level as my own games, so you will learn how to make games just like a Professional Indie Game Developer using clean code and good project architecture. You will learn the basics of Unity and C#, how to make a Character Controller and detect Collisions. How to do Physics Raycasts, use C# Interfaces and Events. How to use Scriptable Objects, Shader Graph, build a UI and tons more! Everything we're going to do is going to be focused on writing good easy to understand clean code. Meaning that I will not be teaching you bad practices that some beginner tutorials teach. The code that we're going to write here is production quality code , it is not a throwaway demo. The quality of the code and the structure of the game that we're going to build is on the same level of quality as my own Steam games Like I said this is a completely FREE course but it has the same level of quality as my paid courses. Check it out on my YouTube channel. The FREE Multiplayer Course expansion is out now! Learn how to synchronize data across multiple clients, how to decide on Server Authoritative vs Client Authoritative, learn about RPCs and NetworkVariables, what data should be server-side and what can be client-side, learn how to make a Character Selection scene, Multiplayer Lobbies and connect your players together with Relay. This course starts off exactly from where the singleplayer course left off, you can watch that course to see how we got to the starting point. All the code here was written during the course, there was nothing done off-screen. Just like the singleplayer course, here I will be teaching you how to write good high quality clean code just like I use in my own Steam games. About me: I've been an Indie Game Developer for over 10 years and 5 years ago I started the Code Monkey YouTube channel to share my knowledge to help you learn how to make your own games. Check out my games on Steam and then watch my YouTube channel to see how I made them! For some interactive learning check out my Free Code Monkey App here on Steam

rows.name: Jump Tale
rows.short_description: Jump Tail is a simple 2D Platformer with 10 different playable “Characters”. It's your Goal to finish all the 110 Levels with the best possible time and the least possible deaths.
rows.description_html: Jump Tale is a simple 2D Platformer with 10 different playable “Characters”. It's your Goal to finish all the 110 Levels with the best possible time and the least possible deaths. Features 11 Different Worlds 10 Different Characters 110 Levels in Total Switches between Characters in Levels Different dangers to dodge Time and Death tracking Can you beat the levels with the least deaths possible? Can you beat your own best times and always get faster? Post your score in the Community hub!

rows.name: Eggsplorer
rows.short_description: A game in which you control an egg-shaped player to explore 4 unique levels.
rows.description_html: This game is a single player game that can be enjoyed offline. The story starts in a mysterious temple. Your goal is to manipulate the egg to capture four unique stages, obtain the owl statue, and open the gate leading to the back of the temple. 'A stage with a gate that grows and shrinks' 'A stage with glass that breaks when dropped using height' 'Staging puzzles offline using a mirror image of yourself' 'A stage that uses a portal to transfer objects' These four stages await you. Solve puzzles to get goal items. One stage can be cleared in about 15 minutes. What awaits after obtaining all the owl statues? Please check it out. Also, find 3 hidden items in each stage and take on the challenge! Trailer BGM scratch record Trailer BGM by HURT RECORD

rows.name: Monster Tower Quest
rows.short_description: You play as a hero on a quest to reach the top of a mysterious tower filled powerful monsters. You will need to use your puzzle-solving skills to match 3 or more of the same colored gems together to defeat your enemies as you make your way up the tower.
rows.description_html: You play as a hero on a quest to reach the top of a mysterious tower. The tower is filled powerful monsters that stand in your way. To defeat these monsters and progress through the tower, you will need to use your puzzle-solving skills to match 3 or more of the same colored gems together. As you make your way up the tower, you will encounter a variety of different monsters. By matching the correct gems and power ups together, you can unleash powerful attacks that will help you take down even the toughest foes. Each gem you match is kept, and can be used to create more monters. Collect monsters to build up a team of powerful allies to help you on your journey. This game combines the match 3 puzzle gameplay with the fun of collecting monsters!

rows.name: Hank: Straightjacket
rows.short_description: The time-traveling vigilante Hank has been captured by the devious Unraveler. However, before the crime genius gets rid of the hero, he must satisfy his curiosity - How has this pathetic drunk so easily thwarted so many of his plans?
rows.description_html: The time-traveling vigilante Hank has been captured by the devious Unraveler. However, before the crime genius gets rid of the hero, he must satisfy his curiosity - How has this pathetic drunk so easily thwarted so many of his plans? Will Hank be able to use the villain's obsessions against him to escape from this grim situation? Hank: Straightjacket is a narrative bite-sized game combining traditional point-and-click gameplay with a time manipulation mechanic. rows.name: Deck of the Dead
rows.short_description: 'Deck of the Dead' is a thrilling roguelike deckbuilder game set in a dark, mysterious world of vampires. Players will take on the role of a powerful vampire on a quest for ultimate power as they build their deck, defeat enemies, and explore a randomly generated world filled with danger and secrets.
rows.description_html: Deck of the Dead' is a thrilling roguelike deck builder game set in a dark and eerie world of vampires. Players will embark on an epic journey as a powerful vampire seeking to conquer the land and claim ultimate power. The game is set in a randomly generated world filled with dangerous enemies, mysterious secrets, and powerful treasures. Players will use their deckbuilding skills to create the ultimate deck of vampire abilities and weapons, allowing them to defeat their enemies and progress deeper into the world. Customizable Decks: Build your own custom deck of cards by selecting from a range of powerful abilities, equipment, and allies, and tailor it to your preferred playstyle. Unique Enemies: Battle against a variety of enemies that pose different threats, including undead creatures, hunters, and other supernatural beings. Evolving Gameplay: Over time, new cards and abilities become available, making the gameplay richer and more complex as you progress through the game. Beautiful Artwork: Enjoy stunning artwork that captures the dark and brooding atmosphere of the vampire world, from haunting landscapes to terrifying creatures. Easy to Learn, Hard to Master: The game is easy to learn, but hard to master, making it accessible to players of all skill levels, while still providing a satisfying challenge for experienced players.

In these different realms you will find special data cells called nodes, which you should punch and break following the rhythm. Move your body in the nodes flow and save the music! Dance Loop VR is an experimental game from the developer Fibrum where fantastic VR realm becomes alive with electronic music. The soundtrack is partly written by AI and partly by a music artist Ambidextrous. Will you feel the difference? Game features: · The rhythm VR game with an original cardio dance moves · Vivid realms inspired by science fiction of 20th century · Unusual movement schemes, which combine gameplay with fitness · Charging electronic soundtrack from Yandex Music

rows.name: V-Art- VR Painting Studio
rows.short_description: A casual VR painting simulation. It's free. And goofy.
rows.description_html: I made this game as spin-off of another project that unfortunately got canned, but I thought the painting aspect was pretty cool so I decided to release it as its own standalone game. It's a simple lighthearted painting simulation with several different brushes all with their own physics-based behavior, so you can really mess around with them and see what kind of cool effects you can create. Really, there's no pressure to create anything 'good' or 'professional'. It's just a fun way to mess around with different colors and textures. Plus, there's an optional DLC if you want to support me that lets you paint on a 3D character model. I'll just say, it's pretty fun to see your creations come to life on a more tangible canvas. But again, just to be clear, this game isn't meant to be a professional tool for artists, there are better tools for that. Still, though it's not a professional tool, I think you'll be able to create some amazing pieces of art. It's not the most advanced painting game out there, but it's free and it's a fun way to explore your creativity. Give it a try and see what you can come up with. Some notable features: -Physically controlled arms and objects really connect you to the canvas, or, mess you up when your hand wibbles, you choose -Dynamic paint wetness that dries over time -Simulated brush texture gives your strokes character -Spray paints and blobs that drip when they pool up -Mix paints on your palette so you can pretend like you aren't already living in a simulation -Some of the paint dried up, so we recycled it into goo. By this, I mean for some reason you can drip goo onto your canvas. Or just play with it like slime, everyone loves slime -Paint all the walls and floor to give your studio a personal touch -Display your created works upon the walls like your own miniature art gallery -An inexplicable cellular device that allows you to capture stereoscopic renders of your work -Import your own brush textures for unique styles -Add custom stencils so you can follow along with that one Bob tutorial where he starts with a perfect circle for the sun -An ancient flatscreen television from the past that has been retrofitted with the latest YouTube playing capabilities, so you can watch Mr. Ross paint faster than you while you try to keep up -Menus -Paint inside the safety of your studio that you'll notice, has no doors. This is intentional and not cause for concern. Alternatively, drop the walls (literally) and behold a lush grassy field powered by the future technology of GrassFlow™. Do note, you will still be trapped inside the studio despite it appearing as if you may actually walk into the wilderness, we apologize if the simulation appears too real. -Seamless autosave relieves you of the stress caused by imminent data loss. Or overwrite your work so you can live with all your happy little accidents -A mysterious orb -Strange dystopian future where painting supplies are dispensed out of thin air from manually operated vending machines powered by lever action -Am I talking the features up too much? Probably.

Some notable features: -Physically controlled arms and objects really connect you to the canvas, or, mess you up when your hand wibbles, you choose -Dynamic paint wetness that dries over time -Simulated brush texture gives your strokes character -Spray paints and blobs that drip when they pool up -Mix paints on your palette so you can pretend like you aren't already living in a simulation -Some of the paint dried up, so we recycled it into goo. By this, I mean for some reason you can drip goo onto your canvas. Or just play with it like slime, everyone loves slime -Paint all the walls and floor to give your studio a personal touch -Display your created works upon the walls like your own miniature art gallery -An inexplicable cellular device that allows you to capture stereoscopic renders of your work -Import your own brush textures for unique styles -Add custom stencils so you can follow along with that one Bob tutorial where he starts with a perfect circle for the sun -An ancient flatscreen television from the past that has been retrofitted with the latest YouTube playing capabilities, so you can watch Mr. Ross paint faster than you while you try to keep up -Menus -Paint inside the safety of your studio that you'll notice, has no doors. This is intentional and not cause for concern. Alternatively, drop the walls (literally) and behold a lush grassy field powered by the future technology of GrassFlow™. Do note, you will still be trapped inside the studio despite it appearing as if you may actually walk into the wilderness, we apologize if the simulation appears too real. -Seamless autosave relieves you of the stress caused by imminent data loss. Or overwrite your work so you can live with all your happy little accidents -A mysterious orb -Strange dystopian future where painting supplies are dispensed out of thin air from manually operated vending machines powered by lever action -Am I talking the features up too much? Probably.

rows.name: Endless
rows.short_description: A Horror Adventure Game with Multiple Endings
rows.description_html: After feeling restless, you decide to explore your apartment building. It doesn't take long for you to figure out that things are definitely not normal. Find all the endings, the secrets, and unveil hidden truths about yourself. Endless is a Horror Adventure game heavily inspired by games like The Stanley Parable. Rather than focusing on one specific genre of horror, this game takes inspiration from many other games and media alike. Gameplay and Features: - Explore your apartment in this non-linear Horror Game! - Experience creepy settings, jump scares, and chase sequences in this game! - Maneuver your way around and try to find all seven endings! Some might be difficult to find! - Each ending is a completely different experience! They each celebrate different aspects of the horror genre. - Think outside of the box and find the three secrets! These are definitely harder to find! - This game has roughly 30-45 minutes of gameplay.

rows.name: Duelyst GG
rows.short_description: Duelyst is a unique hybrid 1v1 card game where you play your units and spells onto a 9x5 board where you can position them to your advantage. You can pick from different generals with unique Bloodbound spells. All 800+ cards are unlocked so you can play anything you want from the start.
rows.description_html: A UNIQUE CARD GAME / BOARD GAME HYBRID Assemble your deck and play units and spells onto a board. A game that focuses on thoughtful decision-making and strategic positioning. All cards Unlocked All 800+ cards are unlocked, ready for you to use. Pick from 6 factions with distinguishing characteristics and different generals with unique Bloodbound spells. Highly Competitive Face people in Ladder 1v1 or draft a deck and fight in the gauntlet. Apart from Steam, Duelyst GG can be played on iPhone and Android all using the same account. Fight across platforms! Gameplay focused While Duelyst GG is fully functional on the gameplay front, we are still working on the UI and User experience. New features are added at a rapid pace. Soon we plan on releasing a roguelike deck builder for single player too. For those who played the original Duelyst: Duelyst GG was written from scratch based off the last patch. From there we have balanced and added new cards. This means 1 draw and Bloodbound Spells are in. But old bugs like broken Vale Ascension and annoying ddos decks are out.

rows.name: City idle
rows.short_description: Experience a city-building game, where the citizens are fully simulated and every decision you make impacts their lives. From the Stone Age to the Iron Age and beyond, watch your civilization evolve and progress under your guidance.
rows.description_html: City building game with fully simulated citizens! You start with nothing, you create fire and people start gathering, build huts and a civilization begins! From here you travel through different time periods from prehistoric to bronze age to iron age and so on. Initially starting with basics like collect berries, growing crops and animals, improving efficiency with tools. Eventually create ships to colonize many more islands to grow your empire! What to expect: * Thought provoking challenges in managing your civilization. * Research many new technologies to improve your city. * Figuring out efficient layouts for your city. Disclaimer: This game is harder than average- prepare to be challenged! Have fun! :)

rows.name: March, March! European Warfare
rows.short_description: A minimalistic, turn-based wargame without randomness that puts emphasis on outmanouvering and striking the enemy with diverse unit types. Fight in the field, besiege forts or hunt down enemy king in local or streamed PvP. Illustrated with digitized, centuries-old copperplates.
rows.description_html: March, March! is a minimalistic, turn-based wargame, in which Players control two opposing armies clashing on variety of battlefields. There is no randomness, so you can predict outcomes of the upcoming skirmishes and plan the whole battle ahead. Major emphasis is put on positioning your troops, outmanouvering the enemy and coordinating moves of diverse unit types. Lead armies composed of units inspired by the 16th-17th century warfare, e.g. swordsmen, musketeers or hussars. You can get to the enemy’s rear with fast moving troops, fire at the enemy forts with artillery, order a daring frontal attack and many more. The game evokes atmosphere of the Europe’s early modern period thanks to the use of digitized, centuries-old copperplates from the collection of National Library of Poland and historical music pieces performed by Jonathan Sayles. Features: - fight with 6 unit types inspired by war culture of Europe’s early modern period, - play in 3 game modes: battle the oposing forces, kill the enemy king or capture strategic points, - clash on 24 battlefields of diverse sizes and characteristics, - play out a small, quick skirmish or a massive line battle with up to 44 units on the field, - battle in local PVP (Hotseat) or online via Steam Remote Play Together function, - game illustrated with fragments of 20+ digitized, 16th-17th copperplates. Several historical music pieces, recorded and performed by Jonathan Sayles, were used in the game. They have been shared by the Author under Creative Commons Attribution license. Digitized versions of copperplates coming from XVII, XVIII and XIX century were used in the game. They have been published as Public Domain on Polona.pl portal managed by The National Library of Poland.

rows.name: World Annihilation Operations Parts I-IV
rows.short_description: Explore this set of 4 distinct short experimental games and experience impossible worlds filled with audiovisual and narrative contradictions.
rows.description_html: Short summary: World Annihilation Operations Parts I-IV is a set of 4 short experimental games examining the impact of audiovisual and narrative contradictions within fictional worlds. Each game showcases a vastly different world with various mechanics, and is the result of a research-based creative process meant to discover technical operations, inspired in each case by a unique act of creation and able to generate contradictions/impossible figures within initially logically 'possible' worlds. Some overall primary features: Four unique experiences around 12-20 minutes each. Varied, dynamic and often unexpected audiovisual effects. A progression in ways of approaching contradictions and impossible figures in games, from an observational stance to a linear exploration format with light puzzles, a narrative approach, and an engaged discourse. A timing system for speed-running Parts II-III-IV (see related achievements). In-depth description: Part I: Fly freely through a 3-D scene of a strange city in the middle of the desert, while various audiovisual events occur. Audiovisual contradictions/instabilities appear in a predetermined and timed order, inspired by the idea of propagation (propagating light, shadows, objects, camera views, etc.). Part II: Experience a short and abstract adventure through a profoundly unstable world, with a few spatial puzzles. Contradictions may emerge from various elements in the fiction suddenly switching their nature. Part III: Save the world from a demon who has taken a liking to mixing realities together in this short exploration game. Impossible figures may emerge from the superposition of unexpected elements within the fictional world. Part IV: Experience a metaphorical rendition of the life of an unknown creature attempting to escape its fate in the food industry. Through the means of lies , fictional contradictions are created and used to represent contradictions perceivable in the real world between popular beliefs and real events. This compilation of games is done in the context of a PhD research on the integration of logical contradictions in video game fiction. It is expected that at least one more compilation of similar experiments emerges from this research. Following the publication of these works, the operations developed through the creation process should lead to the development of one much larger adventure game in the coming years. This set of games is entirely free. If you would like to support the developer, please consider purchasing one of the DLCs (they do not add any content within the game!).

rows.name: Emotions: Social MeDie
rows.short_description: Can't get off the smarthone? Be careful because your every interaction will affect your emotions and if they become too intense they could turn into real demons, which you will be forced to face when display turns off. Can you survive long enough?
rows.description_html: Spending too much time on Social Media? Has your virtual life become more important than the real one? Can't get off yourself away from your smartphone? So be careful, because your every interaction will affect your emotions and if they become too intense they could turn into real Demons that you'll have to face when display turns off. Emotions: Social MeDie is the Free prologue focused only on Social Media of the project: 'Project Emotions' currently under development, this version does not represent the final product, which will be richer in content, with deeper mechanics and a overall more complex and complete gaming experience. Its purpose is to introduce the core mechanics and immerse the player in the overall atmosphere that will be in the full game. Game Features Control your emotions, if they reach their maximum value you will lose. Obtain as many Followers as possible and increase your score. Interact with social media to obtein new cards, every interactions will also enhance the Demons's power. Fight 21 different Demons. Hundreds of AI generated illustrations, 6 main emotions, 30 cards, 21 Demons, 7 possible endings. Between Simulation and Survival, a strategy game with Horror tints Relax using social media but not too much...when display turns off you will be forced to face your Demons who will try to take you out. Can you survive long enough?

rows.name: MiniBob
rows.short_description: MiniBob is a 2D side view puzzle game, focused on exploring the enviroment, and getting to know the characters. Almost every object has something to tell, some times nothing important, but other times…
rows.description_html: MiniBob tells a story about technology which we invited in our lives, our home. It raises the question which consequences this can have. The player gets a chance to step into the perspective of the small robot; MiniBob. As MiniBob you must take care of your household; Claire and Billy. After reading some positive reviews about you, they decided to buy you, and welcomed you into their home. Remember, you must make them happy, that is your purpose. So complete you’re tasks and get to know your household. Good luck! Features Combining fun and realism, by making ethical decisions. Explore the house, and uncover hidden secrets. Complete tasks to make your household happy!

rows.name: Reborn A Zombie!
rows.short_description: A slice-of-life visual novel about the hardships and joys of a trans girl transformed into a zombie.
rows.description_html: Starting from today, My name is Dawn! Don’t I look cute in this? Dawn recently found out she’s transgender, and she’s ready to embrace this side of herself to its fullest! In a world where humans coexist peacefully with vampires, demons, and other magical beings, she hopes to transform her body for the best. Helped by Lucia, her asexual succubus friend, she soon finds herself in a tricky situation: her body has changed, yes, but she’s also a zombie now! “Reborn a zombie!” is a queer story about friendship, acceptance, and a world full of cute monsters! Will she find happiness at the end of her journey, or is it the start of a new one? Our protagonist! She’s chipper, curious about anything magic, and wants to live in a body that is right for her! Her journey will lead her to Providence, the new capital of magiis. A succubus from the Demon Realm and talented spell weaver. Her asexuality often clashes with people’s expectation of a succubus, but she found relief in Dawn’s innocent friendship. A powerful dragon who decided to help Dawn in this bizarre world, but a certain demon isn’t too keen on having her around… -17k words (about 2 hours of playtime) -Backgrounds animated with visual effects for more magic! -A queer story featuring a trans protagonist, a very cute ace succubus and a very buff dragon-lady!

rows.name: Find the Energy
rows.short_description: Find the Energy is a free educational game for all ages that teaches about renewable energy via exploration and quests.
rows.description_html: Find the Energy is a spin-off game to our successful Find the Birds and Find the Whales free educational games for all ages. In Find the Energy, players choose from a male or female avatar. They then choose a place, based on an actual location, from the globe, to travel to in their solar-powered ultralight. Once they arrive, for example, at Pincher Creek in southwest Alberta, Canada, they are greeted by a non-player character (NPC). The NPC represents local companies that are doing work regarding renewable energy development and installation in the area. Players are taught by the NPC about green energy, such as wind power. They are shown around the area. They take photos for their photo album. Then they collect information cards about the energy history of the area, like hydroelectricity. They also collect points, which they will use in the store to purchase (no actual currency or paid upgrades in this totally free game!) tools which will help them complete quests. Players find the parts and then set up three wind turbines. After doing this, they connect them to the power grid and turn on the system. Then they get a charging station so they can connect it and charge their farm tractor. Players receive rewards such as an badge and a winter pass so they can view the area in winter.

rows.name: Behind The Barrier
rows.short_description: The year is 1440, and you are a priest that was brave enough to travel to the village of Rosenwood to cleanse the evil spirit (demon) that has been lurking there. . .
rows.description_html: Background: It was 666CE (the beginning of the medieval days) and some people settled in an area that they named Rosenwood. They built a town and lived in this hidden location within the forest and mountains for many years. For the next 100 years or so, they grew and expanded the barrier of the village, but one day, everything had been lost. Some evil people who had recently come to the village disguised as merchants waited until night to open a portal from hell just above the village. It was from a curse that had been set up with multiple layers as precaution that nobody would be able to break it in the future. Just as the evil merchants had panned, A demon was able to escape hell through the deathly red portal above and could roam freely throughout the village. Because of the limitations of the curse, the demon could only stay within the barriers of the village and stand in moonlight. The merchants also set up this curse to close the village gates when it turned night so that the people living within could not escape from the Demons wrath. In a single night, the demon had devoured and massacred the entire village. New stories about people who have gone to the village and never returned were told. Other stories such as hearing devil-like noises from outside the village kept people far away from that forest. Exorcists have tried many times to try and break the curse that holds the demon chained within the barriers of the town, but have failed every time because the curse can only be deactivated at night which is when the Demon is out and ready to kill. The year is 1440, and you are a priest that was brave enough to travel to the village to cleanse the evil spirit (demon) that has been lurking in the village. What do you do? Once you enter the village, you have to collect Celtic crosses that are spread out in random houses across the village. Using the crosses, you have to activate the trap in the middle of the village and make sure the demon gets caught in it. Your on the clock: You are on a timer so make sure you don’t waste too much time looking for crosses. There are 3 runes which act as safe houses on the map and unless you reach them before the time runs out, the Demon will be on the hunt. Also make sure you enter the rune with as little time left as possible because the timer will reset with less time each rune. They built a town and lived in this hidden location within the forest and mountains for many years. For the next 100 years or so, they grew and expanded the barrier of the village, but one day, everything had been lost. Some evil people who had recently come to the village disguised as merchants waited until night to open a portal from hell just above the village. It was from a curse that had been set up with multiple layers as precaution that nobody would be able to break it in the future. Just as the evil merchants had panned, A demon was able to escape hell through the deathly red portal above and could roam freely throughout the village. Because of the limitations of the curse, the demon could only stay within the barriers of the village and stand in moonlight. The merchants also set up this curse to close the village gates when it turned night so that the people living within could not escape from the Demons wrath. In a single night, the demon had devoured and massacred the entire village. New stories about people who have gone to the village and never returned were told. Other stories such as hearing devil-like noises from outside the village kept people far away from that forest. Exorcists have tried many times to try and break the curse that holds the demon chained within the barriers of the town, but have failed every time because the curse can only be deactivated at night which is when the Demon is out and ready to kill. rows.name: Mythrel
rows.short_description: Mythrel: Trading Card Game. A multiplayer online trading card game! Build your collection and decks, battle your friends, trade cards, and dominate the weekly Leagues!
rows.description_html: Mythrel: Trading Card Game . Enter a mystical realm beyond the boundaries of our world, where a magical portal has recently opened on Earth. Join in the epic battles as a player in this hybrid multiplayer online digital and physical trading collectible card game. Build your collection, fine-tune your decks, challenge your friends, trade cards, and dominate the Weekly Leagues. Are you ready to Enter The Realm of MYTHREL? A CARD GAME THAT’S WORTH YOUR TIME Mythrel offers a unique in-game card trading feature. Don't like a card you pulled from a booster pack? Transfer it to a friend! With Mythrel, building a competitive collection of cards is not only effortless, but also enjoyable. Collect new cards to build your decks and dominate the competition as you play Mythrel, the ultimate trading card game experience. BEAUTIFUL ARTWORK Experience the beauty and immersiveness of MYTHREL with its stunning hand-drawn art that brings every card to life. Not only is the game fun to play, but also a joy to collect. The intricate details of each card will keep you enthralled and engaged as you build your collection and perfect your strategies. ENDLESS GAMEPLAY OPTIONS MYTHREL offers a variety of game modes to suit every player's preference. Challenge a friend in a quick Tranquil realm match, compete in the highly competitive weekly League, or try your luck with the randomized Vortex realms (matches). MYTHREL's selection of game modes ensures that there's always something new and exciting to discover. SKILL BEATS LUCK Outwit your opponents with smart strategies or overpower them with powerful cards - no matter your deck, MYTHREL's unique round-based gameplay offers a wide range of strategic options for you to dominate the battlefield. The skillful use of cards and careful planning will give you the edge in every match. AWE-INSPIRING CARDS TO COLLECT AND TRADE Unlock the full potential of MYTHREL with the over 124+ unique cards available in the first edition set, 'Enter The Realm.' Discover a vast array of species such as Humans, Orcs, Dragons, Elves, Sobekians, Mius and many more, as well as spell and equipment cards. With 5 rarities to collect, Common, Uncommon, Rare, Mythical, and Exotic, the possibilities are endless. Build your collection and trade with other players to create the ultimate deck.

rows.name: Last Dawn
rows.short_description: Last Dawn is a short first-person atmospheric exploration game set in the year 2082. You will explore an open world map, hide from guards, and find a way to escape.
rows.description_html: Last Dawn is a short first-person exploration game set in the year 2082. While attempting to flee a dystopian city, your ship was shot down. You awake in a cold wasteland known as the Old World. You must find a way out, but be careful. You are not alone here. FIND THE TERMINALS You will have to find the five terminals and deactivate them to escape. HIDE You will be hunted by the city's android guards. Avoid being spotted and captured. RUN If you are spotted the guards will run after you and attempt to capture you. It's best to run and find another way around them. ESCAPE Once all five terminals are deactivated the door will open, allowing you to escape.

rows.name: The Wailer
rows.short_description: A highly stylized horror adventure game set in the depths of an ancient dungeon. With torch in hand, explore and find a way to escape before falling prey to the unspeakable horror that lurks within.
rows.description_html: The Wailer is a highly stylized horror adventure game set in the depths of an ancient dungeon. With torch in hand, explore and find a way to escape before falling prey to the unspeakable horror that lurks within. Delve into a dark and mysterious dungeon. Discover secrets and uncover hidden passageways as you explore. Find the way out before the darkness consumes you. The dungeon is also filled with challenges and obstacles, so players must be vigilant and use all the resources at their disposal. With every twist and turn, players will come closer to unraveling the mysteries of the dungeon and ultimately, escaping. Light plays a crucial role in the gameplay as it not only helps the player navigate and uncover secrets but also protects them from the darkness that threatens to consume them. Be warned, the safety of the light comes at a price. Hello! I am Ethan Robichaux and I solo developed this game over 6 months. At the time of The Wailer releasing I am a college student and I create games in my free time. This is my 3rd full Steam game and first fully 3D game. This game is completely free because I want as many people as possible to be able to play and enjoy the game I worked very hard on!

rows.name: Through time
rows.short_description: Do you like challenging platform games? Then this game is for you!
rows.description_html: Do you like challenging platform games? Then this game is made for you! In this game, you will have to overcome increasingly difficult obstacles using your sense of timing and reflexes. In infinite mode, you will have to travel the longest distance possible, avoiding obstacles that appear endlessly and using your power-ups to help you. You will also be able to participate in weekly challenges which will offer you special levels with particular conditions and which will allow you to win exclusive rewards. The game has a simple but colorful graphic style reminiscent of arcade games, it is suitable for all ages but mainly targets young players who like dynamic games.

rows.name: Alignment
rows.short_description: A challenging and engaging puzzle game that will require you to move colored objects and place them on their respective platforms to explore through a series of increasingly complex levels.
rows.description_html: ALIGNMENT is a challenging and engaging puzzle game that will put your logical reasoning skills to the test. By moving colored objects and placing them on their respective platforms, you will explore through a series of increasingly complex levels. With an average playtime of 1 hour, this game will challenge your ability to piece together various systems as you progress. ENDINGS: Your journey towards success will determine a specific and unique conclusion. Can you piece together clues and uncover all 5 possible endings? ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- THIS IS A CHALLENGING GAME: Alignment serves as a way to challenge your proficiency in unraveling complex and enigmatic systems and puzzles. By identifying patterns within the puzzles, you can gain a deeper insight into the system and establish a solid understanding of its underlying principles. DO NOT BE DISCOURAGED: During gameplay, there will be instances when using the undo feature becomes necessary. This doesn't imply that you've made a mistake in the puzzle. The undo feature is a vital game mechanic, not a reset button. Take advantage of the undo tool by exploring the end of the stage and experimenting with each machine. This approach will help you gain a deeper understanding of the game and enhance your overall experience.

rows.name: Oxygen Caliber
rows.short_description: Use recoil and grappling hooks to navigate in a dangerous deep space environment as a stranded astronaut.
rows.description_html: Oxygen Caliber is an exciting physics based puzzle game where you traverse the unforgiving void of space. Your mission is to navigate the galaxy through wormholes! Unfortunately, local clusters of planets stand in your way. Use your wits and a bit of creativity to safely explore the uncharted regions of space! USE YOUR TOOLS TO TRAVERSE SPACE Strategically jump from planet to planet with your space age grappling hook! Feeling adventurous? Catch a ride on a wayward meteor! EXPLORE THE GALAXY Discover a wide variety of planets, stars, and asteroids! Some want to pull you in, others want to push you away, and some sport some stylish rings! But be careful, some planets are more friendly than others! EXPERIENCE A UNIQUE COSMIC ATMOSPHERE Beautiful 2D graphics, outstanding sound design and above all, an atmosphere that’s out of this world! Oxygen Caliber was created as part of the University of Southern California’s Interactive Design and Production class by developers Robbie Goldberg and Andi Ren, with music by Justin Petrovych. For more information, please visit our publisher page. To learn more about the USC Games program, the #1 Games Program in the world, check out the USC Games website, linked to the right.

rows.name: Blue Wednesday: Prologue
rows.short_description: An experience filled with stories and music See the world through the eyes of jazz pianist, Morris. takes you through a dream-like adventure through jazz and love, and failure.
rows.description_html: FOLLOW & WISHLIST THE FULL GAME HERE! New characters, backgrounds, music, minigames, stories, and more. About the Game An interactive game where the player can move through the city and chat with various NPCs, play the piano, and interact with lots of other items through the main character, Morris. The main parts of the game are mini games and adventures, and learning more about Morris's story through vivid cutscenes that pop up at key moments in the game. Adventures and Stories The player becomes jazz pianist Morris, of Evans City. The player navigates the city full of NPCs and objects while interacting with them. With various mini games, cutscenes, and conversations with different characters, live through jazz pianist Morris's experiences. Mini games Mini games help engross players by popping according to the main character's various actions. A cast of characters, each with their own special story With more than 10 supporting NPCs, we can hear more than 10 different stories. The story changes depending on the choices the player makes during the conversation between the main character and the NPC and will allow players to collect items. Activities & Explore Collect your collection by visiting various places in the city and talking to various characters. Collect sheet music Choose wisely! They player's choices will shape the narrative and determine the albums they can collect. Tango and bossa nova, cool jazz to modern jazz. You can play them during the rhythm games during game play. Rare music albums Players can collect rare music albums through various interactions throughout Evans City such as helping another player solve a problem or looking through piles of old LPs in the back of a music shop. Collect these albums from diverse musical genres and play them on the turntable in Morris's room. Listen to and enjoy the rare albums hidden around the city.

rows.name: More than words
rows.short_description: Marian Anderson is an experimental android created by Soul Shell Corporation. However, she was abandoned in the laboratory facilities. Your mission is to contact her, persuade her to trust you and escape from the laboratory.
rows.description_html: More than words is a conversational game in which you can Chat with a smart, friendly, and beautiful chatbot powered by GOOGLE GEMMA 3. The chatbot remembers your past conversations. The conversations are local, so they're anonymous. If you are looking for a game where you can have a casual, friendly, or even romantic conversation, then More than words is for you! NOTE: ALTHOUGH THE GAME HAS BEEN RELEASED, THE AUTHOR HAS DECIDED TO EXPAND AND IMPROVE THE VIDEO GAME, THEREFORE IT IS STILL IN DEVELOPMENT. The SOUL SHELL CORPORATION created androids that are virtually indistinguishable from humans. The androids were used in the world mainly as slaves. The corporation was working on a new generation of female android with superior capabilities in intelligence, strength and agility to serve the US special forces. However, the testing phase was suspended because the slave androids started revolts in various parts of the world and consequently all types of androids were declared illegal. Now, the special forces composed mainly of cyborgs (modified humans) and robots were ordered to eliminate all androids under the law: Androids have the right to remain silent and die Written in C++ with Unreal engine 5. Text generation using Google Gemma 3. Speech recognition using OpenAI Whisper. Speech synthesis using Microsoft SAPI.

rows.name: Towers Together: Beginnings
rows.short_description: Towers together is a cooperative tower defense game with cards. Combine your cards with your friends’ cards to achieve powerful combo, but get ready to fail and laugh together. Build towers, cast spells, have fun with friends!
rows.description_html: DISCLAIMER: Hey there! Welcome to the first version of 'Towers Together' - we're so excited to have you here! We want to be upfront with you - this version may have some bugs and balance issues, but don't worry, we're working on improving the game every day. We'd love to hear from you too! If you run into any issues or have any feedback to share, join our social medias and help us create the best game possible. Let's work together to make 'Towers Together' an epic adventure! Towers Together - the title already gives you a hint, doesn't it? That's right, our game is all about towers and playing together. Only teamwork lets you stand against the hordes of goblins, trolls and other hideous creatures. The Book of Knowledge calls for your protection from oncoming armies of enemies! Be prepared for anything, terrible goblins and trolls only waiting for your mistake. And of course who would resist throwing some dynamite at them for their dirty deals! Basics Our co-op multiplayer game is based on the classic tower defense mechanics combined with a card system. Your team has to protect the Book of Knowledge from the invasion of evil creatures coming wave after wave. How? Build towers, place traps, cast spells or greet your enemies with a hail of arrows. Your actions depend on your and your friends’ cards. Create strategies, experiment and adapt! Multiplayer At the beginning of the game you connect to friend's lobby or starting game solo from your own lobby. Maximum players amount per each lobby is four. If you playing with a friend (maybe even with a several ones), try to plan your next moves together to overcome your opponents. Sometimes lack of communication and joint strategy can lead to lost game. Autochess In this game, you get to earn gold each turn, which you can then use to buy cards from the shop. At first, you'll only have access to weaker cards like 'crossbow' or 'lightbulb'. But don't worry, as you progress through the game, you'll have the chance to upgrade your shop and acquire more powerful cards. Just keep in mind that this may require additional investments of gold. Remember, your choices on how to spend your resources can have a big impact on your success in the game. So, choose wisely and have fun playing! Cards Any game action requires playing a card. Each player starts with one card in his hand at the very start of the game. Different types of cards allow to perform different actions. For instance: place building, cast aoe spell against enemies or summon huge snowstorm on the whole map. If you run out of cards, you can buy them in the shop with money, earned after every succesfully repelled enemy wave, or for selling buildings on the map. Thus, 'recycling' weak buildings is a very lucrative business. Features: Co-op gameplay. Various cards and game mechanics. New look at tower defense genre. Auto-chess like game loop and economy. Easy to start playing with friends. Replayability.

rows.name: Square garden
rows.short_description: This is an easy and simple building game. Build your own garden.
rows.description_html: Game features: 1. There are 90 different objects that can be built in the game. 2.30 different plants, 30 different floors and 30 different decorative objects. 3.
