rows.name: Flora Domina
rows.short_description: In this unique take on turn-based 4X strategy, play as a nature goddess that defends her island by playing cards to use nature as your ally.
rows.description_html: Flora Domina is a turn-based strategic card game where you play as a nature goddess that has to defend her island from humans. Use the power of nature to take back your land from the industrial invaders. Overgrow their mines and factories with flowers, grow forests and brambles to hold them off. You hold the humans off by expanding your territory and playing cards to grow your forests. The humans do the same by building homes, mines and factories. Overgrow the other to conquer them! Summer and winter come and go. With them they bring advantages and disadvantages to each side. Humans will need more coal in winter while your plants will need extra water in summer. Plan ahead and grow when the time is right! The island is procedurally generated every session. The landscape consists of different types. There are deserts, marshes, geysers and more to make growing on the island more interesting. Discover it and use it to your advantage! This game was developed by 3rd year students at Howest - Digital Arts & Entertainment during a period of 11 weeks.

Help him find all his chickens by guiding him through different puzzles of the game and collecting a bunch of cool abilities and gears such as: Mega-Boots! Jetpacks!! Climbing Gloves!!! There are multiple ways to access certain areas, using different combinations of tools. A fun game for both those who want to just chill and relax, and the speed runners and players who like to break the game!

Transport yourself back to the mythical age and engage in thrilling battles with adorable, hand-drawn SD characters. rows.name: The Pyramid Of Bones
rows.short_description: In The Pyramid of Bones you will have to kill as many mummies as you can, when feeling overwhelmed you must always extract through a door to keep your score. Become the greatest mummy slayer of them all!
rows.description_html: The Pyramid of Bones is a unique and challenging cooperative game that will test your skills and teamwork. With fast-paced, top-down gameplay, players must work together to fight off waves of mummies and other deadly creatures as they navigate through the treacherous pyramid. The game features a variety of weapons, from pistols to shotguns, to help players fend off the enemies. Players can also collect powerful items and power-ups that will help them survive longer and become more powerful. The game features a wide variety of mummies, each with their own unique abilities, strengths and weaknesses. Players must use strategy and teamwork to overcome each enemy and progress through the levels. The Pyramid of Bones is a perfect game for friends and family to play together. With its cooperative multiplayer mode, players must work together to survive, slay mummies and extract treasure. Download now and join the adventure!

rows.description_html: Hyper Pop is a frantic action roguelike bullet heaven. rows.name: Infinite Incantation
rows.short_description: Fight for survival as you battle massive hordes of enemies. Wield powerful spells that you can mutate and evolve to ludicrous strength. Customize your character's stats, elemental affinities, and make upgrades to become the ultimate spell-slinging force of destruction.
rows.description_html: Infinite Incantation is a charming papercraft-style bullet heaven action roguelike that will test your spell-slinging skills as you tear through waves of enemies. To survive against the horde, you'll have the chance to roll the dice to procedurally mutate your spells into powerful evolutions, allowing you to take on even tougher challenges. Customize your character with RPG-like upgrades and stack your deck with the spells you'll randomly draw in runs. With fast-paced action, challenging bosses, and endless spell-crafting possibilities, Infinite Incantation is a must-play for fans of spell-casting, screen-filling, and goblin slaying action. Cast Shape Archetype + Element + Effect = Infinite Incantations Infinite Incantation uses a robust component spell system that can combine elements, casting styles, and special effects in a variety of different ways. Stryx, your (totally friendly and charming) owl companion can convert the experience points you collect into powerful spells . Like a spell? Or even dislike it? Choose to randomly evolve it into something even stronger, whether through greater power or mutated attributes . The spell will randomly mutate into something even stronger and more wild. Who knows what kind of mayhem that'll ensue? There are hundreds of combinations you could need to adapt to on the fly. You can customize the type of mage you want to be and how you want to interact with the deep component spell system. Level up and upgrade your stats. Specialize in certain elemental affinities. Build your deck of spell archetype cards before heading out. Mutate spells on the fly and roll the dice to see what you get. Tear up seemingly endless hordes of monsters and bosses all vying for your demise. Twin-Stick Shooter-type controls. Cast spells manually or automatically. Play with a controller or a keyboard and mouse. No scissors or glue required.

rows.name: Mikrocosmos
rows.short_description: This is a party game that combines trading and action elements. Your goal is to establish good trading 'affinities' with planets through trading. Of course, your competitors won't let you easily grab a whole piece of cake. Burning, killing, and snatching...? Perhaps inevitable!
rows.description_html: Community About the Game This is a party game that combines trading and action elements -- trade with enough as many planets as possible to become the best employee of your company! The Kromo universe is a huge trading business circle. As a new employee of the two major consortiums, your task is to quickly get started with the entire business process and earn profits for your company! Your goal is to establish good 'affinities' with planets through trading. Of course, your competitors won't let you easily grab a whole piece of cake. Burning, killing, and snatching...? Perhaps inevitable! There are all kinds of strange materials used for trading in the Kromo universe. You can use them for trading, but also...fighting? The Game Your task is to buy goods and sell them to planets that need them! How to win: try to establish trade with the entire galaxy and outwit your competition! Earn the price difference by reselling materials. Wait what... no money? We can still go mining, right? . . Use merchandise as weapons to attack your competitors! If you shoot down their spaceship, everything on it will be yours! Obtain additional benefits through various small minigames in the universe If you encounter any bugs, please refer to our game's FAQ in Discussion:

rows.name: Garden of Roses: Summerset
rows.short_description: The prologue arc to the 'Garden of Roses' story. A visual novel set in a world where monster girls walk among us. Take the role of Will Getz, a young man with a score to settle after 15 long years of being away from home.
rows.description_html: Do you remember the small town that you grew up in? The world must have looked massive from where you stood, at three feet tall. At that time, you probably thought mysteries lurked behind every corner in the world of adults. If you could go back in time, to a world of the past where monsters and mysteries existed, would you fix some of the broken things you left behind and alter the course of your fate? Welcome to Edelton, the twilight town of Rose and ash. 'Summerset' is the prologue chapter to the larger 'Garden of Roses' to come, full of its share of monsters and mystery and an unfinished score to settle. You play Will Getz, a hot-headed young man with unfinished business to settle. When you were seven years old you left the town you grew up in during the dead of night, never to return. Fifteen years later, you return to the quaint town of Edelton at long last to finish things where you left off. While you're in town you quickly find yourself being drawn to a harpy named Rosa Oaks, and quickly become tangled in all the suffering that befalls her. The seemingly short trip to dot your i's and cross your t's spirals into something much bigger than yourself where everyone is involved. Your discoveries and epiphanies are recorded in the 'Memorandum,' a journal that expands as you start to remember the town from 15 years ago. Your choices, both large and small, have ripple effects that aren't immediately obvious. At the end of your journey, you'll have a chance to look back and figure out how things could've gone differently and turn over any stones you might have missed.

rows.name: Destiny Duel
rows.short_description: Simple to learn, impossible to master. Destiny Duel is a battle of the mind: in order to win, you must predict your opponent's every move. Attack, Guard, Recover, or Dodge. The choice is yours, and every choice matters.
rows.description_html: Destiny Duel is a PvP psychological strategy game. To win, you must eliminate your opponent with 4 moves at your disposal: Attack, Guard, Recover, and Dodge. Each move counters one another, and the goal is to predict your opponent - using the right move in the right situation. - Simple to learn gameplay with only 4 buttons/controls - 7 Maps with different effects - Rank medal system - Many unique cosmetics to customize your character with

rows.name: Battle of Guardians
rows.short_description: Forgotten Guardians returned to save humanity from a demonic invasion. Battle of Guardians, is a real-time online multiplayer PVP and PVE free-to-play fighting game.
rows.description_html: Battle of Guardians is a real-time Online Multiplayer PVP, PVE, and Fighting Tournament game. Players engage in fierce multi-realm battles in the expansive Multidimension game world. BOG is an all-out battle of skills where the best players are in a constant battle to beat other players. Story In a distant past, humanity coexisted with powerful beings known as Guardians. These Guardians possessed abilities far beyond those of mere mortals, and as such, were revered as deities. In return for their worship, the Guardians maintained balance on Earth and protected humanity from harm. As technology advanced, humans grew increasingly reliant on machines to perform the tasks once entrusted to the Guardians. Consequently, the Guardians were gradually forgotten and eventually vanished from the earth. But fate had other plans for humanity. After millennia had passed, a group of humans unknowingly opened a portal to Hell, unleashing a horde of demonic creatures upon the world. Civilization crumbled in the face of this overwhelming invasion, and all seemed lost. But just as humanity's hope was on the brink of extinction, the Guardians reappeared, ready to defend their worshippers once more. Game Mode Tournament Mode : Players (4/8 players, soon for (16/32)) are put in a tournament bracket. One will fight with another in a 1v1 with knock out system.. PVP Mode : Players are fighting against other players in a 1v1 battle of a random matchmaking based on their Match Making Rating (MMR). Story & Training Mode : PVE Mode to increase Level of Player and Learn basic & complex techniques, Players are going to fight against computers in a series of increasingly difficult stages. There are a total of 10 stages. Characters The characters are differentiate into three races: Guardians, Humans, and Demons. The races are differentiated by three attributes, which are Health Points, Damage, and Intelligence. Health Points - The number of health a character has. Damage - Overall damage points that a character can bring upon its opponent. Intelligence - Additional damage points for characters who uses its movement combinations (combos). To summarize, these are the attributes for each race. Guardians - Have more damage points Humans - Have more intelligence points Demons - Have more health points Tiers are here to produce a whole new experience for every player inside of the game. BOG will offer three tiers, all with different features inside of them. These tiers are: Elite Fighter (Common) - Barebones of characters Legendary Warrior (Rare) - Equipped with combo God of War (Ultra Rare) - Full set of combo and ultra skill Playing Tips Player Documentation : Create Account Before join the Battle, you have to create your account through this site Feedback Form : Send us a feedback here! Follow us on social media

rows.name: Dark Traveller
rows.short_description: Dark Traveller is an action-packed puzzle game with multiple storylines and open endings. The game tells the story of a world on the brink of apocalypse in the distant future. In the world, you travel through quantum space-time to rescue your homeland on the rocks with the help of your partner!
rows.description_html: Countless travels Countless rebirths Through the days and desperate times To rescue the family and the world! Travel across quantum space and find the way home In the dying end of the world, you awaken in a quantum crevice. On your journey to salvation and home, you will encounter your AI partner Darkness, witness the mutual salvation of a father and a daughter, and travel through the myriad of time and space in history and future by using the quantum portal. You believe that if you open all the time portals yourself, you will be able to reconstruct space and find your way home. Dominate the laws of time and solve apocalyptic puzzles Throughout your countless space-time travels, you've found many weapons and skills you can rely on, and you've even gained the most important time control in the quantum dimension, which allows you to find hidden clues, navigate obstacles, dodge attacks, and take on the enemies that infest the quantum dimension. Mind-bending physics puzzles and tricky gimmicks The game is full of ingenious gimmicks. The perfect combination of quantum physics concepts, and the game's plot and levels brings you a new puzzle experience. The game's design features a number of traditional Chinese gimmick concepts, making the game a three-dimensional super gimmick. Lowpoly cartoon style with numerous hidden eggs In Dark Traveller, the story of a complex apocalyptic journey featuring a simple and beautiful Lowpoly cartoon style unfolds, and its creative scenarios will give you an unforgettable gaming experience. You'll acquire various equipment or decorations with extra abilities. And there are also plenty of eggs hidden throughout the game to make your journey through time and space a fun one. Multiple endings to find your true destination The excellent combination of inter-temporal logic and mind-bending puzzles gives you multiple time-travel puzzles to solve. Scattered conversations, last words, secret messages and a multitude of subplots contribute to the mazy journey. Sketch the whole picture of events spanning a thousand years from fragmented information, and then you can complete the ultimate apocalyptic puzzle and reach your destined spiritual home.

rows.name: FLUCTUOID
rows.short_description: Fluctuoid (noun.) a thing that changes size. Puzzle platforming that emphasises flow, discovery and a unique, laid back experience. Shrink and grow to make your way through the maze.
rows.description_html: Explore a mysterious maze as the enigmatic FLUCTUOID, a lifeform that can change size. Use your ability to shrink and grow at will to explore 9 different themed worlds, solving puzzles to explore further into the strange place. Gameplay Features Change size with the press of a button. When you're big you're heavy and slow but when you're small you're light and speedy Slip through cracks in the maze by shrinking as you jump towards them Grow big to sink deep into watery pools and explore hidden areas Find a safe path between dangerous obstacles as time slows down the smaller you get Let the sounds relax you on your journey FLUCTUOID starts easy but gets progressively more difficult Don't let the challenge get to you, just take a breath and enjoy the soothing music Try to collect all the mysterious cubes and change the ending you get

Date with them! ------Gameplay----- Dig down into the underground world, uncover precious gems, and find desires in her heart. ------Control------ You can move or navigate UI by using Arrow Keys (↑)(←)(↓)(→) or [W] [A] [S] [D] . Press [Enter] or [Spacebar] to confirm.

rows.name: TankLab
rows.short_description: Operate the tank to fire bullets! Defeat your opponents and claim victory! Choose your favorite skill and conquer the field!A pop and simple shooting game.
rows.description_html: Operate the tank to fire bullets! Defeat your opponents and claim victory! Choose your favorite skill and conquer the field! A pop and simple shooting game. this game 1. 'Challenge Mode' where you aim to clear all stages by defeating tanks 2. 'Local match mode' where up to 4 people can play against each other on one computer 3. 'Online mode' where you can fight someone online 1on1 You can enjoy 3 different modes. You can enjoy it alone or with a large number of people! And even more! Simple appearance and easy operation! It is a book that even those who are not good at games can enjoy.

rows.name: Be Frugal
rows.short_description: Be Frugal is a bus stop design simulation for a growing city. Draw lines between stops and run buses. As new stops open, redraw your lines to keep them active. Decide carefully where you will use your limited resources.
rows.description_html: Wish List Now [url][/url] Discord [url][/url] About the Game You can create bus lines of magnificent cities such as Amsterdam, Barcelona, Brussel, Istanbul, London, New York, Paris, Sydney, Tokyo, Venice. You can see the unique beauties of these cities better at night. At night, it will be easier for you to create new lines with the lights that illuminate the roads. You can build roads in different styles using random paths and your own design intelligence. In this way, you can spend less resources and get more results. You can build junctions, bridges, shortcuts and ring roads with random paths. You shouldn't make the bus lines too long. You can also create new lines for this. In this way, you can carry more passengers to the desired stops by using your limited resources correctly. You can create the bus line between the stops by placing the random roads in an appropriate way. The most important point in the game of this design simulation is to use random incoming paths efficiently.

rows.name: Maxix Robotics
rows.short_description: Survive the night in this Survival Horror environment as you navigate a Historic Robotics Facility by solving puzzles in various wings of the factory. By utilizing a Robotic companion called 'DOTT' you can open doors, activate terminals and more... Just make sure to look behind you.
rows.description_html: Look no further with Maxix Robotics. Welcome to Maxix Robotics! Explore a Historic Robotics factory at night as an engineer and perform tasks via puzzles in a stylized horror environment. By moving around the environment there will be lots of secrets in store for the Maxix Engineer, so make sure to keep an eye out. Bring Along a D.O.T.T. to Complete Tasks Grab Yourself your very own personal D.O.T.T. from our terminals in game. D.O.T.T. is your personal coworker who will help you navigate Maxix Robotics. You are the only human there so make sure to keep your eyes open for anything out of the ordinary. Our B.O.T.T.s are there to help. Explore Maxix Robotics Traverse each area of the Maxix Facility to update your Maxix D.O.T.T. and use your little friend to open doors, complete tasks, and ensure Maxix Compliance standards. D.O.T.T.'s terminals are marked with the same color as your little friend, so make sure you listen to him as he will give you all sorts of cues when you are navigating Maxix Robotics. Solve the Mystery The only limitation is your imagination and failure to complete tasks is not seen well by Maxix management. Explore all aspects of our great facility while paying attention to what lies beneath. Disclaimer: Game has flashing lights, jump-scares, and loud noises associated with Horror Game Mechanics. The Ultimate goal of this game is to clear each of our three wings by completing three very distinct puzzles. Each puzzle will challenge the player and will involve using different tricks to avoid the B.O.T.T.s that are roaming around the facility. There are lots of secrets in store for the player so they must keep an eye out and focus on solving the mystery behind Maxix Robotics.

rows.name: Idle Cave Miner
rows.short_description: Idle Cave Miner is an idle game about crafting items, mining gems, and building your team of miners. Prestige, craft, and travel to other mines to increase your strength to dig deeper, and find what lurks below.
rows.description_html: IDLE CAVE MINER FEATURES: Smelt, Craft, and Refine Ores: Craft cool new Items to mine deeper than ever and find new rare ores and gems! Upgrade your forges to increase their speed and efficiency when smelting rare ores or refining beautiful gems! Use the items you crafted to permanently boost the stats of your team of miners! Build your own team of Miners: Unlock cool and unique new miners to mine for you and help you progress deep within the mines! Upgrade your miners with items you crafted to take them to the next level of mining efficiency! Idle away as your miners work for you, giving you profits you've never seen before! Multiple Mines: The mine upgrades with you, the further down you go, the more the mine shifts to accommodate new unique and fun environments! Unique mines to explore, each with their own resources for you to obtain, whether those are rare ores to be smelted or unique gems to be refined! Farm these mines to get resources to become stronger than ever and progress in the main mine, giving you access to new and interesting new ores and gems! Endless upgrades: Upgrade everything about your favorite miners, building an increasingly strong team to progress further than you've gone before! Prestige to receive powerful rewards that allow you to go deeper than ever into the unknown depths of the mines! Gather permanent upgrades that remain with you when you prestige, allowing you to breeze through what was previously impossible! Lots of missions and achievements: Complete fun achievements to unlock cool rewards! Participate in daily, weekly and monthly missions that give you increased rewards based on their difficulty level! Check your game's stats at any moment to view your overall progress and other fun statistics! Other cool features: Cloud Saves! Online Leaderboards! Play Offline!

rows.name: In Sink: A Co-Op Escape Prologue
rows.short_description: Play an early version of the first level for free! Work together to solve the puzzles and escape a desert island in this multiplayer co-op adventure. Success requires more than just you and your partner thinking alike - you'll have to communicate and stay In Sink to overcome the challenges ahead.
rows.description_html: Play the first level in this free demo, and join the Discord community to unlock Level 2! Dive into 'In Sink' with a friend, where being shipwrecked is just the beginning of your co-operative adventure! Travel through rifts to other worlds where you’ll solve a series of escape rooms, puzzles, and other mysteries, working together to overcome each challenge. Together, you’ll need to think outside the box, and then escape from it. The path to freedom is full of portals! Your journey will take you through a hidden pirate ship, a mysterious art museum, a train that defies the laws of physics, and many more mind-bending settings stuffed with puzzles and challenges. Progress through puzzles with language-less elements like shapes, signs, colours, and numbers, all designed to be colour-blind friendly. Turn wheels, flip levers, use scales, and press buttons and pressure plates to solve unique conundrums with your partner. It's crucial to stay 'in sink' with your partner! You'll need to act as each other's eyes and ears to solve puzzles and find a way out. Features: Two player co-op gameplay Language-free puzzle design Vibrant cartoony visuals Simple and accessible controls Dynamic hint system helps without spoiling solutions

rows.name: The Obscura Experiment
rows.short_description: Anabasis & Co. welcomes you to the family - we’re so glad to have you here! Your mandate as part of this research project will be to monitor and document a new energy form: the [REDACTED]. To begin, let’s review your perso- oh? We’re detecting some anomalies near you… care to investigate?
rows.description_html: An experiment has gone wrong, and the whole complex is failing. Your only chance at survival is to use the various tools at your disposal to escape this now-hostile environment. But beware: an unrelenting force lurks in the shadows… Play as Priya Ellis, a scientist whose research team has been decimated by a mysterious new form of life - the Dark Matter - which is invisible to the naked eye . Thanks to your scanner tablet and the ships' built-in surveillance system , you can outsmart the roaming menace by carefully planning your next move . But, keep an eye on your scanner’s energy : an empty battery would only guarantee your demise! Locking the doors behind you and luring the Dark Matter to energy sources comes at a high risk, but it could buy you some time… Explore a Hi-Tech environment! Climb aboard the spaceship, and discover a state-of-the-art facility! Challenge the unknown, fight the darkness! Come face-to-face with an unseen menace; push back the obscurity with your wits! Observe, Plan & Execute! Familiarize yourself with your surroundings, develop a strategy, and put your plan into action! Investigate the events & uncover the truth! Figure out what happened onboard, and discover the true motivations of Anabasis & Co.!

rows.name: Helpless
rows.short_description: In the heat of deserted lands, a child and their mother weakened by sickness try to survive a harsh world. Through a kid’s perspective, take action and explore the remains of a lost past. Protect yourself from the sun’s deadly intensity and help your family get back on the road.
rows.description_html: A mother and her child are trying desperately to find shelter in order to survive harsh conditions. A tragic event makes them come together more than ever. On top of everything, their only way to travel breaks down. In HELPLESS , take the role of a kid and explore a decaying land where the sun ruined civilization as we know it. Find abandoned places and scavenge them for items in order to make sense of the world you’re in. All the help you need during this perilous trip might come to you in unexpected forms. UNCOVER A LOST PAST Find items and different locations to understand your surroundings. HIDE FROM THE SUN Cover yourself from the dangers of the sun and carefully manage your moves. DEVELOP RELATIONSHIPS Share your findings with your mom by interacting with her and get better knowledge about your family with the support of a new friend. CONTEMPLATE COMPELLING VISUALS Look at the world around you with dynamic cameras and a semi-realistic art style. 26 achievements to unlock Original soundtrack Multiple collectibles to find English and French versions Colorblind-friendly Survivor or Explorator mode

rows.name: Sneaky Pirates
rows.short_description: Sneaky Pirates is a fast-paced online multiplayer social deduction game for 4 players. Hide among ships, steal from rivals, and use power-ups to escape or fight back. Play it safe or go all-in—no winner is safe until the last second! Customize your ship and be the king of pirates! 🏴‍☠️
rows.description_html: Set sail in Sneaky Pirates!  A thrilling online multiplayer social deduction game where deception, strategy, and fast-paced action collide on the open sea! In this high-stakes battle of wits, up to 4 players disguise themselves among a fleet of ships, sneaking around while trying to hunt down and steal from their rivals —all without being caught. 💰 Steal to Win – The pirate with the most gold at the end of the match reigns supreme. In case of a tie, the first one to steal claims victory! 🕵️ Hide in the crowd  – Blend into a sea of AI-controlled ships, carefully plotting your next move while staying unnoticed. ⚔️ Power Up or Fight Back – Use special abilities to escape tight situations, throw off pursuers, or strike down other pirates! 🎨 Customize Your Ship – Buy and equip aesthetic upgrades to make your vessel truly yours. 🎭 Choose Your Playstyle – Stay hidden and play it safe, or throw caution out the window and steal recklessly—both approaches can lead to victory! ⏳ No Winner is Safe – The tides can turn at any moment—a last-second, well-placed steal can change everything! 🌊 Evolving Early Access – The adventure is just beginning! We’re looking forward to expand  Sneaky Pirates with new content and features, shaped by community feedback. Do you have what it takes to deceive, steal, and outsmart other pirates? Join the crew and prove you're the craftiest on the seven seas! 🏴‍☠️

rows.name: Donut Adventure
rows.short_description: A kids friendly platform game. Collect coins and jump to the destination.
rows.description_html: In Donut Adventure, you play as a delicious and adventurous donut who must navigate through a variety of obstacles to reach the end of each level. With vibrant and colorful graphics and a fun, upbeat soundtrack, Donut Dash is a charming and addictive platformer that will keep you coming back for more. As the player, you'll need to use your platforming skills to jump, roll, and slide your way past a variety of obstacles, from gaps in the ground to spikes and enemies. Along the way, you'll collect coins and power-ups that will help you on your journey. Donut Adventure features a variety of levels, each with its own unique challenges and obstacles. As you progress through the game, you'll face increasingly difficult levels that will put your skills to the test. But don't worry - with enough practice and determination, you'll be able to overcome any challenge and help your donut reach its goal! Whether you're a fan of platformers or just looking for a fun and lighthearted game to play, Donut Adventure is the perfect choice. With its charming visuals, addictive gameplay, and lovable protagonist, it's sure to provide hours of entertainment and fun for gamers of all ages. Features: Easy to learn the controls Multiple Levels with more on the way Perfect for young players Controls: Use arrow keys to move and jump Collet Coins on the way Jump to the destination point to advance to next level About the author: Eric Jiang is a 11 year old boy who has passion for game development. This is his first Pygame based game and he already has many plans for future development.

rows.name: Spirit of Midnight: Prologue
rows.short_description: Enjoy an introduction to the upcoming charming adventure game, Spirit of Midnight. Play as a house cat who gains the ability to leave home and embark on a supernatural adventure after encountering a strange spirit. Befriend a badger and restore balance to the forest while uncovering its mysteries!
rows.description_html: Enjoy an introduction to the upcoming charming adventure game, Spirit of Midnight. Play as a house cat who gains the ability to leave home and embark on a supernatural adventure after encountering a strange spirit. Befriend a badger and meet other adorable creatures along the way, all in an effort to restore balance to the forest and uncover the truth behind its mysteries. Use and combine items in your inventory to solve situational puzzles in humorous ways. Sit back, interact, and be entertained. Professionally scored with original music and nighttime vibes. Controller play recommended. Prologue is about 25-35 minutes long. Please provide feedback to help our small team make the game all it can be! (Visit the Community Hub)... If you enjoy the Prologue, consider leaving a review, and don't forget to *WISHLIST* the full game! ~ Thank you for your support!

rows.name: Long Time No See
rows.short_description: Reunite with your best friends, unravel the secrets of a haunted house, and assist a cute little ghost in this heartwarming adventure where every puzzle brings you closer to the mysteries within.
rows.description_html: After a year apart, three friends reunite to spend a stormy Halloween night together in a haunted house. When they cross paths with a little ghost, they embark on an adventure that will test the strength of their friendship. A short cozy Halloween game made as a submission for the Spooktober 5th Annual Visual Novel Jam, created during the month of September. Vibrant, fully voice-acted dialogue Gorgeous digitally-painted characters and environments Atmospheric original score 30 min playtime / 4.5k words Mild Language

rows.name: Robo Rob
rows.short_description: Robo Rob: Dive into this compact, rage-inducing puzzle adventure that's sure to test your patience and skill.
rows.description_html: Welcome to the Rage-Inducing World of Robo Rob! Introducing Robo Rob - the puzzle game that's set to redefine what it means to be 'challenging'. Start off with 21 levels of intricately designed puzzles that will not just test your skill but will push you to the brink. Think you've seen it all? We're just getting started. With regular updates rolling out, each batch of levels ups the ante, mixing in even more diabolical designs to keep you on your toes. And oh, have you met our lasers? They're pretty much celebrities within the Robo Rob community - famous for turning confident gamers into raging puzzle warriors. Sounds like fun? We think so too. Join our Discord community and share your laser woes, celebrate your victories, or even pick up a few speed running tips. It's all happening right here. Robo Rob is more than just a game; it's a test of will, a badge of honour for those who persevere, and a community of fellow ragers cheering you on. Dive in and see if you have what it takes to conquer the evolving world of Robo Rob.

rows.name: Samira: Taken From Time
rows.short_description: Transported back in time, you must help Tiki, an ancient mech beetle, escape the apocalypse. Your puzzle solving skills will be put to the test as you attempt to collect the fragmented pieces of his tablet which will empower him with the ability to stop any and all world-ending events.
rows.description_html: As the world is ending around her, Samira must find a way to flee planet Earth and reunite with her family. As she searches for her ticket to safety, she’s mysteriously teleported back in time. Your puzzle solving skills will be put to the test as you work with an ancient companion by your side, Tiki, the scarab. This third-person, puzzle solving game will take you through an ancient African society where you speak with the ancient gods and goddesses to figure out why Samira’s world is ending. Will you be able to right the course of time or will planet Earth be destroyed forever? Features: Explore the land of Ahemfie and learn about an ancient African society Discover the backstories of the characters around you Solve innovative puzzles as you assemble pieces of the Tablet of Djehuti Make life or death decisions that influence the course of your story Harness ancient powers and use them to traverse the world

Features: Explore the land of Ahemfie and learn about an ancient African society Discover the backstories of the characters around you Solve innovative puzzles as you assemble pieces of the Tablet of Djehuti Make life or death decisions that influence the course of your story Harness ancient powers and use them to traverse the world

rows.name: Pencil Plus: The Wrath of The Spankster
rows.short_description: Pencil Plus: The Wrath of the Spankster is an interactive novel style choose your own adventure game in which players take the role of Conner, a normal high school kid that gains a very unique super power: the ability to pull limitless pencils out of his pockets.
rows.description_html: In Pencil Plus: The Wrath of the Spankster, you play as Conner, a high school student who gains the extraordinary power to pull unlimited pencils out of his pockets. But this power is not just for show - Your mission is to use your skills and wit to take down The Spankster, a fellow student who has acquired the power to spank others without any repercussions. But beware, as the real harm comes from the public humiliation that the victim is subjected to. As you navigate the halls of the high school, you'll encounter a cast of colorful characters and make choices that determine the course of the story. Will you be able to stop The Spankster and restore peace to the school? It's up to you to decide. With four different endings to discover, each based on the choices you make, Pencil Plus: The Wrath of the Spankster offers a truly interactive experience. Will you be a hero, a rebel, or something in between? The fate of the school is in your hands.

rows.name: Dungeons of the Obelisk
rows.short_description: A 2D Turn-Based Dungeon Crawling, Loot Grinding Adventure!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Topia! Create a customizable adventurer and explore the mysterious Obelisk and the dungeons that lie within. Add your friends and chat as you play. Engage in turn-based combat against a range of mobs but beware, the battles are deceptively simple but have a hidden layer of difficulty and strategy that will keep advanced players gripped. Collect rare and legendary items from unique loot drops as you level up your paragon infinitely. Purchase powerful buffs from the Emporium to enhance your chances of finding legendary loot. Save up your crystals to get artifacts and companions from the Curio Shop and check out the Tailor Shop for trendy cosmetics. Defeat the formidable Boss of the Breach to collect prestigious set items. Join the leaderboards to see how you stack up against your friends. Meet a host of friendly NPCs to help you on your adventure. Join our community, strategize with friends, and help our game continue to grow with future updates!

rows.name: PlayM2M
rows.short_description: Discover the secrets of magic and show your mastery in the massively multiplayer online role-playing game PlayM2M! Prove your strength against your enemies in PvM and take your place in brutal PvP battles!
rows.description_html: Embark on an adventure: Explore a vast and open world. Battle powerful enemies. Meet unique characters and stories. Complete mysterious quests. Improve yourself: Learn powerful spells. Develop unique abilities. Earn epic weapons and armor. Level up and become a master. Play alone or with friends. Compete in PvP and PvE modes. Create guilds and fight together. Meet players from all over the world. Conquer mysterious worlds with unique mounts and uncover secrets! Have an unforgettable MMORPG experience. Download PlayM2M now and start a fantastic adventure! What Is PlayM2M ? PlayM2M is a brand new MMORPG that takes you on an adventure in a fantasy world. In this enchanting game you will discover the secrets of magic and progress on your journey to become a true master. In this game, you will create your character that you will take on the role and defeat the powerful world bosses and servants in the Arasina continents of the far east. By gaining bonuses of ancient magic to the loot you obtain, you will be able to strengthen your characters or sell them in the empire's market area. The hack and slash style battle system you are familiar with makes the game very action-packed and fun. It will entertain you on every level and make you feel like you are playing the most fun MMO game of your life. You will reach the perfect experience of specializing in every field with a fair and competitive game order. There are more than 4 different character classes, 4 different dynasties and 2 powerful denominations in the game, and each has its own unique combat abilities. In addition, there are many mounts to accompany you in the game, millions of equipment and accessories to strengthen your pet character, and many different missions, guild wars and PvP arenas. You can also fight as a team with other players or against everyone. Decide Your Destiny! • Experience epic 𝑷𝒗𝑬 adventures and 𝑷𝒗𝑷 duels in brutal fierce battles! • Explore dungeons and labyrinths in massive overworlds! • Battle countless enemies against world bosses and sinister demon lords. • Engage in fast-paced battles, even against hordes of enemies. • Choose a powerful class, become a lord of the empire or a servant of darkness and up to 𝟯𝟬𝟬 level up your character. 𝑪𝑯𝑶𝑶𝑺𝑬 𝒀𝑶𝑼𝑹 𝑷𝑨𝑻𝑯 𝑨𝑵𝑫 𝑭𝑶𝑹𝑮𝑬 𝑨𝑳𝑳𝑰𝑨𝑵𝑪𝑬𝑺 • Choose from four character classes, dynasties and denominations • Found a guild with friends and build on your lands • Discover thousands of countless mounts and pets! Soar freely in the sky on the wings of a griffon or fight like a knight on land! • Continually improve your weapons and equipment through a selection of crafting systems Play As You Like Fight, craft, steal, siege or explore and combine different types of armour, weapons and abilities and unique spells to create your own playstyle. In an ever-growing, persistent world of PlayM2M the choice is yours and yours alone. Tell Your story Discover the secrets of Tharganir as you journey through the lost and mysterious lands of Aravonuria to reclaim your soul and save the world from Nasfary, god of Hell. Experience one of the epic stories of the four great dynasties with others or alone, in whatever order you choose, anywhere in the vast world. A Massively Multiplayer RPG Complete quests with friends, join fellow adventurers to explore dangerous, monster-filled dungeons, or take part in epic PvP battles with hundreds of other players.

rows.name: Banana Attack VR
rows.short_description: Shoot zombie limbs off and watch their ragdoll bodies fall then cook their delicious remains over the fire and feed it to your cute little fox!
rows.description_html: Summary: Shoot banana limbs off and watch their ragdoll bodies fall then cook their delicious remains over the fire and feed it to your cute little fox! Gameplay: - 2 Levels are available (difference between levels is time limit and difficulty) - A horde of banana men will spawn and attack the player - 2 Weapons can be used by the player to kill the banana men (axe + gun) - Score can be increased by cooking the remains of the banana men and feeding it to your little fox (don't over or under cook it!) - Make sure to increase your score while maintaining your HP within the time limit to win! That's it! It is a very simple game. Please note that the game does NOT have any save system. Developer Note: This game was made as a university project, but has since been polished a tiny bit and released on Steam for whoever wants to give it a go! Don't expect a triple A polished game, this game was developed out of passion and pure love for gaming, and is meant to serve as a fun little silly game to play when you just want to mess around and kill silly banana looking enemies :D

rows.name: The Last Pawn
rows.short_description: The Last Pawn is a shooter platformer where you play as the last hope of your kingdom. In your journey across the land, you will find yourself dealing with multiple enemy types, boss battles and 21 different levels.
rows.description_html: Many years ago In a far, far away land, a war began between two kingdoms, the white ones, and the black ones. No one remembers who started it or why. For years the war raged without either side gaining an advantage in battle over the other. But a few years ago, a move that changed the balance of the war caused the enemy kingdom to rush toward their victory. In the years that followed, battle after battle, the number of soldiers decreased, and the force of the kingdom faded. In a desperate move, the king gathered all the last of his soldiers into one last battle that would decide the fate of the kingdom, a battle that on only one soldier managed to survive. The last hope of the kingdom, the last pawn. In The Last Pawn, you will choose the kingdom you want to play as and cross the land in order to defeat the enemy and save the kingdom by yourself. Complete 21 different levels and face bosses in your journey to win the war. Features: A 2.5D shooter platformer experience Choose the kingdom you want to play as Use and upgrade different abilities Face multiple types of enemies and bosses Customize your character with optional customization coins hidden across the game Prepare yourself for the ultimate challenge after the main game is complete

rows.name: He Fucked The Girl Out of Me
rows.short_description: He Fucked The Girl Out Of Me is a semi-autobiographical narrative visual novel about trauma and sex work made for the gameboy. The author explains how sex work impacted her life and changed her perception of the world. The game takes approximately 40 minutes to play from start to finish.
rows.description_html: ⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀       ⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀  ⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀        He Fucked the Girl Out of Me is a semi-fictionalized autobiographical story about my experiences with trauma and sex work. It’s semi-fictional because it would be too painful and messy for me to write about otherwise. If you are looking for AAA gaming, then it would be better to look elsewhere. When I made this game, I expected 100% of people to hate me. Instead, what happened was many people wrote to me telling me how much the game meant to them. The game ended up being featured in museums and conferences around the world and even won awards. It was shocking to me to have people care and to be accepted by others. I never thought I would ever get to feel like a normal person ever again, but since releasing this game I have found that acceptance. Despite the uncomfortable things in this game, I still think there is value in it existing. I am very grateful to anyone who is willing to play this game. This is a Game Boy narrative game. I consider it to be a visual novel but others have considered it an adventure game. I used Electron to turn it into a standalone game for personal computers. It is approximately 40 minutes long. After a certain point there was nothing more worth saying. The truth about fucked up things is that, after being repeated enough, they lose their impact and become pointless suffering. If you are a gamer, then you understand the impulse to escape to virtual worlds. If you’re like me, you play games to have fun. There are zero fun elements in this game. The fact is, making this game was an act of desperation. The pain from shame was destroying my mental health. I couldn’t talk about the things that were hurting me and that made everything worse. The best way to overcome shame is to be open about whatever you are ashamed of. I didn’t have the courage to say it out loud, so I made it into a game. Some people have told me that I am brave for making this game. I just wanted to make the pain stop. I thought, I’ll make a game, just once, and “Ann” can say the things I don’t feel brave enough to say. If the game was played enough, then I’d be unable to go back to hiding in shame again. The game would just be out there. I’ve realized that a game doesn’t have to be fun or escapist to have value. Games can have value on their own as art in their own right. As a game designer and a human being, if you think you would be able to safely play this game then it would mean the world to me if you’d consider trying it. The game is free. None of the DLC is required to experience the game. It’s a way for you to support the game if you want. Controls: Keyboard: Action Button = Space Bar Movement = Arrow Keys X-Input: Action Button = 'B' Movement = D-Pad Content Warnings are listed in-game.

rows.reviews_html: “Where He Fucked the Girl Out of Me is important is in how it can help you understand trauma. Not just the kind experienced by other people, but quite possibly your own. It’s a subject that is incredibly difficult to both explain and wrap your head around, to the point where a lot of people don’t even try. And that’s to the world’s detriment.” Destructoid - Zoey Handley “He Fucked the Girl Out of Me makes me feel how small our words are. I tried to call the developer’s experience ‘painful’ when I started writing this, but does that word even begin to contain what this experience wrought? Does ‘Trauma’? Trying to distill these intense feelings into words feels like it minimizes them. It cools them and makes them easier to handle. But you can sense the volatility these words contain. The immense darkness inside. My words don’t feel like enough to express what this game made me feel.” DreadXP - Joel Couture “This raw, harrowing and very rough to get through Game Boy game deals with the developer's experience as a transgender woman doing sex work. The trigger warnings are real and the trauma is real. It's possible that this game saved the developer's life, and that's not nothing.” Red Pages Podcast

rows.name: Crimson Veil
rows.short_description: An Adult Vampire Hunter RPG! Will you take down the creatures of the night, or will you turn into one yourself...?
rows.description_html: Crimson Veil is a thrilling and involved RPG experience focused around vampires, monster girls and corruption. You play as Mila, a vampire huntress who secretly fantasizes of being taken and turned into a vampire herself. Her inner conflict is yours to control by either engaging with or surrendering to your enemies to view the game’s vast collection of possible bad endings! (as of version 5.7.1) The game features: -  20+ hour campaign across 5 chapters. - 170  unique pieces of artwork which can be collected for your in-game Picture Gallery. - Over 60  fully illustrated characters to interact with. - Over 20 optional hunting contracts and side quests that feature other monsters capable of corrupting you, such as succubi, lamias, slime girls, and many more! - An alternate Vampire Route - take on an entirely separate story as a playable vampire, if you so desire. - A Bad Ending Theater to view every lewd scene included in the game! (Unlocked upon completing the game.) - An interactive Developer’s Room with access to cheats and skips for all parts of the game!* Themes included prominently are: lesbian, femdom, transformation, corruption, and hypnosis. More to come with future updates! The game is available for multiple platforms and is completely free!  I've also written a full walkthrough so that you don't miss a single thing the game has to offer! Themes included prominently are: -Lesbian -Femdom -Transformation -Corruption -Hypnosis. More to come with future updates!

rows.name: LastRo
rows.short_description: LastRo is a top-down shooter roguelike where you play robot, which mission is to clear up a lot of floors against different enemies. Your enemies are 'evolving', which means they become stronger with each floor and difficulty you beat. Try out different weapons, abilities and upgrades to beat them.
rows.description_html: LastRo is a top-down shooter roguelike where you play robot, which mission is to clear up a lot of floors against different types of enemies and Bosses. Upgrade Your Weapons / Robot Upgrade and evolve during each run Your eneimes also evolving Enemies become stronger with difficulty and during the game. You can choose which way and how much stronger they become. Stronger enemies -> more rewards Win or Die (Probably) Unlock new features / upgrades / characters / weapons And Try again (or proceed to next difficulty) This game is completely free (no ads, no transactions). But its good to go prototype If you wish to support me go to any of socials

rows.name: Space Game: Star We There Yet?
rows.short_description: It’s an idle game! It’s a battle game! It’s a SPACE GAME! Welcome to the ultimate interstellar road trip. Travel across the cosmos, collect rare and honorable crew, then use them to battle against friends and foes alike in this unique (and oddly addicting) adventure!
rows.description_html: Welcome to “Star We There Yet?”, a game about traveling the cosmos, collecting extraordinary crew, and battling with friends and foes alike in exciting merge-conflict matchups! Engaging! A wholesome mix of idle “Catch Some Zs” gameplay and “Catch Them All” combat, “S.We.T.Y?” features a huge cast of loveable and loathsome characters, faster-than-light space travel set to a slower-than-slight soundtrack, and tons of intriguing destinations to discover and then immediately leave behind. Fun to play for five minutes or five hours, it’s the perfect game to play in between other more demanding games! Featuring: A cast of 65 characters to collect, each with their own special abilities and winning personalities. Just so many personalities. A relaxing (and oddly addicting) idle space travel experience. Crank the cosmic-y tunes and tap your ship to get up to max speed. Or just use the auto-tappers. That’s what they’re for. Hundreds of stories and Missions for your crew, as they encounter black holes, super novae, hostile aliens, evil twins, space cows, hair stylists, cosmic horrors, and Larry. A unique Merge PVP battle mode, with highly advanced turn-based combat. Merge ships together to form your fleet, deploy them to attack your enemies, or activate your Crew’s special abilities! Basically unlimited planets and star systems to explore. Well not really - but there’s a lot. Space is big! It’s right there in the name. A super chill soundtrack that will make the lightyears roll by in a contented vibe. Optional in-game purchases can boost your progress (and feed our artists), but the game is completely do-able Free To Play. Just like a real post-scarcity futuristic society! “Star We There Yet?” is a fresh and flavorful blend of different game styles, with a little something for everyone. When fully operational, it will allow players to battle across platforms and continents and probably solar systems eventually. What are you waiting for? Play Space Game: Star We There Yet? and set a course for adventure! (And cosmic horror. As previously mentioned.)

rows.name: The Homecoming Exhibition
rows.short_description: A high-fidelity immersive gallery experience that places you into fully interactive 3D world of modern art, sculptures, and culture as you explore the minimalist environment inspired by Hiroshi Senju's Museum. Experience the future of art with groundbreaking work of Nako Baev.
rows.description_html: Welcome to The Homecoming Exhibition , a high-fidelity immersive gallery experience created in Unreal Engine 5 with Lumen . Immerse yourself in a fully interactive 3D world of modern art, sculptures, and culture as you explore the beautiful & extraordinary minimalist environment inspired by Hiroshi Senju Museum . Experience the future of art with 'The Homecoming Exhibition' showcasing the groundbreaking work of Nako Baev . Minimal yet modern & elegant I strived to create an open, luminous space where people would observe my works, relax and spend time in contemplation. I took on the creative challenge to design something where people could get inspired and driven towards their dreams and desires. My mandate was to explore how far I could push the quality of a real-time 3D museum for digital art. Listening to our lovely ambient soundtrack created by Evolsound which perfectly fits the gentle and calming sounds of nature around it. If you closely pay attention to the details you could find yourself an easter egg. Making it one unique experience you'll never forget. About the art & the artist: Nako Baev is an award-winning 3D artist who has worked on various projects in the film and video game industry. His current exhibition focuses more on modern, minimal and restraint outlook giving the goal of this type of exhibition to showcase a number of pieces in a way that allows viewers to fully appreciate their beauty and simplicity. The pieces themselves are characterized by clean lines, a limited color palette, and a focus on form and texture they feature abstract or minimalist compositions. The sculptures are made of materials such as Calacatta marble, Ekeberg marble, or limestone. Each piece would have ample space around it to allow viewers to appreciate it fully and to avoid distractions.

rows.name: Mr. Mat Hematic
rows.short_description: Mr. Mat Hematic is a short, fun, 2D platformer puzzle game where you must use given mathematical operations to alter the environment so you can move around. To complete a level, you need to reach the black door.
rows.description_html: WISHLIST OUR NEW GAME! Mr. Mat Hematic is a short, fun, 2D platformer puzzle game where you must use given mathematical operations to alter the environment so you can move around. To complete a level, you need to reach the black door. Use MOUSE for OPERATION, and KEYBOARD to MOVE There are 4 OPERATIONS: PLUS: Duplicates a green block and you can place it anywhere. MINUS: Removes a green block SQUARE: Doubles the sizes of the green block SQUAREROOT: Shrinks the size of the green block by 2 Features: 12 levels with a unique puzzle mechanic cute art nice music short story with cutscenes level selector level editor PRESS KIT:

rows.name: Gladiators: Survival in Rome
rows.short_description: Gladiators: Survival in Rome is an Action RPG with casual survival game mechanics and active city building. You'll experience a new type of survival game with quests & dungeons, continuous progression, seasonal events and lots of spear poking.
rows.description_html: Gladiators: Survival in Rome is an Action RPG with casual survival game mechanics and big city-building possibilities. You'll experience a new type of survival game with quests, continuous open world progression, monthly events and your dumb ways to die not harming your fun level. 🏹 Survival Games, casualized Chop every tree, hunt rabbits and deer, stone and copper mining - resource management are a staple of every survival game, and Gladiators is no different. However, we threw away the hunger games in favor of a replenishing stamina pool so you can start every game session on exploration instead of just preventing yourself from dying. 🏛️ Build your own Roman village From setting up your first camp to building an entire Roman city, you'll be pretty busy making a home for yourself and all the rescued slaves that turn up to settle as workers. Manage their resource refining jobs, build houses and beautify the city with fountains and other decor. ⚔️ Carry a big stick (mind the pointy end) Craft your weaponry from a selection of clubs, axes, bows, spears and more. Upgrade them to make pointy ends even more pointy, embellish your craft with gems and their attributes, and poke around at Roman legions, bandit bosses and other generally unfriendly folk. 🗺️ Explore Rome and its dungeons Dive into dark caves and unravel the story of Proserpina, better known in Greek mythology as Persephone; lead the siege to the stronghold of Castrum, or rebuild the ancient city of Perugia. Learning about history has never been more fun! 📅 Enjoy Seasonal Events Keep coming back for freshly designed seasonal events as they happen: the Winterfest with Teuton wildlings, the Origin of Saint Valentine, Halloween and many more to come. Missed one? Don't worry, we've put them into your game progression and keep them fresh every year. 📱 Put Rome in your pocket Not at home? Experience Gladiators: Survival in Rome on your phone or Steam Deck, fully optimized for the mobile gaming experience. And we're working to make your savegame available fully cross-platform. And many more features to come: Events ⭐ Quests ⭐ Talent Trees ⭐ Coop Building⭐ Mini Games ⭐ Achievements ⭐ Colosseum PVP Leaderboards ⭐ Guilds & Chat As developers of Gladiators: Survival in Rome, we hope you enjoy our casual approach to the Survival RPG genre. We are always happy to get in touch directly with our players and gather feedback - hop onto our Discord: 💬 Thanks and have fun surviving!

rows.name: Citadale Resurrection
rows.short_description: A collection of old-school retro Citadale games in the style of various systems released in the mid 1980s to early 1990s. Each game has its own unique look, sound, gameplay style and feel and yet they are all distinctly Citadale.
rows.description_html: Infamy returns - and this time it is free! The dark lord has been slain. But evil forces throughout the centuries have always tried to bring him back to un-life. And every time, heroes stood against them, preventing the worst from happening. And these are their adventures. Set throughout history, their strength, wisdom and courage lead them down into darkness. Can they bring back the light, or die trying? Citadale Resurrection is a collection of old-school retro Citadale games in the style of various systems released in the mid 1980s to early 1990s. Each game has its own unique look, sound, gameplay style and feel. And yet, they are all distinctly Citadale. And, to lure you in, the first two games in this collection are free. Start up and play, no hidden fees, no secret costs, 100% free. Should you like what you get, you can buy the other games as DLC. Five games are available, two are free and three are paid DLC, completing the package. Bringing back the past to forge a future. Strength in Agony This is the tale of a young girl’s struggle to escape the dark halls of the castle after her abduction. This Content Pack is automatically installed when you download this game. It also unlocks the soundtrack in the in-game jukebox. Suffer on Revival The very first Citadale game was released in 2013 and wasn't even a Citadale game to begin with. Discover the true origins of the series in this free revival of the game once called 'Minivania'. It also unlocks the soundtrack in the in-game jukebox. Book of Shadows A journey into darkness begins when the missing pages of an infamous tome threaten to fall into the wrong hands. This DLC Pack unlocks the whole Book of Shadows game as well as its soundtrack in the in-game jukebox. Prelude to War The son of the Dark Lord of the old lands searches for a fitting resting place for his father’s cursed remains. This DLC Pack unlocks the whole Prelude to War game as well as its soundtrack in the in-game jukebox. Darkness my Curse Gabriel Dorleac scours Citadale island for the very first time in search for his missing brother. This DLC Pack includes the full game as well as the soundtrack for the in-game jukebox. ------------------------------- Controller Information: Due to limitations with the engine, some controllers may not work properly. There is, unfortunately, nothing I can do about that. Should you have any trouble with your gamepad, maybe try another gamepad or use the keyboard. I apologize for the inconvenience.

rows.name: Ship Graveyard Simulator 2: Prologue
rows.short_description: The Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version of the game. Visit the new beach coast with the largest, biggest ship graveyard in the world, dismantle huge ship parts and collect tons of precious steel. Roll up your sleeves, it's time to get back to the business.
rows.description_html: Ship Graveyard Simulator 2: Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version of the game IT'S GOOD TO BE BACK IN THE BUSINESS! Ship Graveyard Simulator 2: Prologue is back bigger than before and it doesn't matter if you're a veteran in the game or for the first time you will have a hammer and a torch in your hands there are a dozen of kilometers of wreckage on the coast, and thousands of tons of steel - you will get into this business. DISASSEMBLE BIG SHIP PARTS Large ship parts? Oh yes! You will need a special crane and a large container for it. Ship Graveyard Simulator 2: Prologue will have large fragments, modules and wreck components available for demolition, including engines, pumps, control panels, and much more. HUGE SHIPS Order new ships waiting for demolition via the computer in your home, and with the new ship, you will receive a new task! Collect all the necessary steel, aluminum, or copper parts, even a small part has its own value. There will be several types of ships available in the game, which will be divided into individual categories - some of them are real colossi. DESTRUCTION Your main task in the game is to dismantle ships into small parts. Some of them will be small, but a huge challenge awaits you, which will be the disassembly of real giants, and hiring workers who will be able to help you. Use the available tools - hammer, saw, torch, etc. - to disassemble individual pieces of the ship into smaller pieces, collect as many of them as possible and develop your business! DANGERS Remember that you are doing one of the most dangerous jobs in the world and you disarm the biggest shipwrecks in the world, so what could go wrong? In Ship Graveyard Simulator 2: Prologue there are many dangers waiting for you - gas leakage, electric shock from cable, and poisoning with toxins in unsecured rooms. Do you remember about large fragments and ship modules? You'd better have your helmet on.

rows.name: Deckweaver: Descent Into Chaos
rows.short_description: Deckweaver: Descent into Chaos is a first person deckbuilding game where the player crafts their abilities using different cards they find in the environment. Obliterate forces of chaos, fighting through corrupt locations in the world before getting the chance to face and defeat Chaos itself.
rows.description_html: In the fantasy realm of Alveria, step into the shoes of The Wanderer, a daring adventurer who draws their power from a deck of enchanted cards. However, dark and malevolent forces in the form of Lovecraftian monstrosities have descended upon the realm, spreading corruption and chaos throughout the land. As The Wanderer, you must brave the hostile terrain of Alveria, venturing into the very heart of this malice to purify the shrines that lie within. Your ultimate goal is to summon a portal to The Great Abyss, the shadowy realm from which these terrifying creatures emerge, and confront the Elder Being at its heart. Only by destroying this malevolent force can you hope to save Alveria from certain doom. So gather your strength, sharpen your wits, and prepare to face the ultimate challenge in this epic adventure of heroism and magic! The agents of chaos are powerful and runs will be tough. If you are defeated, rest up and venture out to try again in this First Person Deckbuilding Roguelike . Features: Find and choose from 30+ different cards to weave into your deck of spells. Slay agents of chaos as you battle through different maps and environments, purging chaos wherever it stands. Collect artifacts that alter the way you play and explore. Face off against Chaos itself in an epic boss battle to save Alveria.

Slay agents of chaos as you battle through different maps and environments, purging chaos wherever it stands. Collect artifacts that alter the way you play and explore. Face off against Chaos itself in an epic boss battle to save Alveria.

rows.name: DIGITAL EXORCIST case_(0);
rows.short_description: Step into a dark world where cyberdemons haunt humankind. When mutilated bodies start appearing all over this sleepy town in the Mississippi inaka, Sawyer, ex-AGENCY operative; now unemployed shut-in, must exorcise the demon perpetrator in this story-rich, PC-98 style adventure game.
rows.description_html: Open the door to a world where demons whisper from beneath the glow of the screens. A compact adventure game inspired by Japanese adventure classics like Snatcher, Policenauts and The Silver Case. Join retired Digital Exorcist Sawyer and his trusty sidekick Tomo as they investigate chilling crime scenes. Use your wit to guide conversations and help Sawyer rediscover his old techniques to solve the mysteries lurking throughout your adventure. Investigate Gruesome Crime Scenes Thoroughly explore crime scenes with your trusty computerized companion, Tomodachi, as you collect evidence and equipment to assist in your investigation. Purge like it’s 1999! Go head-to-head with demons, and use items and weapons you find to fend them off! Elevated Experience with Stylized Art Style and Soundtrack An immersive, dark and gruesome setting. Brought to life through charming pixel art and a boppin’ soundtrack produced with classic digital synthesizers.

rows.name: Duckball
rows.short_description: Duckball is an action-packed battle royale game where up to 100 players compete to be the last duck standing. Play with friends online and collect wacky items to knock your opponents off the stage in an ever changing 3D environment. Do you have what it takes to be truly glorious?
rows.description_html: Duckball is an action-packed battle royale game where up to 100 players compete to be the last duck standing. Play with friends online and collect wacky items to knock your opponents off the stage in an ever changing 3D environment. Do you have what it takes to be truly glorious? There are 2 main gamemodes to choose from: Deathmatch and Battle Royale. In the Deathmatch gamemode, if you get knocked off of the stage, don't worry you'll respawn in a cannon and be launched back into the fray. In Battle Royale, you have only one life and want to knock out all of your competitors. Roll into the items that are scattered throughout the arena and use them to fight and outmaneuver your rival ducks. Try combining various items such as Flight, Boost, and Bullet to become a fly by Duckball fighter jet! Customizable rulesets provide an unlimited amount of gameplay scenarios. Dive into the world of Duckball and discover what other secrets await.

rows.name: Noah Please!
rows.short_description: Dash and whack your way through waves of animals that want a piece of that ark. There's only room for two of each!
rows.description_html: Noah, you have one task : to allow two of each animal onto the Ark before the Great Flood. To do so, you shall be granted the ability to WHACK ! Use it to push animals you don't need away from the ark and knock them out! Furthermore, you shall be modestly bestowed with energy orbs , which you shall use judiciously in your effort to manage the boarding. Watch out for funny-looking animals ; if you see one of those, you'll wanna put it down quick before it starts outrunning ya. Finally, the Minimap will prove a worthy tool at your disposal. Spots are limited!

rows.name: Dual Chroma: Academy Carols
rows.short_description: Spend Winter break with the popular and unapproachable Prince of the Empire in this cozy and heartwarming Magic Academy visual novel
rows.description_html: Dual Chroma: Academy Carols is a short prequel to our upcoming game: Dual Chroma, a fantasy romance visual novel. Select your magic type, pronouns and name and enter a magical world with other arcane students! Story: Winter break has come to Aradal. Unable to afford the journey back home, you brace yourself for a long snowfall alone at the Magic Academy, only to find you aren't the last student left on campus. What's more, among your newfound festive companions is the popular and typically unapproachable Prince Keldrannon - the last person you'd expect to stay. What begins as a sad and solitary wintertide soon thaws into the promise of something far more precious. Warmth, friendship, perhaps even love. A thoroughly merry and magical celebration may await you, after all. Features: English Visual Novel Multiple endings Fully illustrated

rows.name: Tales of Rein Ravine
rows.short_description: Tales of Rein Ravine is an indie horse game that aims to challenge its players with unique real-life inspired riding, as well as tell an intriguing equestrian story to a young adult audience.
rows.description_html: In lush alpine mountains and meadows stands the renowned equestrian capital of Europe, a town called Rein Ravine and its surrounding province of the same name. You have been admitted to study in its highly sought-after Rein Ravine Equine University International , alongside with other ambitious equestrians from around the world. This once in a lifetime opportunity leads you to train in the three most common European disciplines - showjumping, dressage, and cross country - under the eye of masters claimed to be some of the best in the world. But is equestrian life in this prestigious village as glamorous as it appears? The Early Access version of Tales of Rein Ravine doesn't contain the storyline yet, but while waiting for the school year to begin, you can visit the barns in Rein Ravine and take summer riding lessons! Tales of Rein Ravine aims to challenge its players with first-of-its-kind riding mechanics and gameplay heavily inspired by real-life horse riding, as well as tell an intriguing story - more mature than typical in its genre - to a young adult audience of horse gamers. Horses in Rein Ravine are versatile to ride, ranging from calm and experienced geldings to hot-blooded mares and easily spooked young stallions.

rows.name: Memory Land Extreme
rows.short_description: Welcome to Memory Land Extreme! Can you remember 1000 objects? Do you want to?
rows.description_html: Welcome to Memory Land Extreme, the game where your memory skills will be pushed to their absolute limits! In this experimental game, we've thrown all notions of 'fun' out the window and replaced it with a singular focus on memory retention. If that doesn't make you want to play this, we don't know what will. Shoot the correct objects: You'll need to remember which objects to shoot in order to progress through the level. Which objects are correct? It's up to you to figure it out! Arbitrary correctness: There's no rhyme or reason to which objects are correct. It's all completely arbitrary, which means you'll need to rely solely on your memory skills to succeed. 4 different guns: Spice up your memory training by using one of our four unique guns to shoot the objects. Each gun has its own strengths and weaknesses, so choose wisely! One thousand objects: The ultimate goal of the game is to correctly remember one thousand objects. Can you do it? Features Remember Boats Remember Vegetables Remember Numbers Remember Tables Remember Sofas Remember Letters If you're looking for a challenge and a chance to push your memory skills to their limits, then Memory Land Extreme is the game for you. Just don't expect to have 'fun' while you're at it!

rows.name: CARTOONITE
rows.short_description: Choose your favorite vehicle from an infinite number of possibilities. Have fun crashing into objects to collect resources and build your own world. Show your friends what you've built and do stunts with them.
rows.description_html: Are you looking for something new and never seen before? Cartoonite is for you. It offers you a completely innovative sand box racing game experience never seen before. Do the usual games bore you and would you like something fun and competitive at the same time? Cartoonite is for you. It takes you to the discovery of a colorful and fully explorable world in which you can build and collect resources crashing into objects while challenging your friends in multiplayer with a cartoon style. Do you want to have fun in a colorful world and challenge your friends in multiplayer? Cartoonite is for you. Choose your favorite vehicle from an infinite number of possibilities. Decide between offroad, drift with FR legendary cars or choose between all sorts of vehicles. Have fun crashing into objects to collect resources and build your own world. Show your friends what you've built and do stunts with them. Cartoonite is a limitless world full of color and fun. It offers you a box full of tools and toys to enjoy with your friends in multiplayer in this sand box game. Download now to experience the fun: - A FULLY EXPLOREABLE WORLD : you have the freedom to do what you want. You can play with your friends or challenge them to breathtaking races. Exploring a free and colorful cartoon style world. - BUILD AND RESOURCE SYSTEM : A racing game finally joins a survival game. Collect resources by crashing into all sorts of objects and use your resources to build your world. Like any survival game you have to manage your resources well and explore the map to find all sorts of secrets. - ALL SORT OF VEHICLES : You have the option to choose all sorts of vehicles. You can drift with FR legendary cars or get your car dirty with mud from offroad cars. You can choose trucks or supercars. The important thing is that you make them as unique as you are. - MULTIPLAYER SYSTEM : Share your creations with your friends and have fun with them. Race alongside your friends in this survival racing game and become legendary. Download now and enter the world of your dreams through this revolutionary new sand box racing game full of fun and color in a cartoon style.

rows.name: RagBrawl
rows.short_description: Get ready to ragdoll in RagBrawl! Compete as a floppy Tuffling toy with up to 12 players online and show them your stuff in this chaotic party game!
rows.description_html: Welcome to RagBrawl, the new party game on the block that has you grappling, ragdolling, and battling your way to victory! In this online multiplayer party game, you compete as a floppy Tuffling toy, taking on a variety of objectives and challenges. RagBrawl is all about fast-paced, chaotic action. With a range of game modes to choose from, there's always a new challenge to tackle. Whether you're looking to team up with friends or take on the competition solo, there's a mode to suit your playstyle! Game Modes In Infected mode, avoid being 'infected' and turned moldy. Only the strongest players can survive until the end. In Spool mode, the last player with the spool takes it all! Hold onto a spool until the end of the round or get eliminated! Rag Race mode puts players' grappling skills to the test. Race through an obstacle course, zipping from one room to the next, all while avoiding obstacles along the way. Finally, Stuffed mode is a free-for-all skirmish where you battle it out to defeat other players and collect the fluff they drop behind. The player with the most fluff at the end of the game wins! Customization Stand out in the crowd! RagBrawl features a robust cosmetic system to customize your Tuffling toy with hats, colors, and patterns. Show off your style as you battle your way to the top! No matter which mode you choose, RagBrawl is packed with features to keep the action fresh and exciting! Using ranged and melee combat, or the ability to grapple and ragdoll your way around the map, players need to be quick on their feet and creative in their approach to emerge victorious. So get ready to ragdoll in RagBrawl, and show the competition what you're made of! With its fast-paced action, exciting game modes, and endless customization options, it's the perfect game for any party!
