rows.name: Quacktown Smackdown
rows.short_description: Play as a Rubber Ducky in this 3rd Person Arena Shooter! Utilize squirt guns and water abilities and sink your opponents to become top duck of the tub! Battle it out in the Bubble Bath Battlefield or the Stormy Sandbox. Customize your ducky to make sure the lobby knows who's the Smack Down King!
rows.description_html: Quack Town Smack Down is a 3rd Person Arena shooter wrapped in a Goofy Rubber Duckky Toon Theme! Hustle to pick up randomized abilities spread throughout each map to give you an advantage. The Pistol, Bubble Buckshot, Sniper Soaker, Kahuna Kreator, and Whirler all await to give you an edge over your fellow Dukkies in Free-for-All water combat! Soak the competition by utilizing Bounce pads, water abilities, and terrain. The Bubble Bathtub is the Dukkies home turf sporting colorful toys and open areas. Take it out back in the Sandbox with more verticality, tight spaces, and run-and-gun tactics. Don't forget to customize your Dukkie's Hat, Eyes and the very rubber around their squeakers to make sure the lobby knows who the Smack Down King is!

rows.name: Hand2Hand
rows.short_description: The Hand2Hand project is a fighting game... OF HANDS ! Use everyday object in everyday places out of boredom in epic battles between... yourself.
rows.description_html: The Hand2Hand project is a fighting game... OF HANDS ! Use everyday object in everyday places out of boredom in epic battles between... yourself. Each item represents the weapon and the character using it ; we let the imagination go wild so everything is more epic. ☼ 5 classes ☼ 3 levels of AI ☼ 3 maps ☼ Local 1v1 ☼ Homemade musics & graphics ☼ Pixel perfect hitboxes The game is currently in development, and a bunch of features are yet to come. Nonetheless, we are happy to leave the community a playable version which will evolve during the following years ! Debug They can be changed in the data file Toggle debug display - Shift+D Heal both players - Shift+2 Change player 1 class - Shift+3 Change player 1 stance - Control+3 Toggle player 1 AI - Shift+V Change player 2 class - Shift+4 Change player 2 stance - Control+4 Toggle player 2 AI - Shift+B Toggle slowmo - Shift+5 Toggle FPS display - Shift+0 Screenshot - Shift+F Current status ☼ Hand2Hand still has a long road ahead. Everything before the 1.0 will be free. In other terms the last version before the 1.0 is free but discontinued. ☼ Some sounds are still 'borrowed' from other games, they are placeholders so don't ninja me with lawyers yet ; I will replace them soon enough and well before any penny comes to my pocket from Hand2Hand. ☼ Here bellow are the current milestones. Don't take them literally, as the development could change the order in practice. Demo/prototype =Done= ► 3 total classes ► Basic AI ► Solo map & class selection ► Basic interface ► Class gallery ► Combos ► In game interface ► 2 maps Pre Alpha =Done= ► Integrated mouse ► Option save ► Resolution settings ► 4 total classes ► Improved AI ► 3rd map ► Debug mode setting ► Control settings & save ► 5th class ► Fixed in-game controllers ► Pause system ► In game timer ► Player vs Player selection screen ► Basic tutorial ► Dodge Alpha ====== ► Reforge & juice all current animations ► Parry ► Round system ► Multichannel sound == [We are here !] == ► Combo display in class gallery ► Basic solo mode (1 vs many bots) ► Improved interface with fully integrated mouse & controller ► Training mode ► 6-7 total classes ► Back-end optimization (animation compression and loading) ► Special attacks ► Replace placeholders by homemade sounds ► Multi layer & animated backgrounds ► 4th map ► Zoom levels ► Knocked/falling system ► Editor tool for animations & classes Beta ====== ► Basic online mode ► ~10 classes ► 4 player local ► Advanced solo mode ► Basic story mode ► Advanced AI ► Advanced tutorial 1.0 ====== ► Advanced online mode (match-making) ► Ranked ► Advanced story mode ► ~15 total classes ► Colorblind & accessibility support And then ? ====== ► 40+ classes ► Large scale battle mode (100+ hands) ► Epic story mode ► 30+ maps Starting from here, the game will be extended through new classes, maps and story mode arcs. No DLCs are planned, even in the long run, so you would have a game with constantly new free updates !

rows.name: Fantasy World Souls
rows.short_description: MMO JRPG with more than 400 Heroes to collect. Was inspired in Retro RPG games. Call your friends and fight in Real-Time CO-OP Battle!
rows.description_html: -MMORPG -Old school JRPG style game -Indie Game -Monster training game -Story mode -Real time CO-OP Battle -PVP Arena -100% animated battle -Chat (Steam Deck Compatibility) Summary of story mode: Something goes wrong in creation and a cosmic battle ensues between spiritual beings. They fought for a sphere called 'Exfera Celestes', which would give unimaginable power to those who possessed it. The struggle was so intense that the veil between the spiritual and material world was torn apart and the sphere entered the material world. For some unknown reason the sphere broke into several upon falling into this material world. That's when a part fell near where the hero was, and with his curiosity he ended up possessing it and receiving some power. Now a spiritual Elder appears to him in visions and dreams and tells him the importance of preventing other beings from getting hold of the spheres. Each sphere that the hero gets throughout the story gives him capabilities such as: floating, breathing underwater, seeing spirits and so on.

rows.name: Journey to the Rift
rows.short_description: Uncover the secrets of a mysterious dungeon in this text-based adventure, where every adventure is different! Monsters, puzzles, and strange secrets await within, in this quest where the only limit is your imagination!
rows.description_html: In the far north, a strange melody has been luring all manner of monsters, misfits, and miscreants into the depths below. A mysterious power lurks beneath, but to uncover the secrets of this place, you'll need to be equipped with all the wit, strength, and cunning that you can muster, in your Journey to the Rift! Text-based fun for your imagination! Uncover the secrets of a mysterious dungeon in this text-based adventure, where every adventure is different! Establish a base camp, venture forth into the dungeon, and get ready for the many puzzles, monsters, and other strange denizens that await! Tackle each encounter in your own way, with each situation having multiple ways to progress. A different adventure with each playthrough With over a hundred unique encounters, no two playthroughs will be the same. To add even more variety, the residents of the dungeon will react to how you have handled previous encounters, allowing you to discover different secrets based on how you play! The choices you make will have far reaching consequences beyond the dungeon, so choose wisely! Make your base camp, a base home! Between episodes of spelunking you'll need a place to rest and recuperate. Grow your base camp into a burgeoning settlement complete with everything you'll need for your adventures. Expand enough and you'll attract an eclectic gang of characters that can offer their help, while giving you more opportunities for special quests and adventures!

rows.name: SomethingWithSpace
rows.short_description: A desolate and derelict station has been uncovered. You've been tasked with investigating, only to find the station's automated defenses are still active! How is it still... 'alive'? Pilot your ship and find out! Can you make it out... 'alive'? This helps me get through school! Hope you enjoy!
rows.description_html: A desolate and derelict station has been uncovered. You've been tasked with investigating, only to find the station's automated defenses are still active! Where did this place come from? How is it still... 'alive'... ? In this arcade space shooter, you pilot a ship equipped with bullet-buddies and take on an onslaught of attacks from alien-like automata (and organisms!?). Luckily, your ship is adaptable to some technology provided by the encounter, such as ship repair and weapon upgrades! Don't deploy too many bullet buddies, your ship's hull has only so much material it can use to fabricate mobile turrets! Use the ship's ultima-beam as a way of bull-dozing away much of what stands to hold you back! What lies beyond the veil of space and uncharted territory? Controls: Mouse - Moves the ship Left Click - Primary Fire Right Click - Ultima-beam 1-4 - Spawn Bullet Buddy Left Shift - Speed up Left Ctrl - Slow Down This also helps me get through school! Hope you enjoy!

rows.name: Blackout Hospital
rows.short_description: When the power goes out while working night shift in the hospital, the emergency lights come on with an eerie glow...
rows.description_html: Blackout Hospital is a game where you play as Vasilis, a nonbinary janitor at Altobuck Hospital. When the power goes out while working the night shift, the emergency lights come on and bask the halls in an eerie, ghostly glow. Bizarre happenings start to occur at the hospital, and Vasilis wants no part in it as they try to look for a way out! Along the way they will fight off mysterious enemies, meet strange characters, and make a few allies--but will any of it mean anything if they can never return home? Blackout Hospital is a story-driven RPG game that contains battles, puzzles, and character interaction. This RPG game consists of 3 different endings: A bad ending, a secret ending, and a true ending. Average playtime is about 6-8 hours! Credits follow the true ending!

rows.name: Cyphen
rows.short_description: A social zero gravity combat simulator: Guns, Spaceships and Explosions. Plasma bullets flying everywhere so dodge them! If you find yourself out-gunned.. use your knuckle punchers to eliminate nearby enemy players. Join the vast online world now!
rows.description_html: Zero gravity social combat simulator: Guns, Spaceships and Explosions. Play with your friends and meet new ones in massive online dedicated servers. The Cyphen project has many zero-gravity activities for your engagement. Maneuver a spaceship throughout the vast polygon world, dodging plasma bullets in the pursuit of victory . Voice chat is on by default! Leisure with friends in the social lounge and join a battle just by sitting down at any battle table. The Cyphen experiment will become whatever the community makes of it. Space explorer.

rows.name: Goblins
rows.short_description: Command the Emerald Goblin Army and win the Great Gold War. Master Campaign Battes across 20 unique and increasingly difficult levels. Relax with a fun Mini-Game. Battle and play with your friends in Multiplayer Lobbies and Arenas (Multiplayer Beta Available Now)
rows.description_html: Command the Emerald Goblin Army, avenge and defeat the Ruby Goblin Army and win the Great Gold War. Recruit special classes such as: Mages, Bombers, Barbarians, Necromancers and more. Call for precise artillery strikes to cause maximum destruction. Master Battles through 20 unique and increasingly difficult Campaign maps. Challenge yourself further in Freeplay Battles by selecting the highest difficulty. Enjoy a break from Battles and play a casual Mini-Game . Steal as much gold as possible from the enemy in Ruby Robbery, on your quest to steal a precious gem from the enemy. Face off against the entire 'Knights Gauntlet' at once in a fierce battle. And more to come in the future. -Multiplayer Open BETA Available Now-

rows.name: Misteri Rumah Pak RT
rows.short_description: 'Misteri Rumah Pak RT' is a horror-themed action-puzzle multiplayer game where players must explore a mysterious mansion, solve puzzles, and escape by finding keys, either alone against a computer-controlled antagonist or with up to 4 players in co-op mode.
rows.description_html: 'Misteri Rumah Pak RT' is a horror-themed action-puzzle multiplayer game set in a mysterious mansion house owned by Pak RT. Players must explore the dark and eerie corridors, solve challenging puzzles, and uncover the secrets of the mansion to find the keys that will unlock the exit and allow them to escape. In this game, players must use their problem-solving skills and quick reflexes to navigate the dangers of the mansion, as they face a variety of obstacles and challenges that threaten to prevent their escape. The game can be played with up to 4 players in co-op mode, allowing players to team up and work together, or as a single player experience, where players will face the computer-controlled antagonist. The computer-controlled antagonist adds a unique and challenging twist to the game, as the AI is programmed to be highly intelligent and adaptable to the player's actions. The computer will actively try to prevent players from escaping, making the game even more challenging. With a spooky and immersive atmosphere, challenging puzzles, and intense action, 'Misteri Rumah Pak RT' offers an unforgettable gaming experience for players looking for a horror-themed action-puzzle multiplayer game. Whether playing alone or with friends, players will be transported to a world of mystery and terror as they try to solve the mystery of Pak RT's mansion. The game is available now on Steam, so gather your friends and embark on an adventure to escape the mysterious mansion of Pak RT.

rows.name: AI Solitaire
rows.short_description: AI Solitaire features Klondike Solitaire and Pyramid Solitaire, 18 different deck styles, and has password protected parental controls. The base game is offered for free and can be played as is without any cost forever.
rows.description_html: AI Solitaire features both Klondike Solitaire and Pyramid Solitaire . It includes 18 different deck styles to choose from and has password protected parental controls to make sure that you and your family only see the content you choose to see. The base game is offered for free and can be played as is without any cost forever. We plan to offer rulesets DLC with additional solitaire versions and content DLC with more fun deck styles that you can choose to purchase, or not. The 18 deck styles in the base game include 3 traditional playing card decks and 15 AI art-based card decks. 3 card decks are rated 'Family Friendly'. 15 card decks are rated 'Teen+'. There are no 'Adult' rated card decks included in the base game. None of the decks in the base game include any nudity. rows.name: Rally31
rows.short_description: Rally31 is a small open-world racing game with 12 unique and experimental vehicles. The vehicles are physics-based with each one having a different setup to the suspension system. This adds variety to the difficulty level and driving experience of each machine.
rows.description_html: Rally31 is a small open-world racing game with 12 unique and experimental vehicles. The vehicles are physics-based with each one having a different setup to the suspension system. This adds variety to the difficulty level and driving experience of each machine. The vehicles use a cell shader inspired by the anime Wangan Midnight and the rest of the environment is done in a cartoon style. The level is a chain of islands that are built on a base that is 6 km long and 3 km wide. Each island is fully explorable. You can buy more cars and access your inventory at the player’s house. You can earn money to buy cars by finishing stages. You can get a reward bonus by beating your best time or for completing a stage with a car that is difficult to drive. All the controls are listed in the pause menu that is accessed with the escape key. You can open and close the map with the “M” key. The map marks the start of stages with red flags and the player’s house with a blue house icon. If you get stuck, you can rewind by holding “X” on the keyboard or ”Y” on a controller. If you cannot free yourself with the rewind, then press “R” on the keyboard to reset your position back to the start of the level. The controller can be turned on in the options menu accessed via the pause menu, by clicking “CLICK TO USE A CONTROLLER”. The options menu also allows you to adjust the volume and change the gearbox behaviour from automatic to manual. I plan on supporting and updating this game for the foreseeable future.

rows.name: Stacks:Space!
rows.short_description: Stacks:Space is a space-themed base builder card game with rogue-like elements. Buy booster packs to get new cards, discover craft recipes by stacking cards together, create structures, manufacture drones and droids, defend your base from enemies, visit distant planets, and more!
rows.description_html: Stacks:Space is a space-themed base builder card game with rogue-like elements. Buy booster packs to get new cards, discover craft recipes by stacking cards together, create structures, manufacture drones and droids, defend your base from enemies, visit distant planets, and more! DISCLAIMER: This game is inspired by Stacklands, but it is not Stacklands, and it is not a sequel to Stacklands - it is a completely independent project that feels and plays differently from Stacklands. Options and Features Created with Stacks:Engine, a card game framework that is heavily inspired by the Stacklands and Cultist Simulator games ~370 cards to collect and use in Stacks:Space (~370 cards in Stacks:Village mod) ~100 craft recipes (some cards could be crafted via multiple recipes) 7 unique bosses to defeat 1 base location + 12 visitable quest locations (incl. shops) Astronauts / Settlers have trainable attributes: Strength, Agility, Endurance, Intelligence Various scenarios - each having different starting conditions, different end-game goals, or even a different location Game Tutorial included for the first scenario Daily Challenge Mode - an option to have a relatively quick game run with random goals and restrictions each day Modding support Combat Both ranged and melee combat modes are supported (no combat box!). Melee units will move toward the enemy as soon as they see it. Drag your card next to an enemy card (do not stack them!), and you'll see them punching each other. Ranged units will shoot their projectiles immediately. Stacked cards - the ones doing crafts - do not engage in combat, but could be attacked by an enemy card. Some enemies prefer to attack resource cards instead. Modding support Stacks:Space is moddable! The built-in mod management interface allows near-infinite extension of a game. With just a tiny bit of JSON knowledge, it is possible to create and add new cards, recipes, scenarios, locations, and even completely new games. This game is so moddable that it already includes Stacks:Village , a fantasy village sim, as a mod - accessible via the top-right corner of the starting screen. See this youtube video for gameplay details. The comprehensive modding manual is a work in progress, please stay tuned.

rows.name: MementoMori
rows.short_description: Dive into a World Where Sorrow Meets Beauty
rows.description_html: “All roads lead to our ‘Goodbye.’” Boasting an epic soundtrack that can turn the world of gaming on its head, and some of the most stunning designs ever seen in a game, Bank of Innovation’s newest title, MementoMori, is finally here! Songs performed by many renowned artists enhance the rich world of MementoMori. *We recommend playing while wearing earphones or headphones. ◆ STORY: A tale of “justice” woven by girls whose fragile hearts verge on shattering... There are girls who many call “witches.” Although they themselves are ordinary, they can wield slightly extraordinary powers. However, when calamity spreads throughout the land, witches begin to be feared and detested. Before long, the Church of Longinus commenced what would be known as “The Witch Hunt.” “Witches are to blame for this calamity. If we kill them, then the calamity will vanish along with them!” Witches are executed one by one. But one day, as madness seizes control of the world, it is suddenly overrun by “Curses.” A country incinerated by hellfire. A kingdom consumed by crystals. An empire purged by the Tree of Life. Such are the woeful desires of those who are called “Witches of Qlipha.” Without any means to defend themselves, nation after nation falls into ruin, until finally— The fractured land is sent adrift high into the sky. Meanwhile, the people have yet to take notice. From within these girls cursed to be witches, there emanates glimmers of hope. In order to save their decimated world, these girls set forth liberating the land from darkness. For they believe that it is the right thing to do... ◆ GAME: ・Play utilizing both easy-to-use full auto-battles and high-level strategy! ・Behold stunning action-packed battles animated using Live2D! ・Harness the “Idle System” to gradually get stronger as the girls fight even while you’re away! ・Unlock tons of content as you advance the story! ・Discover infinite strategic possibilities by combining your wit with the girls’ magical powers! ・Enhance gear to precisely influence how the girls grow stronger! ・Communicate with your friends as you form the most powerful guild in the land! ◆ SOUND: The girls of MementoMori are burdened with cruel pasts and inevitable fates. ・Cry to “Laments,” which sing each girl’s emotions to life. ・Play accompanied with a high-quality soundtrack not bound to the limits of game music. The diversity of high-quality musical compositions heavily intertwines with the perilous world of MementoMori, providing a new and exciting gaming experience. ◆ CV/SONG: Illya (CV Kana Hanazawa) (Song by Daoko) Iris (CV Inori Minase) (Song by Hakubi) Rosalie (CV Sumire Uesaka) (Song by Sayaka Yamamoto) Soltina (CV Yoshino Nanjo) (Song by Koresawa) Amleth (CV Atsumi Tanezaki) (Song by Atarayo) Fenrir (CV Minami Takahashi) (Song by Kano) Freesia (CV Yui Horie) (Song by Sonoko Inoue) Belle (CV Yuu Asakawa) (Song by 96NEKO) Luke (CV Ami Koshimizu) (Song by Ayaka Hirahara) Carol (CV Hina Tachibana) (Song by kurokumo) ...and many more! *The above is the Japanese cast for the game. Voices can be changed from English to Japanese in the game’s settings. ------ Powered by Live2D

rows.name: SkyIsland
rows.short_description: 'SkyIsland' is made by a group of students in a college, quarter-view action-adventure game. Enjoy the wonderful world and beautiful environments as you help the protagonist, Pino, fix his broken plane and defeat monsters to return home safely.
rows.description_html: Synopsis While trying to make his grandfather's dream come true, An unknown creature attacked Pino, which led him to crash-land on the Skyisland. To return home safely, fix his broken plane, and defeat the monster. The game 'SkyIsland' is an adventure game created by a team of college students. You can use a sword, spear, and hammer as primary weapons and a bow as a secondary weapon. Each weapon has its own identity and temporary skill. rows.description_html: 'THIS STORY IS A WARNING. YOU COULD BE NEXT.' Amy receives an invitation to a group chat set up by some of her former classmates. Its purpose is to reconnect after all these years. But soon more and more disturbing facts about Amy's classmates are revealed, and Amy begins to fear that the people she's texting with may not be what they seem. Class Reunion Chat Room is a visual novel that immerses you into Amy's role by letting you type her predefined chat messages. What you're supposed to type is visible in gray letters. What you are currently typing will be overlaid in black letters. If you've typed everything correctly, then your black text should overlay the gray text perfectly. Press 'Enter' or klick the send button on the right hand side of the text box to send your message. If you're unable to send your message then you haven't typed the message correctly. Make sure not to forget any easy to miss dots and commas. You can listen to and download the soundtrack on Bandcamp. Features Over 5000 words in length. 20–30 minutes playtime. Original music and sound design. Text input system that lets you write Amy's predefined messages. Authentic chat interface and experience.

rows.name: Virtual Families 3
rows.short_description: The sequel to the smash hit mobile game “Virtual Families 2” is here!
rows.description_html: The Mountain Resort is here! Take your family on a trip to this scenic mountain getaway and renovate this old Resort in need of repair into a popular vacation destination! AI Guests will visit and stay at the Resort, so decorate it creatively to give them a unique and enjoyable experience! ADOPT YOUR FAMILY TODAY! Adopt a little person from the thousands living inside your mobile device! In this life simulation game, help them choose a husband or wife and start their virtual family! Make babies and pass the house on to the kids! Help nurture and guide generations, managing your own beautiful family story. DESIGN YOUR DREAM HOME Expand and renovate your virtual house. Your adoptee’s new home has a lot of potential, but they need your help to fix it up! Imagine your dream home and make it a reality. Add bedrooms, a garden, a home theater, or even a game room! Collect decorations to customize and design each room. MAKE A HAPPY, PROSPEROUS LIFE Train your little people from babies to adulthood to take care of their home and make the best choices in life. Encourage them to work on their career and earn money for decorations, necessities, and luxuries. Upgrade your virtual family to be the best versions of themselves. Your little people will send you messages, thanking, pleading, and praising you for caring for them. Don’t forget to check in on them, because they miss you and become very sad! LIFE SIMULATION RUNS IN REAL TIME! Your little family continues to live, eat, grow, and work when the app is switched off. Along the way, there will be many different random events to respond to, all of them adding surprise to this simulation game and unexpected elements to routine, daily virtual life. Find highly varied, unpredictable game play. No two games run the same; the story unfolds differently for everyone who plays it. This simulation game is designed to have a life of its own!

rows.name: Chrono Rift
rows.short_description: Join the Breach Hunter Guild in Chrono Rift, a multiplayer online coop game of fantasy, action and roguelike elements. Defend the world from monster invasions caused by mysterious breaches and uncover the truth behind the phenomenon. Play now!
rows.description_html: Step into the shoes of a wizard in Chrono Rift and embark on a thrilling adventure to defend the world from monster invasions caused by mysterious spatiotemporal breaches! Join the Breach Hunter Guild and team up with other players online to take on the challenge. With a mix of fantasy, action, and roguelike elements, get ready to unleash your magic and destroy the breaches before it's too late. Will you be the one to uncover the truth behind this crazy phenomenon and save the world? Play Chrono Rift now! Replay the game an infinite amount of time by testing different combinations of spells and effect. Wanna go full DPS? Then get the 'duplicate projectile' effect to multiply your damage! Wanna deal massive damage to a large crowd of enemies? Why not opt for the 'projectile ricochet' effect and AOE spells! Each enemies have elemental strength and weaknesses. Choose your elemental type of damage wisely depending on your teammates and the opponents you will be facing. It is your duty as Breach Hunters to face invaders of different universes and timelines. Determined to destroy your kingdom, an evil entity opens portals to realms where all sorts of evil creatures reside: Zombies, Aliens, Robots, Orcs and even Pirates! Each of these species have their own behaviors and will use different tactics to try to destroy you. Zombies are slows but numerous melee foes. Aliens are fast but afraid of fire. Robots use futuristic tech and more tactical strategies. Orcs are walking tanks who gets close and personal with his enemies. Finally, pirates are... Well they are pirates! Team up with up to 3 other Breach Hunters and stop the evils that are invading your realm! Purchase of this game contains the main game only.

rows.short_description: The following is a series of tapes recovered near the Overlook National Park where four people were recently reported missing- a family of three and one motorist.
rows.description_html: The following is a series of tapes recovered near the Overlook National Park where four people were recently reported missing- a family of three and one motorist. OWLMAN is a retro-stylized, first-person horror game played through the lens of a motorist documenting their favorite getaway. As they proceed back down the mountain and the sun starts to set, it becomes clear something is wrong. Explore an atmospheric open-world forest and evade the OWLMAN, among other threats. Features VHS , retro aesthetic. Linear story taking place across a series of tapes. Infinite Chase Mode : See how long you can evade the Owlman and explore the open world without the constraints of a narrative. OWLMAN is not a you-die-you-lose sort of game. It is sometimes necessary that the characters in the narrative meet their intended fates.

rows.name: Thalassic
rows.short_description: Thalassic is a VR underwater horror survival game where you explore a planet a few thousand years after its evacuation. Explore the depths of this new world ocean with your capsule communicator George. Encounter different creatures as you go deeper and find what lurks down in the depths.
rows.description_html: Thalassic is a VR underwater horror survival game where you explore a planet a few thousand years after its evacuation. Venture through the depths of this new ocean world with your capsule communicator George who is on the radio to guide you on your mission. You must take radiation tests every 200 meters you go to ensure that you are not risking your safety and to see if the planet would be suitable for human life to inhabit the planet once more. Encounter different creatures long thought to be extinct as you go deeper and find what lurks down in the depths. You play the entire game inside your submarine and the only way you can move your lever is down. George your capsule communicator will be guiding you on the way to prevent you from getting lost in what you're doing. He will guide you through puzzles such as finding hologram discs and working other parts of the ship. You must also manage your hunger and vitals during the trip. If they get too low, you will die. Food can be acquired through fishing and the vending machine. There are 4 main rooms in the ship that you must use. The first being the bridge, the bridge is where you control the movement of your submarine, it is a semi-circular glass dome so it is also the best view for the environment around you. The radio that George uses to communicate with you is in this room so being in the bridge is the only way to hear him. The next most important room is the research room, this contains the hologram pad which you use to display radiation levels, fishing and many more hologram discs. This is your living quarters and where you spend most of your time on the journey there. It also holds the vending machine which is your main source of food during the expedition. The next room is the engine room, it is where the engine powering the ship is held, there isn't much else in that room but you want to keep an eye on it because it can overheat sometimes. lastly is the ballast tank, this is what controls the buoyancy allowing the ship to go down.

rows.name: Project Chaos
rows.short_description: Project Chaos Is A High Octane, Manic & Chaotic, Multiplayer First Person Shooter. Set In 2098, A Team Of Rebels, Activists & Terrorists Band Together With One Goal: To Incite Change. Their Method Of Choice? Chaos!
rows.description_html: Based in claustrophobic small maps, with reactive and fast paced movement, PROJECT CHAOS boasts a lack of lengthy death timers, transporting you back into the fight instantly, keeping the momentum of the game rolling. Deaths and kills are not recorded and displayed, in favour of a score based system, where bonuses and also detriments can increase or decrease the score. With the goal of the game to obtain the highest score as either a team or a solo player. Jump into chaotic battles with Project Chaos signature mode: Chaos. Where with each life you spawn with a completely different loadout. Use the constant changes to learn new weapons, experiment with different playstyles or just enjoy the bonkers mess the gamemode produces. Or for the more classic players, jump into the normal Team Death Match and Free For All gamemodes, where you can use your pre-set loadout in an attempt to cause as much chaos as physically possible. You can only cause so much chaos with a stick, so Project Chaos only the provides the most powerful weapons for players to wield. With options like: Smart Rocket Launchers, .50 Cal Snipers, Miniguns, Lightning SMG’s, Full Auto Incendiary Shotguns, and much more make up the in game arsenal.

rows.name: Crypto Miner Tycoon Simulator Starter Edition
rows.short_description: Start in your bedroom in year 2010. Build rigs to mine Bitcoin, Ethereum and other crypto coins. Trade on the market to grow wealth. Expand your business into new offices. Hire skilled employees and assign tasks. Use cash from your mega farms to research new technologies.
rows.description_html: Get the full game About the Game Crypto Miner Tycoon Simulator™ is a complete simulation of the cryptocurrency mining business. The Starter Edition includes one full scenario and story from the main game. In this one, you start as a teenager whose wealthy father is hyped about digital currency. He isn’t really tech savvy, so he gives you some cash and challenges you to build a crypto mining business: Relive mining history Start in your bedroom in 2010 Historically accurate coin exchange rates Various events including new hardware unlocks Speed up the game clock up to 28800x The game uses real historic prices for coins, but your actions can change the course of history. For example, you can set up a PR department that will influence the media and hype some coins up or down. Build mining rigs Assemble rigs from PC parts Install software Use racks to organize space and direct heat Replace broken parts and outdated components A custom C++ game engine was written specially for this game in order to support 1000’s of mining hardware units per facility. Mine coins Play through the CPU, GPU, FPGA and ASIC mining era Mine Bitcoin, Ethereum and more... Realistic network hash rates Manage power, heat, noise, dust Build datacenters with cooling systems and low dust levels. Keep noise down in research labs. Manage your company buy or rent new offices hire people set work shifts and task priorities pay monthly bills and wages You can unlock overtime work by upgrading your management skill or hiring professional managers. Research develop employee skills create research labs discover new technology before competition create your own coin and launch the ICO Each game scenario has a special research goal related to the story. Customization Customize your character Set dress code for employees Use whichever currency you like ($, GBP, EUR, RUB, CNY…) Imperial and metric system supported What are you waiting for? The best time to start mining was 10 years ago.

rows.name: Low Oxygen
rows.short_description: Explore an abandoned facility on the planet you've crashlanded, solving puzzles with strange plants along the way.
rows.description_html: Low Oxygen is a small puzzle platformer about an astronaut that crash-landed on an alien planet, trying to find a way to reach his home, Earth, again. The Objective Explore a strange facility in order to find a way to blast off the surface of your new planet. You'll traverse 50 rooms filled with strange puzzles , and occasionally some fuel canisters, the ticket to your home. The Plants The main mechanic of the game is represented by the strange flora you'll find, plants that grow when they are ridden of their oxygen supply, and now its your time to get used to them, and use them to your advantage! The future My future plans are to expand this by adding a level edtior, steam workshop stuff probably , enabling player to make & share their own hand-crafted experiences! Also controller support ! Closing Thoughts I hope you'll enjoy this small passion project of mine, don't forget to leave a review! I'll try to read through as many of them as possible!

rows.short_description: Thor and the Vikings are on a mission to save Midgard from Fenrir. To achieve their aim, they take a daring journey to Ancient Greece in search of a remedy. However, they soon realize that the task ahead of them will be harder than they imagined.
rows.description_html: Take the journey of a lifetime with Thor and the Vikings! Go to Ancient Greece and help Thor, Hercules’ daughter Alexia, and the other warriors save Midgard from Fenrir. Fenrir, a giant wolf, is ready to destroy Midgard and all its inhabitants in his rage. Follow Fenrir’s story and explore the source of his immense anger as he sets off on a path of destruction. Discover a thrilling story and find out what made Fenrir so angry that he has resolved to destroy Midgard. Are you ready to join the Vikings on their epic quest to defeat the Minotaur? You’ll have to prove your worth by solving the Gods’ puzzles. Embark on an unforgettable adventure as you join the Vikings in their mission to bring peace back to the world! Get ready to embark on a journey to the mythical world of Olympus! Go on Zeus’ quest and find a special flower for the goddess Calypso. Along the way, you will explore the mysterious underworld, meet Hades, and uncover secrets about Cerberus.

rows.short_description: Ready for a challenge? Test your strategy skills in an intense real-time battle with friends. With just enough units and buildings to keep it exciting, you can jump into online multiplayer games the moment that perfect Steam invite arrives!
rows.description_html: Join our Discord: Ready for a challenge? Test your strategy skills in an intense real-time battle with friends. With just enough units and buildings to keep it exciting, you can jump into an online multiplayer game the moment that perfect Steam invite arrives! Reduced Complexity Get ready to enjoy the simplicity! With only five building types and six unit types, you don’t have to worry about feeling bogged down—now it's time for some fun. Random Map Generation Discover an uncharted world with each map you generate! Unlock new levels of excitement as you journey through unpredictable landscapes and ever-changing challenges. Easy Multiplayer With just one click, you can challenge your Steam friends to a thrilling online match! Have fun and prove yourself the ultimate gaming champion. Great Controls Now you can make quick work of commanding your troops with our intuitive control system. Select and group units without the hassle, so that military tactics come to life right before your eyes! Retro Graphics Step back in time and explore the world of pixel art. With our retro graphics, you can experience a classic aesthetic while still staying clear and readable - it's fantastical fun!

rows.name: Golgotha
rows.short_description: Dare to explore the most haunted vicinity in all of England? You will leave no stone unturned as you walk along the eerie grounds of the Black Waters Station and uncover the horror that lies within.
rows.description_html: Golgotha is a short first person horror game that delves deep into creeping fear and severe paranoia as you traverse through the sinister grounds of Black Waters Station. Along the way you will discover the horrors that lie within and ultimately disturb those who are not at rest. The lantern and dim lights will guide your way through the station as you explore and find your way towards the exit. There are multiple cutscenes to encounter and items to discover. Golgotha features no combat. This game focuses primarily on atmosphere and dread. The game's main features are realistic immersion, fantastic sound design and disturbing imagery throughout. Black Waters Station is a large vicinity, and it will require some exploring and searching to progress through the game. (Security Cards, Keys Etc.) In 1942, Black Waters Station was overcome by a toxic and poisonous fog that killed thousands of people as they slept in the tunnels and platforms of the station to escape the war. After the horrific ordeal the authorities closed the doors to Black Waters and sealed it off to the public. In 2003 the station was officially reopened to the public. But after several freak accidents and unexplainable deaths, it was once again closed for good. It has been abandoned and undisturbed for over 20 years. Until now…

rows.name: GB BASIC
rows.short_description: GameBuilder BASIC (GB BASIC) is a retro Fantasy Console that generates ROMs compatible with the popular handheld game console.
rows.description_html: GameBuilder BASIC ( GB BASIC ) is a retro Fantasy Console that generates ROMs compatible with the popular handheld game console. It has everything ready-to-use for writting code, making assets, compiling projects, running with the built-in emulator, exporting to runnable ROM, etc. Why GB BASIC? GB BASIC is programmable in a brand new BASIC dialect. The integrated assets editors are intuitive to use. You can generate real ROMs and play on any GB emulator or hardware. Programming Paradigms Imperative paradigm Non-structured programming Concurrent processing approach Declarative paradigm Data driven approach Features Programmable in BASIC, an easy to learn and fun to use programming language Easy to use API for graphics, input, audio, and other facilities Built-in libraries for scene, actor, controllers, GUI Built-in libraries for collision detection, persistence, RTC, etc. Extension feature including mouse & touch, shell command, debugging, etc. Handy tools for editing tiles, map, scene, actor, font, sound, etc. Project can be exported into real ROM Dozens of example projects Specs CPU : 4.19MHz/8.38MHz for classic/colored respectively Threads : up to 16 concurrent execution contexts Display : 160x144px Code : BASIC, supports multiple source pages Gamepad : 8 buttons (D-Pad + A/B + Select/Start) Mouse and touch : supported by extension Tiles : up to 256 units per page Map : up to 255 tiles in one dimension per page; two layers (graphics, attributes) Sprite : supports 8x8 and 8x16 sprites Scene : up to 255 tiles in one dimension per page; four layers (map, attributes, properties, actors) Actor : up to 8x8 tiles per frame; up to 1024 frames per page Font : supports TrueType (.ttf) and bitmap-based (.png .jpg .bmp .tga); up to 16px; 1bpp or 2bpp Audio : 4 channels; supports importing from JSON, VGM, WAV, FxHammer Palette : 2bit (4 colors) per tile, palette of map and actor is configurable for colored device GUI : supports label, progress bar, menu, etc. Persistence : supported RTC : supported Serial port : supported

rows.name: Escape From The Depth
rows.short_description: Escape From the Depth is a cosmic horror game that takes place in a submarine under the dark, cold, and desolate oceans of Europa. The player must survive while trying to collect the necessary items to safely evacuate the sinking submarine.
rows.description_html: Escape From the Depth is an interactive 3D horror game. You navigate through the submarine level trying to collect items to escape from a monster that roams the hallways of the submarine. The player is armed with a map and is told where to go and which items they will need to grab, all while trying to avoid the monster. Features Stealth Multiple endings Narrated story Stealth The player can crouch and peek between hallway to ensure that the monster is no lurking nearby. Multiple endings Near the end you are presented with two options. What you choose to interact with, will dictate what ending you will get. Narrated story The story is fully narrated. As the player collects the required items they need. The ships AI will indirectly reveal what happen to the ship and it crew members through conversation with the main character.

rows.name: VR Construction Lab
rows.short_description: Go outside the classroom and get on a job site. Fun Construction VR game where anyone can learn and build different walls with varying levels of difficulty.
rows.description_html: The VR Construction Lab comprises game levels where a user is tasked with assembly objectives. Each level has a scoreboard and some levels have a timer that monitors how long a player has been conducting an assembly. Teleport to any location on the job site and pick up components to build a wall. For every rightly placed item, you get a score point. Watch the introduction videos in each level and listen to the instructions. Test your memory and matching skills. Get rewards and unlock new levels of difficulty. Fun for anyone who is curious about construction assembly details. Full body motion, climb ladders, immersive audio, visual reward systems, embedded video instructions and more.

rows.name: Sweet Science – The Girls of Silversee Castle
rows.short_description: This lighthearted visual novel lets you meet four quirky young women. A fun and highly interactive story taking you back in time – to the 1990s and a castle full of science, mysteries and – perhaps – romance...
rows.description_html: What if... ...you went back in time to a place you never wanted to go to? And there you are: at a weird science camp in a prestigious boarding school in Silversee Castle in the 1990s. Will you solve the mystery of how you ended up there? And will you be able to return to your time? And maybe find love? In this visual novel you will meet four extraordinary (and quirky) girls, learn more about your world and uncover the mystery. On the way, original puzzles are challenging you. Master them – or simply chicken out. Dive into the story and find out how sweet science can be! Features & Gameplay: The visual novel includes eight good endings and a few bad ones. Make the right decisions and master the minigames to reach the ending of your choice! The minigames feature unique, science inspired puzzles that will challenge your mind (but you can skip them if it's too hard for you). Moreover, in one of the minigames you will challenge your favorite character to a game of Go, but don't worry: Mr Young is going to explain the rules to you before the game. Sweet Science contains several interwoven story lines. To uncover them all, you will play more than one route. One route contains around 5 hours of gameplay, for all routes we estimate 15-20 hours of game play. On the way, you will encounter hundreds of graphics and a full soundtrack, featuring the song 'Butterfly Lullaby' composed for this game by Alec Weesner, and the song 'Time', sung by Emilia. 'Sweet Science' is waiting for you. – Will you uncover all its secrets? Cast: Artificial Intelligence This is one of the first real AI-generated visual novels: nearly all artwork was generated by AI artists (NovelAI, DALL-E 2, Diffusion Bee). But is this artwork art? The story touches on this and many other questions in an entertaining and open-minded way. Steam Release Special To celebrate the Steam release, we have added one extra scene. You can access it from the main menu at 'Extra+'. It contains mild spoilers, so better watch after finishing at least the first three days of the game. Enjoy! :)

rows.name: UC Love
rows.short_description: A humorous and wholesome anime-style dating simulator based on personified University of California schools + more ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°)! Romance 2D-girls (or guys) with 3D personalities in a cute and funny visual novel format! There are various locations to visit, minigames to play, and secrets to find!
rows.description_html: ABOUT UC Love is a humorous, touching, and wholesome anime-style dating simulator with characters that have three-dimensional personalities. The characters are personifications of many of the University of California schools + a few surprises ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°)! There are various locations to visit, minigames to play, and secrets to find! GAME FEATURES 5 Romanceable UC Girls (Left to Right: UCB, UCLA, UCI, UCR, and UCSB) Two Secret Romanceable Characters ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°) Cameos of the other UCs! Unique Storylines for Each Romanceable Character! 4 Mini-Games! Sprite Sets and Various Expressions! 9 Endings to explore! Chill original music! Wholesome vibes and funny jokes! TIPS Finish the game by successfully asking one of the characters to the dance! Each UC Lover has a set schedule that they follow each day. Explore the campus and pay attention to when you see your love interest in a particular place! Your UC Lover will only agree to go on a date with you if they are close to you, and will only agree to go to the dance with you if they are really close to you! Love interests will be more open and interested with you as they get closer with you! To build a relationship with someone, talk to them repeatedly and/or give them gifts! Each love interest has a loved gift, liked gifts, and disliked gifts, except for a certain Mr. Tree in the Mud, who hates all gifts. If you are at a dating stage, do well with the date minigame for some extra brownie points! After you are able to successfully ask them out on a date, you may be able to ask them out to the dance! :) EXTRA TIPS (SPOILERS) If you're looking to date Tommy, you can find him by taking a walk in the garden at night! :) If you're looking to date Stan Ford, you can find him in the field after you beat the gym minigame on hard! :) There are 5 cameo UCs hidden around the campus! Explore the campus to find: Mercedes (UCM), Diana (UCSD), Crystal (UCSC), Davina (UCD), Francesca (UCSF), Hailey (UC Hastings) GAME NOTES This was developed as a student project as part of ACM UCLA's 2022 Student Run Studios!

rows.name: Mademoiselle Kshatriya
rows.short_description: A young shrine maiden and her friend got lost in her dreaming world on Brahmanism. According to Manusmriti, no woman is permitted into four Varnas. A woman is born to be in the same class as the untouchable class. But her destiny helps her with trying to deny the irrational black magic.
rows.description_html: Special Thanks This game is made from 'SMILE GAME BUILDER'. Story A young shrine maiden woke up in her updated dreaming world on Brahmanism. Only Kshatriya and Vaishya who pay their great respects to Brahmana can be admitted into Brahmanism. The young maiden had worshiped the Sun very religiously and God selected her and tried her within her dream on Brahmanism. A Deity is also interested in that religion because Brahmanism keeps ancient magic that is so-called Chakra. The Sun has great Chakra which can attract matters by solar rays and the shrine has worshiped the Sun as the merciful God. A ordinary girl often visited the shrine in which the Sun is worshiped as God. Those who want to live a happy life are very interested in how to be lucky. The girl was not an exception. She knew Vedas as a superstition before she became ridden by Vedas. She had knowledge about four Varnas but she didn't know how to become Kshatriya or Vaishya. She sometime heard about Caste in her neighborhood but she felt like something was not quite right about the meaning of Caste. Game Style JRPG is main style in the game. When camera control is locked, feature of adventure becomes the main. It is something like dark fantasy and dark jokes. Quick learning of Brahmanism is the main theme.

rows.name: Tome of Fates
rows.short_description: Adventure Gamebook: Dive into an interactive experience where you can create, play, and share your own unique stories. Use the intuitive story editor to craft narratives without coding, explore them solo or in co-op with friends, and share them on the Workshop for everyone to enjoy.
rows.description_html: Immerse yourself in Tome of Fates , an Adventure Gamebook: create, play, and share unique stories through the built-in story editor. Play solo or co-op with friends, craft epic narratives without any coding, then share them on the Steam Workshop for others to enjoy. EDITOR - Story Creation, Simplified Dive into the powerful yet intuitive story editor. This tool allows you to design branching narratives without any programming knowledge, making it easy to bring your imagination to life. WORKSHOP- Share Your Stories Share your stories on Steam Workshop and discover new adventures from the community. MULTIPLAYER - Co-op / Twitch viewer interaction Don't want to play alone? Our unique CO-OP system allows you and your chosen friends to vote on the path the story takes and what choices to make. Bit of a streamer? Use our Twitch Integration system to allow viewers to join in on the fun and influence your story!

rows.name: Up All Night: Daybreak
rows.short_description: Nick just can't let go of the people he's killed.
rows.description_html: Night after night, nightmare after nightmare. Despite the passage of time, Nick Torres just can’t seem to shake the ghosts of his past… and one ghost in particular -- much to Nick’s chagrin -- has found his way back to the waking world. Felix returns in this short kinetic novel, eager for a conversation. Will Nick indulge him? ...Does he have a choice? Up All Night: Daybreak is a direct spin-off of Up All Night , and contains a multitude of spoilers. As such, players are encouraged to experience Up All Night before proceeding with Daybreak . Kinetic story 5,000+ words Custom artwork Original soundtrack Emotionally traumatized Nick Torres

rows.name: Cryspace
rows.short_description: Cryspace is a fresh visual novel with a nostalgic flavor. Talk to your friends online, meet with them in-person, and allow your friend group to grow in numbers, or fall into despair through your own decision-making and discretion. Experience the first few dates with Sam for FREE.
rows.description_html: WELCOME TO CRYSPACE Welcome to Cryspace. Fresh out of college, you decide to make an account on the new social media platform. Upon joining, your lifelong friend, Paul Meyer, adds you, and invites you to a house party. Could this be your chance to live the 'college lifestyle' you always dreamed of? If only it were that simple. You may have had enough drinks to feel confident at that party, enough to the point where you could even ask out Sam, someone you've had a crush on for quite a while, but Paul's nowhere to be found. Making your way upstairs in your search, you're met with a frightening scene. Paul is being pressed by a man, Jordan Myra, who happens to be the ex-boyfriend of Paul's current girlfriend, Crystal Mendez. He's threatening violence against Paul, seemingly out of pure jealousy. Will you call the cops on him? Take on the fight for yourself? Maybe you decide to leave the party and not get involved at all? The choice is yours. In this game of tense and fragile relationships, the fate of your friend group and new relationship rests purely in your hands. Will you be able to secure a future for yourself and your significant other? What's really going on behind the scenes in Paul's relationship with Crystal? With countless branching paths, over seventy different endings, and a narrative where rising conflicts are always around the corner, your critical thinking and ability to empathize will be tested thoroughly. One misstep may be all it takes for everything to come crashing down. INFINITE CUSTOMIZATION Make Cryspace your own with many settings available to make the site look just the way you like it. Introduce your character to the world of Cryspace with a custom profile picture, name, and alter the appearance/behavior of the website to your liking. You may also play as either a male or a female, giving you an immersive experience from start-to-finish as you pursue the truth.

rows.name: Ortheo's Interdimensional Jam Session
rows.short_description: Get lost in the musical madness of Ortheo's Interdimensional Jam Session. Groove to unique beats, create custom levels with drag & drop or play-through charting, and share your creations with Gamebanana support. Experience trippy visuals, challenging gameplay, and endless fun.
rows.description_html: Join Our Discord!!! About the Game Get ready to rock and groove with Ortheo's Interdimensional Jam Session! This rhythm-based game takes you on a musical adventure through dimensions, with striking visuals that will keep you mesmerized for hours. Unique gameplay mechanics challenge you to switch between three rows, pressing the action button in time with falling arrows that match your guitar pick. Precision and quick reflexes are key to success as you navigate through each song, avoiding obstacles such as spikes that threaten to disrupt your performance. MAKE YOUR OWN LEVELS: With two exciting charting modes, Drag & Drop and Play-Through, you can create your own custom levels with ease. In Drag & Drop Charting Mode , simply place notes on a grid to build your own song. For a more immersive experience, switch to Play-Through Charting Mode and chart your inputs as you play through the song, letting your musical abilities guide the way. UNIQUE AND INTENSIVE GAMEPLAY: In Ortheo's Interdimensional Jam Session , you'll experience unique and intense gameplay as you navigate through a world of rhythm and sound. To succeed, you'll need to be quick on your feet and avoid spikes that threaten to disrupt the beat. But what sets this game apart from others is its interdimensional twist – you'll travel through different dimensions, each with its own unique rhythm and challenges. Whether you're a seasoned rhythm game player or a newcomer to the genre, Ortheo's Interdimensional Jam Session is sure to keep you on the edge of your seat with its innovative and addictive gameplay. EXPERIENCE THE PSYCHEDELIC VISUALS: The game is a spin-off of the Ortheo franchise, and is free to play. The game also supports Gamebanana, making it easy to share your custom levels and songs with other players. Get ready to feel the beat and experience the ultimate rhythm-based gameplay with Ortheo's Interdimensional Jam Session! INSPIRED BY THE GREATS: Ortheo's Interdimensional Jam Session is a rhythm game that draws inspiration from some of the greatest rhythm games in the genre. The visual design takes cues from Everhood , offering a psychedelic and trippy experience. The health meter system is inspired by PaRappa the Rapper , adding an additional layer of challenge to the game. Additionally, the game is influenced by the looks of the upcoming Rift of The Necrodancer and Muse Dash . With these great games as inspirations, Ortheo's Interdimensional Jam Session is set to offer players a unique and unforgettable rhythm experience. CREDITS: Programmer: Dallen Larson Art Director: ZachJaDa Composer: Anthony Hampton

rows.name: Vessel Blue
rows.short_description: Solve text-based puzzles by interacting with a computer you've found and uncover Vessel Blue's secrets. You are bound to your chair, so defending yourself against unwanted guests is difficult.
rows.description_html: Subscribe to Lukas Paver's E-Mail list right now About the Game You've found a mysterious computer, and whilst you don't know why, you try to solve the mysteries of 'Vessel Blue', a cryptic company, through the data and files you find on the machine. However, you are not alone. INTERACT WITH THE ENVIRONMENT Solve text-based puzzles using your computer. Explore the mysterious software of the device by reading documents, encrypting files and entering codes into databases. SOLVE PUZZLES WITH YOUR COMPUTER Examine items that are located on your desk to help you proceed through the game. Read documents to find even more clues. But be aware: while you're trying to solve the mysteries, you're hunted by an evil walking pumpkin monster. DEFEND YOURSELF, YOU CANNOT MOVE You CANNOT MOVE in this game! You're glued to your chair, and have to constantly watch your back to scare the pumpkin man away while solving the puzzles.

rows.name: VONA / She
rows.short_description: Perform an Ukrainian housewife’s life attempting to breaking the daily life loop
rows.description_html: Vona is a point and click game where the player will perform a Ukrainian housewife’s life and her attempt to “escape” from her house, breaking the daily life loop and obtaining all the Gender Museums' pieces. The game takes place in a house, where the player has to do the housework: cleaning, cooking, doing the laundry… step by step and in time. But, at the moment when the player does something different (take a relaxing bath, wear too much make-up, drink vodka…), the player will open a museum inside a hole in her kitchen. There is a lot of housework and the player must do everything before the day ends. This can feel oppressive. If the player doesn’t make perfect, she will run out of time. But, it’s in this imperfection where the player can find more fun and when the player will progress in the game.

rows.name: Natural Disaster: A Butterfly's Guide to Mass Destruction
rows.short_description: Natural Disaster is a point-and-click-inspired adventure game set in a View-Master. Explore a world in scenes and sow the seeds of disaster by virtue of the butterfly effect!
rows.description_html: “Does the flap of a butterfly’s wings in Brazil set off a tornado in Texas?” –Edward Lorenz, “The Butterfly Effect” Natural Disaster: A Butterfly’s Guide to Mass Destruction is a slapstick puzzle game with inspiration from point-and-click classics of how one very evil butterfly can bring down an empire. Explore a world through a stereoscope, test your limits as a teeny butterfly in a human’s world, and start chains of cause-and-effect that ripple across the seven scenes to disastrous results. A SMALL WORLD OF SMALL PUZZLES Investigate the environment to discover items you can carry, objects you can activate, and places you can land to find how to lead these people to their worst nightmares. PLAY THROUGH A STEREOSCOPE VIEWER Explore seven rich 3D locations through the lens of a stereoscope. Follow the characters through paths with multiple endings as your actions in one scene continue in another. TIME LOOP TRIALS Upon your death, you find yourself back at the beginning, and all of the humans’ peaceful lives restored. It’s a time loop trap…or an opportunity for new methods. A BUTTERFLY NEVER FORGETS Your shenanigans are logged the Scrapbook. It journals everything you’ve learned about your targets across multiple trials and is a guide for what the butterfly might be curious to try next. HOLD ON…A WIZARD? In all your exploits, no one seems to notice that it is a butterfly causing their misfortune. But what happens when somebody does?

rows.name: Maybe tomorrow
rows.short_description: 'Maybe Tomorrow' is a casual game in which the player drags the stars in the night sky with a mouse and brighten up the sky. Form constellations with stars and learn about Andrew, who has a habit of saying 'maybe tomorrow'
rows.description_html: Photosensitive Epilepsy Warning This game features much flashing lights as well as much patterned lights. Maybe Tomorrow is a casual game where the player drag the stars with a mouse and brighten up the night sky. As the player clears each level, the player learns about Andrew and his habit of saying 'Maybe tomorrow'. Levels are cleared by reaching certain brightness level. Constellations can be formed when stars are close to each other and can help make the sky brighter. Each level features different challenges. Some levels feature obstacles that block lights from the stars, and some levels have objects that can help the players make the sky brighter. Choose your own game difficulty The player can use up to 10 stars per level to clear the level, but players who like challenges can also clear the level by only using certain number of stars per level. Maybe you are the one that motivates Andrew to say 'today'.

rows.name: XBattleCarsPVP
rows.short_description: Gear up for battle in XBattleCar PVP! Choose your vehicle and join your teammates in a real-time battle against other players. Strategize with your team and use your unique vehicle abilities to take down enemy vehicles and secure victory. So get behind the wheel and start your engines!
rows.description_html: Get ready to engage in battle with XBattleCar PVP! This team-based vehicular combat game allows you to compete against other players in real-time battles. Each vehicle in XBattleCar PVP possesses unique skills that you can use to outmaneuver and outsmart your opponents. Some vehicles are equipped with a boost ability that allows them to gain an edge in speed, while others have devastating weapons that can deal heavy damage. With a wide range of vehicles to choose from, it's important to select one that fits your playstyle and strategy. To make things even more exciting, XBattleCar PVP offers an array of weapons that are scattered throughout the map. Keep your eyes peeled for these powerful weapons and use them to gain an advantage over your opponents. The weapons are spread out in different areas of the map, so it's important to explore and familiarize yourself with the terrain. In XBattleCar PVP, your ability to choose the right vehicle and utilize its skills will determine your success on the battlefield. You'll need to be strategic and adaptive to overcome your opponents and emerge victorious. With intense battles and exciting gameplay, XBattleCar PVP is the perfect game for anyone looking for a thrilling vehicular combat experience. 'Zone Control Mode' Zone Control Mode, there will be multiple zones located across the map that players will need to capture and hold. When a player or team enters a designated zone, a countdown will begin, and if the player or team can hold the zone for the duration of the countdown, the zone will become under their control. Each zone capture will provide the player's team with a certain number of points, and the opposing team's score will decrease accordingly. Players will need to use their driving skills, as well as their teamwork and strategy, to capture and defend zones while also preventing the opposing team from doing the same. This mode encourages both offensive and defensive gameplay, making for an exciting and challenging experience. 'Destruction game mode' Destruction game mode, two teams battle it out to see who can destroy the most enemy vehicles within a set time limit. Players can choose from a variety of vehicles, each with its own unique weapons and abilities.To win, players must strategically plan their attacks and take advantage of their vehicle's strengths while avoiding their weaknesses. Upgrade your vehicles to gain an advantage in battle! By completing matches, you can earn in-game currency which can be used to purchase upgrades for your vehicle. These upgrades can improve your vehicle's health and upgrade weapons to increase their damage, giving you an edge on the battlefield. Customizing your vehicle's capabilities can make you a formidable presence in combat. However, it's important to choose your upgrades carefully. With a limited amount of in-game currency, you need to prioritize which upgrades will be most beneficial to your playstyle and strategy. Careful consideration and planning can mean the difference between victory and defeat on the battlefield. So choose your upgrades wisely, and dominate the competition!

rows.name: Tap Shap - The World's First Multi-platform Reaction Game
rows.short_description: Tap Shap is a unique, free-to-play, addictive game & the world's first multi-platform reaction game!
rows.description_html: Happy gaming! Test your motor skills with Tap Shap! Tap Shap is a unique, free-to-play, addictive game! Speed the characters through the obstacles while matching their colour patterns. The endless gameplay has one hand control and is good for children to build their motor skills and for older people who could be losing theirs. rows.short_description: You play as Marshmallow, the cute little pet of a girl named Ava who wants to become a heroine and save her village from the Nightmares. To protect her you use magical bullets, tarot-cards and try to find your very own playstyle to unlock the story and get the highest score!
rows.description_html: Uncover A Mystical World! In “Dreamkeeper” you play as Marshmallow, the cute little pet of a girl named Ava who wants to become a heroine. The so called “Dreamkeepers” are pets who have the magical ability to see nightmares and ward them off, while their owners are sleeping. But in Avas home village the Dreamkeepers are getting weaker and weaker and no one knows why. She embarks on a journey to find the cause of the problem and save her village. Help Marshmallow to fend off the nightmares and discover more about Avas world by increasing the score and unlocking more stories! Choose Your Powers By increasing the high-score you can unlock new tarot-cards with different abilities. There are five in total to choose from for every game you play, but you can only choose two in every fight to protect Ava from the Nightmares. Find your very own playstyle and explore the different card-synergies and modifiers to get the highest score! Choose Your Challenge! There are different game modes that offer the right challenge for every player, whether professional or beginner. After unlocking every card and lore-snippet you can customize your own game and choose modifiers to make the game harder or easier. Beat your own record and set new high scores by protecting Ava from all Nightmares!

rows.name: L/Right Reflection
rows.short_description: 'L/Right Reflection' is an RPG game in which the player fights by reflecting enemy attacks. Choose the appropriate magic for each situation, detect the enemy attacks, and face a variety of enemies.
rows.description_html: 'L/Right Reflection' is an RPG game in which the main character, who is unable to use offensive sorcery, battles by reflecting enemy attacks. The player controls Lumis, a girl who is a sorcerer but cannot use offensive sorcery. How will Lumis defeat the enemies even if she can't attack? The way Lumis defeats the enemies is through reflection sorcery. You can damage the enemy by reflecting the enemy's attack at the right moment. In the battle, enemy attacks are represented by a skill cursor, which looks like a magic circle. At the center of the battle screen, there is an area called a marker. When the skill cursor is just over the marker, press the button for a successful reflection. The game is designed in the style of a rhythm game, in which the player parries the movement of the skill cursor to move in various ways, such as straight lines, curves, waves, and rotations. Also, there is not only one button to press but three different buttons. The enemies use three types of attacks: blows, slashes, and magic, so press the button corresponding to each attack to reflect them. Sorcery In addition to reflection sorcery, Lumis can also use sorcery to advance the battle. Such as, Reflective damage is reduced but slows down the enemy's attack. Reduces HP by half but increases reflective damage Automatically reflect all enemy attacks for one turn, but reflective damage becomes a little These consume MP, but many of them have more powerful effects. Characters This game uses Live2D, so the characters move vividly in conversation and battle scenes! Especially in conversation scenes, the characters' expressions change in detail, making the story more enjoyable.

rows.name: JetpacToo
rows.short_description: A totally free reimagining of the classic Jetpac in a sandbox world with All Vs All or Team Match with unique real-time terraforming played over the surface of a planetoid created exclusively to test key components for the upcoming Me Igigu.
rows.description_html: A mysterious planetoid has appeared in the solar system, in a race to try and exploit its resources different nations send their robot-manned ships to investigate, however as the ships approach a powerful energy wave causes them to crash land almost destroying them. It is now a race between the different factions marooned on the surface to reassemble their ships and head back to claim official ownership to the planetoid. JetpacToo is a single or multi player game supporting cross play between flat-screen and VR. This has been created primarily to test the network and real-time planet terraforming technology for the upcoming god-game Me Igigu and what better way then to recreate an old-school classic in 3D. The game has 2 main modes, All VS All where up to 6 people can compete to find (or steal) the resources to build their ships and protect their launch pad and Team Match, with 2 teams of up to 3 people each.

rows.name: Collect Call
rows.short_description: A puzzle platformer about cooperating and exploring.
rows.description_html: Collect Call is a puzzle platformer game. You might work through the puzzles on your own, or you might talk to other characters to piece together a mystery. Features Gameplay Puzzles gradually introduce new mechanics so you learn at a comfortable pace with intuitive elements, including levers, buttons, physics objects, bridges, and more. The game also includes a story told through dialogue with other characters and lore hints hidden in the levels. Your dialogue choices do matter. Steam Deck Works fine on my Steam Deck. The game runs natively on Linux and Windows, controllers are detected automatically, and it will use 800p by default. My Steam Deck gets about two-thousand fps with vsync and the frame-rate limit turned off. Graphics & Performance The game may use pixel art, but there are still graphical options to configure. The game supports most common resolutions all the way up to 8K. You can also toggle v-sync or set a frame rate limit. Modding & Steam Workshop Collect Call can play custom levels from the Steam Workshop. Custom levels can include custom dialogue, puzzle elements, graphics, and more. Levels can even be chained in a sequence for a custom campaign just like the included one. Custom levels can also be installed manually. You will need map editing software to make your own levels. I used Tiled and suggest you do the same, it is free and open-source. You should also format your levels similar to the included ones for compatibility.

rows.name: SoundTown
rows.short_description: An accessible one-button music game for children and young people with complex physical and cognitive needs.
rows.description_html: An accessible one-button music game for children with complex needs. Born out of my PhD research at the Glasgow School of Art, SoundTown is a game designed for - and with - children and young people with complex physical and cognitive needs. The initial brief for SoundTown was developed through consultations with several appropriate organisations, including schools and charities with knowledge of accessible play. Built in the Unity game engine and powered by the Wwise audio engine, SoundTown consists of six minigames that are accessed directly through the Main Menu. Players interact with SoundTown using a maximum of two buttons or switches. One button navigates the menus, whilst the other is used to select a minigame or play. Thus, SoundTown is explicitly accessible to players only capable of interaction with a single input device such as a switch, foot pedal, or the Xbox Adaptive Controller. SoundTown is completely free to play and always will be. A huge thank you to: - Menphys - Birkett House School - Kinnaird Primary School - Hazelwood School Created by Alexander Horowitz, with artwork by Carol Studzinski, and voiceover by Susannah Horowitz.

rows.name: Lord of the Other World
rows.short_description: This game is a more casual strategy war game, it bid farewell to the endless confrontation between players in traditional strategy games! More emphasis on collaboration between players.
rows.description_html: This game is a more casual strategy war game, it bid farewell to the endless confrontation between players in traditional strategy games! More emphasis on collaboration between players. The game integrates strategy warfare and card development gameplay, simulated business gameplay, team-dungeon gameplay, and designed an urban construction model centered on prosperity and civilization, and innovated a 'private territory' that did not exist in previous strategy games. The new concept of 'safe collection'. At the same time, players can also send business travelers to freely communicate with each other across continents, donate supplies, and prosper together and develop harmoniously! [Exclusive territory, safe collection] Facing a different world that is about to be destroyed, you, as the lord of the city, will become a candidate for the throne and have your own private territory. There you can collect, play wild, and defeat the bosses of monsters, farm safely without being disturbed, focus on improving the construction of the capital, and create your own new world! [Develop civilization and build homes] The fire of civilization is endless. After canceling the concept of combat power in traditional strategy games, we introduced the concepts of civilization and prosperity. As the heir to the throne, force does not determine everything. Therefore, rather than letting players fall into endless battles in the game and constantly pursuing combat effectiveness, we hope that players will help each other, spread civilization and develop cities, and build a prosperous new capital! [Shuttle the mainland, free trade] After canceling the traditional strategy game where players attack each other's cities to plunder resources, we have opened up the runner gameplay of mutual trade between mainlands, six regions, 30 specialties, multiple runner paths, and real-time updates. Trade information, random events. Perhaps not every trade is smooth sailing, but risks and opportunities coexist, challenges and benefits coexist, maybe you are a business wizard in another world! [Wasteland Experience, Relic Treasure Hunting] Stopping in another world, exciting adventure links are also essential! We have opened a wasteland palace that can challenge ourselves. At the same time, as your main city hall level increases, copies of the ruins of different difficulties will also be opened for you. Whether it's dangerous underground caves or desolate desert ruins, you can enjoy the fun of teamwork and multiplayer teaming, and find lost treasures in danger! [Hero Development] Three races, massive heroes, and legendary heroes with various characteristics, each hero has its own mission. They will accompany you all the way in your life in another world, and do their best to help you fight against enemies, fight against monsters, and win the crown! [Territory War] 6 regions, 36 cities, and 36 legendary lords, this continent is full of wealth and opportunities, waiting for your conquest!
