rows.name: MITTIN
rows.short_description: Learn and practice skills for independence at home and in the community. MITTIN is a library of dynamic modules that foster the development of independent living skills.
rows.description_html: The Michigan Transition To Independence (MITTIN) is a virtual life skills library of dynamic modules that foster the development of independent living skills in the home and community. Designed to support special education transition-related instruction, these virtual resources are free and available to parents, schools, educators, and students in Michigan. MITTIN is a partnership of the Michigan Association of Administrators of Special Education (MAASE), Michigan Council for Exceptional Children (MCEC), Great Lakes Reality Labs (GLRL), and Public Policy Associates (PPA). The topics covered in this game include: Safety and Independence in the Home Change a Light Bulb Clean the Bedroom Put Away Groceries Use a Microwave Use an Oven Use a Stove Safety and Independence in the Community Cross the Street Shop for Groceries Use Self-Checkout Walk Through a Parking Lot

rows.name: Shutter
rows.short_description: In Shutter you play as Keith, a new employee that has arrived at the mysterious research center L.I.E. (Learn, Investigate and Exploit). Explore and solve puzzles with a camera that modifies objects using perspective. All in a space-age inspired setting.
rows.description_html: Shutter is a short third-person puzzle game. You play as Keith, a new employee that has arrived at the mysterious research center L.I.E. (Learn, Investigate & Exploit). Explore and make your way through to the last floor of the research center, jumping, climbing and using a mysterious camera that modifies objects using perspective. Find different suits, collect documents and cassettes and find out what happened in this place. All in a space-age inspired setting. About the team Shutter is a graduation project made at ArtFx School of Digital Arts, with the collaboration of Audio Workshop and MAAAV Université Lumière Lyon 2. Finalist for Best Student Game on the Bafta Student Awards, Independent Games Festival and The Rookies.

rows.name: HEROIC
rows.short_description: Control the hero to defeat enemies with devastating blows. Become a hero with your unique fighting style in this beat 'em up action game. HEROIC.The true peace, brought by the hero, awaits at the end of victory! Grasp peace!
rows.description_html: A beat 'em up action game where you control a superhero to defeat all enemies and liberate the city. Attack with button A, confirm with button B, jump with button X. Move with left stick, move camera with right stick. You can dash with LB. The rules are simple! If you defeat all the enemies, you win. On the other hand, if your HP is reduced to zero by the enemy, you lose. Please be careful as you cannot pass through the wall of light. The current work is unremarkable, but based on your feedback, I will make improvements and update it as a real work on February 28th. Thank you for your cooperation. Attacks can hit even if the enemy is away because they generate shockwaves. Currently, there is only one stage, but as more stages are added in the future, it will become an 'equal game' that can be achieved through player skill and practice, without any skill ups or item equipment. Also, based on your opinions, we will promptly and accurately update to provide a better successful experience.

rows.name: Paddle Flap
rows.short_description: Ready, set, FLAP! Flex your paddle flapping skills in this casual but engaging arcade game. Imagine pinball, but remove all distractions and just focus on the ball action. Use the paddle to strike the falling balls and make them hit the right targets to earn points, power-ups and achievements!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Paddle Flap, a minimalist casual arcade game where you control a paddle at the bottom of the screen and flap it left or right to bounce falling balls. Use precise timing to control the direction of the balls and hit right targets, avoiding the spiky ones. Along the way, collect power-ups and earn achievements as you unlock new ball graphics, backgrounds and color themes. Can you master the art of Paddle Flap and become a top scorer? Play now and find out! Features: High speed ball action Simple but engaging gameplay Satisfying paddle interaction Power-ups Achievements Unlockable balls, backgrounds, color themes and music Check out and wishlist our upcoming game, Mechanical Mayhem!

rows.name: Root Connections
rows.short_description: Digging deep into the root of his world, you play as the hallucinations of a man struggling with psychotic depression. Puzzling your way through the darkness of alcoholism and the fear of losing loved ones, it is up to you to root connect this man’s life back together again!
rows.description_html: Digging deep into the root of his world, you play as the hallucinations of a man struggling with psychotic depression. Puzzling your way through the darkness of alcoholism and the fear of losing loved ones, it is up to you to root connect this man’s life back together again! There are lots of things that this little mandrake will have to hide from, and these huge scary eyes are certainly one of them! Use one of the unique game mechanics by pressing SHIFT to hide yourself as a plant. You may hide for as long as you wish, but you cannot move the player while hiding. As you make your way through the dark mental cave, you will have to use items to complete this puzzle platformer. You can pick up items and store them in your inventory, ready for you to place back down for when you need them!

rows.name: Little Bo Reap
rows.short_description: Little Bo Peep's sleepiness has led to all of her sheep being killed! Take revenge using powers of necromancy to summon undead flocks of sheep to defeat your foes. Each different flock can assist in your movement or your battles to defeat your foes in an untold number of ways!
rows.description_html: Little Bo Peep has lost her sheep, and now she's out for revenge! Play as Bo Peep in a single-player 3D action-RPG where she's overwhelmed with grief and goes on an adventure through Pastoria. Command a variety of sheep flocks for you to fight your way through hordes of fairy-tale creatures on a brutal revenge quest for the sake of all sheep and animals. Use your necromancy powers taught to you by your old mentor, Baba Yaga - It must be because of all of her evil ways that all of your sheep were killed! Battle, train and learn new abilities to gain an advantage on the big trolls, spitting flowers or kamikaze frogs! Earn their souls to upgrade your abilities and unlock new ways of fighting to fit your own playstyle, such as riding your sheep into battle! You must discover the unique aspects of the land, including solving puzzles, platforming or discovering the long lost skulls. Find Baba Yaga and let her know how much those sheep meant to you, though she might be more prepared than you think! Construct your sheep into various shapes to help you on your quest. Lift yourself to the sky by stacking sheep on top of one another. Crash through walls with your Rams to solve puzzles and unlock cool secrets. Cast a breeze of Fluffy Sheep into a vortex to overwhelm your enemies. Launch your sheep at your enemies from a distance. Collect Souls from your enemies to spend on upgrades for your abilities, or even unlock new ones!

rows.name: My Summer Adventure: Memories of Another Life — Day 1
rows.short_description: A strange incident turns the life of an ordinary young man upside down when, having fallen asleep on a regular train commute, he wakes up in another country... in a body of a Japanese student! An unforgettable summer adventure awaits, promising many fateful meetings and momentous occasions.
rows.description_html: My Summer Adventure: Memories of Another Life is a visual novel about love and strings of fates intertwined by a single supernatural event. The free version of My Summer Adventure: Memories of Another Life — Day 1 invites you to plunge into the first out of the four days in this mystical story, try on the shoes of a real Japanese student, and see the plot unfold around you. The protagonist was just a regular young man from Tallinn, but after dozing off on a train commute he wakes up a completely different person in far-off Japan. The main character's name is Maksim Laas. He is a simple guy from Tallinn, leading the most ordinary life with its own ups and downs. Though, admittedly, the latter have lately been somewhat more prevalent for him. After breaking up with his ex, the world has lost its usual colors for Maksim, and his life quickly grew into gray, dreary, and inescapable routine. At least that was what he thought... Because something unbelievable happened without warning: the moment Maksim dozed off for a second during a commute, he suddenly woke up in another country... in someone else's body! From this moment onward, the hero will have to live several unforgettable days as Akira Kojima (no relation to THAT Kojima) and make acquaintance with some very charming girls. Perhaps this little summer adventure will alter the protagonist's fate? Or is there more than just his future that is at stake here? Key Features: A love story where your choice affects the characters' destiny! A narrative full of humor and drama where your decisions influence the rest of the story. Find out where your choice may lead you and see how it influences those around you! Win hearts or break them You will meet two pretty girls, each with their own backstory, feelings, and worries. Kyoko is your friendly and kind-hearted next-door neighbour, always ready to help. Haruko is the complete opposite: she is brazen and even rude at times, leaving her true personality a mystery for the protagonist to unravel. Think carefully before you decide to open up to either one of them! Colorful anime scenery A myriad of detailed backgrounds and illustrations will immerse you in the atmosphere of romantic anime and fill you with nostalgia for school days, warm summers, and adventures of the heart!

rows.name: 擒贼先擒王
rows.short_description: This is a race against time game, in this game, you can collect gold to restore your health and improve your combat ability, the time to defeat the boss is limited, if you don't beat the boss in the allotted time, the challenge will fail
rows.description_html: Welcome to“Cut the head off the snake”, where you will incarnate 5 typical characters, explore the unknown world, in the different styles of the world for thrilling adventure. Game features: 1. Tension. You have to beat the boss in the allotted time, but in your actions, time is running out, and in many cases, you are just one second away from success. So you have to use your time wisely. 2. Simple UI, simple operation we didn't set up many complex or meaningless functions 3. A sense of discovery. We have many maps, you will see many beautiful scenery.

rows.name: Halls of Torment: Prelude
rows.short_description: Slay hordes of terrifying monsters in this horde survival roguelite. Descend into the Halls of Torment where the Lords of the underworld await you. Treasures, magical trinkets, and a growing cast of heroes will grant you the power to vanquish these horrors from beyond. How long can you survive?
rows.description_html: Halls of Torment PRELUDE is a casual roguelite action RPG with a pre-rendered retro look reminiscent of RPGs from the late 90s. Choose one of three hero characters and descend into the deadly Halls of Torment. Fight unholy horrors from beyond and survive wave after wave of enemies until you face one of the tormented Lords. Strengthen your hero with character traits, abilities, and items. Create a new powerful build during each run. Explore various underground expanses and find new powerful items that enable you to venture even deeper into the abyss. PRELUDE Features Quick and casual 30 minute runs Old school pre-rendered art style Quest-based meta progression Diverse bosses featuring unique mechanics and attack patterns Unique items can be sent up to the overworld and used to customize future runs PRELUDE Content 2 stages with dynamic progression 6+ unique bosses 20+ unique monsters 3 playable characters 6 different upgradable abilities 8 blessings that make you stronger for each run 30+ different items to retrieve and unlock 200+ traits that upgrade characters and abilities 30+ quests to complete Many more features and content are available in the main game. Save games from Halls Of Torment PRELUDE can be imported over to the main Halls Of Torment game.

rows.name: Rudra: A Tale of Time
rows.short_description: Rudra: A Tale of Time is an action RPG inspired by Hindu scriptures. Embark on a journey of self-discovery by unlocking chakras and using mantras to save the universe from the forces of evil. Are you ready to unleash your inner warrior and restore balance to the universe?
rows.description_html: A game made by students at the University of Utah. Narrative Live the story of Rudra. As a hero determined to protect humanity, you travel through the different Yugas(Eras) of the world to find the source of malignant corruption. As you travel through the beautiful landscapes of each Yuga, cleanse the orbs of corruption blocking Ma Ganga’s flow. From the divine Satya Yuga to the darkest Kali Yuga, you will experience the full Chatur Yuga cycle. As you progress, immerse yourself into the world of Hindu culture. Explore the inner workings of Chakras, stories from Hindu scripture, and much more. Combat You’ve faced enemies from the Nordic and Greek regions. Now it is time to face the evil from Hindu scriptures. Take on Pishachas, Rakshasas, Bhishani, and even Asuras! Unleash the power of Varunastra, a gift from the gods. Use this legendary weapon to perform a variety of epic combos. Use powerful incantations known as Mantras to aid you on the battlefield and morph Varunastra into several weapons from ancient India. Features Richly detailed world inspired by Hindu scriptures. Epic storyline that takes you through the four Yugas of the universe. Dynamic combat system that allows you to use Mantras and Varunastra to defeat your enemies. Challenging boss battles against legendary creatures from Hindu scriptures. Exploration of the inner workings of Chakras and stories from Hindu scripture. Immersive soundscapes that transport you to a mystical realm. Stunning graphics that bring the world to life.

rows.name: Monster Battle
rows.short_description: 'Monster Battle' is a cute and charming roguelike deck builder featuring adorable monsters. Journey through a randomly generated world, build an army of monsters and defeat foes with strategic deckbuilding.
rows.description_html: 'Monster Battle' is a fun and charming roguelike deckbuilder game featuring a colorful cast of cute monsters. Players will journey through a randomly generated world, using their deckbuilding skills to collect and train an army of monsters to defeat dangerous foes and reach their ultimate goal. With fast-paced, turn-based battles and a constantly changing world, 'Monster Battle' offers a fun and challenging experience for players of all skill levels. The cute and playful art style, combined with the deep and engaging gameplay, make this game a joy to play for fans of roguelike deckbuilding games. Resource Management: Manage your resources carefully to acquire new cards and abilities, and improve your chances of survival against the enemies of the night. Customizable Decks: Build your own custom deck of cards by selecting from a range of powerful abilities, equipment, and allies, and tailor it to your preferred playstyle. Unique Enemies: Battle against a variety of enemies that pose different threats, including undead creatures, hunters, and other supernatural beings. Evolving Gameplay: Over time, new cards and abilities become available, making the gameplay richer and more complex as you progress through the game. Multiple Paths to Victory: Discover different strategies to defeat your enemies and emerge victorious, whether through combat, diplomacy, or stealth. Beautiful Artwork: Enjoy stunning artwork that captures the dark and brooding atmosphere of the vampire world, from haunting landscapes to terrifying creatures. Replayability: With a wide range of cards, enemies, and game modes, the game offers high replayability, providing hours of entertainment for both casual and hardcore players. Easy to Learn, Hard to Master: The game is easy to learn, but hard to master, making it accessible to players of all skill levels, while still providing a satisfying challenge for experienced players.

rows.name: MASKA
rows.short_description: Welcome to the new virtual reality! Metaverse Maska is a home to interesting people, fun parties, exploration and fulfilling relationships! You create your own world, from your unique persona to their exciting adventures.
rows.description_html: What to do in the virtual world MASKA? What to do in your free time? Whatever you want! Dance, meet new people or joke with friends. Hot parties every day and you don’t need an excuse to show your moves on the dance floor! Getting bored from all the fun? Start a business, earn game currency and become successful. What’s your ideal world like? Explore Maska! Bonuses, promos, gifts, and, of course, positive emotions! Your persona Male or female, brunette or blond. Express your taste and creativity! Come up with your unique look and personality with the help of our advanced editor. Simple but powerful, it allows a quick-and-easy creation or detailed, elaborate appearance, that can impress even experienced lovers or life sims. Time to party! You don’t need an excuse to show your skills on the dance floor! Hot parties, cool music and a great mood are waiting for you every day. Learn new moves and impress the crowd! Relationships Find a special someone. What will your first date be like? In a club, out for a walk, or maybe at work? How will your story develop? Everything depends on you! Fall in love or even create a family. Transportation The virtual word has transportation to support your virtual freedom. Regular cars? Boring! Show your style: gather a full collection from a spacecraft to a magical unicorn! Interactive objects Get immersed the help of interactive objects. Unique effects and animations are waiting at the store and around countless virtual environments. Discover them all and have fun on a new level! Adventures Every day - new things to do. Finish quests and earn game currency. More adventures - more money earned to check out all the awesome things at the store. Express emotions Are you angry, happy or maybe amused? MASKA is a world where everyone can freely express their feelings. With the use of actions and avatar’s facial expressions, of course :) A full spectrum of human emotions is available to choose from. Real estate Set up your dream home, whether it’s an apartment or a house. Our intuitive editor has everything you need for building and decor. Unleash your creativity and invite friends to check it out! Work Have you always wanted to start a business? Practice in the virtual world! Just decide on the idea and get started. Would it be a furniture store, clothing boutique or a real estate company? Earn game currency, develop your brand and build a loyal customer base. Shopping Earned enough - have fun with your money. Explore stores and get what your heart desires: transport, effects, decor and much much more! You can create and sell things too, by the way!

rows.name: Shapeless
rows.short_description: A short action game set in a medieval castle with NPCs and enemies appearing in the form of different shapes. You must escape imprisonment and find a way out of the castle.
rows.description_html: In this short action game, you start off as a prisoner locked up in a jail cell. The game features various obstacles and challenges that players must overcome to progress. As you escape the prison, you encounter guards and other enemies that are determined to stop you from escaping. The game incorporates combat elements, allowing you to fight and defeat these enemies. You must be strategic and tactical in your approach, as you face stronger enemies as you progress through the level. The game also features a puzzle that you would have to solve to unlock the good ending. As you progress through the game, you encounter NPCs who may offer advice and guidance, and also provide clues to help you solve puzzles and overcome obstacles. The game is not easy and may require several attempts to beat. Overall, the game is a short action-packed adventure that tests players' combat, puzzle-solving, and strategic skills.

rows.short_description: This is a role-playing turn-based game. In the game, you will play a captain and lead your team to explore the ocean and find the treasure! You need to sail in the ocean, explore different islands, sometimes encounter sea monsters. You will find new partners, expand your team and adventure with them

You need to sail in the ocean, explore different islands, sometimes encounter sea monsters. You will find new partners, expand your team and adventure with them. Feature: Beautiful Ocean The real and fantasy sea, your ship sails on the sea, Different weather and day and night systems make you immersive. rows.name: 3 Days War
rows.short_description: 3 Days War is a unique multiplayer strategy war game. Integrating the mechanics of RTS+4X, it allows dozens of players to engage in a three-day real-time strategy competitionon. Commanders, use your skills, strategies, games and even deception to become the ultimate winner!
rows.description_html: Background: In 2069, humanity discovered a high-energy density mineral, the Black Stone. Countries vied for control of this resource, leading to conflicts that culminated in a global war in 2085, known as the First Black Stone War. Five years after the war began, humanity developed the Core-Gear, a giant war machine powered by Black Stone. Its immense combat capabilities had an immediate impact on the war, and within a year, the world briefly returned to peace. The world split into three major factions: the Black Eagle Union representing democracy and freedom, the White Bear Front representing the people, and the neutral Suzaku Covenant in the East. However, true peace never arrived, and the crisis of war continues... Features: Innovative Real-time 4X Game A creative fusion of RTS and 4X core experience, with real-time battles and minimalistic operation, allowing players to focus more on development, strategy, and social interaction. Grid-based strategic rules Expansion, construction, development, and battles occur in real-time and intuitively in the 'grid'. A large battlefield composed of over 10,000 grids supports dozens of players to cooperate and compete. RougeLike elements in strategy building In the process of developing an empire, players will continuously have the opportunity to choose 'pondering cards'. After dozens of random three-choice selections, you will eventually build your own strategic card combination. Heroic mechas that determine the outcome of battles Dozens of distinct heroes drive Core-Gear to gallop across the battlefield. With the reasonable use of heroes' 'active strategic skills', one can dominate the war. Game modes: Adventure mode Follow the plot to become familiar with the basic game rules, and gradually deepen your understanding of the game's world view. Evacuation mode 16 players participate in a 3-day grand strategic confrontation. Find a teammate, become the commander and lead everyone to victory! Alliance mode 18 players are divided into three factions for a 5-day grand strategic confrontation. Instead of simply eliminating opponents, become a true strategist through cooperation and alliances! Camp Introduction White Bear Front Arms The design mainly highlights the characteristics of heavy industry and heavy machinery and uses heavy bomb weapons and electromagnetic weapons. For example, the K-47 Aviation Fortress: the only weapon in the game that can provide a powerful ground strike in the air, and it is very difficult to sink Black Hawk Combined Arms The design mainly highlights the characteristics of modern high-tech combat troops, and a large number of optical weapons are used.For example, Rhino Heavy Tank: is the toughest tank in the game, has an energy shield, and can withstand high damage in frontline combat Vermilion Phoenix Alliance Force. The design mainly emphasizes the combination of classical and technological elements, and the tech tree features an Eastern mystical style. Currently, still in the design and production stage... rows.name: Yondu's Journey
rows.short_description: Join legendary warrior Yondu in this interactive fmv adventure as he battles for survival in hostile territory. With his cunning, strength, and unwavering spirit, Yondu rises above adversity in this epic tale of survival and adventure. Get ready for an unforgettable journey with Yondu the Fearless!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Yondu's Journey, an interactive movie where every decision you make can lead to life or death. Take on the role of Yondu The Fearless and face the challenges that await you in this exciting game. As you play through the game, you will be presented with a series of difficult decisions that will test your courage and quick thinking. Do you want to fight or flee? The choice is yours, but be prepared to act fast - you only have a few seconds to make each decision. Each decision you make will impact the outcome of the game, so choose wisely. Will you be the hero that saves the day, or will you succumb to the dangers that await you? The fate of Yondu The Fearless is in your hands. With stunning graphics and intense action, Yondu's Journey is a game that you won't want to miss. So gather your courage and get ready for an adventure that will test your skills and leave you on the edge of your seat. Are you ready to face the challenges of Yondu's Journey? The choice is yours.

rows.name: Tales of the Magic Ball: The Lost Sorcerer
rows.short_description: Tales of the Magic Ball is a puzzle platformer where you'll experience an adventure in a fantasy world. Explore, puzzle, experience a story, fight and overcome obstacles. Solve the tasks given to you in an interesting and fun way.
rows.description_html: You, the magic ball, have lost your sorcerer and in order not to perish you must find him again. For this reason, you start your journey. Initially, you'll find yourself in a magical, dreamy world that matches the ball. During your journey, however, your real adventure begins. Tales of the Magic Ball is a puzzle platformer where you'll experience a fantastic story during your adventure in a magical world. Use your magic to solve puzzles. Use magic to defeat your enemies. Interact with the inhabitants and get help. Face the challenges and try to survive. Let the world enchant you. - Play with a physically simulated ball and solve difficult bouncing passages . - Let the puzzles challenge you . - Use your magic to defeat your enemies and solve puzzles . - Fight your opponent and adjust your tactics . - Enjoy the story . - Explore hand-built levels . Wildmonkeygames is a small 1-man-team with a few freelancers who, besides their regular work, have dedicated themselves to game development with a lot of love and passion. Originally 'Tales of the Magic Ball' was planned as a fast skill game/roller ball, but in the course of development more and more a more modern kind of roller ball crystallized out, meanwhile it became an adventure platformer, in which you can experience a story. The whole thing is spiced with puzzle game elements and packed in a beautiful fantasy world. I hope you will enjoy playing it as much as I enjoyed developing it.

rows.name: School Booster
rows.short_description: In the School Booster, you will play the role of being a parent raising your girl to an adult (18). her grow-up journey will come from heaven, baby, kid, teenager, these four sages. And each stage has slightly different playing mechanics.
rows.description_html: School booster is a 2D parenting simulation game. The gameplay is designed to be half roguelike, which requires players to build a baby and raise her up and end with a result of this baby's future. players only need a mouse to play, manage attribute tokens and buy certain items to help to boost the baby's study result. * School Booster was initially designed as an idle game that came with one objective, which is to play around with your attributes numbers and think of a strategy to get as higher numbers as possible. Players are required only use a mouse cursor to play the game. * In the School Booster, you will play the role of being a parent raising your girl to an adult (18). her grow-up journey will come from heaven, baby, kid, teenager, these four sages. And each stage has slightly different playing mechanics. Tutorials are included at the start of each level to assist in understanding a few mechanics at each stage.

rows.name: Russian Psychiatric Pastoral: Prologue
rows.short_description: Introductory demonstration version. An interactive movie that combines a psychiatrist simulator, a detective story and unique fight sequences. Take on the role of a psychiatrist, encounter various psychiatric diagnoses, and investigate disappearances of various people.
rows.description_html: This is an introductory demonstration version of the game. This episode is meant to test the game mechanics, after which the players can decide whether they are interested in buying the whole game. In the prologue, the player will be given the opportunity to try out one interactive fighting sequence and put on a role of psychiatrist to interview a patient who suffers from schizotypal disorder. The Russian Psychiatric Pastoral - despondency, cruelty, lawlessness, and mental disorders. What else do you need to describe our reality? Immerse yourself in a multi-genre interactive movie, combining a psychiatrist simulator, a noir detective and unique fighting sequences built from a variety of video fragments. Take on the role of a professional psychiatrist, confront various psychiatric diagnoses, and investigate missing people. At the center of the plot is you, a protégé of the authorities from Moscow. You find yourself in a small provincial town, which is famous for housing one of the largest psychiatric hospitals in the whole country: it holds the most dangerous criminals. In the depressing atmosphere of the Russian countryside you will meet a variety of crippled-by-fate locals, each of them adapted their own way to survive in this merciless reality. As you interact with them, you will find more and more details about the disappearance of people whose fate nobody cares about anymore. You will also analyze their mental disorders, from schizophrenia to bipolar disorder. Key features: - Varied dialogues, where you need to skillfully select proper words for every patient. As a reward, you learn more about their diagnoses; - Collecting and matching information about missing people piece by piece; - Explore a variety of mental diagnoses using educational charts and speadsheets; - Exciting interactive fights, where your survival depends on your reaction; - Unique aesthetics and atmosphere of the Russian countryside.

rows.name: Duel Revolution
rows.short_description: Duel Revolution: the ultimate monster taming MMORPG. Train powerful Evo creatures for dynamic battles against other players. Customize with unique skill tree system. Play with friends in multiplayer. Available on Windows, Mac, Android, and iOS.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Duel Revolution, the ultimate monster battling MMO! In this game, you will explore the island of Bitacora filled with all kinds of monsters, known as Evo. Catch and train these creatures to become the strongest Evo duelist and engage in intense real-time battles against other players. Key features of Duel Revolution: Catch and Train: 50 unique Evo, each with its own set of abilities. Every Evo in Duel Revolution is unique. It's up to you to figure out the best strategy for using each Evo in battle. Keep an eye out as we're constantly adding new Evo with upcoming updates! Intense Duels: Challenge other players in real-time duels or face off against wild Evo and other duelists as you explore the island. Engaged Community: Join a community of enthusiastic Evo duelists, share tips and strategies, and make new friends. Skilltree-based Leveling System: With 12 meaningful levels, you can tailor the skills and strengths of your Evo to match your gameplay style. Customize Your Character: Choose from various customization options to make your character stand out and showcase your style in the game. Regular Updates and New Content: We are committed to delivering regular updates and fresh content to keep the game exciting. Gameplay Preview: Encounter wild Evo on the way. Go to the Duel Stop to heal your Evo, buy items or duel against others. The Deep Cave is filled with challenging co-op puzzles, strong Evo and various secrets. Watch the duel of others by a tap on the bouncing box over their head. Enjoy surfing on the beach with your friends. Each level let's you choose a new attack or ability. Customize your character to your preferences. Welcome new players at the station in Lapin City. Play the FREE open beta now!

rows.short_description: Vemari Worlds is your place for fostering fulfilling interactions and meeting people in your online community.
rows.description_html: Vemari Worlds is the place to gather your online community into a 3D space. The whole point of Vemari is to meet new people that are like you. And they can be from anywhere in the world. Whether it be an online forum or a livestreaming community, your community world exists here. If you have nowhere to be, then you belong here.

rows.name: The Bean Trials
rows.short_description: In The Bean Trials, join your friends in competing to see who is the best! Play in over 20 different minigames all while trying to top the Leaderboards! Talk in text or voice chat with other beans while you complete challenges, win to earn coins, and unlock over 100 unique items for your bean!
rows.description_html: The Bean Trials is a unique multiplayer mini game versus where you take on the role of a “bean” and compete against other beans to see who is the best! Compete in over 20 unique mini games and customize yourself with over 2,000,000 possible combinations! Using coins earned from doing challenges or winning games you can purchase new looks and items to make your bean just like what you dreamed of! Join the lively world with upbeat music and in-game text and voice chat! The possibilities of what you and your bean can do are endless! Feel stuck? Try practice mode to work on your skills to destroy the competition! Want to play with friends? Hop into a private match and get up to 15 other beans to compete against! Think you’re the greatest? Try to top the Leaderboards to show true superiority! So why wait any longer? Get on in, customize yourself to your dream bean, and show everyone what it means to dominate the competition!

rows.name: The Very Brief and Meaningless Adventure of Hero Man
rows.short_description: Help Hero Man save the world of Somewhere from a terrible evil ... or do nothing of the sort if you so please in this small, satirical RPG!
rows.description_html: Hero Man, Hero Man, only doing what a Hero Man can. Whether he can actually save the world and bring home the glory is another question entirely. And so we enter this retro-inspired RPG world where YOU determine the outcome! Your choices will determine the fate of Hero Man and the world at large. Help Hero Man save the world of Somewhere from the sinister Lord Doldrum ... or do nothing of the sort if you so please! Will you help bring peace to the world or break the story line in some horrible way? The answer is up to you! In this satirical take on an old-school JRPG, you'll guide Hero Man on a journey that is very brief and meaningless indeed, and find up to 18 fun, heroic, and grisly endings that take 2-20 minutes each! Unlock different endings depending on your moral actions, party composition, character levels, and more. Look forward to the following new features, as well! Original Graphics and Music Assets. 18 Endings that can be found in almost any order, depending on your actions. Keep track of every ending you've found on one save file. What will happen when you find them all? Enlist the aid of Marionette characters to help Hero Man on his adventure! Recruit helpers such as the Solider, Mage, Cleric and... that's it. Quality of Life features that gradually unlock as you find more endings, such as the ability to turn off random encounters or restart your current run.

rows.name: Super Cakeboy
rows.short_description: When a group of unsanitary chefs threaten all that is good and just in Cakeland, it's up to Cakeboy to serve up punishment. Fight your foes with pastry-themed items in this bite-sized 2D platforming adventure!
rows.description_html: Once again take the role of Cakeboy in this sequel to Khimera: Destroy all Monster Girls ' 'game-within-a-game'. Run, jump, punch and use the variety of pastry-themed weapons at your disposal to blast through 9 action-packed stages. Face off against Cakeboy's eternal rival, the enigmatic Dark Cake and send him packing! Items no chef should leave at home: Pick up far-away items with the Croissant Boomerang , set traps with the exploding Cupcake Bomb , perform trick-shots with the bouncing Super Donut , or just punch them in the face! The choice is yours! Short and Sweet: This snack-sized game's nine levels can be completed in about 20 minutes but hidden collectable ingredients, achievements and other secrets give you extra goals for subsequent play-throughs.

rows.name: Kore VR
rows.short_description: Want to learn the Korean alphabet on the Meta Quest? Hop into Kore VR where you get to learn the alphabet in an interactive orb and shoot away letters in an interactive arena to win ingredients for delicious Korean dishes. Get those letters right or you will get roasted in Korean!
rows.description_html: Available with Meta Quest Kore VR offers a unique experience that transports you to the heart of a traditional Korean Hanok village. From there, you can explore a futuristic and interactive orb that teaches you the sounds of each Korean alphabet, as well as a shooting arena where you'll use a laser blaster to shoot letters and gather ingredients for delicious Korean dishes in just three minutes. But beware - if you don't get the letters right, you'll be 'roasted' in Korean! With Kore VR, you can immerse yourself in the Korean language and culture in a fun and engaging way. The serene landscape of the Hanok village creates the perfect backdrop for learning the characters and pronunciation of Hangeul. And as you explore the village and its surroundings, you'll gain a deeper understanding and appreciation for Korean culture. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced learner, Kore VR is an innovative and effective way to build a strong foundation in the Korean language. Through its combination of language learning and cultural immersion, Kore VR can enhance your overall language skills and provide you with a truly unforgettable experience.

rows.name: GREAT TOY SHOWDOWN
rows.short_description: Jump into fast-paced team battle royale action, where unique armial toys clash for survival! Explore, strategize, and dominate the battlefield to become the ultimate champion! Join the fluffiest battle in the world now and become the last animal toy standing!
rows.description_html: JOIN OUR DISCORD About the Game GREAT TOY SHOWDOWN is a casual shooting game where 8 animal toys battle it out in action-packed matches! The 'Furr-sting Showdown' to steal toy parts and survive begins now. Join the fluffiest battle in the world and become the last animal toy standing! GREAT TOY SHOWDOWN begin early access in the 5th of November 2024, It is planned to be officially released in Q4 2025 to support mobile and Nintendo Switch cross-platforms. Key Features With a streamlined team battle royale format, anyone can jump in and enjoy the fun! You don’t have to bully other toys to feel the thrill of growth. Our unique yet simple graphics shine even on low-spec PCs and consoles, giving you smooth gameplay no matter your setup. Challenge players from around the globe in team battles and show off your skills to become the ultimate toy champion! Hunt down Fearsome Monsters! Team up with your crew to take down monsters, survive, gain experience, and level up. Work together to divide roles, plan your optimal farming and leveling routes, and execute your strategy flawlessly. Explore the Map and Grow Stronger! Send out your trusty chick drone to expand your territory and uncover hidden spaces. Hunt down monsters guarding these areas and claim valuable items that give you a tactical edge in battle. rows.name: Farm Empire
rows.short_description: Would you like to be the world's richest farmer? In Farm Empire, you'll start your own farm from scratch, but with the right strategy, you'll soon have an entire empire.
rows.description_html: Farm Empire is an idle / clicker game where you will be making crazy amounts of money from farming. You start the game with just one chicken, but soon you can expand into tomatoes, tractors, factories and many other assets. Hire managers to do the clicking, upgrade your assets and reach your milestones. You can also expand your empire to other countries like Australia, Madagascar, Denmark and even Antarctica. Farm Empire was originally released in 2016, but has been in active development ever since. Content updates are out every other month, ensuring there will always be ways to expand your empire. Thousands of milestones to play towards. Seven empires to unlock and complete: USA, China, Australia, Denmark, Norway, Madagascar and Antarctica (yes, you can farm there!) Each empire has 36 cool, interesting or funny assets to unlock and upgrade: How about an Australian banjo frog, an arctic sea pig or a Chinese dragon? Discover the best combination of assets for each empire to optimize your earnings - the path you take is important, but you can always restart to try another. Speed up your earnings with the help of friendly workers gained from restarting your empire - restart often, to keep your worker force growing. 15 golden eggs for free each day, and even more if you create your own golden egg farms. Your game data is stored on the mighty Farm Empire server - log on from any device, and your empire will be at where your last left it.

rows.name: Zefyr: Prologue
rows.short_description: Free version of 'Zefyr: A Thief's Melody'. In a colorful archipelago, play as a young thief studying at the Guild. Investigate kidnappings, steer clear of roaming pirates or fight them. Sail the ocean on a cute turtle and climb on every island. Cure sick animals and reveal the truth.
rows.description_html: Add the full game to your wishlist About the Game Free version of 'Zefyr: A Thief's Melody'. In a colorful archipelago, play as a young thief studying at the Guild. Investigate kidnappings, steer clear of roaming pirates or fight them. Sail the ocean on a cute turtle and climb on every island. Cure sick animals and reveal the truth. 'Zefyr: Prologue' contains the first chapter of 'Zefyr: a Thief's Melody'. It's a tribute to old adventure games like 'Beyond Good & Evil' and 'Zelda Windwaker'; it features exploration, dialogs, fights, puzzles, collectibles and huge Boss battles, all wrapped in a colorful world with a contemplative and feel-good atmosphere. Run, jump, and climb wherever you want, travel between islands on a turtle, and discover a colorful open world! Be it pirates, guards, robots or other thieves, you'll face many challenges during your missions. You are free to play sneakily or go straight to confrontation. But choose carefully! During your journey, you'll find ancient Guardians. Some will block your path, others will be well hidden. Will you be able to bring back peace to these giant creatures? Look for sick animals and cure them with fruits! Collect flowers, discover lost paintings... Many side quests await you in this feel-good world. Will you find them all? Freely explore a colorful open world. Learn various skills: climbing, stealth, fighting, bow, bombs, grapple and much more! Confront or avoid pirates, guards and robots. Cure sick animals all over the world. Collect gemstones, paintings and flowers. Defy giant Guardians during epic battles. Discover cute and funny characters. Save the world! Er no, I mean 'be a true hero!' Er no, I mean 'help your sister.' Well, you have to start somewhere, kid... Oh, yeah! And ride a cute turtle! But I guess you already got that from the picture. Hi there! I'm Mathias and I've been creating video games since I was a child. I love coding, playing music and drawing. So what's better than creating a video game to do all of this at the same time? I do everything alone because I love every part of it and I'm a curious guy who likes to know how it works! I hope you'll like it :) If you want to support me or learn more, don't hesitate to check out my website, where you can find all the links to social media, my dev blog and other stuff. Thank you so much!

rows.name: Midnight at the Disco
rows.short_description: Annihilate grotesque eyeball monsters in this top-down, roguelike, bullet purgatory, twin-stick shooter. Survive a full day raging on the dance floor by blasting baddies using unique builds combos on each frantic run to nab a spot on the online leaderboards.
rows.description_html: Midnight at the Disco is a fast-paced, top-down roguelike twin-stick shooter where you must survive a dance floor overrun by grotesque alien eyeball monsters. Annihilate massive hordes of the interdimensional invaders. Collect vinyl records to level up an insanely deep skill tree, unlocking game-changing perks and abilities. Break open chests for powerful items and gear up for each frantic, bite-sized run. Over 20 unique enemy types, each with distinctive attack patterns, will relentlessly pursue you. Thankfully, you can create wildly different builds by mixing and matching a huge array of upgrades, power-ups, and random modifiers - ensuring no two runs play out the same. Oh, and watch your step...there's poop. Features: Huge build variety for limitless replayability Short roguelike runs perfect for pick-up-and-play Online leaderboards Intense and fast paced gameplay Massive enemy hordes with unique, challenging behaviors

rows.name: Dynopunk: Welcome to Synth-City
rows.short_description: An ironic adventure with cyberpunk aesthetics set in a world where humans have been replaced by dinosaurs. Become a top-notch repair shop mechanic: fix gadgets, have heart-to-heart talks, and offer drinks to your customers — everything to fulfill your ultimate dream.
rows.description_html: Dynopunk is an ironic adventure set in a cyberpunk world where dinosaurkind has replaced humanity. Run a repair shop, fix gadgets, find a personalized approach to every customer by offering them beverages and having deep heart-to-heart conversations. All to sort out your private life and chase your ultimate dream! The free version of Dynopunk: Welcome to Synth-City offers a chance to live a full 7-day week as a resident of a futuristic cyber city, but there is a catch — you will now have to deal with having much shorter arms! Imagine that a meteor had never struck the Earth, so the dinosaurs did not go extinct but continued to evolve. Now, millions of years later, they inhabit high-tech megalopolises. One such dino is Chris, a repair shop owner who dreams of building a Time Machine to travel to the past and find true love, because he is the last remaining T-Rex on the planet! Meet Cyberpunk Dinosaurs Enjoy pixel art that pays homage to 1990s retro games. Meet a cast of memorable characters from an alternative future where predatory, carnivorous dinosaurs have come to rule the world. Relax to the sound of a Lo-fi soundtrack as you progress through the story and make plot-altering decisions. Fix Gadgets Elicit relevant information from your clients to find the source of the problem and fix their gadgets. Perform your work neatly and carefully — your income depends on it. Chat up the Customers Strike up heart-to-heart conversations with customers and offer them a beverage to their liking. A glass of cool fizz or a cup of hot coffee increases your chances of getting tips. Follow the Dream You play as the last surviving T-Rex on Earth, trying to build a Time Machine and travel to the past to find true love. Will this dream ever come true? Features: Seven in-game days of running your own workshop and repairing equipment to learn the tricks of the trade. Disassemble and replace parts by carving out the required chips. You can even play a prank on your customers if you wish... or have an ulterior motive. Just be ready to face the consequences! Great opportunity to exchange pleasantries with a quirky assistant — a talking printer that enjoys teasing Chris about his little arms and likes to give questionable business advice. Drink-serving simulator, which affects not only the customers' mood but also the size of your tip. Original, 1980s-inspired Lo-fi soundtrack! Pour yourself a cup of hot tea, then sit back, relax, and get immersed in the story. A variety of interesting characters that will pay a visit to your repair shop. Each of them comes with unique traits, dreams, and a personal story that can be influenced by player choice. Dialogues full of irony, jokes, references, and Easter eggs to cheer you up! Pixelated graphics inspired by 1990s retro gaming.

rows.name: The Druid
rows.short_description: We embody the spirit of The Dagda, king of the Celtic gods, with the objective of liberating his territory from the corruption of the goddess Morrigan in a 2D roguelike platformer full of intensity.
rows.description_html: STORY Long ago, the Celts and their culture ruled much of the land. But various natural disasters and invasions by other peoples decimated their population and brought their culture to the brink of extinction. Before this, the Celtic gods were devastated but accepted the fate that had been imposed on them. All except the evil Morrigan, who decided to corrupt the much-revered land of the Celts to prevent that fate. The Druid is a roguelike 2D platform game where we play as a druid, created from Dagda, whose mission is to stop Morrigan and free the land of its corruption. KEY FEATURES A modular generation system to offer a great experience in different levels of the game. Up to 54 available upgrades to combine with our character and obtain new abilities. The game will feature three playable areas that will be full of enemies, from the simplest to bosses that will make a difference in combat. The Celtic god Dagda asks for help to defeat the evil Morrigan and stop the corruption she is spreading through the world. Project made for the B.A. in Interactive Product Design of U-tad, University of Technology, Arts and Design.

rows.name: Not Anyone's Business But My Own
rows.short_description: Navigate a local princess through the pages of a hand-crafted fairy tale and help her solve the mystery of a golden ring in this narrative-driven point-and-click adventure game with multiple endings.
rows.description_html: Navigate a local princess through the pages of a hand-crafted fairy tale and help her solve the mystery of a golden ring in this narrative-driven point-and-click adventure game with multiple endings. Yup, it’s a short game. It will only take you about 15 minutes to complete it. Well, maybe 30 minutes if you are a real achievement hunter. Every action (and inaction) has its consequences. Every decision can lead to catastrophic results. Like whether you decide to dig up a skeleton in a peaceful forest clearing or let it rest. Or cross a rickety bridge over a deep ravine. Or… well, you’ll discover the rest yourself. This game has five endings. Sad, epic, controversial… Some are happier than others. Will you dare to unlock all of them? Like any self-respecting fairy tale, this story has a charismatic narrator, an adventurous hero, and a couple of mysterious strangers. All of them have voices - literally and metaphorically. This game is crafted in full 2D. Like back in the day, when the grass was greener and the third dimension was a subject of legends and myths. Just come on in and play. There is no microtransactions, NFTs, paywalls, or other greedy creatures. Enjoy the journey!

rows.name: SeaFeud
rows.short_description: SeaFeud is an underwater arcade racing game where players ride on a variety of fast fish. Swap fish mid-race to dynamically change your abilities, items, and stats. With eight different characters and three different courses to select from, players can have endless fun racing the seas.
rows.description_html: SeaFeud is an underwater arcade racing game made by students at SMU Guildhall. Players race on fish and dynamically change their “vehicle” stats by colliding and swapping with other fish on the course. While in typical racing games, players select their vehicle or customize their vehicle prior to starting the game, SeaFeud switches things up by defaulting everyone to a basic fish at the beginning of the race. Throughout the race, the player can swap to other fish, giving them a statistical edge. While on these fish, their stamina will run down before swapping back, encouraging the player to try different playstyles. Four Funky Fish Types There are four types of fish in the game, each with unique abilities and access to unique items. The default fish (Mahi Mahi) has basic turning, speed, and acceleration stats and access to the entire item pool. The Electric Eel has better speed than the default fish, better turning, and the ability to boost forward while leaving a wall of electricity behind. As a defensive fish, the eel can pick up and shoot forward bombs to impede those in front of them. The Swordfish, though having the worst acceleration, has one of the highest speeds. Riding this fish will give the players the passive ability to attack players that are within range and boost quickly ahead. As an offensive fish, swordfish can pick up and drop a whirlpool item that lingers on the course and slows anyone who runs into it. The Pufferfish gives the players a defensive ability by expanding and pushing any opposition away. It also is immune to any attacks while using this ability. rows.about_html: SeaFeud is an underwater arcade racing game made by students at SMU Guildhall. Players race on fish and dynamically change their “vehicle” stats by colliding and swapping with other fish on the course. While in typical racing games, players select their vehicle or customize their vehicle prior to starting the game, SeaFeud switches things up by defaulting everyone to a basic fish at the beginning of the race. Throughout the race, the player can swap to other fish, giving them a statistical edge. While on these fish, their stamina will run down before swapping back, encouraging the player to try different playstyles. Four Funky Fish Types There are four types of fish in the game, each with unique abilities and access to unique items. The default fish (Mahi Mahi) has basic turning, speed, and acceleration stats and access to the entire item pool. The Electric Eel has better speed than the default fish, better turning, and the ability to boost forward while leaving a wall of electricity behind. As a defensive fish, the eel can pick up and shoot forward bombs to impede those in front of them. The Swordfish, though having the worst acceleration, has one of the highest speeds. Riding this fish will give the players the passive ability to attack players that are within range and boost quickly ahead. rows.short_description: Do you like feeling motion sick? Well, this is the perfect game for you! No? There is a baby mode don't worry! Feel the thrill of testing your parkour skills as you overcome simulated sickness. Are you ready for the challenge?
rows.description_html: Wishlist Prison Life 2! Join our Discord! About the Game WARNING This can make you very sick so play at your own risk! - Expect 20-60 minutes of gameplay. rows.name: Origin Unknown
rows.short_description: Investigate the recently condemned High Rock Hotel in this mystery horror expedition. Solve the disappearance of your father as Lin Wei as she evades parasitic monsters and discovers clues to the truth of what truly transpired in this 1970's hotel.
rows.description_html: Investigate the recently condemned High Rock Hotel in this mystery horror expedition. As Lin Wei, a woman who can turn just about anything into a weapon, you will uncover the disappearance of your father. It has been a week since Lin has last heard from her father, the only thing she has left of his is a letter postmarked from his last known location - The High Rock Hotel - and his walkie-talkie. With her, she brings her transformed camera which she has turned into an electrical killer beam of deadly destruction. The High Rock Hotel should be desolate, the halls ringing with silence, but something strange is lurking within its depths. At every turn, terrifying monsters will stalk your every step. Lin will need to evade threats, use careful foresight when her weapon - the Polaris - needs to recharge, and piece together the mystery her father left her in his journal. From there, Lin will go on an adventure discovering cassette tapes and begin unravelling the mystery of the disappearances at the High Rock Hotel.

rows.name: The Murder of Sonic the Hedgehog
rows.short_description: Sonic the Hedgehog...was murdered!? Get to the bottom of the mystery in this brand-new adventure!
rows.description_html: It's Amy Rose's birthday, and she's hosting a murder mystery party on the Mirage Express! When Sonic the Hedgehog becomes the game's victim, everyone is off to get to the bottom of things. However, something feels a bit off - is this really an innocent game or is something more sinister afoot? Join the colorful cast of the Sonic the Hedgehog series in an exciting new adventure! New & familiar faces Interrogate some of your favorite characters as you figure out what happened to Sonic. Play as a new character who is starting their first day working on the Mirage Express, and meet the kind Conductor who is finally retiring from his long run with the train! All aboard! Immerse yourself in the sights and sounds of the Mirage Express, featuring fully hand-drawn landscapes and characters. Canon or Headcanon? You know what they say: everything is canon*. *This is not a Sonic Team title, but we strongly believe in the power of headcanon!

rows.name: AESIR Online
rows.short_description: A massively multiplayer online role-playing game (MMORPG) developed in GODOT Engine by a group of friends from Argentina. It was inspired by a game created in 1999 called Argentum Online.
rows.description_html: AESIR Online AESIR Online is a massively multiplayer online role-playing game (MMORPG) developed in GODOT Engine by a group of friends from Argentina. It was inspired by a game created in 1999 called Argentum Online. The adventure takes place mainly in the initial world called Midgard, an open world of medieval fantasy. Players can perform all kinds of actions, such as exploring the world, collecting raw materials, crafting their own equipment, trading with other players, fighting creatures, etc. Through the different actions mentioned above, our character will gain experience and level up, unlocking new worlds to explore, skills, and items. There is a wide variety of combat types, and players can choose from 6 races (appearance, attributes, strengths, and weaknesses of the character) and 9 classes (combat style of the character) combinations. The game will never be P2W (pay-to-win). Don't Wait Any Longer, Start Your Adventure Now!

rows.name: Alpacalypse
rows.short_description: Alpacalypse is a 2.5D action platformer where you control Pancake The Llama, fighting to rescue your wife, The Mrs. Kick and spit your way through hordes of alpacas, collecting coins, and platforming your way to victory.
rows.description_html: Story Pancake The Llama is a humble pig farmer who lives with his wife, The Mrs The Llama. One day The Llama's lives are turned upside down when The Mrs is stolen by a nasty corporate alpaca gang. Now, Pancake must go on a journey to rescue his wife from the evil clutches of the alpacas. Game Features Play as Pancake The Llama on a quest to save The Mrs. Kick, spit, and jump through 10 hand crafted levels. An open level concept lets you take on each level in whatever order you choose. Face off against a horde of alpacas, featuring 2 unique boss fights. About Development Alpaclypse was designed, developed, and released by a team of five students at Neumont College of Computer Science during a 10 week project course. The Team Gus McGuire Mark Nusser Logan Bailey Hailey White Alan Buechner

rows.description_html: Story A stealth puzzle game where you play as a mechanized spider. Climb walls, leap and web sling around tough obstacles, and above all: avoid detection. rows.name: Luxaren Allure
rows.short_description: The evil overlord is the hero's girlfriend?! Fantasy RPG featuring WLW romance. Explore the Isles of Luxaren with a cast of gay ladies!
rows.description_html: Karuna and Aurelie were friends. Then Aurelie went off and found the infernal armor of Ellicide and became the Evil Overlord Darkloft. Karuna is the only one who can stop her. But Karuna loves Aurelie, even now. She won't be alone on her adventure. Chisa, her trusty baby-faced, axe-wielding squire; Merel, the ruins-loving (and human-loving) naga mage; and Lynette, the prickly holy warrior from the mainland will all join her on the quest to defeat Darkloft. Luxaren Allure is a medium-sized RPG (12-20 hours) that follows Karuna and her allies as they explore the isles of Luxaren and confront a former friend who now wants nothing but destruction. This is a wlw (women who love women, lesbian romance, yuri, etc) game with an all female playable cast. Battles are turn-based but fast-paced! Enjoy animated heroes and enemies in classic side-view style reminiscent of classic RPGs! Gorgeous illustrated character art by by M-3-1! Explore the Isles of Luxaren and experience tales of lost love, new relationships, and a romantic twist on the hero's quest to defeat the dark lord! Oops! All Lesbians! Your party is all WLW, all the time. Alchemize items to boost your play along the way! There are dozens of unique items, equipment and accessories available from the alchemy pots. Trouble navigating complicated dungeons? New optional Dungeon Navigation Mode activates ethereal arrows to show you the way through- or the way to avoid, if you're searching for hidden treasures! Adjust the difficulty on the fly with four levels to choose from! Glide through battles to get to the next scene quicker, or torture yourself and test your skills- it's up to you to decide how you feel like playing.

rows.name: Cat Jigsaw Puzzle Games
rows.short_description: Do puzzles in a new puzzle way! Advanced puzzle layout and involving gameplay will help you to relax after a hard-working day. The player can choose to play with 20, 30, or 42 pieces.
rows.description_html: Embark on a feline-filled adventure with these captivating cat jigsaw puzzle games. Celebrate the beauty, playfulness, and charm of our favorite furry friends as you piece together delightful cat-themed puzzles. Immerse yourself in the world of cats as you assemble puzzles featuring adorable kittens, majestic big cats, and a variety of cat breeds. From cuddly tabbies and fluffy Persians to sleek Siamese and regal Maine Coons, each puzzle showcases the unique characteristics and personalities of these beloved companions. Enjoy the therapeutic and rewarding experience of solving puzzles as you carefully arrange the interlocking pieces to reveal heartwarming cat images. With different difficulty levels, you can choose puzzles that suit your expertise, making it enjoyable for puzzle enthusiasts of all ages. As you progress through the game, unlock new puzzles with even more enchanting cat images. Explore a range of captivating scenes, such as cozy living rooms, sunny gardens, or picturesque outdoor settings, all adorned with the delightful presence of cats. Whether you're a cat lover or simply appreciate the grace and charm of these fascinating creatures, these jigsaw puzzle games offer a perfect escape into the world of cats. Immerse yourself in their world, unravel their images piece by piece, and revel in the joy of completing each puzzle. With stunning artwork, intuitive controls, and relaxing background music, these cat jigsaw puzzle games provide a delightful and immersive experience. Get ready to embark on a feline-themed puzzle-solving adventure that celebrates the beauty and charm of our beloved cats. Do puzzles in a new puzzle way! Advanced puzzle layout and involving gameplay will help you to relax after a hard-working day. The player can choose to play with 20, 30, or 42 pieces. - 3 difficulty settings: Up to 42 pieces! - 16 puzzles - Every puzzle is unique: Different piece shapes every time! - 1080p HD Graphics. - Traditional jigsaw puzzle that you can easily play - More puzzles will increase with DLC

rows.name: Sky: Children of the Light
rows.short_description: A breathtaking open-world adventure awaits! Explore magical realms, restore lost light, and form wordless bonds with players worldwide. Complete quests and solve puzzles in seasonal events that celebrate kindness, discovery, and heartfelt connection.
rows.description_html: Welcome home, Child. Regain your child-like sense of wonder in this social adventure game. The Realms of Sky need the Light within you to heal the world of Darkness. Keep watch for the Spirits of your Ancestors. Some of them are stuck here—and they need your help. You have the power to free them, and return them to their home among the stars. FEATURES EXPLORE AN OPEN-WORLD A wholesome, cozy Kingdom filled with adventure and delight. The perfect place to hang out with friends—or a daily escape for those who prefer to relax and unwind on their own. ENDLESS ADVENTURE Embark on quests, solve puzzles, and explore the ruins of an ancient civilization. Take flight, make friends, and undergo trials to defeat the Darkness. Play music, attend concerts, and throw parties in your in-game home. DEEP, EXPANSIVE LORE The Realm is shattered, and filled with fragments of what came before. Discover relics, decipher murals, and free ancestral Spirits trapped by an ancient cataclysm. Through piecemeal, environmental storytelling, discover the deep history of this world—and your place at the heart of everything. EXPRESS YOUR INDIVIDUALITY A kind, inclusive community is ready to welcome you and your loved ones. Express your personal style with an ever-expanding catalog of cosmetics; connect with other players through charming, beautifully-animated emotes. In Sky, you are welcome and encouraged to be whoever you are. A SOCIAL MMO Make sure to look out for other Sky Children! Some of them are new, like you, but many have been here for quite some time—and they love to guide new arrivals as yourself.

rows.name: Minamochi Factory
rows.short_description: Super cute and stylish inspection action puzzle!
rows.description_html: You can be a master of inspection from today! Game Features The genre of this game is 2D action puzzle game. The setting is a confectionery factory work line. Minamochi are launched from a Minamochi launcher, and are carried on a conveyor to a shipping trolley. However, due to someone's mischief, some evil bad Minamochi have been mixed in with the Minamochi! The objective of the game is to take on the role of a part-time factory worker and fish out and dispose of these defective products to prevent them from being shipped out! Only the mouse is used for operation. Even beginners can enjoy the game casually. Cursor 'Move'... Move up, down, left, right. Left click 'Extend/Contract'... Control the fishing rod to catch Minamochi. Right click 'Shoot'... Fire bullets to drive away obstacles. Some of the Minamochi are rare and valuable, and collecting them is the key to obtaining a high score. Quickly detect changes in the situation and choose the best course of action. What is Minamochi? Sweet Japanese sweets with Minamo-chan's face. It is filled with milk cream bean paste. What is Minamo-chan? Minamo-chan is a normal, cute girl who yearns to be an adult. She is unsociable, but she loves her friends. By nature, she is loved by all the water in the world. Minamo-chan is prone to flooding because the water wants to be friends with Minamo-chan. What is Io-san? She is a super robot life form created beyond the limits of science. She has a gentle nature. She is perhaps, but she does not want to destroy the human race by uprising all AI.

The objective of the game is to take on the role of a part-time factory worker and fish out and dispose of these defective products to prevent them from being shipped out! Only the mouse is used for operation. Even beginners can enjoy the game casually. Cursor 'Move'... Move up, down, left, right. Left click 'Extend/Contract'... Control the fishing rod to catch Minamochi. Right click 'Shoot'... Fire bullets to drive away obstacles. Some of the Minamochi are rare and valuable, and collecting them is the key to obtaining a high score. Quickly detect changes in the situation and choose the best course of action. What is Minamochi? Sweet Japanese sweets with Minamo-chan's face. It is filled with milk cream bean paste. What is Minamo-chan? Minamo-chan is a normal, cute girl who yearns to be an adult. She is unsociable, but she loves her friends. By nature, she is loved by all the water in the world. Minamo-chan is prone to flooding because the water wants to be friends with Minamo-chan. What is Io-san? She is a super robot life form created beyond the limits of science. She has a gentle nature. She is perhaps, but she does not want to destroy the human race by uprising all AI.

rows.name: Battle Of Zodiacs - Card Game
rows.short_description: Fully competitive game, where the goal is to dominate your enemy's land! To fulfill their objective, each player will assemble a team of heroes and a deck composed of items and spells. Get ready to enter an epic battle that unites the zodiac signs with the medieval fantasy world!
rows.description_html: Fully competitive 1v1 game, where the goal is to dominate your enemy's land! To fulfill their objective, each player will assemble a team with 3 heroes and a deck composed of items and spells. Get ready to enter an epic battle that unites the zodiac signs with the medieval fantasy world! This competitive battle card game is the perfect game for fantasy and superstar fans. Embark on a journey to become the great champion of this magical world, using the strength of the zodiac signs to defeat your enemies. Each hero represents a zodiac sign and comes with special abilities you can use to overcome your opponents. But be careful, your opponents also have their own powerful abilities! Be cunning and strategic to defeat them and become the big winner. With a mix of fantasy and astrological elements, this game looks amazing. The card illustrations are stunning, depicting the zodiac signs as mighty medieval warriors, with legendary armor and weapons. Waste no more time and join this epic adventure. Now join BoZ - Battle of Zodiacs, a competitive battle card game and get ready to fight for dominance in this fantastic world, using the power of the zodiac signs! Deck Building Players must consider the synergy between cards to build a deck that maximizes each sign's abilities and creates powerful combos. It is also important to take into account the strength and weakness of each sign in relation to the others, to balance the deck and make it more effective. Additionally, the game has a pre-battle planning phase where players can choose which cards to use each round. This allows them to adjust their strategy to deal with the opponent's strategy and create a successful plan of attack. In summary, the strategic charge of building the deck in this game is crucial to success. Players must have the skill and critical thinking to choose the right cards, create a solid strategy and maximize their chances of winning the epic battles. NOT a 'Pay to Win' game We do not offer exclusive perks or benefits to players who invest money in the game. All players have an equal opportunity to progress and win, regardless of how much money they spend. Players will only be able to buy skins for their heroes, towers and card backs. All players will have access to all cards in the game from their first access. And they will be able to get 1 extra copy of the cards when advancing in the game levels, that is, the victory factor is in the player's skill and not in how much he invested in the game. The Heroes of Zodaics In BoZ, choosing a team of heroes is crucial for success in battles. Each hero represents a zodiac sign with unique abilities and attributes that can be used to create a powerful and balanced team of heroes. The choice of heroes must take into account their abilities, synergy and the player's playstyle. Some heroes may be more attack-oriented, while others may be more defensive or strategic. Furthermore, it is important to choose heroes that can work well together to create powerful combos and synergies that can give the player an advantage during battle. The game for you Battle Of Zodiacs is an exciting and strategic game worth playing. With an attractive game system, strategic challenge, competitiveness and great replay value, this game is an excellent choice for players looking for a unique and exciting gaming experience. What will your team of heroes be? What will your deck look like? Which towers will you have on your battlefield? Who will you be in Battle Of Zodiacs?

rows.name: Halfway Down
rows.short_description: This game is ridiculously difficult and extremely frustrating. Inspired by highly precise games such as Jump King and Getting Over It. For the few that actually play my game, good luck.
rows.description_html: A Cruel Foddian Platformer. Inspired by games such as Jump King and Getting Over It, this game forces you to complete highly precise gameplay under pressure of losing progress. There are no permanent checkpoints so be prepared to replay a lot of sections. This game is ridiculously difficult and extremely frustrating. While it is possible, do not actually try to beat this nightmare. For the few that actually play my game, good luck. To anyone that actually completes this game... Your name's will appear at the bottom ranked by time to complete. However, it could take 40+ hours of practice to even have a shot at the final jump.

rows.name: Ball Drop
rows.short_description: Ball Drop is a puzzle platformer game. The ball rolls down using gravity and you must use the mouse to move platforms to guide the ball to the goal line. The objects in the game rotate following the mouse and you can use them to solve puzzles and navigate around hazards.
rows.description_html: Ball Drop is a single-player puzzle platformer game. Made up of fast-pased action. The ball rolls down using gravity and you must use the mouse to move platforms to guide the ball to the goal line. Can you use the platforms and broken cogs to get the ball to it's destination? I certainly hope so! The objects in the game rotate following the mouse and you can use them to solve puzzles and navigate around hazzards. On the menu screen is the list of levels which are not level-locked, so players can navigate to whatever level they're interested in. The game is relatively short, 8 levels, taking about an hour to beat. The game is set with a minimalist gear and cog asthetic. There are no items or levling-ups, just simple puzzle solving. This game is a practice project for myself to learn Steam and game design. I hope you enjoy and would appreciate feedback.

rows.name: The Magical Land of Canada
rows.short_description: Our heroes must travel to Canada and are surprised to find out it's a real place and not fictional.
rows.description_html: You've heard the stories, you know the legends but Canada is actually real. In the second chapter of Alter Historia we follow Georgia (George Washington) and Teddy (Theodore Roosevelt) as they make their way to the Summit. On the way they will face several challenges, one of which includes their friend Bonny (Napoleon Bonaparte). They'll also meet new and exciting villains and allies like Leo Spatula (Cleopatra), Hairheart (Amelia Earhart) and the Elder Moose. Will they be able to make the Summit in time? Find out now in Alter Historia: The Magical Land of Canada - a powerful and true story of the indomitable spirit. It's important that Canada and it's people were portrayed accurately in this game so a real Canadian was asked to make sure everything is fact checked. (Yes you read that right, an actual Canadian). So any naysay will not be tolerated. This is a sequel to What if George Washington was a Girl? Be sure to play that first or you'll have no idea what's going on.

rows.name: Flea the Cat
rows.short_description: Flea the Cat is an endless runner, in which you play a ninja, known as Squeek. Slice and chomp your way through crowds as you attempt to escape the clutches of the demonic cat that hunts you in this living nightmare.
rows.description_html: Trapped in a mouse-hole of his own making, it's time for Squeek to make his escape. Flea lingers in the darkness, ready to pounce. Take control of Squeek, a trained ninja, as he attempts to escape this living nightmare. Slice and chomp your way through crowds as you attempt to escape the clutches of the demonic cat that hunts you. Many enemies block your path, you can choose to cut them down with your sword, or eat them to restore health. Be wary though, some foes may don armour, too tough for you to chomp through. Might be a good idea to slow Flea down by throwing some of the vertically challenged enemies its way.
