rows.name: Pyrite Tycoon
rows.short_description: In Pyrite Tycoon, watch Pyrite the Goldfish go to work for you, mining minerals and selling them. Want to earn faster? Add more Pyrites and her friends to crank up the chaos. Still not rich enough? Catch creatures and take their valuable treasure for yourself. You monster!
rows.description_html: You've never played a game quite like Pyrite Tycoon. In Pyrite Tycoon, you can hire Pyrite the goldfish to help you make profits. Watch Pyrite go to work for you, collecting rocks and selling them.  Want to earn faster? Add more Pyrites into the mix, or add more of her friends to crank up the chaos. Each has different skills and earns money in a different way. The Toe Biter catches tadpoles, Cake the goldfish gathers berries, and Pinchie the crayfish chops wood. Progress through the game to unlock more friends and loot! If you find yourself asking 'Wouldn't robots be faster at gathering and selling materials for my personal gain than a couple of goldfish?' well, you won't be disappointed. Still not rich enough? You can also catch creatures and take their valuable treasure for yourself. You monster! Or fight against evil enemies and get paid for helping to defeat them. You angel. The game also lets you travel to alien planets to explore and find new resources. Pyrite Tycoon has plenty of depth for those willing to explore. (Pyrite Tycoon was inspired by a goldfish named Pyrite, and her friend Cake. It's the first game made by Jack Lewis for Pyrite Games, created when Jack was 12.)

rows.name: Furies & Magazines - Episode 1
rows.short_description: Graphic Novel Style Top Down Shooting Action Game which tells the story of Ivan Vinogradov, the victim of the CIA's top-secret project.
rows.description_html: Synopsis 'Chain of karma' Ivan Vinogradov is the victim of a top-secret project that was executed by CIA. He was on the verge of death after the project was abruptly aborted, but is rescued by a CIA agent named Frank Connery. For some reason, Frank helps Ivan in various ways. Ivan lives with nightmares every night because of what he went through in the facility. The only thing that sooths his pain is the unknown drug he has been using since the project. However, when the medicine is running low, Ivan wanders through the night to find a replacement. Features - Top Down Shooting Action Game with Graphic Novel Style - Simple, intuitive controls - Gamepad Support - Hundreds of high-quality pre-rendered cutscenes - Classical music by Chopin, Mussorgsky, Liszt, and a variety of original soundtracks ※EPISODE 1 consists of 5 chapters. ※Furies & Magazines is planned up to EPISODE 7.

rows.short_description: Xenon-Runner is a fast paced speedrunning parkour FPS where you compete against yourself, your friends, and the world. Utilize grappling, power sliding, recoil knockback, and wallrunning to complete the levels as fast as possible.
rows.description_html: Utilize movement abilities to increase speed Race your friends Advanced Grappling Mechanics Controls Shift - Power Slide Right Mouse - Grapple B - rewind to checkpoint L - rewind to start How to Exit the game? There is a transport portal outside the claw that says exit! Why no 2D Menus and UI? Less time creating boring menus = more time making fun game!

rows.name: Earth's Greatest Defender
rows.short_description: Shoot aliens in the coolest way possible using classic weapons and your grappling hook!
rows.description_html: Earth's Greatest Defender is a passion project that started in December 2021. It takes everything that we love about boomer shooters: fast paced action, loud weapons, tons of explosions, and a lot of obliterated aliens, all with the rhythm of a metal soundtrack. It is a game about shooting enemies in the most badass way possible. The game features a familiar set of weapons: machine gun, shotgun, rocket launcher, sniper rifle, and freeze gun. While basic, the real power of those weapons comes from switching between them to adapt to every situation, and combining them with the grappling hook . Shooting aliens is fun, but doing it while flying around using the grappling hook is 1000% more badass. It is the real star of Earth's Greatest Defender . Grappling can be done on any part of the levels. You can use it to get the high ground, but you can also use it to move super fast and become an unstoppable alien-killing machine. Built-in level editor If shooting aliens isn't your thing (really, it should be), Earth's Greatest Defender also features challenge levels, where the goal will be to use the grappling hook and other movement techniques to reach the final teleporter. If those levels still aren't enough, Earth's Greatest Defender features a map editor which allows you to create fun arenas in just a few clicks. Create the structure, add a few enemies, test it. Once your level is cool enough, share it and it might just be featured in the game!

rows.name: Andromeda
rows.short_description: In this casual sci-fi side scrolling space shooter, you are the last human and decide to make a final trip to the Andromeda galaxy before saying your final goodbye to the universe. Conquer enemies, experience the story, and find out what awaits you in Andromeda.
rows.description_html: Andromeda is a 2D side-scrolling space shooter game that offers a unique and thought-provoking experience. In this casual adventure, you assume the role of the last remaining human in existence, embarking on a final journey to the galaxy of Andromeda before uploading your consciousness to the mega computer with the rest of humanity. Encounter formidable enemies, collect power-ups, and navigate your way through five challenging levels to discover what lies at the end of your journey.

rows.name: Sleigh Strikers
rows.short_description: Santa's going high-tech with the Present Launcher 1225! Join the jolly ride, rescue reindeer, and blast presents down chimneys in this holly, jolly, fast paced shoot 'em up. Make every shot count and save Christmas in a dash!
rows.description_html: In Sleigh Strikers Santa's elves have engineered the ultimate gift-giving gadget: the Present Launcher 1225 . With the reindeer missing, it's up to you to deliver the goods in a blitz of festive fury. Race through 10 increasingly challenging levels, each faster and more frantic than the last, and bring back the missing reindeer to save Christmas. Ready, aim, unwrap! Challenge the rest of the world at your present delivering skills and deliver your way to the top of the Global Leaderboards. Ready to Sleigh? the frosty fun ramps up with each level. Your mission: zip presents or coal down chimneys, scoring points for precision. But beware, a merry mix-up between the naughty and nice lists will cost you! Aim like an elf on expresso to snag those high scores and stars. While it's all jingle bells and joy to start, mastering the leaderboard is a craft only the most dedicated Santa's helpers will perfect.

rows.name: Backrooms: Realm of Shadows
rows.short_description: Backrooms: Realm of Shadows is a horror game that takes place in a seemingly endless maze of interconnected rooms and hallways, known as the Backrooms.
rows.description_html: Backrooms: Realm of Shadows is a horror game that takes place in a seemingly endless maze of interconnected rooms and hallways, known as the Backrooms. The game is based on the popular internet creepypasta about a mysterious place that exists between the walls and floors of buildings, a place where people can become trapped and lost for days, weeks, or even years. In the game, you play as a person who has become trapped in the Backrooms, and your goal is to find a way out before the endless maze drives you insane. The Backrooms are a surreal and unsettling place, filled with strange noises, flickering lights, and mysterious creatures that seem to be watching you from the shadows. As you explore the Backrooms, you'll need to find keys, solve puzzles, and avoid dangerous traps and obstacles. You'll also encounter other lost souls who are trying to escape, but not all of them can be trusted. The deeper you go, the more unsettling the Backrooms become, and the harder it is to tell what's real and what's just a figment of your imagination. Backrooms: Realm of Shadows is designed to be a tense and atmospheric horror experience, with a focus on exploration, puzzle-solving, and survival. It's a game that will keep you on edge from start to finish, as you try to find your way out of this terrifying and otherworldly place. UNIQUE LEVELS In The Backrooms: Realm of Shadows, there are different levels or layers of the Backrooms, each with its own unique characteristics and challenges. THE ENTITIES In The Backrooms: Realm of Shadows, there are several entities that the player can encounter throughout the various levels of the Backrooms. These entities are typically hostile and dangerous, and encountering them can be deadly. Encountering any of these entities can be a terrifying and deadly experience, and players must exercise caution and use stealth to avoid them.

rows.name: Moon is Not the Limit
rows.short_description: Reach into orbit with Moon is not the Limit! Take to the stars as a recent recruit to the space program and learn all about the science behind space travel.
rows.description_html: Moon is not the Limit is a narratively driven educational spaceflight simulation game designed to teach players about the science behind space travel. Experience the journey as the newest astronaut to join the newly-formed Multi-national Aeronautics & Space Administration, MASA, as you answer space-related trivia to guide your rocket to a safe Moon landing! Discover starfaring features: A cast of voice acted characters to accompany you on your journey! Compelling narrative-driven dialogue. Trivia to test your astronomical knowledge. Customize-able Quick-Time-Events so you can experience the perils of space at your own pace. Afraid you don't have what it takes? Worry not! Your co-pilot and mission controller have your back with various dialogue comments about travel and life in space. Just sit back and remember to answer the questions posed correctly or your spaceflight may come to a sudden, and explosive, end.

rows.name: Fear The Unknown - Dave Story
rows.short_description: This story is one of the rare accounts we've managed to document a tale from the few who have encountered UFOs and lived to tell the tale. Dave considers himself lucky, and maybe you will be too, if you dare to face the unknown and survive.
rows.description_html: Fear the unknown ,In the game, you will play as one of the lucky ones who met them and survived. Fear The Unknown : Dave Story This episode tells the story of an ordinary working-class guy who was sent to work in a remote location, deep and far from civilization. He was incredibly lucky—his story reached us. Pay attention to the small details, as they may help you survive. This is just the beginning. The Gameplay This game offers a first-person narrative experience, blending walking simulation with elements of exploration, driving, drinking, and interactive conversations. It is a short game about UFO and aliens and is very inspired by x-files series, with approximately 30 minutes of gameplay. Game Control ASDW - Movements [LMB] - Action [RMB] - Task help , Drink Support GamePad Comments from the developer Although we may sometimes appear similar to one another, each of us possesses unique qualities and new values.

rows.name: Aquaphobia
rows.short_description: Aquaphobia is a short, first-person poetic artwork by Jakob Kudsk Steensen. It connects inner psychological landscapes to exterior ecosystems. Told in parallel to a break-up story, each environment explores a stage of treatment for aquaphobia, within the wider context of global rising water levels.
rows.description_html: Aquaphobia is a short, first-person poetic artwork, connecting inner psychological landscapes to exterior ecosystems. Beginning in the subterranean mud tunnels of Redhook, Brooklyn, a morphing water microbe guides the viewer on a journey through roots, water, plants, and sub-city infrastructure. The microbe recites a poem which details a troubled break-up between itself and the viewer. The piece connects the fear of water to our current ecological situation by exploring humanity’s relationship to rising sea levels. Originally made in VR in 2017, in 2023 Aquaphobia makes its premier as a first-person poetic experience - the first part of a series of published works by Jakob Kudsk Steensen.

rows.description_html: Throw magic bombs! Destroy everything around you! Avenge your family! ◆ Hand-drawn levels that you can destroy! ◆ Make tunnels, destroy walls, use the terrain to your advantage! Every level contains terrain that can be destroyed with bombs. ◆ Elemental bombs with unique effects! ◆ There are 8 unique bomb types for the player to unlock, each with unique effects! Normal Bomb: A simple explosion. Very reliable! Electric Bomb: Spawns an Electric Star that zaps nearby enemies. (WARNING: Very volatile!) And more! (Play the game to find them all!) ◆ Interactions and reactions between bombs (and the environment)! ◆ Most bombs can react with each other or the environment to create something new! Throw an electric bomb at lava and watch it explode! Make enemies shoot fireballs into an ice cloud to deal bonus damage to them! And more! Use these combinations to your advantage! ◆ Defeat powerful Elemental Bosses and the Embodiment of Chaos! ◆ Become destruction itself and unleash your explosive power on the Elemental Bosses and the Chaos Mage! Project made for the B.A. in Interactive Product Design, B.F.A. in Animation and B.F.A. in Digital Design degrees of U-tad, University of Technology, Arts and Design.

rows.short_description: Kill Your Shapes is a third-person shooter roguelike set in a world where reality and creation has been simplified down to shapes. Kill the enemy shapes and get new items and abilities. There are several levels and bosses to beat.
rows.description_html: Kill Your Shapes is a third-person shooter roguelike set in a world where reality and creation has been simplified down to shapes. Kill the enemy shapes and get new items and abilities. If you get enough of one item it becomes 'juiced up' and gives more bonuses. Run around each level, survive and kill shapes, get more items and become powerful. Each run should feel different with opportunities to make different kinds of builds. There are several levels and bosses to beat. Play as different characters, each with unique mechanics and abilities. Some items you encounter may be better for a specific character. There are over 20 items.

rows.name: Run On Home
rows.short_description: A short horror/comedy themed 2.5D platformer with puzzles, hostile enemies, and multiple endings. After reaching the end the first time you'll unlock the demon killing gun.
rows.description_html: First One! This is my first solo published game. The code was written completely by me and I will prepare a package that can be purchased through the Unity Asset Store if anyone want's to use this system to build their own 2.5D Platformer. About the Game Can you get this guy home safely after his Uber left him stranded in Murder City ? This short story of horror and survival will have you shaking in your boots as you race your way home without getting caught by an evil Demon. Everything in this world wants this guy dead and it's up to you to help him reach his destination. In this game the player has to use their platforming skills to get this random guy home. You'll come across puzzles/obstacles, and hostiles that want to put you in the dirt. On top of all of that, the player must avoid capture from a demon named Blamo. There are many paths to the end and a total of 4 different endings.

rows.name: Nocturnal Quest: An Idle RPG Adventure
rows.short_description: Nocturnal Quest is a Semi-Idle Adventure RPG with 100s of spells & effects, 6 classes, 12 specializations, and countless builds. Have your teams grind gear and progress through an infinity of levels!
rows.description_html: Nocturnal Quest is a Semi-Idle RPG game. Players recruit heroes, kill monsters, craft weapons & armor, advance talent trees, enchant/reforge equipment, discover mysterious gems, and finally assemble the most powerful adventure teams! Please note: Idle play is one of the main components of this game. Features A semi-idle game with deep and complex itemization systems to support endless character builds! Up to 6 adventurer classes to choose from. Every class has 2 specializations, with 3 spells each. Turn-Based + Real-Time battle system: During battles, each unit takes its turn according to its initiative stat. However, triggered effects, buff/debuff ticks, and regeneration happen in 'real time'. This unique system allows for deep strategy. There are more than 100 different active and passive skills to experiment with. Enchant, Reforge, and Transfer systems allow high customization of adventurers’ equipment. A deep gem system and a variety of set bonuses to further expand your strategy. More than 20 types of monsters among 6 different maps. Attract residents and conduct explorations to further expand your town! Create unique builds and fight! Grow magical fruits at the Botanist! Brew magical potions at the Alchemist!

rows.name: Quit Smoking VR Therapist
rows.short_description: Do you want to quit smoking? This application can help you to eliminate and erase your taste for a cigarette. Based on the latest knowledge in the field of psychology, neuroscience and hypnotherapy.
rows.description_html: Quit Smoking VR Therapist is an application that can help you get rid of cigarette addiction with ease and without stress. Based on the latest knowledge in the field of psychology, neuroscience and hypnotherapy, it will simplify the path to life without smoking in the environment of virtual reality. Prior to using the application, relax for a couple of minutes, do not let anyone or anything disturb you. The application is most effective in a state of deep relaxation. For the best and fastest result, we recommend reusing the application several times a week. The application is not suitable for people who are sensitive to bright white and for people with epilepsy.

For the best and fastest result, we recommend reusing the application several times a week. The application is not suitable for people who are sensitive to bright white and for people with epilepsy.

rows.name: VERY BAD DREAMS - FREE DIVE
rows.short_description: Bad Dreams is a Solo VR Horror game with immersive gameplay based on real gesture. A unique experience, where nightmares become reality.Fight, Run, Jump, Wipe your eyes, Cover your ears... while avoiding the game's traps and puzzles, you won't come out unscathed!
rows.description_html: There is a fine line between dream and nightmare... Very Bad Dreams is an intense and demanding experience that will test your nerves. Forget everything you thought you knew about horror games, because Very Bad Dreams transcends the boundaries of the gaming experience. Developed by an independent French studio, Very Bad Dreams is much more than just a game. It is an extraordinary immersive experience, where your survival depends on real actions. You will need to react instinctively to survive this scary world. Feel the impacts of your strike force, feel vibrations in your head when you are hit by an enemy or your heart races, run and jump using your real gestures, hold your head with both hands so as not to become mad. So many new gameplay elements that will give you the impression of never doing the same thing. Do you like looking for endless loot? Try hundreds of weapon and potion combinations? Spend hours in your inventory ? Very Bad Dreams is not for you... Here only one word of warning, be afraid... very afraid, whether you have a gun, a bat or a knife the best thing is to flee and NOT fall into madness. You wake up on an idyllic beach, feet in white sand, lulled by a light breeze as the sun sets on the horizon. During this leisurely walk, the gates of hell open to you. Driven by your pride, you think you can cross them without suffering the consequences but quickly the perfect dream in which you found yourself turns into an oppressive nightmare with no way out. Lead the fight for your existence in an atmosphere where madness is palpable and anxiety grows with every step you take, face hordes of zombies, solve puzzles or search for the best place to hide. For the bravest among you, prepare to live an extraordinary immersive experience, where horror comes to life and where every moment can seal your fate. Face your inner demons, triumph over your deepest fears. But remember, never, ever succumb to madness Do you dare to dive into the endless abyss of Very Bad Dreams? We will have warned you...

rows.name: Pigeon Strike
rows.short_description: This cute casual game is offering you the chance to relax and get some lazy revenge while you test your reflexes and expand your poop reign.
rows.description_html: We all have our bad days. You're late, your tire's flat, and you have a coffee spill on your new shirt. In Pigеon Strike you get to be the master troublemaker that delivers even more bad luck. This fun casual game is offering you the chance to relax and get some lazy revenge while you test your reflexes and expand your poop reign. Pigeon Strike is full of surprises - players can collect awesome boosters that can be found all over the map and will give you a bunch of new cool abilities! Who doesn't like customizations? You also get the chance to change the appearance of your character slightly or drastically! Skins come in many shapes and forms - collect them all and enhance your gameplay by adding extra detail to your poopy friend! Birds fly long distances and some even migrate to different places. Players, along with their feathered friends, discover three different maps and everything they have to offer. Prizes and benefits change with every map, so play along to be part of this awesome adventure! Stay tuned for more maps in the future! Key Features: Classic Navigation through the map (W, A, S, D or Arrow Keys) Dodge or Slash your way through various obstacles Fly through 3 different maps Evolve with 5 boosters (poop storm, shrapnel, immune, slo-mo, double score) and make a total mess around you Escape or distract nasty seagulls Chase totally unsuspecting people 12 awesome skins and appearances brought to life with our hand-crafted 2D art Ridiculously fun, satisfying, and addicting to play!

rows.name: Push battle Royale
rows.short_description: Push battle Royal is a battle royale game that challenges players to survive and eliminate other players while navigating through shrinking zones on a hostile island.
rows.description_html: Push battle Royal is a battle royale game that challenges players to survive and eliminate other players while navigating through shrinking zones on a hostile island. In this game, the primary goal is to stay alive and be the last person or team standing. Players can use a wide range of weapons, gear, and tactics to outsmart and overpower their opponents. The game is fast-paced and requires quick reflexes, strategic thinking, and teamwork to succeed. With its thrilling gameplay, immersive graphics, and engaging mechanics, Push battle Royal is a popular choice for gamers who love adrenaline-fueled action and intense competition.

rows.name: Battle For The Hill
rows.short_description: Will YOU control Congress, the Supreme Court, or the Presidency? In Battle for the Hill, a real-time multiplayer political strategy game, you’ll pass laws, shape the economy, and fight for power. Build alliances, manipulate the system, or dominate the market—every decision changes history.
rows.description_html: 🗳️ Shape America’s Future in Battle for the Hill 🏛️ Will you pass landmark legislation, control the economy, or influence the Supreme Court? In Battle for the Hill , a real-time multiplayer political strategy game, you’ll navigate the chaos of American politics in a fully simulated democracy. 📜 Lead One of Three Branches of Government: ✔️ Pass laws as a Senator or Representative ✔️ Enforce policies as the President or Governor ✔️ Shape legal precedent as a Supreme Court Justice or as a Circuit Court Judge 💰 Master the In-Game Economy: ✔️ Corporations battle for market share in a live economy ✔️ Financial strategies affect trade, inflation, and industry ✔️ Influence Wall Street, Main Street, and the working class 👥 Real-Time Multiplayer & Community: ✔️ Play alongside hundreds in a persistent online simulator. ✔️ Engage in alliances, political debates, and backroom deals. ✔️ Impact elections, the judiciary, and corporate power structures. 🔹 Make History or Break It. Will you uphold democracy—or dismantle it? 🌎 Wishlist Battle for the Hill on Steam today!

rows.reviews_html: “Battle for the hill is a great game to get immersed in, from the multi-party system to the bill creation, no matter where you are on the political spectrum you are on there is a party for you. From right wing maga loving gop to far left socialists, you pick a side and go for the throat. Each party has their own discord so you can make friends or enemies or even frenemies. The election system is nice, raising stats, entering primaries, seeing how far you can go to win an election, the outcome is always fascinating. You can run attack ads, campaign for your colleges, change your states positions if you are elected governor, they even have gerrymandering if that is your thing. If you want to experience an exciting yet sometimes frustrating political simulation game battle for the hill is one you should try out. Will you be next? This ad review is brought to you by Yuri, join the socialist today!” Yuri Cleary “Battle for the Hill is a video game which is everything BUT a video game. It's a crash course on the real world via the most relevant topic in our lives: Our Government. Much like our real governments, disagreement and depression are the two things that come to mind first. However BFTH manages to circumvent reality and produce a sense of community among 'politicians,' causing us to think critically about issues we normally would have a safe answer for. In Battle for the Hill, unlike most simulations, the reality of 'consequences' heralds players to doom or success. Resource management in cash or having to actually manage a group of people...your actions can have severe repercussions on hundreds of people and they develop situations you have to respond to. In BFTH you can be a Senator, Governor, Congress person, Party political figure such as Chair, President, SCOTUS, Cabinet, and else. There's always room for opportunity and a broom for the inactive; to be replaced by you...potentially vibrant and ambitious enough to make it to the top. BFTH isn't fun because it's a video game. It's entertaining because it's a community; Since the game has negative and positive implications for your behavior, your actions, and your decisions... BFTH becomes a real simulation. There is no total failure, but no total victory either. Everything is a perspective, and if you enjoy the realism of a world which makes you contemplate and consider the consequentialism of a 'world,' You'll learn more about politics here than you would from an 80 year old socialist professor at Harvard.” James Ernest

rows.name: Hibernation Day
rows.short_description: Hibernation Day is a short dialog based adventure with cozy visuals. It's about family and the problems we face trying to keep it afloat.
rows.description_html: Hibernation Day is about family and the problems we face trying to keep it afloat. Our small team combined life experiences to compose a new-year-esk story you can relate to and spiced it up with some humor, so you wouldn't fall asleep listening to a calming soundtrack. The game features no saves but can be finished in around 20 very satisfying minutes, it's also slightly non-linear – try again and choose differently if you want more of them crisp wintery dialogs. Story It is almost the end of Hibernation Day , a holiday of the last day before a long winter slumber. However, the celebration isn't going well and everybody's on edge. Your cool older sister isn't happy to be stuck at home, your silly younger brother is nowhere to be found, and the parents are fighting (as they often do). Help your family get along and find peace in the last day before winter hibernation. Creators Developer and game designer: Serezhka Korneevskii Artist: Nastasia Viatkina Writer: Aleksandr Korneevskii You must be aware that this game is our love-child, and if you treat it poorly, you should expect us to visit your parents for the explanations.

rows.name: Life After Magic
rows.short_description: Can you save magic before the clock strikes midnight on New Year’s Eve? Life After Magic is a queer, retro visual novel that follows jaded ex-magical girls as they reconnect, deal with young adulthood, and face off against one last threat before Y2K hits.
rows.description_html: Being an adult sucks! Life was so much easier when Akiko was saving the world with her magical girl squad, the Sentinels of Justice. Now she’s stuck working a boring retail job, watching the days creep closer to Y2K. She’s lost touch with her high school friends, her powers, and herself. Worst of all... MAGIC IS DISAPPEARING When Akiko realizes her healing magic is fading, she knows it's a sign of trouble. But things only get worse from there — her old teammates are affected too and soon the greater populace of the city! As Akiko, with help from the Sentinels, track down what's happening to magic (and who might be behind it) before it's too late. Meet the Sentinels Reconnect with your former teammates! All the Sentinels have moved on from magical girl life in their own way. Spend your free time getting closer to them (and even finding love!) with optional routes between your work day and your magical girl sleuthing. But the Sentinels aren't the only ones you'll meet! Hang out with your Glamour Pop work wife and avoid running into your ex, Solaire Blaze (don't even get us started!). Go to Work!? Even former magical girls have to pay rent! Go to your shift at Glamour Pop: the high-end, low-paying retail job that you got after high school. Deal with the demands of the customers and if successful, you might just have more energy to hang with your friends! Plus, you wouldn't want to get on the bad side of Glamour Pop's CEO Anna Lee… Life After Magic is a queer, retro visual novel featuring: 100k+ words 13 tracks of original music Handmade pixel art, CGs & VFX Sapphic main cast with lots to discover about each character Optional routes for friendship and romance (and a secret or two!) Workplace mini-game and one special ending mini-game Y2K anxiety A funky li'l cat Developed by

rows.name: Pandamonium
rows.short_description: Pandamonium is a single-player psychological horror game. You have been taken. The only way out is through three eerie mazes where roaming panda-suited strangers are on the hunt. Escape them, or become them.
rows.description_html: Will the Pandas get you? The Back Rooms have haunted a generation. No one knows how they get there; no one knows how to get out. Evil could lurk beyond any corner in this labyrinth. It’s your worst nightmare come true, you hear them scratching at the walls, the footsteps echoing, but getting closer. There are signs on the walls, prayers for help. But others are written in human blood. It’s the Pandas and they’re taunting you. • A psychological horror game set in the Back Rooms • Run and hide as giant pandas chase you from level to level. Each with its own unique ability to make your life hell. • Each level increases in difficulty. • Make your way to safe rooms where the nightmarish pandas can’t get you… you hope. • Collect power-ups to fight off the pandas, but it won’t last long. • Single player, first person. Can you make your way through the Back Rooms with your Mind and Body intact? Or will the Pandas drag you deeper?

rows.name: Born Again
rows.short_description: Explore an enchanting world with friends or on a solo adventure, as you Hack-n-Slash your way through minions of the Outer Realm in redemption of your dishonorable past!
rows.description_html: Become an honorable Ronin in the Realms of Born Again. Explore an enchanting world with friends or on a solo adventure. Experience fast-paced gameplay against engaging enemies, and immersive abilities that change the pace of each duel. Each victory progresses your Ronin, offering increases in strength, equipment, and blessings. Path to Honor Hack-n-Slash your way through minions of the Outer Realm in redemption of your dishonorable past. Face off against kings, rulers, and deities along your path to becoming a renowned Ronin! Thread of Fate Weave together enchanting blessings on your Ronin's Thread, creating mechanic mashups, gameplay alterations, and equipment synergies. Permanent Death Death of your player ends your Ronin's Thread, but redeems the Honor gained from their life achievements. Save or spend your Honor for the benefit of new or existing Ronin! Item Storage Store items and equipment in your bank for safety through death. Gear up new characters or begin trading with other players to amass a grand fortune. Cooperative Multiplayer Enter with friends or finds them along the way! Cooperate in team-play against minion of the Realm and work together to overcome challenges thought impossible alone. Choose your Look Find your cosmetic style and boldly show it across the Realm! Customize your Ronin from hats to armors, weapons, and boots!

rows.name: Fear of Neighbours
rows.short_description: Fear of Neighbours is a psychological horror game that puts you in the shoes of a resident in a quiet Finnish neighbourhood.
rows.description_html: Fear of Neighbours is a psychological horror game that puts you in the shoes of a resident in a quiet Finnish neighbourhood. However, as you settle into your apartment, you begin to notice strange occurrences and unsettling behavior from your neighbours. Unexplained noises, bizarre events, and creepy sightings of your neighbors make you wonder if you're truly safe in your own home.

rows.name: Dungeon Mage
rows.short_description: Collect, fight and craft: Face the dangers of the shifting dungeon layouts and challenge the fierce bosses within. A completly free community-driven game!
rows.description_html: Collect, fight, explore, craft, build and venture deeper: The dungeon is a dangerous place and harbors countless evils trying to lay waste to you while you are uncovering the secrets of the structures within. Carve out your place within the ecosystem of the dungeon, unravelling its mysteries, engaging in thrilling combat or even kicking your feet up while you fish for long forgotten treasure. Manifest yourself in the dungeon - you just have to be strong enough to do so. This free community-driven dungeon exploration game features a vast amount of content to explore, tons of enemies to defeat and countless items to obtain. Our community's contribution is helping the game reach its full potential by continously providing feedback, contributing ideas and play-testing the on-going free updates this game receives. Are you ready to face the dungeon on your own? Key features: - Fast-Paced Combat - Combing Items For Powerful Weapons - Dungeon Fishing - Randomized Exploration - Free Content Updates Credits to: - Programming: greenpixels - Art: greenpixels, ePics, RunninBlood, Anokolisa, LYASeeK, Penusbmic, Elthen's Pixel Art Shop, unTied Games - Audio: Paninjin, Abstraction, Ancient Games, MakotoHiramatsu - Helper Assets: GMLive, Post-Processing FX

rows.name: RAID: Shadow Legends
rows.short_description: RAID: Shadow Legends is a free-to-play collection RPG with 800+ playable Champions and 8 game modes. Heed the Arbiter's call and defend the dark fantasy world of Teleria.
rows.description_html: The realm of Teleria trembles beneath the shadow of the Dark Lord Siroth. You have been called upon by the Arbiter, the immortal guardian of Teleria, to stop him. Heed the call! Dive into a deep turn-based RPG with 8 exciting game modes and extensive character customization. Enjoy a story-driven campaign, competitive PvP clashes with players from across the world, and constant new challenges with our stream of updates. KEY GAME FEATURES SUMMON 800+ CHAMPIONS Collect hundreds of unique Champions from 15 playable factions and combine them into unstoppable teams to take down your enemies. Dark elves, Ogryn warlords, Lizardmen, and more can all join your ranks – if you earn their loyalty. MASTER TACTICAL TURN-BASED GAMEPLAY Kit out your Champions with epic gear you loot along the way and customize their masteries for millions of possible builds. Level up your team and play them your way, unleashing a barrage of powerful skills and game-changing support abilities. PROVE YOURSELF IN 3 PvP MODES Enter the Arena and go head-to-head with other players to unlock special gear and climb up the leaderboards. Then, really put your skills to the test in real-time PvP battles with Live Arena. EXPLORE ENGAGING PvE CONTENT Tear your way through a visually stunning campaign accompanied by a rich, fully-voiced dark fantasy narrative. Conquer the forces of Darkness as well as 13 challenging Dungeon bosses, fast-paced Faction Wars, and the notorious Doom Tower to earn valuable loot. TEAM UP WITH FRIENDS Join forces with your fellow players to take on Clan Bosses for exclusive gear, Shards to summon new Champions, and more. Once you’re strong enough, you can also compete against 4 other Clans in the epic Hydra Clash. GET LOST IN THE LORE Learn about the inhabitants of Teleria through their unique backstories as well as the world itself. Immerse yourself even further by checking out the animated limited series RAID: Call of the Arbiter on YouTube.

rows.name: Novus
rows.short_description: Gorilla Tag meets FPS. It's that easy.
rows.description_html: Novus aims to combine the Gorilla Tag type locomotion present in Gorilla Tag with the FPS genre of games mainly present on flat-screen games. There's an interactive type of movement in play which makes you have to use your hands to bounce of the ground to move where you want to, or you can use the dash. The goal is simply to shoot the other players and get as many kills as possible. There is also an in game proximity voice chat to help everyone communicate with each other and have fun! This way the game is more than 2x more immersing.

rows.name: I was born poor
rows.short_description: Cherubino is a boy who was born poor and he lives in village where TV is provided for free by local government. His life is truely surrounded by nothingness. But Cherubino is getting his way through poverty with the spiritual help of 'Brahmana' of Brahmanas.
rows.description_html: Special Thanks This game is made from 'SMILE GAME BUILDER'. Features The story is a continuation of 'Mademoiselle Kshatriya'. Not only Brahmana but also Azhdaha appears again in the game. It is a 20 minutes short movie rather than JRPG game, though a very important turning point is waiting for the player. Characters Cherubino A poor boy living in a small village. Cherubino didn't notice the real reason why local government is willing to give TV to poor families for free. And they usually turn on TV in the night because the electric charge for TV is free. They think TV can be used for a lamp in the dark. The point is that they are too poor to pay for the electric charge of a lamp. For good or for evil, Cherubino was selected by Brahmana for his plan. Why did Brahmana select Cherubino? The answer is going to become clear in the ending. Brahmana A key character in the game. Brahmana talks to Cherubino through spiritual world but Cherubino doesn't see Brahmana with his eyes like a spiritual entity. He is trying to do something good or bad by using Cherubino as one of his tools. But his hidden attempt will not be in the light until the ending.

rows.name: Green New Deal Simulator
rows.short_description: Achieve zero emissions and full employment in this casual card-driven game.
rows.description_html: The Green New Deal Simulator is a tiny deck-building game about the biggest challenge of our time: climate change. Your goal is to transition the United States to a post-carbon economy while ensuring full employment. Invest in renewable energy sources, end fossil fuel consumption, capture the CO2 in the atmosphere, update the energy grid, research new green technologies… But watch out: the clock is ticking, and it seems like the budget is never enough! Features The Green New Deal Simulator is the long-awaited sequel to the Democratic Socialism Simulator. It features a completely new gameplay while maintaining the same accessibility. Drag and drop your action cards onto various regions of the USA, evaluate their impact, and expand your deck. A game lasts about 40 minutes. - Intuitive board game-like mechanics - 22 action cards based on real-world policies and solutions - A cast of proud working class animals - Original soundtrack by Jesse Stiles made with locally sourced analog synthesizers - 100% free: no ads, no subscriptions, no in-game purchases

rows.name: Linxy The Lynx
rows.short_description: Stop Prof.B.Ray's Nature Taker-er before he destroys Mangoberry island and his main course... YOU!
rows.description_html: Linxy is known for saving his home (Mangoberry Island) from the nefarious Prof.B.Ray on a weekly basis and this time it's not all that different, B.Ray is up to some scheme that revolves using his Nature Taker-er to power his Linxy Destroyer-er! Overview Play as Linxy and use his slick moves to get to Prof.B.Ray's fortress! Along the way you'll find bounce pads and aerial bounce pads that'll boost you vertically and horizontally respectively, you'll encounter grind rails that Linxy can ride at high speeds but it's not a smooth ride you'll need to be quick in order to jump bottomless pits, stalagmite pits and lava pits that split rails apart! Collectables Along your way you'll find little motherboard looking things called Remix Chips, these chips allow you to unlock new levels that are harder and introduce a couple of new mechanics you won't encounter on your normal journey. Collect a ton of Coconuts for a final secret! Moveset Linxy has an easy to learn hard to master moveset so anyone at any skill level can pick up the game and play! Linxy has your typical jump, a double jump, a slide and a slide jump! The slide jump prioritizes distance over height so if you want to get up to higher ground you're best off normal jumping. As for a slide it will give Linxy a temporary burst of speed and can be used to pop every enemy in the game!

rows.name: The House of E.
rows.short_description: The House of E. is a story-driven puzzle game with horror elements and a creepy atmosphere.
rows.description_html: The House of E. is a story-driven puzzle game with horror elements and a creepy atmosphere. As you explore the darkest corners of the spooky mansion, you will collect items and solve riddles. Notes and newspaper pages will shed light on past events, and all combined will put you one step closer to discovering the truth. And in the end, you will have to decide not only about Emma’s fate. The game has three different endings. Due to its length, there is no save option. Although David and Emma Adams are siblings, they grew apart in time. But when the news of Emma's disappearance reaches David, he decides to do whatever is in his power to find her. Seeing the hopelessness of the local PD, he decides to take the matter into his own hands. The trail leads him to the old mansion owned by a mystery horror novelist, who, as it turns out, also vanished without a trace. Believing those disappearances are not a coincidence, David goes to the manor. He ventures into the unknown... rows.short_description: Your average student life quickly descents into horror as a mysterious witch takes over the college... Can you save the girl you love? Or even make it out alive?
rows.description_html: The Midnight Witch cannot wait to meet you… It was supposed to be just another day in college – you would hang out with your girl, joke with your friends, fall asleep with lectures… just like any average student. But when a stunningly beautiful new professor shows up, your average day takes an unexpected dark turn. As it turns out, her angelic face is just a facade for her true identity – she is a witch. But not the nice kind. This one is out for blood. You and the other students are now all trapped in this classroom, waiting for death to pick you off one by one. Can you find a way out? Foil the Witch’s cruel game? Save the girl you love? … can you even make it alive ? rows.name: PoligonVR
rows.short_description: Imagine a virtual world where you can create or be anything you ever wanted. PoligonVR is a powerful community driven sandbox where we give you the necessary tools to turn your dreams into virtual reality.
rows.description_html: Imagine a virtual world where you can create or be anything you ever wanted. PoligonVR is a powerful community driven sandbox where we give you the necessary tools to turn your dreams into virtual reality. Our goal is to provide a safe, fun & exciting experience for everyone. You can explore the user generated content, have a chat with your friends or watch a movie together! The choice is yours at any time. We provide a way to seamlessly switch between VR & Desktop mode quickly without having to restart the game. This allows you to test something in VR or need to take a quick VR break without having to shut everything down. We want to shape this platform based on your feedback so we can deliver the best experience for you. With our Unity based Content Creation Kit (CCK) you can easily upload and manage your content. We designed the CCK to be both powerful and easy to use for anyone. For custom content, PoligonVR utilizes 'Single-pass instanced rendering' which provides VR performance benefits compared to the traditional 'Multi-pass rendering'. We provide a safe, high performant scripting solution we call 'P#'. With P#, you can create complex worlds where you are in control of the world logic. Within our CCK we provide examples of common world logics such as buttons, video players and much more. Because they are powered by P#, you can modify & tweak the provided examples to your needs at any given time. Experience super immersive audio with Steam Audio. We allow world creators to integrate Steam Audio directly into their worlds & the voice chat to provide a realistic and immersive experience. You can upload your own custom avatars, or try out public avatars created by others or ask a friend to share their avatar with you! Sparked your interest? Join our Discord server for more information on how to join the closed-beta and future updates!

rows.name: Sky division
rows.short_description: Lost on a desert island with a wounded enemy pilot and no resources, can you cooperate even though you are enemies? or will you kill each other? Sky division is a visual novel that deals with themes such as the meaninglessness of war and unrequited love.
rows.description_html: Sky division is a visual novel, where the player plays the role of a human pilot fighting a war against an alien race to conquer their planet. During a reconnaissance mission the protagonist is shot down on a desert island and finds a wounded enemy pilot. The story focuses on the relationship between the two and the mutual understanding between two races that are in conflict. Sky division is a visual novel set in a dystopian future in which humanity abandoned Terra for unknown reasons. After traveling 600 years through the inhospitable darkness of space in huge spaceships called 'arks', governed with an iron fist by 'the federation', a conglomerate of countries that united with the purpose of avoiding the extinction of the entire race. After 6 generations away from home, mankind forgot the languages they used in terra, the religions and even the feelings, to the point that love and sentimental relationships were left in the past. A few books were preserved but are considered forbidden to the general population. The planet to which they were traveling was considered a paradise for the proliferation of the race, with no intelligent life and abundant resources. But when they arrived they saw how wrong they were, there was intelligent life on the planet and the planet was immersed in a territorial war and for the survival of the different races that inhabited it. (8.0) -New scenarios were added, such as the forest at night and the place where the dax fighter fell. -New songs and sounds to improve the atmosphere. -A voice actor to play some of Dax's words and moans. -Fixed some bugs that prevented you from continuing if you collected fruits instead of hunting animals.

rows.name: Airborne
rows.short_description: Airborne is a combination of 2D Platformers, Rage Games, Parkour, while also being packed with Action. You need to get to the end of the level by dodging Spikes, Bullets, Turrets, Lasers and more!
rows.description_html: LISTEN TO THE SOUNDTRACK About the Game Airborne is a combination of 2D Platformers, Rage Games, Parkour, while also being packed with Action. You need to get to the end of the level by dodging Spikes, Bullets, Turrets, Lasers and more! This game is not easy, as you will need quick reflexes and platforming skills, while also being able to be played casually. You will need to escape precise levels that are designed to test the limits of your abilities. Your goal is to make it to the end of each level by dodging obstacles such as spikes, bullets, turrets, and lasers. You'll also need to use launch pads strategically to make death-defying jumps and reach seemingly impossible places. But the fun (and rage) doesn't stop there! There is also a vast library of community-made levels, created by players just like you using the integrated level editor. With new levels being added all the time, there's practically infinite content being made by players all around the world. Airborne has an advanced level editor with almost all features from the base game with the ability to publish your levels to the world using Steam Workshop! You can make pretty much anything your heart desires and share it with your friends - It is guaranteed to make them rage. If you're a fan of precision platformers and adrenaline-fueled gameplay, then this is the game for you. With its intense rage platforming, interesting level design, and community-made content, you'll never run out of levels to beat!. the cube can jump btw

rows.name: Irradiant
rows.short_description: Silence the shrine. Irradiant is a small score-attack action game by a solo developer, where you're faced with destroying mischievous spirits bewitching a shrine as fast as possible.
rows.description_html: Irradiant is a minimal 2D, score-attack action game where you're faced with destroying mischievous spirits bewitching a shrine as fast as possible. You'll need to thread the needle on precision movement, button mashing and careful use of soul charges - your resource for unleashing devastation screen-wide slashes. Do you play safely at the cost of score? Or push your skills to the limit to shave off precious seconds? Your achievements can be viewed by all, with the online leaderboard. Replay your best run or watch others to see what techniques they use. Will you live long enough to face Kaizen and bring silence to the shrine? Highly responsive controls, it's up to you to master your abilities to obtain the best score you can. Time ticks away, hesitation will only hurt you. Light attacks are as quick as your fingers and give you air time. Heavy attacks have a cooldown but deal extra damage and fling you upwards. Collect soul charges to unleash a powerful slash attack, but beware: enemies you kill with it won't reward you with more soul charges. Use the environment to your advantage with wall jumps and dashes to speed towards enemies as they appear. Compete for the top of the leaderboard, where every second counts. Watch replays of leaderboard scores to discover new techniques. Custom engine with minimal hardware requirements. Playing with a controller is highly recommended. Music by Peritune. Voice effects by Voicevox.

rows.name: Shiner
rows.short_description: Learn every attack that gets used against you in this turn-based strategy game. Meet (and battle) a colorful cast of fully voice-acted characters as you search for the bully who wronged you.
rows.description_html: Shiner is a turn-based strategy game where you learn all the attacks of the enemies you beat! Starting with only the knowledge of how to do a simple punch, can you snowball yourself into an avatar of (fuzzy) destruction? Make friends with a cast of cute and colorful characters! Every character in the game has a unique personality and a unique set of attacks for you to learn if you can beat them. “Why would I fight my friends,” you ask? Look, relationships are complicated. Buds can horse around is all I’m saying. Craft powerful builds! You’ll learn a ton of attacks, but you can only bring 4 of them into each fight. Can you find the right combination to beat an opponent who heals to full health every turn? What about someone who reflects all the damage you deal right back at you? Every battle is a puzzle and an opportunity for you to find a new way to break the game. 4 zones to battle your way through. A fully voice-acted cast of characters. 'One-Punch Mode' if the battles get too tough. A bite-sized experience! The game's only 1 or 2 hours long. Ranch dressing elemental. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: VIRA
rows.short_description: Maxim Bludnev helps his father, who got into a mess. A funny 2D Quest that will show a simple story with black humor and interesting details!
rows.description_html: Max Bludnev is the main character, who returns to his native land after a year of absence. He is finding out news about his Father, who got into trouble and Maxim will have to help him out and at the same time get to the truth of all his father's problems. 2015 year! The good old 2D Quest on the principle of Point and Click. Jokes, Black Humor and simple controls are present! - A short but interesting story about the adventures of Maxim. - A system of saving on the principle of entering a Pin code! - Real-life locations! Look for: MAZA (2025)

rows.short_description: Avoid all incoming obstacles while managing your HP! There are only 2 ways to die. One, is be hit by an obstacle, and two, when your HP is 0. Try to get as many points as possible to renew your high score!
rows.description_html: This is an auto-scroller game where you control a heart to move up or down to avoid incoming obstacles while maintaining your HP. Other than obstacles, there will be damage zone in red and heal zone in green which decreases and increases the heart's HP. Make sure to manage your HP well to get the high score!

rows.name: Knightmares
rows.short_description: Face yourself in an epic tale of honor, courage and fusions. Knightmares will make you see fantasy from... A different point of view.
rows.description_html: Knightmares, the Ultimate Deckbuilding Adventure! Prepare to embark on an epic journey into a world filled with darkness, strategy, and the power of fusion. In this groundbreaking deckbuilding game, you'll have the opportunity to create the most formidable combinations imaginable, all while battling against the relentless nightmares that haunt the land. Knightmares offers a vast array of cards, each with its own unique abilities and strengths. As you progress through the game, you'll discover new cards to add to your ever-growing deck, allowing for endless possibilities and customization. The strategic choices you make during deck construction will determine your chances of success as you face off against the nightmares. One of the most exciting features of Knightmares is the fusion system. By combining specific cards in your deck, you can unlock even more powerful combinations and abilities. Experiment with different fusions to find the perfect synergy and unleash devastating attacks upon your enemies. But be warned: the nightmares you'll encounter are not to be taken lightly. Each nightmare possesses its own set of challenges and requires careful planning to overcome. Your deckbuilding skills will be put to the test as you strategize your way through intense battles and unlock new levels of power. Features: More than 100 cards to fuse. More than 80 fusions to discover. A wide variety of decks. Project made for the B.A. in Interactive Product Design degree of U-tad, University of Technology, Arts and Design.

rows.name: 沉舟：序章
rows.short_description: Play as a group of underground workers who fight in the dark, and stage a treacherous spy war story in Nanjing during World War II. How will you respond to identity crises, betrayals, and collapsed beliefs? Loyalty or betrayal, abandon others or be abandoned...
rows.description_html: During the time that the demo was released, I received a lot of complaints about the poor art style, and I have been struggling with this problem. But I wanted to give you a better experience and a more satisfying answer for myself. I finally decided to change to the art style that was more suitable for the story, which meant that almost all of the art assets we had used in the past had to be abandoned and redrawn, which was a challenge for the project in terms of money and time. But please rest assured, the remake is currently underway, and the pictures displayed on the store page are in the style of the old version, and after the first part is completed, I will update it to the store page in time to share with you! Stay tuned! ----------------------------------------------------- The story setting: In April 1943, the Japanese Eleventh Army gathered a large number of troops, intending to eliminate the main forces of the defenders of the 6th Theater of China, open up the middle and upper reaches of the Yangtze River, and seize the ship materials of the Chinese army. Around the war situation in the 6th Theater, the forces of all sides strategize, fight openly and secretly, and launch a fierce and bloody competition. Unexpectedly, Nanjing, this faraway city becomes the key to victory in this battle. And our story begins here... Identity crisis, Mystery Visitor, Loyalty and betrayal, abandonment or abandonment... Play as a group of underground workers fighting in the dark and make some important decisions. These choices may affect not only yourself, but also the lives of others. BUT please remember that the victory always needs price. Bright spots: In this game, players will complete the entire story through different chapters and different characters' perspectives. Even if a character dies or is imprisoned due to your choices, the game will not end. The world does not stop by anybody, even the protagonist of this story. There will be others who will continue to fight for the same goal. Main elements of the game: Plot direction, spy war, explore, forties of the last century, great heroine, love elements but low proportion, pixel style... Solemnly declare: This story is purely fictional, a story created in a historical context, not a complete historical fact. At present, the production progress is 10%, the story is born out of a novel written a few years ago, as a game script, the main plot has been completed, the branch plot needs to be improved, and now it is mainly after the art materials are in place, the progress will be accelerated.

rows.name: Manic Archers - Bullseye DEMO
rows.short_description: Manic Archers is the very first topdown Zelda-type versus game ever! It features simplistic and on-the-point gameplay with amazing game mechanics and lovely arcade style pixelart-details. It is playable with up to 4 players simultaneously on one screen in several variants.
rows.description_html: FREE BULLSEYE DEMO This free Manic Archers Demo will be released to complement the official release of Manic Archers (changed from Early Access) on March, 20th 2023. It features a limited game mode selection, limited map selection, limited powerups and will automatically quit after a few minutes (can be restarted though). Other than that it behaves equivalent to the full version you can purchase on Steam as well: ULTIMATE LOCAL MULTIPLAYER RETROGAMING ARCADE Manic Archers is a game that I personally would have liked to play back then, but it was not possible in the 16bit era because of technical limitations. A game that overflows with gems inspired by the arcade 2D high-times - 1000s of sprites and interlocking effects cumulating into a sensory overload of 16bit hype - while keeping that absolute, direct and perfectly controllable arcade grip. It took 2 years to perfect this game as a solo-developer. WHY YOU SHOULD GET THE FULL VERSION OF MANIC ARCHERS NOW Manic Archers is the first topdown Zelda-type versus game ever ! On-the-point gameplay and simple yet deep mechanics First rpg-style top-down versus fighting game with an arcade feel Lovely, hand-animated pixelart, inspired by the golden age of 2d arcade games Highly strategic matches vs. complete chaotic infernos Interactive levels Many common multiplayer modes AI support and coop-mode to practice without your friends Atmospheric music and hard hitting sound-effects Easy to play, hard to master Authentic classic RPG-scale sprites and environment expanded to HD resolution Official release planned for Switch, Playstation and Xbox separately till mid 2023. GAMEPLAY FIRST MANIC ARCHERS is an atmospheric and extremely addictive local and online multiplayer arcade game in pixelart-style. It features simplistic and on-the-point gameplay with amazing game mechanics and lovely pixelart-details. It is playable with up to 4 players simultaneously on one single screen in several well known multiplayer variants. THE MOST SIMPLE GAME OF ALL TIME One screen and 3 buttons is all you need to know - jump, shoot and dash/block . The depth of good gameplay is found in simplicity accompanied by great mechanics . THINK ZELDA AND DEATHMATCH With the intention to make a multiplayer match top-down game, MANIC ARCHERS owes to and actually should remind of the heritage of all top-down games like the Zelda and Final Fantasy series. Imagine the same love for details put into a competitive multiplayer arcade game for 4 players simultaneously. APPROVED MULTIPLAYER FUN In versus-mode players each control an archer, shooting the opposing archers until only one archer is left - besides Free-For-All versus, Manic Archers is featuring several other well known multiplayer modes . During the game a lot of combinable and game changing powerups and special arrows appear on the playing field, enabling players to turn the game around in an instant. AI TO KEEP YOU GAMING In case you need one more player to start a 2on2 teamplay match or if you are alone and want to train, Manic Archers got AI opponents to fill up the slots . RETRO CAUSE WE DO NOT NEED 3D FOR THAT The game takes place on a single screen with classic arcade wrap-around scrolling . The players make use of the top-down environment strategically such as water, higher grounds, obstacles and interactive map parts such as switches, explosives, burnable trees and more. Key Features Up to 4 players local and online Play arcade style locally AND online with up to 4 Players (via Remote Play Together). Versus Simple Free-For-All match, fast paced, deep gameplay mechanics (also available for Teamplay). King of the hill Keep control of the center of the map to gain points and secure the round (also available for Teamplay). Catch the fool with the chicken All players match against the one who got the chicken - the one who keeps the chicken longest wins the round. Conquer Dominate parts of the map to gain points, the one who dominated most flags the longest wins. Survival Coop How long can you and your friends survive against hordes of enemies? Manic Archers features a small coop-campaign that is also playable alone. Though DO NOT buy Manic Archers just for the coop-campaign - Manic Archers is primarily meant as a versus game. Deep gameplay mechanics The gameplay is set up for competitive and fun matches through deep but easy to learn game mechanics. AI Opponents Fill up the remaining slots with AI opponents with adjustable skill or create matches alone to train. Interactive and individual maps Interactive maps allow strategic advances which are easy to understand and use. The interactive elements available vary in each map SPECIAL MOVES Though you will probably find out these yourself, as they're pretty simple... SUPER DASH - Dash while on the way down of a jump, shortly before you hit the ground STOMP JUMP - Hit the JUMP button again while in mid air SHIELD - Hold down the dash button to shield yourself against attacks you are facing
rows.about_html: FREE BULLSEYE DEMO This free Manic Archers Demo will be released to complement the official release of Manic Archers (changed from Early Access) on March, 20th 2023. It features a limited game mode selection, limited map selection, limited powerups and will automatically quit after a few minutes (can be restarted though). Other than that it behaves equivalent to the full version you can purchase on Steam as well: ULTIMATE LOCAL MULTIPLAYER RETROGAMING ARCADE Manic Archers is a game that I personally would have liked to play back then, but it was not possible in the 16bit era because of technical limitations. A game that overflows with gems inspired by the arcade 2D high-times - 1000s of sprites and interlocking effects cumulating into a sensory overload of 16bit hype - while keeping that absolute, direct and perfectly controllable arcade grip. It took 2 years to perfect this game as a solo-developer. WHY YOU SHOULD GET THE FULL VERSION OF MANIC ARCHERS NOW Manic Archers is the first topdown Zelda-type versus game ever ! On-the-point gameplay and simple yet deep mechanics First rpg-style top-down versus fighting game with an arcade feel Lovely, hand-animated pixelart, inspired by the golden age of 2d arcade games Highly strategic matches vs. complete chaotic infernos Interactive levels Many common multiplayer modes AI support and coop-mode to practice without your friends Atmospheric music and hard hitting sound-effects Easy to play, hard to master Authentic classic RPG-scale sprites and environment expanded to HD resolution Official release planned for Switch, Playstation and Xbox separately till mid 2023. GAMEPLAY FIRST MANIC ARCHERS is an atmospheric and extremely addictive local and online multiplayer arcade game in pixelart-style. It features simplistic and on-the-point gameplay with amazing game mechanics and lovely pixelart-details. It is playable with up to 4 players simultaneously on one single screen in several well known multiplayer variants. THE MOST SIMPLE GAME OF ALL TIME One screen and 3 buttons is all you need to know - jump, shoot and dash/block . The depth of good gameplay is found in simplicity accompanied by great mechanics . THINK ZELDA AND DEATHMATCH With the intention to make a multiplayer match top-down game, MANIC ARCHERS owes to and actually should remind of the heritage of all top-down games like the Zelda and Final Fantasy series. Imagine the same love for details put into a competitive multiplayer arcade game for 4 players simultaneously. APPROVED MULTIPLAYER FUN In versus-mode players each control an archer, shooting the opposing archers until only one archer is left - besides Free-For-All versus, Manic Archers is featuring several other well known multiplayer modes . During the game a lot of combinable and game changing powerups and special arrows appear on the playing field, enabling players to turn the game around in an instant. AI TO KEEP YOU GAMING In case you need one more player to start a 2on2 teamplay match or if you are alone and want to train, Manic Archers got AI opponents to fill up the slots . RETRO CAUSE WE DO NOT NEED 3D FOR THAT The game takes place on a single screen with classic arcade wrap-around scrolling . The players make use of the top-down environment strategically such as water, higher grounds, obstacles and interactive map parts such as switches, explosives, burnable trees and more. Key Features Up to 4 players local and online Play arcade style locally AND online with up to 4 Players (via Remote Play Together). Versus Simple Free-For-All match, fast paced, deep gameplay mechanics (also available for Teamplay). King of the hill Keep control of the center of the map to gain points and secure the round (also available for Teamplay). Catch the fool with the chicken All players match against the one who got the chicken - the one who keeps the chicken longest wins the round. Conquer Dominate parts of the map to gain points, the one who dominated most flags the longest wins. Survival Coop How long can you and your friends survive against hordes of enemies? Manic Archers features a small coop-campaign that is also playable alone. Though DO NOT buy Manic Archers just for the coop-campaign - Manic Archers is primarily meant as a versus game. Deep gameplay mechanics The gameplay is set up for competitive and fun matches through deep but easy to learn game mechanics. AI Opponents Fill up the remaining slots with AI opponents with adjustable skill or create matches alone to train. Interactive and individual maps Interactive maps allow strategic advances which are easy to understand and use. The interactive elements available vary in each map SPECIAL MOVES Though you will probably find out these yourself, as they're pretty simple... SUPER DASH - Dash while on the way down of a jump, shortly before you hit the ground STOMP JUMP - Hit the JUMP button again while in mid air SHIELD - Hold down the dash button to shield yourself against attacks you are facing
rows.reviews_html: “@manicarchers is one of the best party games I've played in awhile! The powerups are unique, the artstyle is our nostalgia, and the gameplay is just hilarious/random. This is a great party game, and love it's Steam Co-Op compatible. @IGCollective #indiegames #pixelart” Indie Game Collective / TheShiny1 (during Early Access) “Manic Archers is an absolutely frenetic multiplayer twinstick brawler. Good range of maps and play modes for replayability. It looks and sounds great and is super intense if a little too fast for me (editor: reviewed during Early Access, before speed selection). Manic Archers is an awesome brawler! It gives me Street Fighter cross Little Fighter vibes and everything about it is exciting. [...]” CSH Picone (during Early Access)

rows.description_html: RoboHunters is a fast-paced top down action shooter. Destroy swarms of rogue machines, level up, and fight the Robo Sentry boss! As you level up, your characer will gain new abilities such as Napalm Boots, Gravity Vortex, and the Destroyer Disc! Leveling up the same ability more than once will increase its power. rows.name: EPOCHRYPHA
rows.short_description: Epochrypha calls you and your friends to hack and slash through time as you work together to unscramble it. Choose from a band of unique warriors as you play hot-potato with unstable relics, fight through fast paced combat, and restore order to the timeline.
rows.description_html: Epochrypha calls you and your friends to hack and slash through time as you work together to unscramble it. Choose from a band of unique warriors as you play hot-potato with unstable relics, fight through fast paced combat, and restore order to the timeline. Epocrypha features fast paced Hack and Slash combat combined with high stakes hot-potato. Players are responsible for transporting important items through hostile environments to restore time to its natural state. These relics are too unstable to be held for long, so players must strategically split the burden of carrying it as they navigate through enemies and obstacles to get to the boss. 1-2 Controllers are required for Local Multiplayer functionality.

rows.name: Hell Of A Racket
rows.short_description: Play as a fallen angel seeking redemption by punishing satanic worshipers who don't play the holiest of sports....tennis!
rows.description_html: Play as a fallen angel seeking redemption by punishing satanic worshipers who don't play the holiest of sports....tennis! Use your blessed racket to wreak havoc and show these satanic practices have no standing in God's land! Hell of a Racket is a unique twist on an old-school genre: First-Person Shooter? No. First-Person Swinger! Engage with enemies in a unique way by reflecting projectiles at them with your racket or simply smacking them! Jump, dash, run, or wall-climb your way around the arena and kill your enemies as you work your way to the final boss: Pickle Ball Satan! Core Mechanics and Features: - Reflect projectiles and launch enemies into each other with a swing of your tennis racket. - Charge your swing to send out faster projectiles. - Dynamic environment that utilizes your skillset - Be mindful of your timing, get it wrong, and suffer from inaccuracy. - Rack up kills against enemies in exciting ways to increase your multiplier and achieve a high score! - Utilize powerups to increase your strength or mobility! Includes a slew of accessibility features to make this game playable for a broad audience.

rows.name: Lobby Loitering
rows.short_description: Have you ever felt like, in a single step, the world around you changed, and you didn't notice until it was too late? Explore a collection of alternate realities in an attempt to get Marcel back to the reality he belongs in.
rows.description_html: A young man named Marcel goes to the mall with his older brother late one afternoon. While wandering around, he quickly finds himself in a bizarre version of the place he was just in. An odd entity in a dark hotel room fills him in on his situation, and it's not looking good -- Marcel has transported himself to an alternate reality, and he's got a long journey back home. In Lobby Loitering , it's up to you to help Marcel return to his world by exploring the chain of odd hotels he gets transferred to. Help eccentric strangers with their daily problems, discover secrets and lore about the worlds you traverse, and get into plenty of places you shouldn't be in.

rows.description_html: Barrett Foster is a riddle game in which you will have to solve puzzles to progress and solve a personal investigation: The dramatic disappearance of Emma, a close friend of Barrett. In a realistic universe and in first person view, you will have to explore emma’s home to discover all the secrets of her disappearance: Identify and analyze the objects present in the place but also activate mechanisms and secret codes to conduct the investigation! Beware of noises and your gestures because they can and will have consequences! .

rows.name: Akpala
rows.short_description: Don't you want to play a magical battle, chanting magic with your voice in VR space? A thrilling action game that offers three new experiences like never before has arrived! Multiplayer VR game for up to 4 players, featuring 2v2 team battles and a battle royale mode.
rows.description_html: Cast spells by chanting, and striking heroic poses for enhanced magic effects. Learn and perform different spells according to the needs of the battle. Movement, strategic thinking and resource management are crucial in every duel! Be sure that you use every tool in your arsenal. Engage in voice-based communication with 3D AI characters! During the tutorial stages, you will not only be able to learn everything about the game but also 'chit-chat' with the character that is guiding you with AI-generated conversations. Be sure that you don't get captivated by Lukia and actually finish the tutorial! Supports up to four players in multiplayer mode with 1v1 or 2v2 team battles and battle royales. Grab your partner or join solo with our matchmaking feature and get to play with other Wizards from all around the world. In multiplayer, strategically create and place blocks on the stage to build advantageous positions or snipe from above. These blocks can make a huge difference in different scenarios. Need to go higher? Build a ladder! Plain battleground? Create some cover! Take advantage of different perks and jumping-pads to move through the battlefield. Collect black orbs that yield random outcomes and mana orbs to keep casting your spells. Flex your wits, move your body, and chant magic loudly on the battlefield!

rows.name: Military Tanks
rows.short_description: Do you like tanks game? Are you ready to feel the full power of a tank games?
rows.description_html: War Tanks is one of the best free-to-play tank games available today! Dive into this modern tank warfare game, where you can engage in fast-paced, realistic tank battles with millions of players from all over the world. Command armored vehicles, from light tanks to heavy tanks, and experience the thrill of real-time PvP combat. Join players in tactical team-based battles across a variety of battle arenas, where every decision counts. With customizable tanks and extensive tank upgrades, you’ll be able to build your own war machine, unlocking modern tanks with unique abilities. War Tanks offers a blend of realistic tank simulation and an engaging arcade-style shooter, giving players an immersive and exciting experience. Whether you prefer fast tank tactics or strategic planning, this game has something for everyone. FEATURES: Variety tanks: Choose from light, medium, and heavy tanks, each offering different speeds and strengths for dynamic tank physics. Upgrades and customization: Modify your battle tanks with advanced weapons and equipment to gain the upper hand in combat. Global tournaments and leaderboards: Compete in global PvP to top the tank battle leaderboards and show off your skills. Destructible environments: Fight in real-time tank battles with destructible environments, adding a layer of strategy to your gameplay. Modern tank tactics: Lead your team through strategic maneuvers in team-based multiplayer battles, dominating the battlefield. ONLINE MULTIPLAYER AND MAP VARIETY: Take part in multiplayer tank battles across realistic maps and diverse terrains. Explore desert battlefields, mountain passes, winter plains, and more, with detailed environments designed for intense tank combat. PERFORMANCE AND OPTIMIZATION: The game is fully optimized for most modern gaming devices, ensuring high FPS and seamless gameplay. The tank destruction physics and stunning 3D graphics provide an unmatched immersive experience. Additionally, Military Tanks is regularly updated with new tanks, maps, and special events to keep the action fresh. Join the fight today, build your perfect tank, and dominate the battlefield in this modern tank shooter! Experience fast-paced tank action, unlock new technologies, and climb the ranks to become the ultimate tank commander.
