rows.name: Dubspace - Chapter 1
rows.short_description: Embark on a cyberpunk action-adventure in zero-gravity as brother Mailcom, on a mission to uncover dark conspiracies and determine the fate of Zion space station. Enjoy physics-based movement, environmental puzzles, emergent combat, all set to a mighty dub soundtrack.
rows.description_html: Dubspace revolves around physical interactions that rely on forces and impulses. Mailcom navigates the zero-gravity environment using his jetpack, as well as weapons, pushing and pulling objects and obstacles. He may move fast, but he must be careful. Mailcom will explore dark and foreboding space stations, each with its own unique environment and set of challenges. These stations are filled with obstacles, traps, and other hazards. Launching a heavy object into the path of an enemy, redirecting the projectile with a well-timed push or solving an environmental puzzle, players must make use of properties such as mass and bounciness to their advantage. Enemies come in many forms and shapes, spawned in a variety of ways to create endless combat situations. With a choice of weapons, grenades and items at their disposal, players can eliminate enemies in any way they see fit. NOTE: Controller is required for local multiplayer

rows.name: TOONCOP
rows.short_description: Battle rogue cartoons in Tooncop, a fast-paced FPS horde shooter! Survive 15 minutes, level up, and rack up cash while taking down waves of chaotic, mischievous toons.
rows.description_html: Play for Free. Survive the Cartoon Apocalypse. Tooncop is a fast-paced, first-person horde shooter prototype where you take on waves of chaotic, rogue cartoon enemies spilling into the real world. There’s no pay-to-win, no microtransactions, and no cosmetic grinding—just raw arcade-style gameplay focused on survival, score chasing, and moment-to-moment chaos. Each run gives you 15 minutes to survive increasingly aggressive enemy waves, collect XP, chain power-ups, and push for high scores. The game is designed to be simple, snappy, and satisfying—with a growing emphasis on muscle memory and flow state combat . Whether you're testing your reflexes or just blasting rogue Pomchis for fun, Tooncop is all about gameplay first. 💡 This is an early prototype created by a solo developer. Expect frequent updates, new maps, and evolving mechanics as the project grows. Play now for free on Steam and help shape what comes next.
rows.about_html: Play for Free. Survive the Cartoon Apocalypse. Tooncop is a fast-paced, first-person horde shooter prototype where you take on waves of chaotic, rogue cartoon enemies spilling into the real world. There’s no pay-to-win, no microtransactions, and no cosmetic grinding—just raw arcade-style gameplay focused on survival, score chasing, and moment-to-moment chaos. The game is designed to be simple, snappy, and satisfying—with a growing emphasis on muscle memory and flow state combat . rows.name: Twell
rows.short_description: This adventure is about you waking up in this world named Twell. The only thing you can do now is explore what this world has to offer. Explore 8 unique dungeons, discover many secrets and visit many locations.
rows.description_html: This adventure is about you as a player waking up in this world named Twell. You don't have any memory from before and the only thing you can do now is explore what this world has to offer. You will explore 8 unique dungeons, discover many secrets and visit multiple populated locations. This is an adventure game full of puzzles and with a simple action battle system. It is made in RPG Maker XP. This free game will to entertain you as a player with a variety of challenges and motivating you to explore what it offers, without too much talking and too much grinding. Why is it free? I get this question a lot. I truly hope that you will play the game and enjoy it. That's more important to me. - Every dungeon has unique puzzles, enemies, bosses and theme. - Use key items to solve puzzles and uncover new areas. - The look of the character depends on which equipment you wear. - Visit many locations with unique characters to interact with. - Choose which type of sword you want and which skills you want to learn. - Side quests are available to you at the start, solve them whenever you want. - Feel free to play the game in your own order. No hand-holding, but it's clear where to go next. - The game keeps your progress when it's game over, you just choose a location to start. - You can unlock extra challenges for Battle Mode. - You can also start the game on hard difficulty for some extra challenge.

rows.name: My Bath Tub Companion
rows.short_description: My Bath Tub Companion is a free experience, to induce a calm & peaceful (and mildly horny) feeling. You'll feel satisfied sitting back, feel yourself relax as you watch her relax. Relaxation is the key to a blissful bath tub experience. Calm music & a beautiful girl to look at.
rows.description_html: Relax & recover in this short free 3D environment where you take control of your favorite bath tub girl. My Bath Tub Companion is an experience, to induce a calm & peaceful (and mildly horny) feeling. You'll feel satisfied sitting back, feel yourself relax as you watch her relax. Watch her from a distance, become her rubber duck toy, or see through her eyes. Take control and watch her enjoy herself with props around the room. Gain answers to some of life's biggest questions, like: What is my girlfriend doing when she is in the bath tub for so long? How did we use up so much hot water on the utility bill? Why is there a charge for 50 rubber ducks on my credit card? People have places to be, stress to worry about, but not you. Sit back, relax, listen to the sounds, enjoy the soothing visuals. Relaxation is the key to a blissful bath tub experience, and we've got you covered. Calm music & a beautiful girl to look at. Features List Create ducks in the bath tub Possess the rubber duck & see what she does with it Possess her to see through her eyes Relaxing music About This is a fun project we decided to work on together to develop our skills. If you like what you see, consider joining our Discord to see our latest art & full game releases as they come.

rows.name: PolyFight
rows.short_description: Duel your adversary and prove your skills to be superior.
rows.description_html: JUST FIGHT There's a simple pleasure to jumping into a quick match against a friend or foe. With a minimalist art style and straight-forward controls you'll feel at home in the familiar game-play yet challenged by the adaptability of your opponents. PolyFight is a test of your reaction time, positional play, and accuracy with a mouse. Up to 8 players! NO ROUND THE SAME Each round greets you with a refreshed layout of moveable walls. Could there be a mountain of obstacles between you and your opponent? Could there be nothing? Will you get lucky and spawn behind cover? How quickly can you adapt to the changing environment? CUSTOMIZE Squares, purples, triangles, yellows. There's a shade and shape for every player to play their way.

rows.name: Wretched Depths
rows.short_description: Play as Sam and fish to your hearts content, sell fish you've caught, collect better gear, and use it to explore the depths of the mysterious lake, but be warned as no one knows what lies at the bottom. Wretched Depths is a PSX-style horror fishing game created by students at the University of Utah.
rows.description_html: Sam, an avid fishing fan, has traveled to the remote Twin Pines to cast into the mysterious Lake Imperium. However as she begins to adjust to her surroundings. Odd and unexplainable events begin to occur left and right in a town where the people seem strange, and the fish even stranger. Play as Sam and fish to your hearts content, sell the fish you've caught, collect better gear, and use it to explore deeper into the depths of the lake. But, be warned as no one knows what lies at the bottom of Lake Imperium. Do you really want to find out what lurks below...? Wretched Depths is a PSX-style horror-fishing game created by students in the University of Utah's Entertainment Arts & Engineering capstone class. Key Features: A dynamic fishing system A manageable, grid-based inventory An environment filled with unique fish Strange encounters wherever you look A system of equipment upgrades and collectables

Draw your cards to get powerful props and skills. Collect all kinds of materials and fight against the tide of monsters hunting.
rows.description_html: Free Announcement To celebrate the launch of Black Myth Wukong, we have decided to open it to Steam users for free. We would like to express our sincerest gratitude to the users who have purchased the game before, and thank you for your strong support. About the Game It's a murderous adventure filled with whimsy, grotesque ghosts and high-powered weapons. It may take a little bit of strategic thinking and a little bit of luck to complete this big adventure. If you encounter setbacks, try a few more times and rationally allocate the resources in your hands, and there may be a solution. When you no longer meet the current difficulty of the game, remember to properly increase the number of monsters before the game starts, and you will discover a new world. QQ：883417277 Cards：Killing monsters has a chance to get rich cards. Draw cards to randomly get weapons, props, passive skills, etc., so that you can be full of combat power at any time. AI teammates：There are many different types of AI teammates with special skills in the game. Find and use their powerful abilities to help you complete the final mission. Squad mode：You can enter the squad mode at any time in the game to edit your squad formation or configure the cards you own to deal with various dangerous situations. Explore：Explore the rooms randomly distributed in the map, you can get rich rewards, of course, there are also things waiting for you in the room. Guard：Thousands of monsters will launch a general attack at the end, and you need to use the collected materials to fight them. Weather：A changeable and random weather system, each weather that is randomly and dynamically switched will have an important impact on the game process.

rows.name: Waven
rows.short_description: Forge your own destiny! Choose your character, equip your best spells and sail from island to island in quest of fortune and glory. Level up your hero and your strategy in this free-to-play tactical multiplayer RPG with unique colorful graphics.
rows.description_html: In a flooded world where only a few islands have survived the rising waters, you play a seafaring adventurer searching for answers to this great upheaval. Long ago, gods and dragons ruled the world. Today, magic remains but what of the mythical beings of yesteryear? At the dawn of a new era, choose your hero, equip your best spells and set sail for an incredible odyssey. Sail from island to island in a vast world full of colorful creatures, gain power, refine your strategy and uncover the secrets of a world adrift. WAVEN is a new roleplaying game experience that is accessible, fun and immersive. It combines adventure and turn-based strategy, inspired by the best tactical RPGs, with deckbuilding mechanics and valuable items to collect. It can be played for free online on PC, Mac, smartphone and tablet. Alone or with friends, face off against multitudes of burlesque monsters of increasing difficulty. Master the elements, cast powerful spells, summon mythical companions and battle your enemies in close combat or from a distance to defeat them and win tons of loot! Gain experience to upgrade your hero and prove your valor by entering the doors of the 'Kolossium' to challenge other players and become a legend yourself! TACTICAL RPGs REVISITED WAVEN takes inspiration from the combat and progress systems of the best tactical RPGs while building on the strategic depth of turn-based combat and deck building. The result? An explosive and joyful combo! LIVELY TURN-BASED COMBAT Prepare your deck before each battle and use every ruse available to you to take home the victory! Play in your own style! Your options are practically unlimited when combining the many character archetypes, spells, equipment and companions available. ALL MODES ARE YOURS PvE, PvP : take advantage of each game mode to express yourself! Fight monsters to harvest resources and win equipment, and challenge other players to climb to the top of the rankings! PLAY AS A GREAT HERO Win battles, earn experience, spells and companions, customize your equipment and deck, and take your strategy to new heights. A CROSS-PLATFORM ADVENTURE Continue your adventure wherever you are! Enjoy WAVEN on PC, Mac, smartphone or tablet with the same account. AN ORIGINAL UNIVERSE WITH A UNIQUE GRAPHIC STYLE Explore a colorful heroic fantasy world inside a distinctive graphic universe, the 'Krosmoz', a persistent world that has existed for years in video games, animated series and much more.

rows.name: Puzzle Wizards
rows.short_description: Save Fairyland from the SoloGro™ Bros in this cozy co-op MMO from the creators of Puzzle Pirates! Adventure with friends to earn loot, furniture and clothes. Build and decorate your village and join a Wizards' Guild to help restore the world. Play cross-platform on Steam, iOS and Android.
rows.description_html: Puzzle Wizards is a cozy co-op cross-platform puzzle MMO from the creators of Puzzle Pirates. Master the harvest, crafting and battle puzzles to go on exciting adventures with friends in the wilds. Earn valuable resources and treasures to build and customize your village and home with furniture and decorations. Win funky familiars and craft fancy robes, hats, wands and more. Team up and work together with your fellow Wizards to build and decorate Guilds and restore the world! Seasonal event! Fairyland has been disrupted by the wicked SoloGro Bros, a cult-like group of technology entrepreneurs led by visionaries who believe that all anyone needs is SoloGro™, their terrible-tasting 'decentralized' energy drink. Help the poor Fairies throw off the yoke of these mono-crop fanatics by untangling their SoloGro vines, curing innocent crops infected by SoloGro™ fever, battling Bros who have had one-too-many Gro's and using their bean bombs to blow up their own infernal SoloGro Generators. Earn fabulous Fairy loot, furniture, clothes and familiars as rewards from grateful Fairies, build a Fairy house in your village and a Shop in your Guild to welcome them to the wizarding world. Puzzle Wizards is powered by three puzzles: Harvest, Mixing and Battle. Each have their purpose in the heartwood realms: Harvest: use your match-3 skills to gather resources from the world. Mixing: craft clothes, hats, wands, potions and other useful items with this line-drawing puzzle, whilst fending off the challenges of naughty ingredients. Battle: defeat the enemy spirits of the Wildwoods with the fast-paced battle puzzle, sliding to make four tile and larger matches and flipping attacks back to your foes. Voyage into the wildwoods on solo and co-operative adventures to gather resources, recipes and rare drops. Wilds are themed as Sun, Moon and Star with inner, middle and outer difficulties. Adventures are in quick, bite-sized chunks of around fifteen to thirty minutes of fun. Wildwood clearings can be chained together, increasing in difficulty as you progress. Difficulty is adapted to the number of players in your party -- it's possible to solo or play in a group of four or more -- and it's easy to drop in and drop out without stranding your team-mates. The arch-wizard has entrusted you with your own village. The place has fallen on hard times! You'll need to clear the tangled woods with magical sparks from adventures, rescue lost villagers, rebuild theirs shops and redecorate with crafted items and loot from the wilds. Build, expand and customize your own house and fill it with a menagerie of magical familiars. The village is your personal space and a solo progression path, developing your access to cosmetics and empowering items like wands, charms and potions. Puzzle Wizards has a full friend system and will add your Steam friends who are playing automatically. There is chat built-in to the game. You can also meet new friends adventuring and in Wizard Guilds. The game is friendly and co-operative: there's no place for negative behavior and bad language is filtered. Wizards band together to form Guilds to bravely explore the dangerous middle and outer wilds, facing down scary monsters and other spirits. You'll need to help out with construction work to build the Guild Towers that will grant your guild access to the most challenging wilds and lairs. Relax in the Wizards Tavern after adventures and challenge each other wand duels. In the future we'll be adding more social 'parlor' games and tournaments, too! Puzzle Wizards' content will expand with seasonal theme releases offering new adventures, loot and advanced gameplay challenges. Themes released so far: Halloween, Winterfest, Lunar Love Dragon and our current seasonal theme, Fairyland vs. the Sologro™ Bros.

rows.name: 100% Challenge
rows.short_description: Action arcade! CAPTURE enemies of your color and AVOID the rest to become the best in the world! Fast, addictive and 100% challenging!
rows.description_html: Control the Core to capture objects of the same color and avoid touching those of a different color. Doing this will create a progress bar that, when completed, allows you to advance to the next level. If you touch the wrong colors, you will create a color barrier that will make it difficult to capture the right objects. You can eliminate it by touching it with objects of the same color. Complete the progress bar 10 times to beat the 10 levels and earn the maximum reward. Doing it quickly and without taking damage will give you the highest score. In each attempt, you will earn progress points that you can use to acquire new skills and go further and further. Single player modes : Tutorial will teach you the basics of the game. Arcade allows you to earn points by completing matches, with which you can unlock upgrades. Horde is an endless arcade mode where you can challenge yourself to see how far you can go. Ultimate Challenge is the real challenge where you can configure your skill tree and post your score on the World Ranking until you become the best. Two player modes : Coop is the Arcade mode where two players collaborate to progress and earn skill points. Versus is a Horde mode for two players where the last one surviving wins. Try pushing your opponent or swapping the color barrier with them! The Ultimate Challenge is a special game mode where you can configure which skills you want to activate. The more difficult you make it, the higher score you can get. The result you get in Ultimate Challenge can be posted on the World Ranking and show the world who is the best at the 100% Challenge. We love creating games, we are learning, and this is our first game! For this reason, we really appreciate constructive feedback that can help us improve. Please expect to find in this game a small, simple, arcade-style, casual, challenging, and replayable scoring game. The goal is to beat your previous record, unlock skills to go further and further, and compete for the best score worldwide. As it is a simple game, we have prepared a Demo version where you can learn and enjoy most of the available mechanics. If you feel like seeing everything, showing off your skills in the world ranking, or simply supporting us to continue with future projects, you can contribute by purchasing the full version. We have tried to add some extra modes that we hope you will really enjoy. Other features and accessibility Easy or difficult? We have tried to make a game with mechanics that are easy to understand and remember so that everyone can enjoy it. But we have also made sure that difficulty is a determining factor in progressing. We hope that the skills you acquire will allow everyone to achieve their own balance where they feel comfortable and have fun participating in the challenge! Colorblind mode : We know that the game mechanics require distinguishable color palettes, so we have included a modified color mode for colorblind people that can be activated in the settings. Unfortunately, we cannot verify its effectiveness, but we hope that everyone who wants to can enjoy the game. If you want us to improve any aspect of accessibility, you can also leave us a comment. Languages : We want the game to be accessible to everyone, so this page and part of the game content have been translated using an automatic translator. If we have included any errors or used inappropriate language, please let us know so that we can try to correct it. Attribution The SFX are royalty-free, and some of them were downloaded from FreeSFX and Freesound. The game soundtrack, as well as the music that can be heard in the trailer, is the work of Kevin MacLeod. You can find more information about the titles included in the credits within the game. Trailer track title: Rhinoceros Some cuts and small modifications were made to this audio track to adjust it to the needs of the trailer. You can listen to the original work on the author's website. Thank you! Thank you very much for taking the time to read this message. Good luck in your games!

rows.name: Stellar Stroll
rows.short_description: Explore the cosmos with your furry friend and collect antimatter to open portals to different celestial worlds. Use gravity and momentum to navigate through planets, asteroids, and comets while avoiding black holes and space debris.
rows.description_html: Embark on a thrilling interstellar journey with your fuzzy co-pilot in this exhilarating space adventure game. As your furry friend is a rookie in space exploration, your guidance and expertise will be crucial to navigate the perils of the cosmos. Key Features Master your spaceship: Pilot your craft with precision, utilizing your knowledge of physics and expert piloting skills to traverse the vastness of space. Protect your companion: Keep a watchful eye on your furry sidekick as you maneuver through obstacles, shielding them from harm by blocking incoming debris with your ship or guiding them to safety. Laser gun at your disposal: Utilize your spaceship's laser gun to blast away incoming space debris, clearing a path for both you and your fuzzy friend. Docking capabilities: Invite your companion to dock their ship with yours, allowing them to experience the awe-inspiring wonders of the universe up close and personal. Unforgettable cosmic journey: Explore the breathtaking beauty of outer space with your furry companion by your side, creating lasting memories as you uncover the mysteries of the cosmos together. Prepare to embark on an unforgettable adventure, piloting your ship and safeguarding your endearing partner as you uncover the marvels of the universe!

rows.short_description: Experience the ultimate adrenaline-fueled rush with Final Gun - the fast-paced, multiplayer top-down shooter game where you engage in an epic arms race up to 4 players as you fight for the title of the ultimate gun master.
rows.description_html: Experience the ultimate adrenaline-fueled rush with Final Gun - the fast-paced, multiplayer top-down shooter game where your aim and reflexes will be put to the test! Engage in an epic arms race up to 4 players as you fight for the title of the ultimate gun master. Progress through an arsenal of lethal weapons by taking out your opponents and dominating the arena. Are you ready to take your place at the top of the leaderboard? With fast-paced gameplay and thrilling matches, Final Gun is the perfect game for all shooter fans.

rows.name: Rainbowcore Hypernova
rows.short_description: Unleash your inner fighter in Rainbowcore Hypernova, the explosively fun and free fighting game featuring vibrant characters, easy controls, and dynamic battles
rows.description_html: Welcome to Rainbowcore Hypernova, the explosively fun and absurd fighting game experience! Choose from seven vibrant and colorful characters, each representing a different color of the rainbow. Master the easy-to-learn controls with just three buttons and a variety of motion inputs. Engage in fast-paced and dynamic battles with a unique arsenal of moves for every character. Immerse yourself in a banger soundtrack that blends epic music with absurd mouth noises. Explosive visuals set against the backdrop of a surreal underground mushroom cave. Connect with other players seamlessly through peer-to-peer rollback netcode gameplay. Best of all, Rainbowcore Hypernova is completely free to play! Join the Rainbowcore Hypernova community and unleash your inner fighter. Show off your skills and become the ultimate Rainbowcore Hypernova champion! Epilepsy warning: This game contains many flashing images and animations

rows.name: Amulet of Iovar
rows.short_description: Amulet of Iovar is an oldschool roguelike inspired by Nethack. Delve deep into the Dungeon of Iovar, steal the amulet of the divine and ascend to godhood!
rows.description_html: Description For eons, the ancient wizard Iovar has sought godhood. In his never-ending quest, he's built a huge dungeon full of critters big and small. Now, hes finally crafted an amulet worthy of gods. You, along with many others, have heard of Iovars mission. Time has come, as you and a colorful cast of critters strike to steal godhood from under Iovars nose. Delve deep into the Dungeon of Iovar, and prove godhood is rightfully yours! Features Fully randomly generated dungeon 8 Classes to play 90+ Monsters to fight, including 6 powerful bosses 30+ Weapons to wield 60+ Armor pieces to wear 200+ Items to use Cast spells by mixing and matching different spell elements and types Manage your hunger and weight Use potions, scrolls, wands and other items Enchant gear for additional strength Unlock information about items and critters with Tomes of knowledge

rows.name: Rise of Eros
rows.short_description: Rise of Eros is the world's first AAA adult mobile game, produced in a realistic 3D style with full 360-degree angles that reveal characters' delicate facial features and every inch of their bodies. Start your very own adventure replete with love and sex, stunning goddesses, and dazzling combat.
rows.description_html: At the dawn of the world, two originary deities were created from humanity's most primal desires: the god Eros and the goddess Aphrodite. With the development of civilization, the flourishing of different desires and drives led to the birth of more and more deities, and eventually erupted in a Great War of the Gods. Eros emerged victorious, yet his betrayal at the hands of Aphrodite left him sealed away inside an ancient Relic, and the world abandoned to an age of godlessness. Several millennia later, various civilizations have flowered on the continent of Dienne, tenaciously clinging on in the absence of protection by the deities. While searching for a way to bring her boyfriend back to life, Inase, a scholar of ancient societies, accidentally breaks the seal and awakens Eros. To reclaim his powers and piece together his fragmented memories, he sets out on a journey with his newfound concubines… [AAA: The Next Generation in Adult Gaming] Rise of Eros is the world's first AAA-tier adult game. Each goddess's lifelike expressions and skin textures are rendered with the use of high-spec character modeling and a bespoke shader. Each charming goddess is waiting for you to conquer her, whether in uniform, corsets, or fancy dress. Stir up their passions and experience otherwordly pleasures. [Easy to Pick Up: Thrillingly Smooth Combat] Whether adventuring through the story or hacking away in Boss battles, the combat is designed to be intuitive and responsive. Unleash earth-shaking special moves and dominate the battlefield. [Do It Your Way: Build Your Party] You'll get to know goddesses with unique powers throughout your adventures. Face each new challenge by working out your strongest party and gear combos and creating your own combat style. Claim exclusive Relics to boost the power of your Ultimate skills and turn the tables on your enemies. [360-Degree Angles: Explore Your Goddesses' Favorite Positions] Cultivate Intimacy with your goddesses and you'll find them in steamy scenes where you can freely adjust the pacing and angles, come to understand what turns them on, and uncover their favorite positions to discover joys that transcend the mortal realm. *Please note that game accounts registered on different platforms are not interchangeable or transferable.
rows.about_html: At the dawn of the world, two originary deities were created from humanity's most primal desires: the god Eros and the goddess Aphrodite. With the development of civilization, the flourishing of different desires and drives led to the birth of more and more deities, and eventually erupted in a Great War of the Gods. Eros emerged victorious, yet his betrayal at the hands of Aphrodite left him sealed away inside an ancient Relic, and the world abandoned to an age of godlessness. Several millennia later, various civilizations have flowered on the continent of Dienne, tenaciously clinging on in the absence of protection by the deities. While searching for a way to bring her boyfriend back to life, Inase, a scholar of ancient societies, accidentally breaks the seal and awakens Eros. To reclaim his powers and piece together his fragmented memories, he sets out on a journey with his newfound concubines… [AAA: The Next Generation in Adult Gaming] Rise of Eros is the world's first AAA-tier adult game. Each goddess's lifelike expressions and skin textures are rendered with the use of high-spec character modeling and a bespoke shader. Each charming goddess is waiting for you to conquer her, whether in uniform, corsets, or fancy dress. Stir up their passions and experience otherwordly pleasures. rows.name: DFHack - Dwarf Fortress Modding Engine
rows.short_description: Extensions for Dwarf Fortress, including bugfixes, interface improvements, automation agents, design blueprints, modding building blocks, and other tools.
rows.description_html: DFHack is an add-on for Dwarf Fortress (search for it here on Steam!) that enables mods and tools to significantly extend the game. The default DFHack distribution contains a wide variety of these tools, including bugfixes, interface improvements, automation agents, design blueprints, modding building blocks, and more. Third-party tools (e.g. mods downloaded from Dwarf Fortress Steam Workshop or the forums) can also seamlessly integrate with the DFHack framework and extend the game far beyond what can be done by just modding the raws. DFHack’s mission is to provide tools and interfaces for players and modders to: expand the bounds of what is possible in Dwarf Fortress reduce the impact of game bugs give the player more agency and control over the game provide alternatives to toilsome or frustrating aspects of gameplay make the game more fun Our online Quickstart Guide (see the 'View the website' link in the sidebar) will help you get up to speed with how to use DFHack. It's also available in-game via the quickstart-guide command. The best way to make feature requests or report problems is to open an Issue on our GitHub issue tracker (see the 'Stats' link in the sidebar). When reporting problems, links to your zipped, uploaded savegame and mods are immensely helpful, and issues with attached savegames and mods get fixed faster. We need a zip of your mods because we can't load your savegame without them. DFHack installs directly into your Dwarf Fortress directory, so be sure to install it to the same Steam library and drive as Dwarf Fortress. If you are on Linux, both games must also have the same 'Compatibility' setting (e.g. 'Steam Linux Runtime 1.0 (scout)'). It is not a problem if you already have DFHack manually installed and are switching to Steam. You can subscribe to the Steam version and it will absorb the installed files. Your saved DFHack configuration in the dfhack-config directory is safe. No additional steps are necessary.

rows.name: Scholar's Mate - First Move
rows.short_description: Scholar's Mate First Move is a first-person horror experience in a psychiatric hospital. Use your wits to escape from this sinister place.
rows.description_html: In Scholar's Mate First Move you will play as Judith, a young college student who was going back home after finishing the semester. After waking up disoriented in an abandoned hospital room, she will try to escape and get back home safe. Exploration and ingenuity will be your only chance to get out of this strange and dark place alive. Will you succeed? A first-person horror experience in the purest 'EscapeRoom' style. Investigate, think and solve. Original voices and music.

rows.name: CETERIS Paribus
rows.short_description: CETERIS Paribus is an educational point&click game aimed at providing basic economics literacy to players 13 and up. Kai is in need of last-minute help with their Economics homework and Pavlos teaches them concepts, terms and events through hidden-object and drag-and-drop mini-games.
rows.description_html: Kai is in big trouble! Economics homework is due tomorrow and it’s too late to study. Luckily, Professor Pavlos lives right next door! Pavlos will not only help Kai complete their homework on time, but also explain economics practically, through the different ways it affects our lives. Follow Kai across Pavlos’ house, discovering pieces of the old professor’s life in every room. Each piece teaches Kai something new about economics, in a simple and contextual way. Complete all rooms and finish Kai’s homework and you too will know the basics of economics! In Ceteris Paribus you will: Navigate a charming environment built in Unreal Engine; Experience a combination of classic point-and-click adventure and hidden object games; Discover open and secret rooms in Pavlos’ house, filled with memories and references to real historical events; Learn more about economics in a fun way, maybe understanding terms such as “inflation” and “cryptocurrency” for the first time; Decide for yourself if Pavlos is really a vampire or not. Kai is anxiously awaiting your help!

rows.name: On The Brink
rows.short_description: Use Capri's gravity manipulation to slingshot across the universe as she embarks on a mission to liberate a forgotten dimension from the clutches of an all-powerful being. Solve puzzles, uncover mysteries, and shatter space-time itself in this snappy sci-fi action platformer.
rows.description_html: Use Capri's gravity manipulation to slingshot across the universe as she embarks on a mission to liberate a forgotten dimension from the clutches of an all-powerful being. Solve puzzles, uncover mysteries, and shatter space-time itself in this snappy sci-fi action platformer. What lies in the dimensions above our own? An original sci-fi narrative set in the far reaches of the universe following Capri's fight to right cosmic wrongs and save PROJECT: Almagest . High-speed movement is interwoven with unique puzzle mechanics sure to engage hypothalamuses and prefrontal cortexes alike. Galaxy distribution across the universe is dynamic and infinite. Stay conscious, or be lost in the infinite aether. On The Brink has subtitles available alongside controller support for both Windows and Mac OSX. Recommended for third-dimensional beings. Playable in the second dimension, with decreased performance.

rows.name: IndependANT
rows.short_description: Explore the vast Living Room to find food for your struggling ant colony in this cute and casual collectathon!
rows.description_html: THE COLONY HAS FALLEN! I mean, literally , the ant farm you call home has fallen off the table and smashed to pieces on the Living Room floor. What's worse: the Queen has gone missing in the chaos! Now leaderless and homeless, the ants of the farm are on the brink of starvation. As a brave worker ant, it's up to you to scour the unknown world of the Living Room for food. You'll explore the towering furniture, interact with the local ant population, and lay claim to all manner of delicious bug snacks! Do you have what it takes to become truly IndependANT? FEATURES: A small open world rich with detail! 4 delicious foods to find! 18 weird lil' ants to talk to! 20-30 minutes of gameplay, probably! WHY DID WE MAKE THIS? IndependANT is part of Young Horses: Free Range, where we collect our smaller side projects and release them for free! This game is a tech demo we made to help us get used to the Unreal 5 engine. It turned out well enough that we thought fans might enjoy playing it (but not so well that you might enjoy paying for it...) So give it a try! It's free, so there's only so disappointed you can be!

rows.name: Snowscapes
rows.short_description: A cozy nature simulation meets card-based strategy.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Snowscapes, a cozy nature simulation game. Control the simulation, play cards to influence the world and have fun in this little frozen ecosystem. Watch it all happening from above or step into any animal to see it all up close. Nature simulation meets card game! It is up to you, if you will start a chaos or try to maintain a balance. You get a new set of cards every now and then to keep your options open - you can spawn multiple animals into your ecosystem or you can place them one by one. You can help them have babies and you can make them live longer. Animals can be spawned for free, special effects cost tokens which you earn by maintaining balance, raising babies and having animals live long enough to die from old age. Snowscapes features: Different cards to influence the simulation - spawning animals, causing effects, shaping the environment Nature simulation - animals eat, reproduce, grow and die Possibility to watch the simulation from multiple cameras - including right in the action Immersive experience Play cards to influence the world Take your time and enjoy this scenery as you balance your perfect ecosystem! Keep track of your animals

rows.description_html: Slay thousands of monsters and survive as the beautiful Shrine Maiden Kagura-chan. Kagura Survivors is a fantasy casual rouge-lite game where you must choose how to level up Kagura into a mighty Shrine Maiden. Battle thousands of monsters and survive if you can! Something is wrong in the Kaguraverse. An anomaly is creating tears in space-time and causing parallel worlds to converge! It falls upon Kagura-chan, the vessel of the Goddess's will, to get to the bottom of this crisis and return order to the various universes. If only it were that simple... As she steps through a rift to the Dimensional Crossroads, she finds that her powers are gone! With every portal she enters, she is reset to Level 1, no stronger than a fledgling adventurer. And to make matters worse, the forces of darkness are always close behind... Take up the sword and play as Kagura-chan, battling hordes of evil creatures across the rift in dimensions to solve the anomaly and set things right again.

rows.name: Wild Omission
rows.short_description: Wild Omission is an open world sandbox survival game with severe weather set in an infinite procedurally generated world. Play alone or with friends.
rows.description_html: Wild Omission is an open world multiplayer sandbox survival game with severe weather set in an infinite procedurally generated world . Your goal survive, craft tools, and build bases that hold up against the most extreme weather. You can go at it alone, or with friends. Whether it's your friends, a wild animal, or a tornado , pretty much anything and everything can kill you if you aren't careful. You must start off with nothing, and pull together to overcome all odds. Use the resources you have gathered to craft tools, weapons, and shelter. Build the house of your dreams, The only limit is your imagination, and what you can craft. Weather is usually mild, but it can become deadly. Fortify your base and repair it when bad weather strikes. Bring your friends along with you to help (or to grief your base). Create a community!

rows.name: OSLO:2084
rows.short_description: In OSLO:2084, hack your way through a dystopian world where AI rules supreme and democracy is a distant memory. As Embla, fight for freedom and change the course of history in this thrilling cyberpunk adventure.
rows.description_html: DYSTOPIAN FUTURE In OSLO:2084, you take on the role of Embla, a brilliant and ambitious hobby hacker with a burning desire to challenge the status quo. The world around you is unrecognizable, a wasteland of desperation and oppression ruled by a merciless regime. The AI that once promised to bring order and prosperity has turned rogue, entrenching the powerful and suppressing the masses. As you explore the floating highs and lowest depths of Oslo's underbelly, you'll encounter a cast of eccentric characters and uncover dark secrets that will challenge your every belief. Can you rise up against the forces of corruption and rewrite the rules of the game? The future fate of humanity rests in your hands! KNOWLEDGE IS POWER Oslo:2084 is an educational and social impact game that promotes key values, including democratic data culture, engagement in democratic governance, and empowering players as agents for change. With immersive gameplay, Oslo:2084 aims to raise awareness about hate crimes and discrimination, while building empathy and understanding of the world around us. While the game itself is effective in engaging students, it's worth noting that the accompanying resource booklet - created in partnership with the European Wergeland Center and Utøya AS - can significantly enhance learning outcomes when used in conjunction with the game during teaching or other learning activities. Download these resources by clicking 'view the manual' on the right panel.

rows.short_description: Toing's Pops is a singleplayer survival horror game, you must run and hide from Toing while uncovering the information needed for your escape. Amidst all the chaos, just remember why you came...
rows.description_html: Toing's Pops is the most popular candy store in all of Baltimore. People of all ages flock to it for entertainment and food. However, something feels off. There have been reports of increased levels of radiation around the area in the past, and the characters seem a bit too... Real. You decide to investigate on your own after hours, however Toing has other plans. Toing is the main mascot of the store, succeeding the previous mascot. Being the head guy, he doesn't like being second place. He will become overly aggressive if that happens, however staff are there to calm him down. Staff are not there after hours, there is nobody to calm him down. You anger him, and he is coming for you. Find a way to escape! Going out the front door would trip the alarm, so that's out of the question. Dealing with the police is the last thing you want to do. Is there a back door you could escape through? The novelty glasses you won seem to show a bit more than meets the eye, could this be of any help?

rows.name: Hero's Land
rows.short_description: HERO'S LAND is an MMO PVPVE game where survival isn't just a goal—it's a necessity. Monsters and enemies are out to get you, making every encounter a potential ambush. Fight for glory, and welcome to a world where strategy and courage are your greatest assets.
rows.description_html: Free To Play About the Game Game Info Embark on a journey across a continent riddled with danger, where formidable monsters and fierce enemies lurk around every corner. Here, survival is a brutal game of might and cunning, with Heroes fighting to upgrade their weapons and gear and enhance their chances in the relentless fight for existence. Your accomplishments are proudly displayed on the leaderboards for all to see, but remember to be on guard when others seek to usurp your rank. But the question remains: How will you carve your path to survival? Endless resources and mobs await outside the safety zone. Equip your finest build from stash and inventory, selling loot to level up fast. Hack 'n' Slash your way out! Survive and thrive with the hero of your choice. Take on mobs and bosses to loot epic weapons and gear. Always be prepared for PvP situations that may break out at any time. Heroes will face substantial losses of levels upon death, with the peril of losing their gear and weapons on treacherous maps. Yet, the riskiest zones yield the most incredible rewards—the longer you last, the greater your potential gains. Stake it all to secure the best gear unlock heroes, pets, and talents, making you even more formidable in your next fight! Dive into the action with our game's rich lineup of PVP events, from battle royales to guild wars. Tailor your inventory on the fly with various weapons and gear to suit every twist and turn of battles. Leverage unique buildings like Boost Pads, Sentries, Traps, and more to outmaneuver opponents. Create your combination of survival and destruction! Team up in dungeon raids and other engaging game modes, or ally with friends to build a guild and reign supreme. Plus, bring up to three pets, each with unique skills, to bolster your strength and strategy on every adventure.

rows.name: Lennod Jump Game
rows.short_description: A new and innovative retro jump game with simple gameplay to soothe the heart.
rows.description_html: The land of Dnal is in trouble! A powerful force of unknown origin has swept over the land and infested the world with the Chaos Mushrooms. Only the man called Lennod can save the land, at the request of the Queen. The Quest Forget branching paths and side-quests. In this simple jump game, you have one goal: Reach the end and save the day. At all costs. Gameplay Control Lennod in his quest to save the land in this story-driven traditional 2d platformer. In order to achieve victory, you and Lennod must: Manuever skillfully and quickly to avoid obstacles Formulate strategies to navigate hostile terrain Use your wits to defeat ferocious creatures Collect food to sustain our hero on his quest Collect score and complete challenges to unlock venerated achievements Participate in athletic games Solve a puzzle Take to the stars and chase your enemies down in bullet combat Jump! Jump and Run! Characters Lennod Lennod is one of the characters in all of human history. His eyepatch is infamous for its ability to cover his eye, and his signature walking technique is quite an enigmatic machination. You will discover in this journey that he is also quite skilled at jumping. Queen of Dnal The Queen of the land of Dnal. She is the one who requested to Lennod that he save the land with his jumping. Chaos Mushroom's Leader (?) The source of the chaotic Chaos Mushrooms... Just who is this guy!? And what are... his goals?

rows.name: Your Average Bear
rows.short_description: Become the sneakiest bear in The Average National Park — Accept delivery orders from your fellow animals, collect the food with the help of various tools, and hand them off without getting caught!
rows.description_html: Your Average Bear is a stealth comedy about a black bear trying to sneakily part campers from their food. This game was developed as part of the University of Utah's EAE Program 2022-2023 Capstone Course, in which students form small studios and develop a game from start to finish, ideation phase to full release, in only two semesters. After moving into the scenic woods of Your Average Campground, this black bear needs to prove himself to his new neighbors, and what better way to do so than to bring them the human foods their hearts desire? With the use of an animal-exclusive food-delivery app, take orders from your fellow animals, use your tools to evade campers and rangers, steal the delectable treats, and bring them back to your creature customers, all without getting caught! Are you up to the challenge? Features: A comedic take on the stealth genre Unique bear- and nature-themed abilities Unique bear- and nature-themed food delivery app (Just 1) A fun, low-poly, simplified art style Him Title/header font used: “Vanilla Extract” by Shara Weber () from FontSpace (), licensed under Creative Commons by Attribution.

rows.name: Cosmic Survivor
rows.short_description: A Brutal, Roguelite Arcade Blaster. Similar in style and gameplay to arcade classics like Asteroids and Defender.
rows.description_html: Cosmic Survivor is an intense, survival shoot 'em up with roguelite elements, where your skill is on trial and the horde is always waiting. Features a short game loop with rising intensity. Learn the best survival strategy or upgrade your ship over time to climb the Global Leaderboard. Originally developed for mobile VR, this free version is the full game for Windows. If you'd like to support the developer you can purchase a VR version on AppLabs for the MetaQuest. Like living dangerously? Jump straight to maniac levels of intensity by pressing '6' on the keyboard at six seconds on the clock.

rows.name: Project Apidom
rows.short_description: Free-to-play multiplayer extraction RPG set in the apocalyptic future world of Pangea. Fight against enemies, both other players and monsters, for resources. Craft items and earn skill points to build an unstoppable Apidom that matches your playstyle.
rows.description_html: From a team of passionate developers and gamers comes a multiplayer extraction RPG, combining elements of MOBA-like combat and RPG-like character builds. Leave the comfort of the Breach, the space between worlds, and come back to Pangea to fight back against ancient monsters and recover the remaining resources of the planet for your own survival. Once a thriving world of competing scientific factions, Pangea was invaded by the ancient monsters, forcing those factions to flee into the Breach and create Apidoms - mechanical robots, vessels of their consciousness - to return in their stead. They are fast and agile, yet lack the strength to fight back. They must be upgraded. With limited resources, Tech and Brute factions are forced to come back to the surface of Pangea. There they scavenge for materials and items, crafting and upgrading their Apidoms to fight against the monsters, and each other. On the surface, Apidoms are faced with constant and dreadful battles, fighting against both the monsters and other Apidoms. The survival of the fittest is the only way to live in a destroyed world, with newly discovered or crafted items allowing the Apidom to survive until the next encounter. Discover and craft a variety of weapon and armor sets to unlock endless possibilities for building your Apidom. Combine that with skill points gained from battle experience, and each Apidom becomes a unique tank, support, magician…whatever your heart desires, or the situation requires. Receive Shards and other loot from the battles to craft better items or upgrade the ones you have. Dismantle items you don't want and spend skill points to tailor your Apidom to your needs. There are no predetermined roles but the ones you make yourself!

rows.name: Kreeps
rows.short_description: Kreeps is a tower defense game where you choose how your towers and the enemies scale as the game progresses. Use any combination of 7 different types of towers and weapons to defend against the growing Kreep horde.
rows.description_html: Kreeps is a tower defense game where you choose how your towers and the enemies scale as the game progresses. Choose your path At the end of each wave the player makes 3 choices: 1. Select a location Location choices give all Kreeps a permanent buff and also extend the path. These buffs stack as the game progresses. 2. Select a Kreep Kreep choices are added to each following wave. 3. Select a shop card The shop provides the choice of a weapon to purchase, 3 random free upgrades, or the choice of extra gold. Only 1 can be selected each wave. Choose from 7 different types of towers and weapons each with their own unique upgrades for a variety of strategies to choose from. There are 6 different types of Kreeps each with their own weakness. Choose carefully.

rows.name: Mindbug Online
rows.short_description: Mindbug redefines the card-battler genre, focusing on pure strategy and fast-paced excitement from the very first turn. Outsmart opponents with the groundbreaking Mindbug mechanic and rise through the new roguelike mode, discovering fresh powers, creatures, and combos each run.
rows.description_html: New Game Mode: Mindbug Ascension Ascension: Roguelike Progression Mode Introducing Ascension, a new roguelike mode where your decisions and deck choices carry over as you progress. Build a unique path, discover powerful creatures, and challenge increasingly difficult encounters in a thrilling progression experience. With randomized encounters, evolving strategies, and permanent rewards, Ascension adds a fresh layer of depth to Mindbug for both new and veteran players. About the Game Unique Card Battler Mindbug takes the excitement of strategy card games and distills it into the most streamlined, skill-based dueling experience in the multiverse. Quick to pick up, endlessly strategic, and fair to all players. There’s no endless deck-construction, no random booster packs, and no complicated rules to memorize. Every decision matters, and every match feels fresh and unpredictable. Experience Meets Innovation Co-designed by Richard Garfield (Creator of Magic: The Gathering), Mindbug combines decades of TCG expertise with a groundbreaking, original game mechanic. The Mindbugs allow you to steal your opponent’s creature play twice per game — creating tense, mind-bending duels that reward strategy, timing, and skill. Crazy Card Abilities Mindbug is simple to learn but deep to master. Every card is powerful in the right situation, and every play can turn the game on its head. You’ll find yourself making meaningful choices from turn to turn, balancing risk, bluffing, and clever combos. The game is short, but each decision is super impactful. Fast and Intense Matches Play a complete game in under 5 minutes. Mindbug delivers rapid-fire duels that are easy to teach, fast to set up, and endlessly replayable. Perfect for a quick match with friends, a competitive showdown, or just a few minutes of strategic fun. Infinite Strategies Even though Mindbug is extremely easy to learn, the game will keep surprising you with new and exciting challenges and combos. The unique Mindbug mechanic allows you to control your opponents’ creatures and leads to unique decision-making that requires even veteran card game players to adjust their traditional playstyle. What are you waiting for earthling? Show your incredible skill and turn your opponents’ strongest creatures into your own advantage! Play Mindbug Online Now!

rows.name: Era of Celestials
rows.short_description: The next-generation sound and graphics beyond the host, take you personally feel the magnificent turmoil of the magic continent!Wings feathering star, attributes soar to activate a new appearance; more 'war god hall' blood competition, PK king race strong, free combat, fame and fortune!
rows.description_html: The enemy army have marched all the way to the gate of the last bastion. The Celestials looked to their greatest champions. Answer the call and embark on the Path of Vanquisher! Fight for the glory! [Ultimate Game Experience] Smooth control, smart blow feedback, realistic sounds, and stunning visuals with splendid special animation effects and detailed 3D graphics integrated to bring an ultimate game experience. [Unique Elysian Transformation System] With the unique Elysian Transformation system, courageous heroes can transform into invincible Elysians and mow down murderous enemies. Elysians with different capabilities are waiting to be unsealed in your journey, harness the power of Elysians and use them wisely to face different dilemmas! [Sprite Companions] In Era of Celestials, sprites are your most loyal protectors. In the heat of battle, they will always be right by your side! Different sprites provide different forms of assistance, and you may switch between them at will, opening up a wealth of strategies to help you overcome any situation. [Spectacular Costumes] Era of Celestials contains a bewildering array of spectacular costumes, complete with awesome glow effects. So now there's no excuse not to look your best, even on the battlefield. [Real-Time PvP Battles] From the 1v1 real-time combat of Showdown to the multiplayer brawls of the Sanguine Contest and Lava Expedition, Era of Celestials is filled with action-packed combat and generous spoils for the victors. [Boss Hunts] The Path of the Vanquisher is paved with amazing equipment, and hunting bosses is the main way of getting equipment and crafting materials in Era of Celestials. Kill world bosses, instance bosses, the evil dragons that show up for limited amounts of time, or any of the many other bosses to earn handsome rewards and send your BR soaring.

rows.name: Stellarace (Demo)
rows.short_description: Welcome to Stellarace, the ultimate space roller skating game where players can choose from four different avatars to race through the galaxy, competing against each other to be the fastest skater in the universe!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Stellarace, the ultimate space roller skating game where players can choose from four different avatars to race through the galaxy, competing against each other to be the fastest skater in the universe! In Stellarace, you'll race through a variety of challenging space tracks filled with obstacles, jumps, and twists and turns. You'll need to be quick on your feet and have lightning-fast reflexes to dodge obstacles and make sharp turns, all while trying to outrun your opponents. you'll need to go as fast as possible to outpace your opponents and win the race. To help you achieve this, the game features a boost system that allows you to speed up and gain an advantage over your opponents. However, use it wisely, as overuse of the boost can lead to your skater overheating and slowing down. The game also features power-ups and bonuses that can give you a competitive edge. You can collect speed boosts and secure your place as the champion. With its high-speed gameplay and challenging tracks, Stellarace is the perfect game for anyone who loves the thrill of racing and outpacing their enemies. So, put on your skates and get ready to race through the stars in Stellarace!

rows.name: Erin's Naughty Friday Prologue
rows.short_description: Erin's Naughty Friday is an ENF (embarrassed nude female) game where Erin suddenly finds herself stuck naked! This is fun, lighthearted adult game where all activities are consensual and there is no serious violence. The prologue contains no sexual situations.
rows.description_html: Never Before Has So Much Been At Stake! Erin has a very important party to attend tonight... but a misunderstanding leads to her being fresh out of the shower with nothing at all to wear ! Storyline Erin has always been known as the quintessential good girl - the one who always follows the rules, gets top-notch grades, and never misses an opportunity for some good clean fun. But one fateful day, her world is turned upside down when she steps out of the shower and realizes that all her belongings have vanished into thin air. That's right, everything - including her clothes! Your aspiration : guide Erin though an epic comedic adventure to make it to Monica Ortega's massive mid-year house party! Your motivation : Erin's a nice, friendly person and she would really appreciate your assistance! Your inspiration : She's naked... so... yeah! Gameplay Get ready for a wild ride with Erin's Naughty Friday, a single-player adventure where YOU call the shots! Meet the effervescent Erin Bells, an upbeat and vivacious protagonist who's ready to take on anything - with your guidance, of course. As you journey through this entirely preposterous story, the indomitable Erin will frequently ponder three different options. Each time, you as her conscience must help her make the 'right' decision. Every choice you make will have consequences for Erin as you guide her through a series of wacky incidents and interactions. Will you lead her down a path of prudishness or help her to embrace her mischievous side? The power is in your hands as you channel your inner conscience to guide Erin towards her ultimate goal of attending the biggest party of the year. But don't stress out! Easygoing Erin is a free-spirited body-positive young woman with high self-confidence and a knack for finding the fun in any situation. So what are you waiting for? Join Erin on her crazy adventure and make sure she has the time of her life! What's in the prologue? ~20 minutes of content in a casual and lighthearted story with loads of bare-bottomed Erin and it's totally free! If you decide to give the game a try, please let me know what you think in the discussion forums. Thanks !
rows.about_html: Never Before Has So Much Been At Stake! Erin has a very important party to attend tonight... but a misunderstanding leads to her being fresh out of the shower with nothing at all to wear ! Storyline Erin has always been known as the quintessential good girl - the one who always follows the rules, gets top-notch grades, and never misses an opportunity for some good clean fun. But one fateful day, her world is turned upside down when she steps out of the shower and realizes that all her belongings have vanished into thin air. That's right, everything - including her clothes! Your aspiration : guide Erin though an epic comedic adventure to make it to Monica Ortega's massive mid-year house party! Your motivation : Erin's a nice, friendly person and she would really appreciate your assistance! Your inspiration : She's naked... so... yeah! Gameplay Get ready for a wild ride with Erin's Naughty Friday, a single-player adventure where YOU call the shots! Meet the effervescent Erin Bells, an upbeat and vivacious protagonist who's ready to take on anything - with your guidance, of course. As you journey through this entirely preposterous story, the indomitable Erin will frequently ponder three different options. Each time, you as her conscience must help her make the 'right' decision. Every choice you make will have consequences for Erin as you guide her through a series of wacky incidents and interactions. Will you lead her down a path of prudishness or help her to embrace her mischievous side? The power is in your hands as you channel your inner conscience to guide Erin towards her ultimate goal of attending the biggest party of the year. But don't stress out! Easygoing Erin is a free-spirited body-positive young woman with high self-confidence and a knack for finding the fun in any situation. So what are you waiting for? Join Erin on her crazy adventure and make sure she has the time of her life! What's in the prologue? ~20 minutes of content in a casual and lighthearted story with loads of bare-bottomed Erin and it's totally free! If you decide to give the game a try, please let me know what you think in the discussion forums. Thanks !

rows.name: HEX PLAT
rows.short_description: The Game Is A Simple 2.5d Platform Action Game. The player can move and jump. That and solve puzzles using little gimmicks in the stages. The objective of each stage is simple: manipulate the spheres to reach the red glowing tiles, that's it.
rows.description_html: About This Game The Game Is A Simple 2.5d Platform Action Game. The player can move and jump. That and solve puzzles using little gimmicks in the stages. Some of the stages are a bit meaner than others, but you'll get through them. How to Play The only controls in the game are A, D and Space on the keyboard; the UI controls use the mouse, but the basic parts of the game can be played with one hand. The objective of each stage is simple: manipulate the spheres to reach the red glowing tiles, that's it.

rows.name: Space Expedition
rows.short_description: Space Expedition is a 2D sci-fi platformer where you play as an astronaut who is sent to a space station to collect samples of mysterious dark matter. Space Expedition combines puzzle platforming, pixel art, and atmospheric adventures set in the style of 1980s sci-fi horror films.
rows.description_html: Sequel to the game AVAILABLE NOW About the Game ' Space Expedition is an old-school platformer game that mixes different styles of play. It tells the story of a brave astronaut who wants to find out what happened on a faraway space station. Space Adventure Explore new places, solve puzzles, avoid traps, fight monsters, use machines, and fly spaceships—all in a pixel-art world! You’ll need to be smart to finish tasks, quick to escape danger, sharp to get past obstacles, and brave to fight enemies. This game is for real heroes! Get ready, put on your space suit, and charge your jetpack—the quest begins! Main Features Atmospheric Exploration: Enjoy a world with unique areas, beautiful landscapes, and strange creatures that spark your curiosity. Engaging Puzzles: Use your brain and problem-solving skills as you interact with the world, move objects, and work with the planet’s native creatures to move forward. Intuitive PC Controls: Play smoothly with easy-to-use controls made for PC, making your time in the alien world as fun as possible. Captivating Soundscapes: Lose yourself in the rich sound experience of Space Expedition, featuring an original soundtrack and sound design that matches the game’s look and feel. Mysterious Story: Learn the story of the alien planet as you explore its unknown areas. Find hidden artifacts, old ruins, and secret messages that show the world’s secrets and your purpose there. A Decade of Fun Originally released 10 years ago, Space Expedition has won the hearts of many players worldwide. Now, this classic game is free on Steam, allowing new players to enjoy it. Prepare for an unforgettable trip that goes beyond space and time. Learn the mysteries of the cosmos and explore an alien world full of wonder and excitement. Will you take the challenge and find the secrets of this mysterious place? Experience the Adventure Space Expedition is a game that keeps you on your toes. From dodging traps to fighting monsters, there is never a dull moment. Each level is carefully designed to test your skills and keep you engaged. Whether you are solving puzzles or piloting spaceships, you will always find something new and exciting to do. A World of Wonder The game world is full of unique biomes and mesmerizing landscapes that will captivate you. The pixel-art graphics and original soundtrack create an immersive experience that draws you in. As you progress through the game, you will uncover hidden artifacts, ancient ruins, and cryptic messages that reveal the planet's secrets and your purpose within it. Join the Adventure Space Expedition has been a favorite for many players over the past decade. Now, with its release on Steam for free, a new generation of players can experience its charm. Get ready to explore an alien world filled with wonder and intrigue. Will you rise to the challenge and uncover the secrets of this mysterious place?'

rows.name: Landfall Archives
rows.short_description: Break into the Landfall Archives to steal and play previously unreleased games, demos, interactive slide shows, and even an unreleased version of Totally Accurate Battle Simulator from 2017!
rows.description_html: Break into the Landfall Archives and steal previously unreleased games, demos, interactive slide shows, and even an old version of TABS! Landfall Archives is a collection of every project Landfall and friends have worked on since 2016 that didn't make it to the shelves but which all deserve to see the light of day. This collection of 23 projects includes: Anything for my pals (2021) Control a herd of Pals to help you navigate through a short level with obstacles. Robots Forever (2018) Find weapons to fight modular robots! Every robot part has its own health and can be destroyed separately so you better watch out… Robots Forever 2 (2019) This game builds on the concept of modular robots from the first Robots Forever. Included are more robots with varying sizes and parts, as well as randomly spawning weapons with upgrades. Post Game (2019) Small building game where you build conveyor belts and other parts to move packages around a facility. The more packages you get into the containers, the more credits you collect! Physics Survival (2019) A physics animated top-down game where you explore and interact with the environment and animals to gather resources that you can use to get more equipment and units. TABS 2017 (2017) TABS 2017 is an early version of Totally Accurate Battle Simulator using the 2.0 physics system that was scrapped in 2017 in favor of the current 3.0 version. In the game you use a variety of different units to beat a level or you can play around in the sandbox mode. Airships 1 (2018) An exploration of airship building, using a system with different modular parts you can use to build your ship. Fly the ship around the landscape to explore! We imagined this to be a way to travel around in some of the other prototypes. Airships 2 (2018) Another version of airship building with different modular parts and improved stabilization for the airships, aiding in flying and construction. Wrecktangels (2019) Local PVP Simple side-view battle game where you jump and shoot each other while using a time-slow mechanic. The world is built out of objects that collapse and break apart as they are hit, to keep you on your toes! RTS card game (2021) Play cards to spawn units, and cast spells during real-time strategy gameplay. Build your own deck and combine cards to change which units and abilities are part of your deck. We made this to explore real-time card mechanics with some light RTS gameplay. Physics Fighter (2021) Brawl with enemies in small rooms, using your fist, legs, and a knife. The enemies have different attacks and patterns that they follow during fights to keep you on your toes. Medieval America (2020) Online PVP Physics shooter where you battle your enemy on a destructible level that collapses as the battle goes on, be careful not to fall! Plant Plane (2019) Go on a peaceful journey along the level in a plane, creating bushes and leaving nature around you as you fly past. Ocean Plane (2023) Fly around and fire small missiles at airships and towers, in and around an ocean. Playful (2021) Online PVP A 1v1 game where you can battle and play in different scenarios with your own rules and goals. It was made to be a sandbox to create your own small games in. Blob Game (2018) A small experience of being locked in a room with an unknown creature while a voice speaks to you. There are a few different endings to this game, can you find them all? Walking House Game (2021) Prototype for a building game where you control and build a walking castle. Travel to explore and gather resources around you to build and upgrade your base. Beware of the enemies lurking nearby! Missile Game (2021) Control missiles and fly them through different levels with varying obstacles to bring down physics towers, with the goal of destroying the small objects you find in the structures. Creepy Robots (2017) Run and climb around a small town scene while being chased by humanoid robots! ROUNDS 3D (2022) Online PVP Prototype for a 3-dimensional version of the game ROUNDS. It’s mainly explored with the shooting mechanics and a handful of upgrades. Counts and Stakes (2020) Online PVP A vampires vs vampire hunters-themed top-down-shooter focusing on precise aiming. Play against other players in small arenas with physics obstacles that you can interact with. Physics Presentation (2018) Not exactly a game, but more of an interactive slideshow made to be used as a presentation explaining the principles of the physics used in Landfalls games. Auction Brawl (2017) 2-4 Local Splitscreen Split screen fighting game where you bid on items that you then use to brawl against the other bidders. You can also grab and use most other items in the auction room to fight your fellow players!

rows.name: Jump Puzzle
rows.short_description: A platform jumping puzzle game, Reasonable use of various abilities of different animals, Keep the unicorn from falling into the abyss, Find your way home.
rows.description_html: A platform jumping puzzle game, Reasonable use of various abilities of different animals, Keep the unicorn from falling into the abyss, Find your way home. Simple game operation, just choose the direction and jump Rich game experience, plots with different functions constitute unique levels Sometimes some plots are needed, move or rotate it. Sometimes some plots are not needed, break or move it Sometimes different heights are required, ascend or descend it It even sometimes requires bumping to solve puzzles And all it takes is choosing a direction, jumping. In short, simple operation and extreme thinking are the core of the game

rows.name: Shapes & Shots - Prologue
rows.short_description: Shapes & Shots is a Roguelite Shooter Bullet-hell, where you can control time as you make your way through a twisted and delusional universe. Your enemies will merge, creating infinite combinations to try to overwhelm you: only your skills, combined with upgrades you choose, can lead you to victory.
rows.description_html: Shapes & Shots is a Roguelite Shooter Bullet-hell , where you can control time as you make your way through a twisted and delusional universe. Your enemies will merge, creating infinite combinations to try to overwhelm you: only your skills, combined with the variety of upgrades you choose, can lead you to victory. When it gets tough out there and you realize there is no cover, or when you are about to be overwhelmed by a barrage of bullets... Stop everything, take a deep breath, and reposition yourself behind the enemies. Unload all your might against them and turn the tide. In this universe, enemies can merge, combine the power of their weapons, and gain unique characteristics. Take care of them before they realize that unity is strength. Challenges will increase: you must level up to increase your base characteristics. Choose whether to enhance the ability to control time or to increase mobility and damage. But that is not all. In your climb to victory, you will find many chests that will grant you access to unique game-changing powers!

rows.name: 零号协议AgreementZero
rows.short_description: 3D simulation adult game
rows.description_html: This is a full 3D simulation development type game. The character played by the player enters a virtual world, but a fault occurs during the entry process, causing the player to lose some memory. The only thing to remember is that the task is to find and establish a close connection with an important girl here. In this process, gradually retrieve memories and use various means to achieve goals. Provide companionship, assistance, or services (massage, etc.) to girls in daily life to enhance their liking for you, break through layers of spiritual and physical barriers, and ultimately form a strong connection with the girl to complete the final task. Free map, you can enter any room to find girls to interact with. In the game, you can also edit and change the appearance of girls' clothing, and after unlocking the action, you can 'recall' it at any time to view it.

Complete quests, master your skills, trade loot with others or befriend them in a party to conquer the mightiest of monsters! FEATURES A massively multiplayer online persistent world Challenging PvPvE dungeons Party system to adventure with your friends Player-driven economy Unique monsters with different AI Self-contained quests No classes, instead you are what you wield Never Pay-to-Win

rows.name: Grimm of the Dome
rows.short_description: In this last city of mankind, an isolated paradise in the ocean, your choices and dices will lead it to Utopia or Distopia. You will help the magistrate AI to investigate the AI-worship religious group, illicit drugs, those who were resurrected, and those who are neither android nor mankind…
rows.description_html: In this non-linear adventure game made by only one jobless poet, your choices and dices will lead people in this Utopia or Distopia to different endings. Wander in the last city of human civilization as Agent Grimm Roll the dice to stop at a random point of the daily patrol as an Archival Division agent. Drop pins on the map to stop at a designated point and advance the investigation. Meet with various people and witness/influence their unique lives. Help the 'super magistrate AI' to investigate the mystery cases Investigate the sudden suicide of the most influential religion leader of the city, with neither omen or last words, but wired manner of death destroying the implant chips, and an unknown intruder at the scene. Investigate the returnal of dead people, and their possible connections to the illicit psychotropic substances and uncontrolled AI. Investigate the religious group which has over 1/4 of human population as their adherents and their dangerous scientific research projects. Meet with the Ai-worship religion, the gangs, those who are challenging the distinction between humans and androids, and other residents of the Dome City. Wander in the city constructed by an over 200,000-word parable of science and politics. Play through tens of side stories, and encounter people of unique characteristics and history. Unlock all 4 different endings, leading the city to its utopia or distopia future. **The English translation is currently based on machine translation. A manually-verified translation will soon be updated in the patch v1.01. **

rows.name: Darksy's Adventure
rows.short_description: Darksy's Adventure is a 3D platformer with furry characters and abstract 3D worlds. Tail whip and pounce your way to victory!
rows.description_html: Darksy's Adventure is a 3D platformer with furry characters and abstract 3D worlds. It was to be another regular day for Darksy but on his way to work he got captured. Luckily, using his cunning observation and thinking he managed to escape. Having been left far from home, Darksy must now make his way home. Join Darksy on his long journey through deadly yet colourful areas filled with deadly foes who want to stop him. Features: 19 standard level in total, each with their own soundtrack 6 unique boss fights 6 massive worlds: The Forest, Pirates Ocean, Wild Furry West, Catastrophic City, Construction Site, Underwater Factory Character customization 4 special abilities: Speed Boost, Magnet, Super Darksy and Invisibility 13 secret retro levels that can be accessed by finding secret game cartridges In game Cutscenes Fun base abilities including: Pounce, Tail whip and shooting atoms 3 difficulty settings
