rows.name: Fallen Force
rows.short_description: Rogue-lite arena shooter, where you kill monsters by knocking them out of arena. Shoot them, punch them, freeze them, burn them and much more in this unique take on a genre.
rows.description_html: Wishlist the game if you find it interesting!❤️ Gameplay In Fallen Force enemy is dead only if you punch him off the edge of arena. You have to use clever positioning, mix of fast light attacks with strong charged attacks and special abilities that grant you temporary edge over your enemies while avoiding getting punched yourself. Survive 20 rounds of endless enemy waves, upgrade yourself and become an unstoppable force. Customization You have the option to create your own player. Choose one of many characters, weapons and abilities with thousands of options from the start and buy as many upgrades to create the most powerful build possible. Punch them, shoot them, burn them, freeze them and push your enemies out of arena whatever way you want, for that is the only way to win...

rows.name: The Twin Paradox
rows.short_description: The Twin paradox is an RPG where you must prepare yourself for the first time travel. Make decisions, explore, and learn real science with the scientists of the 'Beyond' laboratory. It's up to you to make the journey a success.
rows.description_html: The Twin Paradox is an RPG in which you must prepare yourself for the first time travel. Explore the 'Beyond' laboratory and interact with its scientists. Learn physics concepts that will help you understand how time travel could work in real life, as well as a bunch of interesting things from other sciences. Math-Free If math isn't your thing, don't worry! This isn't the classic game where you have to do mathematical operations to defeat enemies. Characteristics Scientists from various fields who will teach you many things. You will learn Einstein's famous special relativity. Very interactive map for exploration enthusiasts. Immerse yourself in your character because your actions will have consequences. Can you find all the references and easter eggs?

Immerse yourself in your character because your actions will have consequences. Can you find all the references and easter eggs?

rows.name: Aker Fern 2 : Demo
rows.short_description: As Mikołaj Fern I have been travelling and experiencing many adventures along the way. I was considered an antagonist by most of people from that era. Over five hundred years have passed until I came back to live as Dan Tern. As him I will lead a certain story that never reached its definitive end.
rows.description_html: Get to know the first episode of the story created by Chaos Group Games. Full version available on Steam on the Aker Fern 2 website _______________________STORY_______________________ Aker Fern 2 : Demo - presents us the story taking place after what happened in the original Aker Fern from 2020. Dan Tern and Tatiana Mika find certain place hiding a certain mystery about Mikołaj Fern , the last incarnation of our protagonist. As a result of their pursuit after it something that will be the turning point for the story in next chapters of the game. _______________________CHARACTERS_______________________ Dan Tern The protagonist. He is a young man who tries to enjoy his normal life. What distinguish him from others is the fact he remembers his memories and experiences of his previous life . „After my death people conspiring against my family decided to use the opportunity and did so in the most dirty way they could, by putting the curse on my soul.” Tatiana Mika Extremely curious and stubborn. Tatiana Mika helps Dan from time to time in matters of his interest, she is doing it ever since he saved her from the Last Devil . She has an unusual glove on her right hand which is a control device for a device called Nano cube allowing her to obtain even the most secured information . „I feel a bit sorry for the taxi driver though. I thought he was about to get a heart attack the moment he saw Dan carrying Ajris' body. The only thing that was missing was a question if he had a shovel to borrow. „ Lena She is a part of organization having as objective researching and solving the dangerous situations caused by paranormal phenomena. Due to her responsibilities she is using help from Dan because of knowledge he obtained as Mikołaj Fern . Lena is also caretaker of Karen . „ You are impossible, Dan Tern. To come to us with this sleeping girl and expect us to wake her up despite the obvious danger it brings.”. Ajrs Ajris was traveling with Mikołaj Fern. When he died and his soul has been cursed by opponents of his family, it was Ajris who became the person who allowed him to rest in peace. Sadly she paid with life for it . As a ghost she has been waiting for his return to this world. When it happened and he recovered his past memories she was finally noticed by him. Since then she is accompanying him in his new life. „ You don’t have to be afraid of me. After what I saw I’m convinced that you are way more terrifying than me.” ______________________EKIPA________________________ _______________________OPENING______________________ ___INFORMATION ABOUT OUR PROJECT CAN BE FOUND ON OUR SOCIAL MEDIA___

rows.name: Dippy & Chippy
rows.short_description: Join forces with your best friend and embark on a thrilling adventure as the two-headed ogre duo, Dippy & Chippy, in the ultimate two-player couch coop game of exploring dungeons and discovering treasures!
rows.description_html: Dippy & Chippy is a thrilling two-player co-opetition promoting the game that takes you on an epic adventure through a world filled with danger and excitement. In this action-packed game, you'll take control of a two-headed ogre and work together with your partner to fight your way through hordes of skeletons and other monsters. Using a single controller, you and your partner must coordinate your movements and attacks to overcome the challenges that lie ahead. With intuitive controls and challenging gameplay, Dippy & Chippy is perfect for gamers of all skill levels. As you progress through the game, you'll encounter a variety of environments and enemies, each with its own unique challenges and dangers. You'll need to stay alert and use all your skills to survive. Featuring stunning graphics and an immersive soundtrack, Dippy & Chippy is a game that will keep you on the edge of your seat from start to finish. So grab a friend and get ready for an unforgettable adventure in this exciting and engaging game. Key Features Test your bond! - 2 players on a single controller responsible for 1 ogre. Co-ordinate, and communicate to move and kill enemies. Immersive feedback - Each element has curated VFX and SFX feedback to keep 2 players engaged and comfortable Variety of challenges - Each level brings new enemies/traps and compelling coordination from the players! Players from all skill levels! - Dippy & Chippy can be played with players with vastly different skill gaps without being unfair.

rows.name: Continent of the Ninth Golden
rows.short_description: Continent of the Ninth Golden is an action MMORPG. Players take part in the game as heroes of Blenheim to stand against Nefer, an evil villain trying to open a gate to the Netherworld and swarm the land with his infernal legion.
rows.description_html: Continent of the Ninth Golden is an action MORPG. Players take part in the game as heroes of Blenheim to stand against Nefer, an evil villain trying to open a gate to the Netherworld and swarm the land with his infernal legion. C9 showcases quality visuals, strategic combat, and a gripping story. Choose a character that best represents how you want to experience the game. The five base classes -- Fighter, Hunter, Shaman, Witchblade, and Mystic -- can each upgrade into multiple advanced classes, all of which are unique in their skills, visuals, and play styles. The console-like controls, various skill combos, and RPG-based elements make C9 a satisfying choice for all fans of action games. Key Features: Unrivaled Action RPG Continent of the Ninth Golden is a wholly unique action MMORPG experience. With its non-targeting combat, you no longer have to suffer with “locking on” to a single enemy! C9 gives you the freedom to lay waste to any enemy foolish enough to get in range of your sweeping weapons. This unique system has earned C9 five awards, including Grand Game Award Korea in 2009. Various Skill Combos Enjoy the complete freedom of combining skills and commands with cancellations and evasions to create an almost unlimited number of combos. Chain your attacks together and see just how much damage you can do in a single frenzy of attacks! Hack through every enemy that gets in your way! Precise Controls C9 features precise, customizable controls using either a mouse and keyboard or a gamepad. Unlike other RPGs, the way you control your character determines whether or not you survive! No more pushing the same four buttons over and over in a tedious rotation. Your hands will never be at rest during combat. With enough skill and practice, you can learn how to juggle and control your enemies with such precision they never have the chance to fight back! PvP Player versus player is a core element of C9. Players can use the combos they have perfected in various PvP modes. Use your skills with just the right timing, and chain your combos together perfectly to secure your victory! Ultimate Fury Skills Ultimate Fury Skills are the most powerful skills a player can learn. These skills boast supreme damage with very impressive visual effects. Each advanced class has its own, unique ultimate fury skill. Diverse Content C9 allows you to enhance items, build guild housing, craft items, and remodel equipment; very popular features for players of online RPGs. The game also features a unique Legend system to display your in-game achievements to other players and express the personality of your character.

rows.name: The Lancaster Leak - O'Brien State Park
rows.short_description: YOU CONTROL THE FOUND FOOTAGE. An FBI intern leaked special investigation tapes before suddenly disappearing. The first tape of the series contains found footage from O'Brien State Park revealing the true events that were covered up in the 1980s.
rows.description_html: Episode 1 - O'Brien State Park Missing persons happen at state parks all the time, with most never receiving closure. However, after an FBI investigation tape was leaked, new light is shined on a missing person case all the way back from 1985. You Control the Found Footage Experience the investigation tape firsthand as the FBI annotates events. Immersive Graphics and Sounds Jam-packed visuals, effects, and sound design that create a stunning VHS style. Only the Beginning This is only the first of many tapes leaked by FBI intern Valerie Bardot. There seems to be a bigger picture, slowly being revealed by whoever tampered with the tapes post-leak. EPISODE 2 COMING SOON! Key Features 15-20 Minute walking simulator Jumpscares Story Heavy

rows.name: Untitled Ghost Game
rows.short_description: Free multiplayer 2D ghost hunting game that you can play with friends created by a small game dev team.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Untitled Ghost Game, a spine-tingling 2D ghost hunting adventure brought to you by a small but dedicated team of developers. Interactive items and several unique maps Step into the shoes of a paranormal investigator armed with an arsenal of ghost hunting equipment, including an EMF reader, a Luigi board, a thermometer, a clock, a spirit box, a sketchbook, and a geiger counter. Explore a variety of creepy locations, including Mario's Cottage, Leonardo's Villa, Haunted Boardwalk, and the Spooky Mall. Gameplay mechanics and loop Your objective is to use your equipment to locate the ghost and ghost room to see how it interacts with the environment, items, and hiding places. Once you have gathered enough information, it's up to you to make an educated guess about the type of ghost you're dealing with. Once you've made your guess, the exorcist can come in and take care of the ghost. Ghost interactions and music But beware - ghosts can be unpredictable and dangerous, so be sure to keep your wits about you. With atmospheric visuals, spooky sound effects, and a haunting (badass) soundtrack from the musical artist Sodaguyz, Untitled Ghost Game will keep you on the edge of your seat. So join us on this bone-chilling journey into the unknown, brought to you by a small passionate team of indie developers who are dedicated to bringing you the best in 2D ghost hunting gameplay.

rows.name: Roguebot
rows.short_description: Fast-paced Roguelike shooter in a dystopian steampunk future.
rows.description_html: Roguebot is a fast-paced third person action-roguelite in which the player must fight their way to the top of a futuristic facility. Armed with a plethora of firearms and melee abilities you get to control a small robot on its journey through three distinct biomes. The deeply interwoven story unfolds as you find mysterious satellites that lie scattered in this ominous environment. No run is the same as the floors are procedurally created. COMBAT SYSTEM Fast paced action, by combining different types of ranged and melee attacks. Responsive movement to dodge enemy attacks. By collecting config shards after defeating bosses, you can unlock different abilites that influence many gameplay mechanics. MODULAR EQUIPMENT Strategically decide what modifications to buy with machine parts dropped from enemies. Freely combine over a dozen of equipment modifications with different rarities, allowing for high build variety. Discover many synergies between different equipment mods and abilites. PROCEDURAL LEVELS No run will be the same, each floor has a generated layout, with thoroughly thought out rules and conditions taken into account. 3 distinct sections that differ in enemy types, level geometry, environmental hazards and visual theme. Each section is guarded by a unique boss fight. THEME AND LORE What starts out as an unassuming sci-fi game quickly turns into a discussion about morality and the human condition. Read through three meticulously crafted stories of humans in the past. Unveil their fate as you go. The cyclical nature of the Roguelite genre becomes a story-telling tool. Learn more about the world and lore by talking to NPCs.

rows.short_description: Overwatch 2 is a critically acclaimed, team-based shooter game set in an optimistic future with an evolving roster of heroes. Team up with friends and jump in today.
rows.reviews_html: “Overwatch 2 Stadium is a mode so unique to what the hero shooter has to offer that it almost feels like an entirely new spinoff.” Destructoid “...an action-packed and enjoyable progression of the beloved hero-shooter franchise. Overwatch 2 is a big step towards restoring the faith in the franchise and has me thinking it’s time to pour a few more hundred hours into my favorite team-based shooter” 9/10 – Game Informer “...an evolution of the intense, nuanced, and brilliantly colourful team-based battle that made its predecessor so enjoyable.” 8/10 – IGN

rows.name: Agents of SomeCompany
rows.short_description: Unleash your speedrunning skills and complete your missions as fast as you can in this first-person parkour platformer. Speed through the low-poly world and compete with other players to prove you're SomeCompany's best agent.
rows.description_html: See the world through the eyes of SomeCompany 's agents. Gain and use parkour abilities to become the fastest in the world. Follow company's plan and don't forget to take your pills... Double jump, wallrunning, stomp and dash - utilize them all to complete the levels quickly. Fight with your foes using bow and sword, gain time by defeating them and don't let them kill you. Run as fast as you can through six chapters of levels with different low-poly environments and distinctive music. Reach bronze, silver, gold and ultimately diamond medal. Prove you're a valuable asset for the company. Compete with other players and become the most renowned agent in the world.
